entries.english: The shoots grow upwards towards the sun, and the leaves begin to photosynthesize, producing food for the plant.
entries.translation: Oboke to twi ka ochomo malo e chieng', kendo oboke madongo chako loso chiemo katiyo gi chieng', kendo mae miyo yien no chiemo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the plant grows, it develops a stem, leaves, flowers, and fruit.
entries.translation: Kaka yath medo dongo, obedo gi kore, oboke madongo, maua, kod olemo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flowers produce seeds, which are dispersed by wind, water, or animals.
entries.translation: Maua loso ga kodhi, ma ikeyo gi yamo, pi, kata lee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When a seed lands in a suitable location, it can germinate and begin the process of growth all over again.
entries.translation: Kodhi ka olwar e kama owinjore, onyalo twi kendo ochak okang' mar dongo ba obed yath moro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of seed germination is a marvel of nature.
entries.translation: Okang' mar twi mar kodhi en gino maber matimre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a testament to the power of life and the resilience of the natural world.
entries.translation: En ranyisi mar teko mar ngima kod tegno kod niano mar piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When a seed sprouts, it is a sign of hope and new beginnings.
entries.translation: Ka kodhi twi, en ranyisi mar geno kod chakruok manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have been warned.
entries.translation: Osemiyi siem.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have been given a clear and concise warning.
entries.translation: Osemiyi siem makende kendo modimbre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have been told that if you continue to engage in this behavior, you will be banned.
entries.translation: Osenyisi ni ka idhi nyime gi timo timbe gi, ibirogoyi marfuk.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have now had two chances to correct your behavior, and you have failed to do so.
entries.translation: Koro isebedo gi thuolo ariyo mag loko timbe ni, to loko timbeni osetami.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result, you will now be banned from this forum.
entries.translation: Nikech mano, koro ibiro goyi marfuk mar bedo e kanyakla ni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This ban is permanent, and you will not be allowed to create a new account or participate in this forum in any way.
entries.translation: Marfuk ni en ma nyaka chieng', to okbi yieni mar yao akaont moro manyien kata chiwri e kanyakla ni e yo moro amora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We hope that this ban will serve as a warning to others who may be tempted to engage in similar behavior.
entries.translation: Wageno ni marfuk ni biro bedo kaka siem ne jok moko manyalo bedo ni dwaro temo timo tim machal gi mano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We will not tolerate this type of behavior on our forum, and we will take action to protect our community from it.
entries.translation: Ok wabiweyo tim ni odhi nyime e kanyakla marwa ni, kendo wabiro kao okang' mar rito kendo geng'o oganda wa e tim no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions about this ban, please do not hesitate to contact us.
entries.translation: Ka in gi penjo moro amora ewi marfuk ni, yie mondo itudri kodwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thank you for your cooperation.
entries.translation: Ero kamano kuom timo gima dwarore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What the hell are you doing, you idiot?!"
entries.translation: "Mano ang'o ma itimo no, in ng'ama ofuwo?!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Excuse me?"
entries.translation: "Iwachoni?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "You cut me off! You almost made me crash!"
entries.translation: "Ing'ada e wach! Ne ichiegni miyo ayud masira!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm sorry, I didn't mean to. I was just trying to get around that slow-moving truck."
entries.translation: "Agoyo mos, ne okachano mar hinyi. Ne atemo mana kadho lori mane ringo mos cha."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Well, you could have at least used your turn signal!"
entries.translation: "Kare, makmana ni ne ditemo kata tiyo gi ranyisi mar okang' mar mar kadho!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I did use my turn signal!"
entries.translation: "Ne atiyo gi ranyisi mara mar kadho!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "No, you didn't! You just pulled right out in front of me!"
entries.translation: "Ooyo, ne okitiyo kode! Ne iwuok awuoka idonjo e nyima dichiel!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm telling you, I used my turn signal!"
entries.translation: "Anyisi, ne atiyo gi ranyisi mara mar kadho!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Whatever. You're still a terrible driver."
entries.translation: "Kata kamano. Podi in dereba marach ahinya."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "And you're a jerk!"
entries.translation: "Kendo in ng'ama achach!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "At least I know how to drive!"
entries.translation: "An berber ang'eyo riembo mtoka!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Oh, yeah? Well, I'm a better writer than you are!"
entries.translation: "Ah, adier? Ber, an jandiko maber moloyi!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's debatable."
entries.translation: "Mano wanyalo twakye."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's not debatable! I'm Ernest Hemingway!"
entries.translation: "Kanyo ongee twak! An Ernest Hemingway!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Who?"
entries.translation: "Ng'a?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Ernest Hemingway! The greatest writer of all time!"
entries.translation: "Ernest Hemingway! Jandiko maduong' ahinya e kinde duto!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Never heard of him."
entries.translation: "Pok awinje."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Well, you've heard of me now!"
entries.translation: "Kare, ero koro iwinja!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yeah, I heard of you."
entries.translation: "Eeh, ero awinji."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grace: Can you tell me a little bit about its history?
entries.translation: Grace: Bende inyalo nyisaye wach matin ewi sigande?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: Of course. Tea originated in China, where it has been cultivated for over 5,000 years.
entries.translation: Japuonj: Kamano. Chae ne ochakre e piny China, kama osepureye kuom kinde ma ohingo higni 5,000.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first written record of tea dates back to the 3rd century BC, when it was mentioned in a Chinese medical text.
entries.translation: Rekod mokwongo ma ondiki mar chae yudre e senchari mar 3 BC, kane owache e andike mag thieth mag China.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tea was originally used as a medicinal herb, but it quickly became a popular drink among Chinese people of all social classes.
entries.translation: Chae ne otigo mokuongo kaka yadh nyaluo, makmana ni piyo piyo nono ne obedo gima ji mang'eny madho e piny China.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grace: What about outside of China? When did tea start to spread to other parts of the world?
entries.translation: Grace: To oko mar China to? Karang'o ma chae ne ochako landre e pinje mamoko mayudre e piny ngima?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: Tea was first introduced to Europe in the 16th century by Portuguese traders.
entries.translation: Japuonj: Jo ohala mag piny Portugal ne otero chae mokuongo e loka Ulaya e senchari mar 16.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It quickly became popular among European elites, and by the 18th century, tea had become a staple of British culture.
entries.translation: Ne olandre mapiyo e kind jogo manigi nyalo Ulaya, kendo kochopo senchari mar 18, chai ne obedo achiel kuom kido kod timbe mag jo Ingresa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 19th century, tea was also introduced to North America, where it became a popular drink among both colonists and Native Americans.
entries.translation: E senchari mar 19, chae ne ochopo Amerka ma Nyandwat, kama ne obedo gino ma imadho ahinya e kind joloch kod Jo Amerka sie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grace: That's really interesting.I never knew that tea had such a long history.
entries.translation: Grace: Mano ber ahinya. Ne okang'eyo ni chae nigi sigana mabor kamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: It's a fascinating story, and it's one that's still being written today.
entries.translation: Japuonj: En mbaka mamit, kendo en mbaka mapodi idhi nyime gi ndiko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During World War II, the Allies and Axis powers used a variety of aircraft to achieve air superiority.
entries.translation: E kinde mar Lweny mar Ariyo e Piny Ngima, joloch mag Allies kod Axis ne otiyo kod ndeke mopogre opogre e yudo loch margi mar kor yamo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important factors in determining the outcome of a battle was the accuracy of the aircraft's bombing.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gigo maduong' ahinya ma ne itiyo go e ng'eyo duoko mar lweny ne en kaka ndeke go ne dimbo maber kama gidwaro muocho gi mbom.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The height at which an aircraft could fly was also a critical factor, as it determined how far it could travel and how much weight it could carry.
entries.translation: Bor ma ndege ne nyalo fuyo go bende ne en gino ma ing'iyo, nikech ne onyiso bor ma ndege no ne nyalo fuyo kod pek mane onyalo ting'o.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The United States developed a number of high-altitude bombers during the war, including the B-17 Flying Fortress and the B-29 Superfortress.
entries.translation: Piny Amerka ne oloso kwan mang'eny mar ndege mamuocho mbom kagifuyo malo ahinya e kinde lweny go, magi ne gin kaachiel gi B-17 Flying Fortress kod B-29 Superfortress.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These aircraft were able to fly at altitudes of over 30,000 feet, which made them difficult for enemy fighters to intercept.
entries.translation: Ndeke gi ne nyalo fulo e polo malo e bor mohingo fut 30,000 kowuok piny, mae ne omiyo wasigu yudo kinde matek e monjo ndeke go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also carried a large payload of bombs, which could be used to attack targets deep behind enemy lines.
entries.translation: Bende ne giting'o mbom madongo dongo, manene inyalo tiyo godo e monjo joma gichano monjo ka wasigu kia kata matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The German Luftwaffe also developed a number of high-altitude bombers, including the Heinkel He 177 Greif and the Messerschmitt Me 264 Amerika Bomber.
entries.translation: Luftwaffle mar piny Jirman bende ne oloso ndeke makiro mbom kagifuyo e polo malo, ndeke gi ne gin Heinkel He 177 Greif kod Messerschmitt Me 264 Amerika Bomber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These aircraft were not as successful as their American counterparts, however, due to a number of technical problems.
entries.translation: Ndeke gi ne okti maber ahinya ka ndeke mag piny Amerka, kata kamano, mae ne okel gi chandruoge mang'eny mag lony.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know what you did yesterday.
entries.translation: Ang'eyo gima ne itimo nyoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You posted a picture of yourself wearing that green rag on social media.
entries.translation: Ne iketo picha mari ka irwako law mamajan no e mbui mar tudruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you thought it was funny, but it wasn’t.
entries.translation: Ang'eyo ni ne iparo ni gino ne moro ji, to ne okomor ji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was disrespectful to your mother, and it hurt her feelings.
entries.translation: Ne onyiso achaye ne minuu, kendo ne ochwanyo chunye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I’m not asking you to apologize because I’m mad at you.
entries.translation: Ok anyisi mondo ikwa ng'uono nike asin kodi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I’m asking you to apologize because it’s the right thing to do.
entries.translation: Anyisi mondo ikwa ng'uono nikech mano e gima kare ka itimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your mother loves you, and she deserves your respect.
entries.translation: Minuu oheri, kendo ber ka imiye luor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please call her today and tell her you’re sorry.
entries.translation: Yie igochne kawuono mondo ikwaye ng'uono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tell her that you didn’t mean to hurt her feelings, and that you promise to never wear that green rag again.
entries.translation: Nyise ni ne ok ihero mar miye lit e chunye, kendo ni isingone ni okan ichak irwak law mamajan moyech oyech no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you’re a good person, and I know you love your mother.
entries.translation: Ang'eyo ni in ng'ama ber kendo ang'eyo ni ihero mamau.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So please, do the right thing and apologize.
entries.translation: Omiyo koro, yie itm gima owinjore kendo ikwa ng'uono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After you apologize to your mother, I want you to burn that green rag.
entries.translation: Bang' kwayo minuu ng'uono, adwaro mondo iwang' law mamajan no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s a symbol of your disrespect, and it needs to be gone.
entries.translation: En gino manyiso achaya, omiyo ber ka iweye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know it might be hard to let go of that rag, but it’s important.
entries.translation: Ang'eyo ni wito lawno nyalo bedoni matek, makmana ni en gima ochuno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s a symbol of your past, and it’s time to move on.
entries.translation: En ranyisi mar kinde ni machon, kendo sani en saa mar weri gi gik machon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You’re a new person now.
entries.translation: In ng'ama nyien koro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You’re a better person.
entries.translation: In ng'ama ber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And you don’t need that rag to define you anymore.
entries.translation: Kendo ok idwar law moyech no mondo okonyi lero ni in ng'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So please, burn it.
entries.translation: Omiyo koro, yie iwang'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Burn it and let it go.
entries.translation: Wang'e mondo wiyi owil kode.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And then go hug your mother and tell her you love her.
entries.translation: Omiyo koro dhi ikwak minuu kendo inyise ni ihere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loves you too.
entries.translation: Oheri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A car was driving too fast and lost control, swerving into the other lane and hitting a car head-on.
entries.translation: Mtoka moro ne iriembo matek ahinya ba obayo yoo, ochochni ka odonjo e ndara moro ba otuomre wich gi wich gi mtoka moro mane biro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The driver of the first car was killed instantly, and the driver of the second car was seriously injured.
entries.translation: Dreba mar mtoka mokuongo no ne otho kanyo gi kanyo, to dereba mar mtoka mar ariyo ne ohinyre matek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My friend Joseph called me to talk about it.
entries.translation: Osiepna ma Joseph ne oluonga mondo alos ewi wachno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's so sad," he said. "I can't imagine how the families of the victims are coping."
entries.translation: "En gima lit ahinya," ne owacho. "Akia kata kaka anyuola mag joma oyudo masira go timre."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Me neither," I responded. "It's a reminder that we need to be careful when we're driving.
entries.translation: "Anbe," ne aduoke. "En gino maparonwa ni ber ka wabedo akicha e sama wariembo mtoka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Even a small mistake can have devastating consequences."
entries.translation: Kata ketho matin kende nyalo kelo masira maduong'."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I agree," replied Jo. "We all need to follow the rules of the road and drive defensively."
entries.translation: "Ayie," Jo ne oduoko. "Waduto tee dwarre ka waluwo chike mag apaya kendo wariemb ka wan akicha."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Absolutely," I quickly added. "And we need to be aware of the dangers of distracted driving. Things like texting and talking on the phone can take our attention away from the road and lead to accidents."
entries.translation: "Mano adier," ne asiro piyo piyo. "Kendo dwarre ka wang'eyo masira ma ikelo gi chochni sama iriembo. Gik moko kaka oro ote machuok kata wuoyo e sim nyalo lalo pachwa bagol pachwa e ndara kendo kelo masira."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I know," said Jo sheepishly. "I'm guilty of it myself sometimes."
entries.translation: "Ang'eyo," Jo ne oduoka kamano. "An awuon an achich mar gino seche moko."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the small town of Malgudi, there was a corrupt police inspector named Ramasamy.
entries.translation: E boma matin mar Malgudi, ne nitie inspekta mar obila mane en ja mibadhi kendo ne iluonge ni Ramasamy.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He would often take bribes from the people he arrested, and he would also use his power to harass and intimidate people.
entries.translation: Kinde ka kinde ne onyalo choko asoya kowuok kuom ji mane omako, kendo ne onyalo tiyo gi telo mare e sando kendo buogo ji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Ramasamy arrested a young man named Krishnan for a crime he did not commit.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro achiel, Ramasamy ne omako dichuo ma rawera manyinge Krishnan nikech ketho mane ok otimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishnan was innocent, but Ramasamy refused to listen to him.
entries.translation: Krishnan ne ongee ketho, to Ramasamy ne otamre winje.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He demanded a bribe from Krishnan, and when Krishnan refused to pay, Ramasamy threw him in jail.
entries.translation: Ne okwayo Krishnan asoya, kendo ka Krishnan ne otamre miye asoya, Ramasamy ne owite e jela.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishnan's father, a poor farmer, was desperate to get his son out of jail.
entries.translation: Wuon Krishnan, japur ma jachan, ne temo gi yore te mondo ogol wuode e jela.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He went to see Ramasamy and begged him to release Krishnan, but Ramasamy refused.
entries.translation: Ne odhi ir Ramasamy kendo ne okwaye mondo owe Krishnan, to Ramasamy ne otamre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The farmer then went to the local temple and prayed to God for help.
entries.translation: Japurno ne odhi e hekalu mantie e aluorano kendo ne olemo mondo Nyasaye okonye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next day, the farmer was walking home from the temple when he saw a large snake crossing the road.
entries.translation: Kinyne, japurno ne wuotho ka odok e dala kowuok e hekalu e sama ne oneno thuol maduong' ka ng'ado ndara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The farmer was afraid of snakes, but he knew that he had to do something to help his son.
entries.translation: Japurno ne oluoroga thuonde, to gima ne ong'eyo ne en ni nyaka otim gimoro mondo okony wuode.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He picked up the snake and carried it to the police station.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Ramasamy saw the snake, he was terrified.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: Let me take a look. [Examines the patient's teeth.] Hmm, it looks like you have a cavity.

entries.english: I'm going to need to drill out the decay and fill the hole.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: (gives the patient a local anesthetic) Okay, this will numb the area so you won't feel anything.

entries.english: Patient: Thank you, doctor. That wasn't so bad.

entries.english: We're expecting a bumper crop of sugarcane, which is used to make rum.

entries.english: Rum is a distilled spirit made from sugarcane molasses or sugarcane juice.

entries.english: It's typically aged in wooden barrels, which gives it its characteristic flavor.

entries.english: Rum can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or mixed in cocktails.

entries.english: There are many different types of rum, each with its own unique flavor profile.

entries.english: Some of the most popular types of rum include light rum, dark rum, and spiced rum.

entries.english: Light rum is typically made from molasses and has a light, sweet flavor.

entries.english: Dark rum is made from sugarcane juice and has a richer, more complex flavor.

entries.english: Spiced rum is made with added spices, such as cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves.

entries.english: Rum is a versatile spirit that can be used in a variety of cocktails.

entries.english: Some classic rum cocktails include the daiquiri, the mojito, and the pina colada.

entries.english: Rum can also be used in more creative cocktails, such as the Hemingway Daiquiri or the Painkiller.

entries.english: We must reject the forces of division and hate.

entries.english: It growled at me and I could smell its breath, hot and reeking of death.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog came closer and closer, its teeth bared.
entries.translation: Guok no ne osudo machiegni koda, lekene ne nioko tee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I closed my eyes and waited for the end.
entries.translation: Ne amiyo wangena ka arito giko mare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I heard a voice.
entries.translation: To ne awinjo duol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a woman's voice, soft and gentle.
entries.translation: Ne en duond miyo, duol mayom.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Do not be afraid," she said. "I will help you."
entries.translation: "Kik iluor," ne owacho. "Abiro konyi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I opened my eyes and saw the woman standing in front of me.
entries.translation: Ne ayao wengena ba aneno miyo no ka ochung' e mbelena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was tall and slender, with long black hair and dark eyes.
entries.translation: Ne orabora to orandere, to yie wiye ne bor to rateng' to wangene bende ne rateng'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She wore a white dress that flowed around her like a mist.
entries.translation: Ne orwako marinda marachar mane oluore kaka tho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Who are you?" I asked. "I am the Angel of Death," she said.
entries.translation: "In ng'a?" ne apenjo. "Am Malaika mar Tho," ne oduoka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I have come to take you to the other side." I was not afraid anymore.
entries.translation: "Abiro kawi mondo adhi kodi loka moro cha." ne okaluor kata matin kendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I knew that the woman would take me to a place where there was no pain or suffering.
entries.translation: Ne ang'eyo ni miyo no biro tera kama ongee rem gi sandruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took her hand and she led me away.
entries.translation: Ne amako lwete kendo ne otelo mbelena ka otaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As we walked, the black dog followed us.
entries.translation: Kane awuotho, guok marateng' no ne oluwowa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm Dr. Boakye, a pediatrician at the Korle Bu Teaching Hospital.
entries.translation: An Dr. Boakye, laktar mar nyithindo e kar thieth mar Korle Bu Teaching Hospital.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm here today to talk to you about the new malaria vaccine that's been approved for use in Ghana.
entries.translation: An kae kawuono mondo alos kodi ewi chanjo manyien mar maleria ma opuodhi mondo otigo e piny Ghana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: I'm not interested in having my children vaccinated.
entries.translation: Baba: An ok adwar mondo nyithinda oyud chanjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I understand that you're concerned, but I'd like to take a few minutes to explain why I think it's a good idea to vaccinate your children against malaria.
entries.translation: Laktar: Ang'eyo ni idewo jogi, to ne daher mar kao dakika matin mondo alerni gima omiyo aparo ni en paro maber mar nyithindi yudo chanjo mar maleria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: I don't need to be convinced. Malaria is a serious disease, but it's not that common in our village.
entries.translation: Baba: Ok adwar mondo olerna. Maleria en tuo marach, makmana ni ok ong'eny ahinya e gweng'wa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: But my children are healthy. They've never had malaria
entries.translation: Baba: To nyithinda nigi afia maber. Tuo mar maleria pok omakogi nyaka nene
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's good, but it doesn't mean they're immune. Anyone can get malaria, even if they've never had it before.
entries.translation: Laktar: Mano ber, makmana ni mano oknyis ni tuo no dak makgi ngang'. Ng'ato ang'ata nyalo yudo tuo mar maleria, kata kapok ne tuono omakogi kata dichiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "So, I was just on the internet, minding my own business, when I saw this pop-up ad that said I had a virus on my computer.
entries.translation: "Koro, ne an aana e mbui, ka atimo gige na, e sama ne aneno ote moro kanyisa ni kompyuta mara nigi vairas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was like, "What? No way!"
entries.translation: Ne abuok ba awacho ni, "Ang'o? Mano dak nyalre!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I clicked on it, and it took me to this website that looked really official, and it said that I needed to download this software to fix the virus.
entries.translation: Bang' mano ne agwele, to ne otera e mbui ni mane neno ma opuodhi, kendo ne owacho ni ne adwarra ka agolo softwea ni e mbui mondo otiek vairas no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So I did, and I installed it, and then it started filling my computer with all this malware.
entries.translation: Omiyo ne atimo kamano, ba akete e kompyuta na, kendo ne ochako pong'o kompyuta na gi vairas ni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was so mad!
entries.translation: Ne asin ahinya!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I tried to uninstall it, but it wouldn't let me.
entries.translation: Ne atemo gole e kompyuta na, to ne otamre wuok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I finally had to take my computer to a repair shop, and they had to wipe the whole thing and reinstall Windows.
entries.translation: Ne ochuna giko ne to atero kompyuta na e duka mar loso kompyuta, kendo ne gigolo giko tee ba giketona Windows kendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a total nightmare.
entries.translation: Ne en midhiero maduong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, that's why I'm always so careful about clicking on pop-up ads.
entries.translation: Koro, mano e gima omiyo an ga akicha ahinya ewi gwelo lendo mabiro abira kendgi e wang' kompyuta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You never know what they're going to do.
entries.translation: Ok ing'eyo gima gidhi timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They could be filled with malware, or they could steal your personal information.
entries.translation: Nyalo bedo ni gipong' gi vairas, kata ginyalo kwalo weche magi in iwuon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's just not worth the risk.
entries.translation: Oken gima ber ka ng'ato timo dawe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you ever see a pop-up ad that looks suspicious, just close it and don't click on it.
entries.translation: Ka ineno ote mabiro abira kende to neno gima ichich go, lore alora, kik igwele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if you're ever not sure whether or not it's safe, just don't do it.
entries.translation: To ka iongee gi adier ka en kare kata oken kare, kik iyawe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here is a delicious pork dish from the county of Lancashire.
entries.translation: Ero ring anguro molos mamit ahinya kowuok e kaonti mar Lancashire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 1. Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
entries.translation: 1. Mur oven nyaka ochop e liet mar digrii 180.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. Trim the pork belly of any excess fat and score the skin in a criss-cross pattern.
entries.translation: 2. Ng'ad ring anguro no mondo igol mo mang'eny madibedye kasto ikade ka ogajre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. In a bowl, mix together the mustard, treacle, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and oil.
entries.translation: 3. E bakul, riw kanyakla karadali, mola marateng', vinegar, mor Worcestershire kod mo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rub this mixture all over the pork belly.
entries.translation: Rudh gik ma oriwgi e ring anguro cha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Place the pork belly in a roasting tin and roast in the oven for 2 hours, or until the skin is golden brown and the meat is cooked through.
entries.translation: 4. Ket ring angurono e okebe mar bulo ring'o kendo ibule e kendo mar oven kuom seche 2, kata nyaka piene olokre marabuor ka dhahabu to ring'o ochiek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. While the pork is roasting, finely chop the onion, garlic, bay leaves and thyme.
entries.translation: 5. E sama ring'o bulre no, ng'ad otungu gi gik tedo mamoko go matindo tindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is widely regarded as one of the most significant figures in world history.
entries.translation: Okawe kaka achiel kuom jogo madongo ahinya e sigana mar piny ngima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela was born in 1918 in Mvezo, South Africa.
entries.translation: Mandela ne onyuol e giga mar 1918 e gweng' mar Mvezo, e piny Afrika ma Milambo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He grew up in a rural village and was educated at a Methodist mission school.
entries.translation: Ne odongo e gweng' kendo ne osomo e skund mision mar Methodist.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After high school, he studied law at the University of Fort Hare.
entries.translation: Bang' tieko sekondari, ne osomo chike e Mbalarieny ma Fort Hare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1944, he joined the African National Congress (ANC), a political organization that was fighting against apartheid.
entries.translation: E higa mar 1944, ne odonjo e duond bura mar African National Congress (ANC), duond od bura mane gore ka gitemo tieko leny mar akwede mar pien dend ji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela was arrested for his political activities in 1962 and sentenced to life in prison.
entries.translation: Ne omaki Mandela nikech siasa mane otimo e higa mar 1962 kendo le olorne e jela e twech mar ngimane duto e jela.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He spent 27 years in prison, during which time he became a symbol of the anti-apartheid movement.
entries.translation: Ne otieko higni 27 e jela, e kinde mane obedo ranyisi mar kwedo akwede mar ji nikech range mar dendgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1990, Mandela was released from prison and elected president of South Africa in 1994.
entries.translation: E higa mar 1990, ne ogola Mandela e jela kendo ne oyiere ker mar Afrika ma Milambo e higa mar 1994.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As president, Mandela worked to unite South Africa and promote reconciliation between blacks and whites.
entries.translation: Kaka ker, Mandela ne otiyo matek mar riwo Afrika ma Milambo kod bero winjruok e kind jorateng' gi wasunge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also oversaw the end of apartheid and the transition to a democratic government.
entries.translation: Bende ne otieko akwede kod goch mar ji nikech range mar dendgi kendo ne okelo piny owacho mar demokrasia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela is a Nobel Peace Prize laureate and has been awarded numerous other honors.
entries.translation: Mandela en ng'ama oyudo mich mar Nobel Peace Prize kendo oseyudo mich mang'eny mopogre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After school, I usually go home and do my homework.
entries.translation: Bang' skul, ajadhiga dala kendo atimo tich ma omiya e skul.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then I might watch TV or play video games.
entries.translation: Bang' mano anyalo rango wang' jowi kata tugo tuke mag tipo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sometimes I go out with my friends.
entries.translation: Seche moko ariera ga gi osiepe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We might go to the movies, or to a park, or just hang out at someone's house.
entries.translation: Wanyalo dhi neno sinema, kata e kuonde yueyo, kata rieruok tu e od ng'ato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On weekends, I often sleep in late.
entries.translation: Odiecheinge mag giko juma, ang'iyo nindo nyaka seche moniang'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then I might go shopping, or see a movie, or go to a museum.
entries.translation: Bang'e to adhi nyiepo, kata rango sinema, kata dhi e kar kano gikmoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also like to spend time with my family.
entries.translation: Ahero bende budho gi anyuola na.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We might go out to dinner, or play games, or just watch TV together.
entries.translation: Wanyalo dhi chiemo oko e magawa, kata tugo tuke, kata neno wang' jowi kanyakla.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm really enjoying my life after school.
entries.translation: Ahero sana ngima e seche ma aongee e skul.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have a lot of freedom, and I can do whatever I want.
entries.translation: An gi thuolo mang'eny, kendo anyalo timo gima adwaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm also learning a lot about myself, and about the world around me.
entries.translation: Bende apuonjra mang'eny ewi an awuon, kendo ewi piny moluora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm excited to see what the future holds.
entries.translation: Amor ka aneno gima kiny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Using data to help people with mental health issues is a relatively new field, but it is showing great promise.
entries.translation: Tiyo gi weche e konyo ji mantie gi chandruok mag ngima mar paro mar dhano en gino manyien, to onyiso geno maduong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One example is the use of data to personalize therapy for patients.
entries.translation: Ranyisi achiel en tiyo kod weche go e loso ni jotuo thieth ma owinjre kode en owuon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By looking at a patient's individual data, therapists can better understand their needs and create a treatment plan that is tailored to them.
entries.translation: Kuom rango weche mag jatuo achiel en owuon, jolony mag thieth nyalo ng'eyo maber dwaro margi kendo loso nigi chenro mar thieth ma olos ne gin giwegi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to better outcomes for patients, as they are more likely to receive the help that they need.
entries.translation: Mae nyalo kelo duoko mabeyo ne jotuo, ka gin githuolo maber mar yudo kony magidwaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study also found that the patients who received personalized therapy were more likely to stay in treatment for longer periods of time.
entries.translation: Nonro no bende ne oyudo ni jotuo mane oyudo thieth ma olos ni gin giwegi ne nigi nyalo mar bedo e thieth kuom kinde malach mag thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This study is just one example of how data can be used to improve mental health care.
entries.translation: Nonro ni en aena ranyisi achiel mar kaka weche inyalo ti godo e bero thieth mar tuo mar wich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As more research is done in this area, we can expect to see even more advances in the use of data to help people with mental health issues.
entries.translation: Kaka itimo nonro mang'eny e wi weche gi, wageno neno okange mang'eny kaka itiyo gi weche e konyo ji manigi tuo mar wich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My sister is a therapist who uses data to help her patients.
entries.translation: Nyaminwa e jalony mar thieth matiyo ga gi weche e konyo jotuo meke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freshwater lakes are home to a wide variety of flora and fauna, from microscopic algae to large fish and mammals.
entries.translation: Nam mantie gi pi ma okotimo chumbi en kama lee gi yiende mang'eny odakye, kochakre e olowa matin mogik nyaka e rech kod lee madongo ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The unique environment of freshwater lakes provides a variety of habitats for these organisms, and the interactions between them are complex and fascinating.
entries.translation: Aluora makende mar nam mantie gi pi ma okotimo chumbi en kar dak mar kit chuech gi, kendo kaka gigo odak kanyo en gino matek ng'eyo kendo omoro dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most striking features of freshwater lakes is the presence of a distinct zonation of plant life, which is determined by the depth of the water and the amount of sunlight that reaches the bottom.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gigo makende e nam mag pi maongee chumbi en kaka yien mopogre opogre odak kuonde mopogre opogre, mae ing'eyo kokalo kuom tut mar pi kod kiwango mar chieng' machopo e buo nam.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In shallow areas, where there is plenty of light, a dense mat of rooted plants known as a "macrophyte bed" forms.
entries.translation: E kuonde mathany thany, kama nitie ler mang'eny, yien manigi tiende mang'eny ma iluongo ni "macrophyte bed" yudre gaye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This provides a habitat for a variety of invertebrates, fish, and amphibians.
entries.translation: Mae bende en kama le mopogre opogre kaka lee maongee luhumbru, rech, kod ogwande odakye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In deeper areas, where there is less light, the water column is dominated by phytoplankton, which are microscopic algae that float freely in the water.
entries.translation: E kuonde matut, kama ler nitiee matin, yien mang'eny kanyo en phytoplankton, magin oloha matindo mogik mabet ewi pi koringo moos.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These organisms are the primary producers in the lake ecosystem, and they are the basis of the food chain.
entries.translation: Kit chuech gi gin gigo magolo chiemo e aluora mar nam, kendo gin ema gikelo chiemo e nam.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fauna of freshwater lakes is also diverse, and includes a wide variety of fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals.
entries.translation: Lee mantie e nam mapige okotimo chumbi bende opogre opogre, kendo oting'o rech, ogwande, lee malak, winy, kod lee manyuolo nyithindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fish are the most abundant vertebrates in freshwater lakes, and they play a vital role in the food chain.
entries.translation: Rech e lee meng'eny mogik e nam ma pige ok otimo chumbi, kendo gin gi tich maduong' e loso chiemo e nam.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most common fish species in freshwater lakes include trout, bass, pike, and perch.
entries.translation: Moko kuom rech mantie e nam ma pige okotimo chumbi gin trout, bass, pike, kod perch.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, the storage area is also equipped with a fire alarm system, so that if there is a fire, the alarm will sound and the fire department will be notified.
entries.translation: Ewi mano, kar keno bende nigi lony mar king'ora mar mach, omiyo ka kanyo omako mach, king'ora no biro ywak to migao ma ochung' ne mach biro yudo wach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The storage area is also regularly inspected by the fire department, so that any potential fire hazards can be identified and addressed before they become a problem.
entries.translation: Kar keno bende itimo niga apedha kinde ka kinde gi migao mar mach, omiyo gimoro amora manyalo kelo mach ing'eyo chon kendo iloso kapok obedo masira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these measures, the storage area is a safe and secure place to store valuable goods.
entries.translation: Kaluwore kod okange gi, kar keno en kama ber to oriti mar kano gikmoko manigi nengo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the fire safety measures, the storage area is also equipped with a security system to protect against theft.
entries.translation: Kanyakla gi okange mag keto arita, kar kano bende nigi lony mar arita mondo ogeng' kuo kik timre kanyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The security system consists of a surveillance camera, a burglar alarm, and a security guard.
entries.translation: Lony mar arita no nigi kamera mar keto arita, king'ora mar kuo, kod jarit.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The surveillance camera monitors the area 24 hours a day, the burglar alarm is activated if anyone tries to break in, and the security guard is on duty to patrol the area and respond to any incidents.
entries.translation: Kamera mar arita no menyo ga kanyo seche 24 e odiechieng', king'ora mar kuo no ywak ga kapo ni ng'ato temo donjo gi thuon, to jarit mantie e tich cherre ga kanyo kendo konyo e gimoro amora motimre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these security measures, the storage area is a safe and secure place to store valuable goods.
entries.translation: Koluwore kod okenge mag arit gi, kar keno no e kama arita berye kendo inyalo kanoye giki mag nengo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook Users Drunkenly Post About Their Lives
entries.translation: Jogo Matiyo Gi Facebook Ohero Keto Weche Mag Ngima Gi E Mbui Ahinya
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook users are getting drunk and posting about their lives, and it's causing a stir.
entries.translation: Jogo matiyo kod Facebook mer gi mbui kendo giketo weche mag ngima gi e mbui ahinya, to mae kelo paro mopogre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The social media platform has been flooded with photos and videos of people who are clearly intoxicated, and many of them are sharing personal details about themselves that they wouldn't normally share.
entries.translation: Yoo mar tudruok e mbui no opong' aduwa gi piche kod tipo mag ji maneno maler ni omer, to thothgi nyiso nyaka wechegi ma iye ma okber ka ginyiso oganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some users are concerned that the trend is dangerous, as it could lead to people making poor decisions or doing things they regret.
entries.translation: Jok moko matiyo gi mbui no pachgi chandre ni mae en gima nyalo kelo hinyruok, nikech onyalo ji ong'ad paro e yo marach kata timo gik ma gibiro ywago ang'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others are simply amused by the antics of their fellow drunk Facebook users.
entries.translation: Jomoko to um auma nono gi gigo ma jowetegi momer gi mbui timo e Facebook.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One user posted a photo of herself passed out on the floor with the caption, "I'm so drunk I can't even stand up."
entries.translation: Ng'ato achiel ne oketo piche ka omer ma okiare kendo onindo e dier ot to ondiko e picha no ni, "Amer madak achung' kata malo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another user shared a video of herself dancing on a table while shouting, "I'm the life of the party!"
entries.translation: Ng'at moro to ne ooro tipo mare ka omiel ewi mesa kendo ogoyo koko, "An e ngima mar nyasi ni!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The trend has even caught the attention of celebrities.
entries.translation: Gima timre no omako nyaka dhog joma ideo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Comedian Amy Schumer posted a photo of herself on Twitter with the caption, "I'm so drunk I can't even spell my own name."
entries.translation: Jami ji nyiero Amy Schumer ne oketo piche e mbui mar Twitter kendo ondiko ni, "Amer ma dak andik kata mana nyinga awuon."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook has not commented on the trend, but it's clear that it's causing a stir.
entries.translation: Facebook pok ogolo pachgi ewi gima timre no, to neno e lela ni gino kelo paro mopogre opogre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Only time will tell whether the trend will continue or fade away.
entries.translation: Kinde ema biro nyiso ka gima timre no biro dhi nyime kata obiro lal nono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia is a landlocked country in Southern Africa.
entries.translation: Zambia en piny ma ongee nam ataro kendo oyudre e Milambo mar Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is bordered by Angola to the west, the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the north, Tanzania to the northeast, Malawi to the east, Mozambique to the southeast, Zimbabwe to the south, and Botswana to the southwest.
entries.translation: Ogoyo tong' gi piny Angola e yimbo, Piny Demokrasia mar Kongo e nyandwat, Tanzania e nyandwat ma ugwe, Malawi e ugwe, Mozambique e milambo ma ugwe, Zimbabwe e milambo, kod Botswana e milambo ma yimbo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia has a population of over 17 million people and a land area of 752,618 square kilometers.
entries.translation: Zambia nigi kwan mar ji mohingo ji tara 17 kendo duong' mar pinyno en skweya kilomita 752,618.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia's current president is Hakainde Hichilema, who was elected in August 2021.
entries.translation: Ker ma sani mar piny Zambia en Hakainde Hichilema, mane oyier Dwe mar Aboro higa mar 2021.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hichilema is a member of the United Party for National Development (UPND).
entries.translation: Hichilema en jakanyo mar duond bura mar United Party for National Development (UPND).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The UPND is the largest opposition party in Zambia.
entries.translation: UPND e duond bura maduong' mogik kuom duond buche makwedo piny owacho e piny Zambia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The economy of Zambia is based on copper mining.
entries.translation: Yuto mar piny Zambia luwore kod kunyo mula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Copper is the country's largest export.
entries.translation: Mula ema pinyno uso ahinya ne pinje mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other important exports include cobalt, zinc, and lead.
entries.translation: Gigo mamoko maduong' ma pinyno uso ni pinje mamoko en kobalt, zinc, kod lisase.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Zambian economy has been struggling in recent years due to low copper prices.
entries.translation: Yuto mar piny Zambia osebedo matek e higni mokalo nikech bech mula odok piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia is a member of the United Nations, the African Union, and the Southern African Development Community (SADC).
entries.translation: Zambia en jakanyo mar Riwruok mar Pinje, Riwruok mar Afrika, kod Dongruok mar Oganda mag Afrika ma Milambo (SADC).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The signing of Lionel Messi by Paris Saint-Germain sent shockwaves through the world of soccer.
entries.translation: Nyiepo ma tim mar Paris Saint-Germain ne onyieo go Lionel Messi ne obuogo johera mag adhula e piny ngima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Argentine superstar had been one of the most coveted players in the world for years, and his arrival in Paris marked a major turning point in the club's history.
entries.translation: Jatugo no mawuok e piny Argentina osebedo achiel kuom jotugo ma dhano gombo ahinya e piny ngima kuom higni mang'eny, to dhi mare e timno mar Paris ne onyiso chakruok mar lokruok maduong' e sigand tim no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Messi had spent his entire professional career with Barcelona, where he had won everything there was to win.
entries.translation: Messi ne osebedo e timno mar Barcelona chakre ne ochak tugo adhula, kama ne oseloyo gikmoko duto tee mane onyalo loyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But after a tumultuous few months, he decided to leave the club and sign with PSG.
entries.translation: Mak mana ni bang' dweche matin mag gikmoko dhi kaka ne okochan, ne chunye ong'ado mar wuok e tim mar adhula no kendo donjo e tim mar PSG.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The move was a major coup for PSG, who were looking to add a superstar to their squad in order to compete for the Champions League title.
entries.translation: Okang' no ne en lokruok maduong' ne PSG, mane dwaro medo jatugo maduong' e jotukgi mondo gipiem ka gigeno loyo okombe ma idendo ni Champions League.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Messi's signing was met with excitement by PSG fans, who were eager to see the world's best player in action.
entries.translation: Johera mag PSG ne omor mokalo kod nyiepo mane onyiew go Messi no, ne gigeno ahinya neno jatugo maber moloyo e piny mangima katugo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But there were also some concerns about how he would fit into the team.
entries.translation: To ne nitie parruok moko kaka jatugo no nedhi donjre gi jotugo mamoko e tim no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PSG already had a number of talented players, and it was unclear how Messi would be able to work with them.
entries.translation: Ne oyudo ka PSG nigi jotugo mang'eny mabeyo, to ne ok oyangre maber kaka Messi biro tugo kanyakla kodgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of Mice and Men is a novel by John Steinbeck that tells the story of two migrant workers, George and Lennie, who travel together in search of work during the Great Depression.
entries.translation: Of Mice and Men en bugno mondik gi John Steinbeck manyisowa sigana mar jotich ariyo magin jodak, George kod Lennie, manewuothoga kanyakla kagimanyo tich e kinde Great Depression.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The novel is set in a time and place where the American Dream is all but dead, and the only way to survive is to stick together and look out for each other.
entries.translation: Bugno ondike e saa gi kama Lek mar Amerka en gikmoko tee kopogre gi tho, to yo makende mar tony en makruok kanyakla kod konyo nyawaduu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George and Lennie are both dreamers.
entries.translation: George kod Lennie gin jolek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George dreams of one day owning a farm, where he and Lennie can live in peace and harmony.
entries.translation: Lek mar George en ni chieng' moro obed gi puothe, kama en gi Lennie ginyalo dak gi kwe kod winjruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lennie dreams of petting soft rabbits and being gentle with them.
entries.translation: Lek mar Lennie en pidho apuoyo mamuol kendo bedo mamuol kodgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But their dreams are constantly thwarted by the harsh realities of the world they live in.
entries.translation: Makmana ni lekgi yudo ng'ikruok kinde ka kinde kaluwore kod chal mar piny magidakye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, George and Lennie find work on a ranch in California.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro achiel, George kod Lennie ne oyudo tich e puodho moro California.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are immediately befriended by Candy, an old ranch hand who is missing an arm.
entries.translation: Piyo piyo nono to gimako osiep gi Candy, jatich mane tiyo ga e puodho no to sani oongee lwete achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Candy tells George and Lennie about his dream of one day owning a small farm, and the three men decide to pool their money together to buy a farm.
entries.translation: Candy nyiso George gi Lennie lek mare mar chieng' moro achiel bedo kod puodho matin, to chuo adek go ne oyiero mar keto pesgi kamoro achiel mondo ginyiew puodho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But their plans are once again thwarted when Lennie accidentally kills a woman.
entries.translation: Makmana ni chenro gi kendo ne oyudo ng'ikruok esama Lennie ne onego miyo moro ka okochano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George is forced to shoot Lennie to prevent him from being lynched.
entries.translation: Ochuno George mondo ogo Lennie bunde mondo ogeng' kik make okume.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George is devastated by Lennie's death, but he knows that it was the only thing he could do.
entries.translation: George winjo marach ahinya kaluwore kod tho mar Lennie, makmana ni ong'eyo ni mano kende e gima ne onyalo timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I'm so itchy! I think I have lice.
entries.translation: A: Aguonyra! Aparo ni an gi onyuogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: Oh no! That's terrible.
entries.translation: B: Ooh! Mano rach ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know how to get rid of them, though.
entries.translation: Ang'eyo kaka igolo gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can use a traditional remedy.
entries.translation: Wanyalo tiyo gi yo manyachon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: What is it?
entries.translation: A: Mano en mane?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: We'll need some olive oil, some lemon juice, and a few cloves of garlic.
entries.translation: B: Wabiro dwaro mor zeituni, pig ndim, kod thuno matin mag shumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Okay, I have all of that. What do we do with it?
entries.translation: A: Kare, an gi gigo tee. Ang'o ma wadhi timo kodgi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: First, we'll mix the olive oil, lemon juice, and garlic together.
entries.translation: B: Mokwongo, wabiro ruwo mor zeituni, pi ndim, kod shumi go kanyakla.
