entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, we'll apply it to your hair and scalp.
entries.translation: Bang'e, wabiro kete e yier wiyi kod pien wiyi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We'll let it sit for about an hour.
entries.translation: Wabiro weye obed kuom sa achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: An hour? That sounds like a long time.
entries.translation: A: Sa achiel? Mano nenre ni en thuolo malach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: It is, but it's worth it.
entries.translation: B: Obor, makmana ni oromre go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The oil will help to suffocate the lice and the lemon juice will help to kill them.
entries.translation: Morno biro konyo e thung'o onyuogo go to pi ndim biro konyo e nego gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The garlic will help to repel them.
entries.translation: Shumi to biro konyo e riembo gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Okay, I'll do it.
entries.translation: A: Kare, abiro timo kamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Mommy, what are those?" the toddler asked, pointing at the plants in the living room.
entries.translation: "Mama, mago gin ang'o?" nyathi matin no ne openjo, ka osiemo yien mopindh e od budho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Those are plants," Mommy replied "They're living things, just like you and me."
entries.translation: "Mago gin yien," Mama ne oduoke "Gin gigo manigi ngima, mana kaka in kod an."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Can I touch them?" the toddler asked.
entries.translation: "Bende anyalo mulo gi?" nyathino ne openjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, you can, but be gentle," Mommy said "The leaves are fragile."
entries.translation: "Kamano, inyalo, makmana ni imulgi mos," Mama ne owacho "Oboke go reprep."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The toddler reached out and touched a leaf.
entries.translation: Nyathino ne osudo ba omulo oboke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The leaf felt soft and smooth.
entries.translation: Oboke no ne yom to poth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I like it," the toddler said.
entries.translation: "Ahere," nyathino ne owacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm glad," Mommy said. "Plants are good for us. They help clean the air and make us feel better."
entries.translation: "Amor," Mama ne owacho. "Yien ber ne wan. Gikonyo e luoko muya e kor lwasi kendo gitimo wawinj maber."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The toddler continued to look at the plants. Then, he noticed a cable running along the floor.
entries.translation: Nyathino ne odhi nyime girango yien go. Bang'e, ne ofwenyo waya ma okalo e dier ot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What's that?" he asked.
entries.translation: "Mano en ang'o?" ne openjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's a cable," Mommy said.
entries.translation: "Mano waya," Mama ne oduoke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's used to connect the TV to the wall."
entries.translation: "Itiyo ga kode e chuogo wang' jowi e kor sisi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Can I touch it?" the toddler asked.
entries.translation: "Anyalo mule?" nyathino ne openjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "No, you can't," Mommy said. "Cables can be dangerous.They can give you a shock."
entries.translation: "Ooyo, dak imule," Mama ne owacho. "Wache nyalo kelo hinyruok. Ginyalo goyi sok."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The toddler looked disappointed, but he didn't touch the cable.
entries.translation: Nyathino ne neno ng'ama ochwanyre, makmana ni ne okomulo wche go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Birthdays are a time to celebrate the day you were born.
entries.translation: Odiechieng' mar paro chieng' nyuol en thuolo mar timo nyasi mar chieng'i mar nyuol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a day to reflect on all the good things in your life and to thank those who have made you who you are.
entries.translation: En odiechieng' mar paro gigo mabeyo duto tee e ngimani kendo duoko erokamano ne jogo ma otimo in ng'ama in kawuono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a day to set goals for the year ahead and to make plans for the future.
entries.translation: Bende en odiechieng' mar chano gigo ma idwaro timo e higano kendo keto chenro mar odiechienge mabiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To make the most of your birthday, start by making a list of all the things you are grateful for.
entries.translation: Mondo iti maber gi odiechieng' mari mar nyuol, chak kod loso list mochan mar gikmoko duto ma iduokeye erokamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could include your family, friends, health, home, job, or anything else that is important to you.
entries.translation: Mae nyalo riwo kaynakla anyuola mari, ngima, dala, tich, kod gikmoko tee ma ineno ka duong' kendo ber kodi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have made your list, take some time to reflect on each item and how it has made your life better.
entries.translation: Bang' ka isechano list mari, kaw thuolo moro ipar gimoro ka gimoro kod kaka osebero ngima mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Next, set some goals for the year ahead.
entries.translation: Bang'e, ket gigo midwaro timo e higa mabiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These goals can be anything you want them to be, but they should be specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound.
entries.translation: Gigo midwaro timo gi nyalo bedo gimoro amora midwaro, makmana ni nyaka gibed gigo sie, inyalo pim gi, inyalo tim gi, gin kare, kod inyalo tiek gi e kinde mowinjre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, you might set a goal to lose weight, get a promotion at work, or travel to a new place.
entries.translation: Kuom ranyisi, inyalo keto ni idwaro duoko pek mari piny, kata mondo omedi cheo e tich, kata dhi e piny manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, make plans for the day of your birthday.
entries.translation: Magiko, ket chenro mag timo e odiechieng' mari mar nyuol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could include spending time with your loved ones, eating your favorite foods, or doing something you have always wanted to do.
entries.translation: Mae nyalo ting'o bedo kanyakla gi jogo ma ihero, chamo chiemo mihero ahinya, kata timo gimoro ma isegombo timo kuom thuolo malach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: Romantic Comedies are so unrealistic.
entries.translation: Ng'ato mar 1: Tuke Mag Hera Mamiyo ji Nyiero go okgin gigo manyalo timre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: I know, right? The love interests always fall in love at first sight, and they never have any problems.
entries.translation: Ngato mar 2: Ang'eyo, kamano? Dwaro mar hera timre ga ka uherre odiechieng' ma ukuongo romeye no, kendo giongee thagruok moro amoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: And the conflicts are always so contrived.
entries.translation: Ng'ato mar 1: Kendo ywarruok kinde duto kelo ga hinyruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Like, in one movie, the couple broke up because the guy's best friend was in love with the girl.
entries.translation: Mana kaka e sinema moro achiel, joma oherre go ne owere nikech osiep wuoyi no ma ngita gi del ne ohero nyako no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: That's so ridiculous. It's not like that happens in real life.
entries.translation: Ng'ato mar 2: Mano wach malich. Gima kamano oktimre ga ngima mar adier.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: Exactly. And even when they do get together, it's always so perfect.
entries.translation: Ng'ato mar 1: Kamano. To kata kagiromo ba gin kamoro achiel, en ga gima ber ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They never have any fights or disagreements.
entries.translation: Okgigore ga kata ok gikadhre ga e wach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: It's like the movies are trying to tell us that love is always easy and perfect.
entries.translation: Ng'ato mar 2: Chal ka gima sinema go temo nyisowa ni hera kinde duto en ga gima yot kendo gimakare chuth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But that's not the case.
entries.translation: Makmana ni mano ok e adiera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Love is hard work.
entries.translation: Hera en tich matek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It takes time and effort to build a lasting relationship.
entries.translation: Loso hera madak kinde mang'eny dwaro thuolo kod teko maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: I know. That's why I don't watch rom-coms anymore.
entries.translation: Ng'ato mar 1: Ang'eyo. Mano e gima omiyo ne aweyo neno sinema mar rom-coms.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They give people unrealistic expectations about love.
entries.translation: Gimiyo ji geno maongee e weche hera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My first day of school was a day I will never forget.
entries.translation: Odiechienga mokuongo e skul en odiechieng' ma wiya okan wilgo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was both excited and nervous, not knowing what to expect.
entries.translation: Ne amor to an gi kibach, ne akia gima agen ni dhitimre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I woke up that morning, I got dressed quickly and ate a quick breakfast.
entries.translation: Kane achiew okinyi no, ne arwakra piyo piyo kendo amadho chae mapiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, my mom drove me to school and walked me to my classroom.
entries.translation: Bang'e, minwa ne otera e skul gi nyamburko kendo ne owuotho koda kotera e klasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I walked into the classroom, I was immediately greeted by my teacher, Ms. Smith.
entries.translation: Kane adonjo e klas, japuonjwa, Madam smith ne omosa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was a kind-looking woman with a warm smile.
entries.translation: Ne en miyo no mane neno ng'ama muol to buonjo bee ne obuonjo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She introduced herself to me and then showed me to my seat.
entries.translation: Ne ofulre na bang'e to onyisa komba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I sat down next to a girl named Sarah.
entries.translation: Ne abet e bath nyako ma iluongo ni Sarah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled at me and said, "Hi, I'm Sarah."
entries.translation: Ne obuonjo koda kasto owacho ni, "Amosi, iluonga ni Sarah."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I smiled back and said, "Hi, I'm Vera."
entries.translation: Ne abuonjo kode an bende kasto awacho ni, "Ber, an Vera."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked for a few minutes before the bell rang for class to start.
entries.translation: Ne wawuoyo kuom dakika matin kapok olang' oywak mondo klas ochakre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Smith began by introducing herself and telling us about the rules of the classroom.
entries.translation: Madam Smith ne ochako kod fulre bang'e to onyisowa chike mag klas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, she started teaching us about math.
entries.translation: Bang'e, ne ochako puonjowa kwano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was a little bit confused at first, but Ms. Smith explained everything clearly.
entries.translation: Mokwongo gik moko ne ochocha matin, makmana ni Madam Smith ne olero na gikmoko tee maler.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After math class, we had a break.
entries.translation: Bang' klas mar kwano, ne wadhi yueyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sarah and I went outside to play on the playground.
entries.translation: Sarah kod an ne wadhi oko mondo watug e pap.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We played on the swings and the slide for a while, then we went back inside for lunch.
entries.translation: Ne watugo e osuyo kod kuonde kier, bang'e to ne wadok e klass chamo lanj.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When tissue is injured, the body’s immune system sends white blood cells to the area.
entries.translation: Ka fuondeni ohinyre, chenro mar del mar geng'o tuoche oroga nyiriri marachar mag remo e kama ohinyre no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These cells release chemicals that cause blood vessels to dilate and become more permeable.
entries.translation: Nyiriri gi golo ga kemikal mamiyo ga leche mag remo kuot kendo gik moko koro nyalo kalo kuomgi mayot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This allows fluid and white blood cells to leak out of the blood vessels and into the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Mae miyo ga pi gi nyiriri marachar mag remo wuok e leche mag remo kendo donjo e fuonde mohinyre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fluid forms a clear, watery swelling called edema.
entries.translation: Pigno loso ga gima okuok maneno maler to otimo pipi, gima okuot no iluongo ni edema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The white blood cells help to fight infection and to remove damaged tissue.
entries.translation: Nyiriri marachar mag remo konyo ga e goyo tuo kendo e golo fuon mokethre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also release chemicals that stimulate the growth of new tissue.
entries.translation: Bende gigolo ga kemikal mamiyo ga fuon manyien chako dongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The classic signs of acute inflammation are redness, heat, swelling, and pain.
entries.translation: Ranyisi mongirore mag kama okuot en bedo makwar, liet, kuot, kod lit.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These signs are caused by the increased blood flow and the release of chemicals in the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Ranyisi gi ikelo gi medruok mar kaka remo ringo e del kod kemikal ma ogol kadhi e kama ohinre no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Redness is caused by the dilation of blood vessels.
entries.translation: Kwarno ikelo gi yawruok mar leche mag remo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Heat is caused by the increased blood flow and the release of inflammatory chemicals.
entries.translation: Liet ikelo gi medruok mar kaka remo ringo e del kod golo kemikal mag kelo kuot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Swelling is caused by the leakage of fluid from blood vessels into the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Kuot ikelo kod chwer mar pigepige kowuok e leche mag remo kadhi e kama ohinyre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pain is caused by the release of inflammatory chemicals and the pressure of the swelling.
entries.translation: Rem ikelo kod golo kemikal mag kelo kuot kod presa mar kuot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acute inflammation is a normal part of the healing process.
entries.translation: Kuot ma ahinya en gino matimre ga e okang' mar kuo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, if it is severe or prolonged, it can damage healthy tissue.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, ka kuot no omedre ahinya kata obudho, onyalo ketho fuonde mangima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, acute inflammation can lead to chronic inflammation, which is a long-term condition that can cause pain, disability, and even death.
entries.translation: E seche moko, kuot no nyalo kelo kuot ma okrum, maen chandruok mabudho ahinya kendo nyalo kelo rem, ng'ol, kod kata mana tho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that can cause acute inflammation, including infection, injury, and autoimmune diseases.
entries.translation: Nitie gik moko mang'eny manyalo kelo kuot, kaachiel gi tuo, hinyruok, kod tuoche mayudre ka gigo mageng'o tuoche e dendi okelo tuo kar riembo tuo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Infections are caused by bacteria, viruses, or fungi.
entries.translation: Tuoche ikelo gi bakteria, midhusi, kata gigo makelo tuo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When these organisms enter the body, they can trigger an immune response that leads to inflammation.
entries.translation: Gigi kodonjo e dend dhano, ginyalo miyo gigo mageng'o tuo e del ochak gore kodgi kendo mae dhimiyo del kuot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Injuries can also cause inflammation.
entries.translation: Hinyruoge bende nyalo miyo del kuot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When tissue is damaged, it releases chemicals that attract white blood cells and other immune cells to the area.
entries.translation: Fuon ka okethre, ogolo ga kemikal maywayo nyiriri marachar mag remo kod nyiriri mamoko mag geng'o tuo kendo kelogi e kama ohinyre no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These cells release chemicals that cause inflammation.
entries.translation: Nyiriri gi golo ga kemikal mamiyo del kuot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Autoimmune diseases are caused by the body’s immune system attacking its own tissues.
entries.translation: Tuoche ma ikelo ka gino mageng'o tuo e del okelo tuo yudore ga sama gima geng'o tuo omonjo fuonde mek del kar geng'o gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to inflammation in the affected tissues.
entries.translation: Mae nyalo miyo fuondi ma ohinyre go okuodi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acute inflammation is usually treated with pain relievers, such as ibuprofen or acetaminophen.
entries.translation: Kuot maduong' ithiedho ga gi yath magolo rem, kaka brufen kata acetaminophen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, corticosteroids may be used to reduce inflammation.
entries.translation: E kuonde moko, inyalo ti gi corticosteroid e duoko kuot piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the inflammation is caused by an infection, antibiotics may be prescribed.
entries.translation: Ka kuot no okel gi tuo, inyalo ti gi yien mathiedho tuo mokel gi bakteria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chronic inflammation is a long-term condition that can cause pain, disability, and even death.
entries.translation: Kuot madhi aming'a en chandruok mabet thuolo malach kendo nyalo kelo rem, ng'ol, kod kata mana tho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is often caused by autoimmune diseases, such as rheumatoid arthritis and Crohn’s disease.
entries.translation: Thothne ikele ga gi tuoche mayudre ka gigo geng'o tuo e del okelo ne del tuo, kaka athraitis mong'ere ni rheumatoid arthritis kod tuo mar Crohn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chronic inflammation can also be caused by obesity, smoking, and air pollution.
entries.translation: Kuot momedre bende inyalo kel gi chwe mokalo tong', madho ndawa, kata muya mochido.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no cure for chronic inflammation, but it can be managed with medication, lifestyle changes, and physical therapy.
entries.translation: Ongee gino manyalo tieko kuot molandre, makmana ni inyalo duoke piny gi yath, loko ngima ma idak, kod thieth mar del.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mozambican Civil War was a conflict that lasted from 1977 to 1992.
entries.translation: Lweny mar Ji Giwegi e piny Mozambique ne en dhao mane obet chakre higa mar 1977 nyaka higa mar 1992.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war caused widespread devastation and displacement, and led to the deaths of an estimated 1 million people.
entries.translation: Lweny no ne okelo kethrouk kuonde mang'eny kendo ne omiyo dhano odar, kod kelo tho mar kwan dhano madirom tara 1.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war began after RENAMO launched an insurgency against FRELIMO in 1977.
entries.translation: Lweny no ne ochakre bang' ka RENAMO nochako ng'anyo mar kwedo FRELIMO e higa mar 1977.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: RENAMO was opposed to FRELIMO's socialist policies and its close ties to the Soviet Union.
entries.translation: RENAMO ne kwedo chike mag FRELIMO mag timo gik moko kaka oganda achiel kod kaka ne otiyo machiegni gi riwruok mar Soviet Union.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war quickly escalated, and by the early 1980s, RENAMO had control of much of the countryside.
entries.translation: Lweny no ne omedre mapiyo piyo, kendo kane ochopo chak higa mag piero aboro, RENAMO ne ochung' ne gwenge mang'eny mag pinyno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: FRELIMO was forced to rely on Soviet and Cuban military aid to keep RENAMO at bay.
entries.translation: Ne ochuno FRELIMO mondo ogen kuom kony kowuok kuom jolweny mag riwruog Soviet kod piny mar Cuba mondo girakre gi RENAMO.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1984, FRELIMO and RENAMO signed a peace agreement, but the fighting continued.
entries.translation: E higa mar 1984, FRELIMO kod RENAMO ne oketo sei e winjruok mar kwe, makmana ni lweny to ne odhi nyime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1992, the two sides signed a new peace agreement, which called for a ceasefire and the holding of multiparty elections.
entries.translation: E higa mar 1992, kweth ariyo mane obalo go ne oketo sei e winjruok manyien mar kwe, mane dwaro mondo ochung lweny kendo otim yiero maduong' mar buche mang'eny mag siasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a bright and sunny day in the small village of Locksmiths, and the festival of locks was in full swing.
entries.translation: Ne en odiechieng' mane ler rieny to chieng' nitie e gweng' matin mar Locksmiths, kendo nyasi mar kifunde ne timore e okang' mamalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The streets were crowded with people, all eager to see the latest and greatest in lockmaking technology.
entries.translation: Nderni ne opong' gi ji mang'eny, ka giduto ne gin gi siso mar neno lony manyasani kendo maduong' mokalo e loso kifunde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were vendors selling everything from simple padlocks to complex combination locks, and artisans demonstrating their skills in lockpicking and locksmithing.
entries.translation: Ne nitie jouso mane uso gikmoko tee kochakre e kifunde matindo nyaka e kifunde madongo, kod jogo maloso gikmoko gi lwetgi kaginyiso lony margi e yiero kendo loso kifunde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the center of the village square, a large stage had been set up for the day's festivities.
entries.translation: E dier chuny gweng'no, ne olosi kama duong' ma oyang mar timoye nyasi mag odiechiengno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A group of musicians were playing lively tunes, and a crowd of people were gathered around, clapping and dancing.
entries.translation: Kanyakla mar jothum ne goyo thum, to kweth mar ji ne ochokore e kanyono ka gipamo kendo gimiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the stage, a skilled locksmith was demonstrating how to pick a lock, and the crowd was mesmerized by his skill.
entries.translation: E pap, jalony e weche loso kifunde ne nyiso kaka iyiero kiful, kendo kweth dhano mane nikanyo dhoggi ne omoko gi lony mare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the sun began to set, the festival came to a close.
entries.translation: Nyasi no ne orumo ka chieng' ne chako podho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My friend, Abel, and I were walking home from school one day when we saw a blood drive being held at our local community center.
entries.translation: Abel ma osiepa kod an odiechieng' moro achiel ne wawuotho ka wawuok e skul wadok e dala e sama ne waneno kampen mar golo remo ka itimo e bar mar gweng'wa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were both 17 years old, and we had never donated blood before.
entries.translation: Waduto ne wan jo higni 17, to ne oyudo pok wasegolo remo e kinde mokalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We decided to stop in and see what it was all about.
entries.translation: Ne wang'ado paro ni wachung' wadonji mondo wane gima ne dhi nyime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of donating blood was actually pretty simple.
entries.translation: Chenro mar golo remo no ne en chenro mayot ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We both filled out a questionnaire and answered some questions about our health history.
entries.translation: Waduto ne wapong'o otas mar penjo kendo ne waduoko penjo moko ewi sigana mar ngima wa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, we had our blood pressure checked and our veins were checked to make sure they were big enough.
entries.translation: Bang' mano, ne opim presa mar rembwa kendo ne orangi leche magwa mating'o remo maber mondo one ni ne gidongo moromo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once we were cleared to donate, we each sat down in a chair and had a needle inserted into our arms.
entries.translation: Bang' kane oseyangwa ni wanyalo golo remo, waduto ne wabedo piny e kom kendo ne ochwo sandan e lwetewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The blood was collected in a bag, and the whole process took about 15 minutes.
entries.translation: Ne ochok remo e ofuko, kendo chenro no tee ne okao madirom dakika 15.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It felt good to know that we were helping to save lives.
entries.translation: Ne wawinjo maber ka wang'eyo ni ne wakonyo e reso ngima jokmoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After we donated, we were given a juice box and a cookie to help us recover.
entries.translation: Bang' golo remo, ne omiwa juis kod buskut mondo okonywa chango kata duoko teko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We also received a thank-you card from the blood bank.
entries.translation: Bende ne wayudo kad mar goyonwa erokamano kowuok kuom bengi mar remo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm glad that Abel and I decided to donate blood.
entries.translation: Amor nikech Abel kod an ne wayiero mar golo remo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a quick and easy way to make a difference in the world.
entries.translation: Ne en yo mapiyo kendo mayot mar kelo lokruok e piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I encourage everyone to consider donating blood if they are eligible.
entries.translation: Ajiwo ji duto tee mondo giyier mar golo remo kapo ni ginyalo golo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a simple act of kindness that can help save lives.
entries.translation: En yoo mayot mar nyiso ng'uono kendo onyalo konyo e reso ngima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A solo traveler was found safe after spending two nights lost in the Swiss Alps.
entries.translation: Ne oyudi jawuoth mawuotho kende ka ngimane ni kare bang' bet otieno ariyo ka olal e gode mag Swiss Alps.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The 25-year-old woman, who has not been identified, was hiking in the mountains when she became separated from her group.
entries.translation: Miyo ma jahigni 25, ma pok oyangi no, ne wuotho e gode go seche mane olal ba owere gi jowetene mane en godo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was reported missing on Tuesday, and search teams were dispatched to find her.
entries.translation: Ne ochiw ripot ni olal odiechieng' mar Tich Ariyo, kendo ne oor kweth mar joma goyo apedhe mondo omanye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman was eventually found on Thursday, about 10 miles from where she had been hiking.
entries.translation: To gikone ne oyud miyo no Tich Ang'wen, e bor madirom mail 10 kowuok kama ne owuothoye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was cold and dehydrated, but otherwise in good condition.
entries.translation: Ne ong'ich kendo pi ne orumo e dende, makmana ni ne en e chal maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She told rescuers that she had been following a trail when she got turned around.
entries.translation: Ne onyiso jogo mane orese ni ne oluwo yoo moyangi e sama ne olalno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She spent the night in a cave, and she survived by eating snow and drinking from a stream.
entries.translation: Ne onindo e rogo mar lwanda, kendo ne okonyre kokalo kuom chamo baraf kod modho pi mane mol e aora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman's experience is a reminder of the importance of being prepared when hiking in the mountains.
entries.translation: Gigo ma miyo no ne okaloye en paro ni dhano ber mar timo ikruok makare sama iwuotho e gode.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hikers should always bring a map, compass, and a flashlight, and they should tell someone where they are going and when they expect to return.
entries.translation: Joma wuotho e gode ber kating'o map, kompas, kod toch, kendo ber ka gikono ng'ato kama gidhiye kod saa ma gichano duogeye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I was a kid, I would spend hours poring over magazines.
entries.translation: Ka ne an nyathi, ne anyalo kao seche mang'eny ka asomo gaset e yo ma odimbre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I would read every article, look at every picture, and cut out the ones I liked to put in my scrapbook.
entries.translation: Ne anyalo somo sula ka sula, rango picha ka picha, kendo ng'ado oko piche mane omora mondo aketgi e buga mar choko piche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I loved the way magazines could transport me to different worlds and make me think about things in new ways.
entries.translation: Ne ahero kaka gasede ne nyalo tera e pinje mopogre opogre kendo miyo apar gikmoko e yore manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I was reading an article about brain science in a magazine.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro, ne asomo sula moro mar gaset maneloso ewi sayans mar obuongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The article was really interesting, and it made me think about how my brain works.
entries.translation: Sula no ne mit ahinya, kendo ne omiyo aparo kaka obuongona tiyo ga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I realized that I could use my brain to learn anything I wanted, and that was an amazing feeling.
entries.translation: Ne afwenyo ni anyalo tiyo gi obuongo na e puonjra gimoro amora ma adwaro, to mano ne miyo awinjo maber ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've been reading magazines ever since, and I still love the way they can open my mind to new ideas.
entries.translation: Asebedo ka asomo gasede chakre chon, to podi ahero kaka ginyalo yao pacha mondo ane gigo manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The debate about whether animals are happier in the wild or in zoos is a complex one with no easy answers.
entries.translation: Twak ewi kabe lee mor ahinya ka gin e bungu kata ka gin kama olor nigiye en twak ma iye tek kendo maonge duoko mayot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many factors to consider, including the individual animal's needs, the type of zoo, and the quality of care provided.
entries.translation: Nitie gik mang'eny maber ka irango, moko gin dwaro mag lee no en owuon, chal mar kama iloroniye lee no, kod ber mar arita ma ichiwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some animals, such as elephants, are highly social and need to interact with other elephants in order to thrive.
entries.translation: Lee moko, kaka liech, ong'iyo ahinya gi jowetegi kendo gidwaro riwre gi liech mamoko mondo gidag maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the wild, elephants live in herds of up to 100 individuals.
entries.translation: E bungu, liech dakga e kweth mar liech ma ok ohingo 100.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They spend their days foraging for food, playing, and socializing.
entries.translation: Odiechieng' giwuoth ka gimanyo chiemo, gitugo, kendo ka giriwre gi jowadgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a zoo, elephants may not have the same opportunities to interact with other elephants, which can lead to boredom and frustration.
entries.translation: E kar loro ni lee, liech dak bed gi thuolo machal kamano mag riwre gi liech mamoko, to mae nyalo miyo gibed maonge mor kendo gibed gi chuny ma onyosre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other animals, such as lions, are solitary hunters.
entries.translation: Lee mamoko, kaka sibuor, gin lee madhiga e dwar kendgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the wild, lions live in prides of up to 15 individuals.
entries.translation: E bungu, sibuor dak ga e kweth mar sibuoche ma ok okalo 15.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, each lion within the pride has its own territory and does not interact with other lions very often.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, sibuor ka sibuor mantie e kwethno nigi aluora mare owuon kendo ok oriwre gi sibuoche mamoko e kinde mathoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a zoo, lions may be able to live in larger enclosures with more space to roam, which can provide them with more opportunities to exercise and explore.
entries.translation: E kar loro ni lee, sibuoche nyalo dak e kuonde malach mochiel to nigi nafas maduong' mar kwayo, mae nyalo miyogi thuolo mang'eny mag timo orako kendo bayo mathoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The type of zoo also plays a role in the welfare of its animals.
entries.translation: Chal mar kar loro ni lee no bende nigi gino ma otimo ewi ngima maber mar lee meke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some zoos are very large and provide their animals with spacious enclosures, while others are smaller and may not have as much space.
entries.translation: Kuonde mamoko mag loro ne lee dongo ahinya kendo miyo lee kuonde malach mochiel, to kuonde mamoko mag loro ne lee tindo kendo giongee thuolo malach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I'm driving down the road, I see a goat giving birth in the median.
entries.translation: E sama ne ariembo nyamburko e ndara, ne aneno diel kanyuol e diere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's lying on her side and her two front legs are extended in front of her.
entries.translation: Onindo gi bute to tiendene ariyo ma mbele oriere e nyime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baby goat is coming out of her right side and it's head is already visible.
entries.translation: Nyathi diel wuok e bathe makor achwich kendo wiye osewuok oko neno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mother goat looks up at me and I can see the fear in her eyes.
entries.translation: Diel manyuol no ranga kendo anyalo neno luoro e wengene.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's probably wondering if I'm going to hurt her or her baby.
entries.translation: Nyalo bedo ni openjre ka adhi hinye kata ka adhi hinyo nyathine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I stop the car and get out.
entries.translation: Achungo nyamburko kendo awuok oko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I walk over to the goat and kneel down next to her.
entries.translation: Awuotho ka achomo diendno kendo agoyo chonga e bathe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I gently stroke her head and tell her that everything is going to be okay.
entries.translation: Achwado wiye eyo mamuol kendo anyise ni gikmoko duto tee biro bedo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baby goat starts to emerge and I can see that it's a little girl.
entries.translation: Nyathi diel chako wuok kendo anyalo neno ni en nyako matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's crying and her mother licks her clean.
entries.translation: Oywak to min gi nang'e ka oyueye maler.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I watch as the mother goat and baby bond and I feel a sense of peace.
entries.translation: Arango kaka min diel gi nyathi diel bedo e achiel kendo awinjo ni an gi kwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The city was a vast, sprawling metropolis, full of life and energy.
entries.translation: Boma no ne en boma maduong' mane dongre piyo, kendo ne en kod ngima gi teko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a place where anything was possible, and where dreams could come true.
entries.translation: Ne en kama gimoro amora ne nyalo timreye, kendo kama lek ne nyalo chopeye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But for every person who found success in the city, there were many more who struggled to make ends meet.
entries.translation: Makmana ni kuom ng'ato ka ng'ato mane timo maber e boma no, ne nitie ji mang'eny mane temo mondo oyud kaka ginyalo konyre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These people lived in the slums, in tiny apartments that were often overcrowded and in disrepair.
entries.translation: Jogi ne odak kuonde dak ma ongohore, e udi matindo ahinya ma kinde duto ne nigi ji ma opong'o gi kendo chalgi ne rach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They worked long hours for low pay, and they often had to go without basic necessities like food and healthcare.
entries.translation: Ne gitiyo kuom seche mang'eny to chudo ne tin, kendo kinde duto ne ginyalo bedo maongee gigo mochuno e ngima ndano kama chiemo kod thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One such person was a young woman named Amelia.
entries.translation: Ng'ato achiel mane odak e ngima no ne en miyo matin ma iluongo ni Amelia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had come to the city with big dreams, but she quickly found that reality was much different than she had imagined.
entries.translation: Ne oyudo obiro e boma no kaen gi lek madongo, makmana ni piyo piyo nono ne oyudo ni adiera ne opogre ahinya gi kaka ne oparo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She worked as a waitress in a small diner, and she could barely make enough money to pay her rent.
entries.translation: Ne otiyo kaka ng'ano masabo ji e magawa matin, kendo ne ok onyal loso pesa mane nyalo rome chulo ode.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She often went to bed hungry, and she was always worried about her future.
entries.translation: Thothne ne onindo ga ma ok ochiemo, kendo ne osiko oparore ewi ngimane e kinde mabiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Amelia was walking home from work when she saw a man sitting on a bench.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro achiel, Amelia ne wuotho ka owuok tich odhi ot e sama ne oneno dichuo moro ka obet e mbero.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was homeless, and he was holding a sign that said, "Will work for food." Amelia felt sorry for the man, and she decided to buy him a sandwich.
entries.translation: Ne oongee kar jot, to ne oting'o oboke mane wacho ni, "Abiro tiyo mondo omiya chiemo kaka chudo." Amelia ne owinjo malit ahinya nikech ng'ano, kendo ne ong'ado mar nyieone sandwich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As she was talking to the man, she learned that his name was Charlie.
entries.translation: E sama ne owuoyo gi dichuo no, ne ofwenyo ni ne iluonge ni Charlie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Demonetization is the process of removing legal tender from circulation.
entries.translation: Wilo pesa en tielo no mar loko pesa ma itiyo go e piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In India, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced on November 8, 2016, that all ₹500 and ₹1000 banknotes would cease to be legal tender from midnight.
entries.translation: E piny India, Jatend Migepe Narendra Modi ne olando tarik 8 dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2016, ni node duto tee mag ₹500 kod ₹1000 biro bedo ni okti e pinyno kochakre saa auchiel otieno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This move was intended to crack down on corruption and counterfeiting, but it also caused significant disruption and hardship for many people.
entries.translation: Okang' ni ne en mar pedho jo mibadhi kod joma loso pesa ma ok en mar adier, to kendo ne okelo rochruok maduong' kod pek mar ngima ne ji mang'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are several reasons to be skeptical of demonetization.
entries.translation: Nitie gigo mang'eny manyalo miyo piny odang' gi loko pesa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, it is not clear that it will be effective in reducing corruption.
entries.translation: Mokuongo, ok oyangre ni obiro konyo e duoko mibadhi piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Corruption is a complex problem that cannot be solved simply by removing cash from circulation.
entries.translation: Mibadhi en chandruok ma kore tek kendo oknyal tieke kuom golo agola pesa mane itiyo go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, there is some evidence that demonetization may actually increase corruption, as it makes it more difficult for people to track and trace their money.
entries.translation: Kuom wacho adier, nitie neno moro manyiso ni wilo pesa matiyo nyalo medo mibadhi, nikech oketo bedo matek ahinya mondo ji oluw kendo oyud pesgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, demonetization is likely to have a negative impact on the poor.
entries.translation: Mar ariyo, loko pesa nyalo kelo chandruok ne joma odhier.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many poor people in India rely on cash for their daily transactions.
entries.translation: Thoth ji ma odhier e piny India ogeno kuom pesa aching' e gigo magitimo pile.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sudden withdrawal of large-denomination banknotes made it difficult for them to buy food, pay their bills, and access other essential services.
entries.translation: Golo node madongo apoya nono ne otimo obedo matek ne jodhier yudo kaka ginyalo nyieo chiemo, chulo chudo ma ber ka gichulo, kod yudo gigo ma ochuno e ngima dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, demonetization has caused significant disruption to the economy.
entries.translation: Mar adek, wilo pesa okelo chochni maduong' e weche mag yudo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Businesses had to close for days or even weeks while they adjusted to the new currency.
entries.translation: Ohalni ne olor kuom odiechienge kata wige e seche mane gitimo lokruok mar node manyien go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dish is said to have originated in the Philippines, where it is known as lechon.
entries.translation: Kit chiemo ni wachre ni ne owuok e piny Philippines, kama ong'ere kama lechon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also popular in other parts of Southeast Asia, such as Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand.
entries.translation: Ong'ere ahinya e pinje mamoko mayudre e Ugwe ma Milambo mar Asia, kaka Indonesia, Malaysia, kod Thailand.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To make lechon, a whole pig is gutted and cleaned, then stuffed with a mixture of garlic, ginger, lemongrass, and other spices.
entries.translation: Sama iloso lechon, anguro mangima iyang'o kendo igolo gik iye tee kasto iluoke maler, bang'e isoyo e iye kitungu mar galik, tangaus, majand lum, kod gigo mamoko ma itiyo go e tedo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pig is then roasted over a fire of charcoal or wood for several hours.
entries.translation: Bang' mano anguro no ibulo kuom seche mang'eny e wii mach mar makaa kata mar yien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The result is a juicy, flavorful meat that is perfect for a special occasion.
entries.translation: Ring'o malosre kanyo en ring'o ma nitie gi ndhandhu mamit moloyo kendo en chiemo michamo e nyasi moyiedh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lechon is often served with rice and vegetables.
entries.translation: Lechon ichamo ga gi ochele kod alode.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also be eaten as a main course or as an appetizer.
entries.translation: Bende inyalo chame kaka chiemo maduong' kata kaka chiemo ma ichamo ka irito chiemo moro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are ever lucky enough to try lechon, you will not be disappointed.
entries.translation: Ka in gi haw ahinya ba iyudo thuolo mar bilo lechon, ibiro mor gi chiemono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is truly a unique and delicious dish.
entries.translation: En chiemo ma kende kendo mamit moloyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the traditional method of cooking lechon, there are also several modern variations.
entries.translation: Ka opogore gi yor nyaluo mar tedo lechon, nitie bende yore mathoth manyasani mag tedo chiemo ni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some chefs cook the pig in a pit oven, while others use a rotisserie.
entries.translation: Jotedo moko kao ga anguro to bulo e mach ma okuny e bur piny sama jokmoko to tiyo kod jiko manyasani mar bulo ring'o.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also recipes for making lechon in a slow cooker or in the oven.
entries.translation: Nitie bende okang' mag loso lechon e kendo madhi moos kata e oven.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter how it is cooked, lechon is always a crowd-pleaser.
entries.translation: Ka okidewo kaka otede, lechon en chiemo mamoro ga dhano mang'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a hearty and flavorful dish that is perfect for any occasion.
entries.translation: En chiemo mamit kendo manigi ndhandh mopogre opogore maber kod nyasi moro amora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So if you are looking for a new and exciting dish to try, lechon is definitely worth a look.
entries.translation: Omiyo kapo ni imanyo chiemo manyien kendo mamit mondo ibil, inyalo manyo lechon item.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: What's up with your car? It's been making a weird noise lately.
entries.translation: An: Ang'o marach gi nyamburko ni? Osebo ka ogoyo koko moro magalagala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: Yeah, I know. I'm taking it to the mechanic tomorrow.
entries.translation: Nera: Kamano, ang'eyo. Kiny anatere ni makanika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Is it going to be expensive.
entries.translation: An: Bei biro bedo moridre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: It might be. The car is old, and parts are hard to come by. But I'm hoping it's just a minor issue.
entries.translation: Nera: Nyalo bedo moridre. Nyamburko ni oti, kendo gike bee tek yudo. Makmana ni ageno ni en gimoro matin tu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Well, good luck. Let me know what the mechanic says.
entries.translation: An: Kamano, hawi maber. Ibiro nyisa gima makanika biro wacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: I will. Thanks.
entries.translation: Nera: Abiro nyisi. Erokamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Hey, by the way, did you know that nuclear cars are a thing?
entries.translation: An: To bende ne ing'eyo ni nyamburko mag nyuklia beyo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: No, I didn't. That's interesting.
entries.translation: Nera: Dawe, ne ok ang'eyo. Mano gima ber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Yeah, they're pretty cool. They use nuclear power to generate electricity, which powers the car's motor.
entries.translation: An: Kamano, giber ahinya. Gitiyo gi teko mar nyuklia e loso stima, ma ema itiyo go e riembo injni mar nyamburko no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: That sounds like it would be really expensive.
entries.translation: Nera: Mano chal ni beche nyalo bedo malo ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: It can be, but it's also a lot more efficient than traditional cars. Nuclear cars can go for hundreds of miles on a single tank of fuel.
entries.translation: An: Nyalore, makmana ni otiyo maber ahinya moloyo nyamburko ma nyachon. Nyamburko mag nyuklia nyalo dhi mail miche gi miche ka otiyo gi tange achiel mar mo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: Hmm, I'll have to look into that.
entries.translation: Nera: Mmh, abiro rangeye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A man walks into a comedy club and orders a filet mignon.
entries.translation: Dichuo moro odonjo e kar miyo ji nyiero kendo oluongo ring'o mayom maongee chogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The waiter brings him the steak and he starts to eat it.
entries.translation: Ng'ama sabo ji okelo ne ring'o maongee chogo no kendo ochako chame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few bites, he stops and says, "This steak is terrible! It's tough and tasteless."
entries.translation: Bang' kaye matin, oweyo chiemo kendo owacho ni, "Ring'o ni rach ahinya! Otek to oongee ndhandh."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The waiter replies, "Well, sir, you did order a filet mignon."
entries.translation: Jauso no oduoke ni, "Kamano, telo, ne iluongo ring'o maongee chogo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, but I didn't order a raw filet mignon!"
entries.translation: "Kamano, makmana ni ne okaluongo ring'o manumu maongee chogo!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Sir, all of our steaks are served raw. We require our customers to cook them themselves."
entries.translation: "Telo, ringwa tee ikelo e mesa kanumu. Jonyiepo tee tedo ga ring gi kendgi giwegi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But I don't know how to cook!"
entries.translation: "To an akia tedo!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's not our problem. We're a comedy club, not a restaurant."
entries.translation: "Mano oken sida marwa. Wan kar miyo ji nyiero, ok magawa mar uso chiemo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man angrily gets up and storms out of the club.
entries.translation: Dichuogno ochung' ka iye owang' kendo owuok oko mar kar miyo ji nyiero no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been in a car accident, and he was unconscious.
entries.translation: Ne oyudo masira mar gari kendo pache nolal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His parents, who had been driving by when the accident happened, rushed to his side.
entries.translation: Jonyuolne, mane riembo machiegni sama ne masira no otimore, nochopo mapiyo ire mapiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were frantic with worry.
entries.translation: Ne gipong' kod luoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The paramedics arrived and loaded the boy into an ambulance.
entries.translation: Jothieth nochopo kendo keto rawera no e ambiulens.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His parents followed in their car, their hearts pounding with fear.
entries.translation: Jonyuolne noluwo tokni e gachgi, ka chunygi guecho kod luoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At the hospital, the doctors examined the boy and determined that he had a concussion and a broken leg.
entries.translation: E osuptal, lakteche norango rawerano kendo yudoni ne en kod hinyruok e obuongo kod tiende be notur.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They admitted him to the hospital and began treatment.
entries.translation: Ne girwake e osuptandno kendo chako miye thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy's parents stayed by his side, never leaving him alone.
entries.translation: Jonyuol rawerano noriyo e bathe kanyo ma ok giweye kende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They watched over him as he slept, their hearts filled with love and hope.
entries.translation: Ne girange sama onindo, ka chunygi opong' kod hera gi geno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Royalty," said the Blacksmith, "is a curious thing. It's a kind of magic, really.
entries.translation: "Bedo ruoth," jathep thep no nowacho, "en gima lich. Ochal gima tiende tek adier.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People get all worked up about it, and they don't even know why.
entries.translation: Ji temo matek fwaro tiende, kendo gikia kata gima omiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not as if kings and queens have any real power, these days. They're just figureheads.
entries.translation: En kagima tinde ruodhi kod mikachgi onge kod teko mathoth. Gin agina jotelo kanyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But people still seem to need them.
entries.translation: Kata kamano ji pod chal gima dwaro gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They need someone to look up to, someone to represent the idea of the nation." The Blacksmith paused.
entries.translation: Gidwaro ng'ato ma gi nyalo rango, ng'ato mochung' ne achiel mar piny." Jathep thep no ne oling'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I suppose it's a kind of comfort," he continued.
entries.translation: "Aparoni en ngima mayom," ne odhi mbele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "To know that there's someone out there who's better than you.
entries.translation: "Mondo ing'eni nitiere ng'ato oko kanyo ma ber moloyi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Someone who's got it all sorted out.
entries.translation: Ng'ato ma gik moko te oseik ne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Someone who can make the world a better place.
entries.translation: Ng'ato ma nyalo loso piny obed maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, it's all an illusion. But that doesn't make it any less important.
entries.translation: Adier, en aena lek. Kata kamano mano ok kete obed gima onge tiende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People need their illusions. They need to believe in something.
entries.translation: Ji dwaro lekgi. Onego giyieng' paro margi kuom gimoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if that something is a king or a queen, then so be it."
entries.translation: To ka gino en ruoth kata ruoth madhako, to obed abeda."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Blacksmith paused for a moment, then smiled.
entries.translation: Jathep thepno ne owe wuoyo matin, kae ne obuonjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Old Man and the Sea
entries.translation: Jaduong' moti kod nam ataro.
