entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Santiago, an old Cuban fisherman, has gone eighty-four days without catching a fish.
entries.translation: Santiago, jalupo moti maya Cuba, osedhi ndalo praboro gi ang'wen ka ok omako rech.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is the oldest man in the village, and the youngest, Manolin, no longer wants to fish with him because the old man is unlucky.
entries.translation: En e jago ma oti ahinya e gweng'no, to matin mogik, ma nyinge Manolin, ok dwar dhi lupo kode nikech jaduong'no hape rach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Santiago sets out in his skiff and hooks a giant marlin.
entries.translation: Odiechieng' achiel, Santiago ne owuok kod yie mare kendo mako rech mar marlin maduong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The marlin is so big that it pulls the skiff far out to sea.
entries.translation: Rech mar marlin no duong' ma oywayo yieno mabor ei nam.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Santiago fights the marlin for two days and nights, but he cannot bring it in.
entries.translation: Santiago yware kod rechno kuom odiechieng'e kod otieno ariyo, kata kamano ne ok onyal rwake ei yie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The marlin is too heavy, and the old man is too tired.
entries.translation: Rechno ne pek ahinya kendo jaduong'no ne ool ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, the marlin begins to tire.
entries.translation: Gikone, rechno ochako bedo mo ol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Santiago is able to get a harpoon into the marlin, and he kills it.
entries.translation: Santiago ne ochuoyo rechno kod tong', kendo nege.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But the marlin is so big that Santiago cannot bring it into the boat.
entries.translation: Kata kamano rechno ne duong' ahinya kendo Santiago ok nyal rwake ei yie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ties the marlin to the side of the boat and begins to row back to shore.
entries.translation: Otweyo rechno e bath yie kendo chako kwang' kochomo dho wath.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A school of sharks follows the boat, and they begin to eat the marlin.
entries.translation: Rech mathoth mag shak ne luwo yieno kendo gichako chamo rech mar marlin no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Santiago fights the sharks off, but he cannot stop them all.
entries.translation: Santiago riembore kod rech mag shak go, kata kamano ok onyal tamo giduto chamo reye mar marlin no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By the time he reaches shore, only the head and the tail of the marlin are left.
entries.translation: E sama ochopo e dho wath, mana wich kod ip ema odong' e reye mar marlin no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The police will likely take the person to the station and question him.
entries.translation: Obila go nenore ni biro tero jagono e steson margi kendo dayo dhoge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They will want to know where he got the wallet and why he was carrying it.
entries.translation: Gibiro dwaro ng'eyo kuma nene ogole kibeti no kendo gima omiyo ne oting'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the person cannot provide a satisfactory explanation, he may be arrested and charged with theft.
entries.translation: Ka jagono ok nyal chiwo duoko mowinjore, inyalo tweye kendo donjone gi keth mar kwele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the person is arrested, he will be taken to jail and held until his trial.
entries.translation: Ka otwe jagono, ibiro tere e jela kendo geng'ne nyaka yale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At his trial, the prosecution will have to prove beyond a reasonable doubt that he is guilty of theft.
entries.translation: E sama iyale, jomin wach nyaka bi chiu neno moromo nyiso ni en kod makosa mar kwelo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The defense will have the opportunity to present evidence and witnesses that may help to exonerate the person.
entries.translation: Okinde mag achich biro bedo kod thuolo mar chiwo neno kod joneno ma nyalo konyo golo jagono e kes.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the person is found guilty, he may be sentenced to jail time, probation, or community service.
entries.translation: Ka oyudni jagono ni kod ketho, inyalo tweye e jela, kete e thuolo ma iluwe kod obila, kata kete timo tije e kor gweng'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He may also be ordered to pay restitution to the victim of the theft.
entries.translation: Bende inyalo kete mondo ochul jago mane omayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, the person may be able to avoid criminal charges by entering into a diversion program.
entries.translation: E seche moko, jagono nyalo hepo chopo e nyim doho ka odonje chenro mar diversion.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Diversion programs are designed to help people who have committed minor crimes avoid the criminal justice system.
entries.translation: Chenro mag diversion gin chenro molosi mar konyo jogo ma omak kod makosa matindo tindo kuom yudo kum michiwe doho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a diversion program, the person may be required to complete community service, pay restitution, or attend counseling.
entries.translation: E chenro mar diversion, jagono inyalo ket mondo otim tije e gweng', chulo gima okwalo, kata donje chenro mar ng'ado rieko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the person is found not guilty, he will be released from jail and the charges against him will be dropped.
entries.translation: Ka ok oyud jagono kod ketho, ibiro gole e jela kendo wit oko bura ma odonjne godo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He will be able to go on with his life without a criminal record.
entries.translation: Obiro nyalo dhi nyime kod ngimane ma onge rekod moro amora mar keth ma oketne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to note that the above is just a general overview of what may happen to a presumed thief who is held by police.
entries.translation: Owinjore ing'e ma oler malo kanyono en mana gima nyalo timore ne jal ma odin kod obila odino ka ichich kode ni okwelo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The specific circumstances of each case will vary, and the outcome may depend on a number of factors, such as the evidence available, the person's criminal history, and the judge or jury's decision.
entries.translation: Gigo opogore moro ka moro kendo duoko biro luwore kod gik mopogore, kaka neno ma nitie, historia mar ketho ma jagono ni godo, kod bura mong'ad kod jang'ad bura.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The couple, a renowned linguist and a world-renowned pastry chef, had been trying for a baby for years.
entries.translation: Ji ariyogo, jadhum mong'ere kod jatedo mong'ere e piny ngima, osetemo manyo nyathi kuom higni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had been to every doctor and specialist they could find, but nothing seemed to work.
entries.translation: Gisedhe kuom lakteche duto kod jolony ma gi nyalo yudo, kata kamano ong'e gima kelone gi kony.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The linguist was starting to lose hope, and the pastry chef was worried that their reputation would be ruined if they couldn't have a child.
entries.translation: Geno mar jadhumno nosechako nimo, kendo jatedono ne oluor ni nying' gi biro kethore ka yudo nyathi otamogi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, the linguist was working on a new translation of a difficult poem when he had a breakthrough.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro, jadhumno ne loko wer moro ma tek to kanyo ema ne oyude rieko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He realized that the key to having a child was to find a way to combine their two passions.
entries.translation: Ne ofwenyo ni mondo ne gi yud nyathi ne nyaka giyud yo mar riwo gik moko ariyo mane gihero timo go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He called the pastry chef and told her his idea.
entries.translation: Ne oluongo jaode ma jatedono kendo nyise pache.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pastry chef was skeptical at first, but she agreed to give it a try.
entries.translation: Jatedono ne nigi to e parono mokuongo, kata kamano neoyie mar teme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They spent the next few months working on a new recipe for a cake that would be infused with the linguist's love of language and the pastry chef's love of baking.
entries.translation: Negi kao dweche matin bang'e ka gipango tedo kek mane dhi ting'o ranyisi mar dhum mar dichuo kod ranyisi mar hero tedo kek mar dhako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the cake was finally finished, they took it to the premier of a new play that the linguist was translating.
entries.translation: Kane otiek tedo kegno, negi tere e nyasi mar sidho tugo ma dichuo ne loko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They waited until the after-party, and then they cut the cake and served it to everyone.
entries.translation: Negi rito nyaka giko mar nyasi kae ne gi ng'ado kek kendo miyo ji duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The cake was a huge hit.
entries.translation: Kek no ne oyudo puoch malach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Everyone loved the taste, and they were all impressed by the story behind it.
entries.translation: Ji duto ne ohero mit mare kendo ne gi mor kod stori mane luwo kegno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hockey is a fast-paced, physical sport that is played on ice.
entries.translation: Tugo mar hockey en tugo ma itugo ewi pe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is played with two teams of six players each, with one goaltender.

entries.english: In the 15th century, the Portuguese arrived in Cameroon and established trade relations with the local people.
entries.translation: E senchari mar 15, oganda Portugal ne ochopo Cameroon kendo ne giketo winjruok mar ohala e kindgi ji oganda mane odak e aluora no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The region was later colonized by Germany in the 1880s, and it became a German colony known as Kamerun.
entries.translation: Bang'e to jo Jirman ema ne okao loch mar pinyno e higa mag pier aboro, kendo ne obedo pinyno mitayo gi jo Jirman kendo ne gichake ni Kamerun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During World War I, Cameroon was occupied by British and French forces, and it was divided between the two countries after the war.
entries.translation: E kinde mar Lweny Mokwongo mar Piny, kolwenj Ingresa gi France ema ne odak e piny Cameroon, kendo ne opoge e kind pinje ariyo go bang' lweny go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The British-controlled region became known as Southern Cameroons, while the French-controlled region became known as French Cameroon.
entries.translation: Aluora manenitie e buo loch mar jo Ingresa bang'e nong'ere kaka Cameroon ma Milambo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1960, Southern Cameroons became independent from Britain, and it merged with French Cameroon to form the Federal Republic of Cameroon.
entries.translation: E higa mar 1960, Cameroon ma Milambo ne oyudo loch kowuok e oganda Ingresa, kendo ne oriwre gi Cameroon ma itayo gi jo France eka giloso Piny Owacho mar Cameroon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1972, the federal system was abolished and Cameroon became a unitary state.
entries.translation: E higa mar 1972, chenro mar piny owacho no ne okethi kendo Cameroon ne obedo piny mariwo ji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cameroon has experienced a number of political and economic challenges in recent years.
entries.translation: Cameroon osekalo e pek mang'eny mag siasa kod yore yuto e kinde mokalo gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mystery surrounds disappearance of Eva Green.
entries.translation: Weche mopondo okwako lal mar Eva Green.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eva Green, a 25-year-old woman from London, has been missing for over a week.
entries.translation: Eva Green, miyo ma jahigni 25 mawuok e boma ma London, oselal kuom kinde mohingo wik achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was last seen on February 25th, leaving her apartment in the city's Notting Hill neighborhood.
entries.translation: Ne onene magiko tarik 25 de mar Ariyo, kowuok kare mar dak mayudre e aluora mar Notting Hill e boma no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Green is described as being 5'6" tall, with long brown hair and green eyes.
entries.translation: Bor mar Green en fut 5 gi inj 6, yie wiye bor to rabuor to tong wang'e en majan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was last seen wearing a black coat, jeans, and a white t-shirt.
entries.translation: Ne onene mogik korwako kot marateng', jins, kod tisat marachar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Police have said that they are concerned for Green's safety and are asking anyone with information about her whereabouts to come forward.
entries.translation: Polis owacho ni arita kwe mar Green chando wigi ahinya kendo gikwayo ng'ato ang'ata mading'e kama entiee mondo ogo lipot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Green's family and friends are desperate for news of her.
entries.translation: Anyuola kod osiepe Green odich ahinya gi weche manyiso kama entiee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They have been posting flyers and distributing missing person's posters around the city.
entries.translation: Gisebedo ka gibao otese kendo gikeyo posta mag milome mar ng'ama olal e boma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They have also set up a Facebook page to help spread the word about her disappearance.
entries.translation: Bende giseyao oboke mar Facebook mondo gikony e lando lam mare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The police have not yet released any information about possible suspects or motives in Green's disappearance.
entries.translation: Polis pok ogolo lendo moro amora motudre gi achije mitudo gi lal mare kata gima omiyo Green olal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are asking anyone with information to come forward, no matter how small.
entries.translation: Gikwayo ng'ato ang'ata madibed ni ong'eyo gimoro amora mondo obi ogo lupot, ka okodeo tin mar wach mong'eyo no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Green's disappearance is a mystery, but her family and friends are hopeful that she will be found safe and sound.
entries.translation: Lal mar Green en gino magalagala, makmana ni anyuola kod osiepe meke nigi geno ni ibiro yude ka ongima kendo en kare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trimming your dog's nails is a necessary part of grooming, but it can be a daunting task for some pet owners.
entries.translation: Ng'ado kok guogi en okang' maduong' e duse, makmana ni onyalo bedo tich matek ne jok moko ma opidho le.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're not sure how to trim your dog's nails, don't worry - it's easier than you think.
entries.translation: Ka iongee adier kod kaka inyalo ng'ado koke guogi, kik ibed gi kibach - en gima yot moloyo kaka ne iparo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first step is to gather your supplies.
entries.translation: Okang' mokwongo en choko gigo ma idwaro tiyo go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You'll need a pair of sharp scissors or a nail clipper, a styptic powder or pencil, and a towel.
entries.translation: Ibiro dwaro makas kata kata gir ng'ado kogno, poda kata pensil mar chungo chuer mar remo, kod taulo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Next, you'll need to clip your dog's nails in a comfortable place.
entries.translation: Bang'e, ibiro ng'ado koke guogi kama okan ohinyre ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If your dog is nervous, try clipping their nails in a quiet room where they can't see out the window.
entries.translation: Ka guogi oluor, tem ng'ado koke e ot maongee koko kendo dak oneye drisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You may also want to have someone help you hold your dog still.
entries.translation: Bende inyalo dwaro mondo ng'ato okonyi makoguogi no ba diye kamoro achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To trim your dog's nails, start by gently grasping their paw.
entries.translation: Mondo ing'ad koke guogi, chak kod mako kokene e yoo mamuol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, use your scissors or clippers to clip the tip of the nail.
entries.translation: Bang'e, ti kod makas mari mondo ing'ad wi koke go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be careful not to cut too short, as this can cause pain and bleeding.
entries.translation: Bed motang' mondo kik ing'ade machiek ahinya, mae nyalo kelo rem gi miyo remo ochuer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you do cut your dog's nail too short, apply a styptic powder or pencil to stop the bleeding.
entries.translation: Ka ing'ado kok guogi machiek ahinya, ti kod poda kata pensil mar chungo chuer mondo remo kik chuer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Styptic powders and pencils are available at most pet stores.
entries.translation: Poda kod pensil mar chungo remo machuer yudore e duke mang'eny mag lee mipidho e dala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you've trimmed all of your dog's nails, be sure to reward them with a treat.
entries.translation: Ka iseng'ado koke tee mag guogi, ne ni igoyone erokamano kokalo kod range maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trimming nails can be a stressful experience for some dogs, so it's important to make it a positive experience.
entries.translation: Ng'ado kogno nyalo bedo gino matek ahinya ne guogi moko, omiyo en gima duong' ka ikete obedo ondambo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With a little practice, you'll be able to trim your dog's nails like a pro.
entries.translation: Kokalo kuom timo orako matin, ibiro bedo ni inyalo ng'ado koke guokgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And your dog will be happy to have their nails trimmed, too!
entries.translation: Kendo guogi biro bedo mamor matek nikech ong'adne koke, maber!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are a few additional tips for trimming your dog's nails:
entries.translation: Magi gin moko kuom gigo ma inyalo timo e sama ing'ado ne guogi koke:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Start by trimming the nails on your dog's front paws.
entries.translation: * Chak kod ng'ado koke guogi mantie e tiendene ma mbele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is usually the easiest place to start.
entries.translation: Mae ega kama yot mogik mar chako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * If your dog is nervous, try trimming their nails one at a time.
entries.translation: * Ka guogi oluor, tem ng'ado koke achiel ka achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Be sure to trim the nails evenly.
entries.translation: * Ne ni ing'ado kogno go maromre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You don't want one nail to be shorter than the others.
entries.translation: Okidwar ni kogno achiel obed machiek moloyo moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * If you're not sure how to trim your dog's nails, ask your veterinarian or a groomer for help.
entries.translation: * Ka okin gi adiera mar kaka ing'ado koke guok, kwa kony kowuok kuom laktar mar lee kata jalony mar ng'ado koke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With a little care and attention, you can keep your dog's nails trimmed and healthy.
entries.translation: Ka ibedo akicha to iketo pachi kanyo, inyalo ng'ado koke guogi maber kendo ritogi maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ivory Coast is a country in West Africa that has been in the midst of a civil war since 2010.
entries.translation: Piny Ivory Coast en piny mayudre e Afrika ma Yimbo to osebedo e lweny mar jopiny giwegi chakre higa mar 2010.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The conflict began after incumbent president Laurent Gbagbo refused to accept defeat in the 2010 presidential election.
entries.translation: Ywarruok no ne ochakre bang' ker manene nitie e loch, Laurent Gbagbo, ne otamre yie loch e yiero maduong' mar ker mar 2010.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gbagbo was eventually ousted by forces loyal to Alassane Ouattara, who was declared the winner of the election.
entries.translation: Gikone to jolweny mane omakre gi Alassane Ouattara ne othicho Gbagbo oko mar loch, kendo ne gilando Allassane Ouattara kaka jaloch mar yiero no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the conflict has continued, with sporadic violence breaking out in the country.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, ywarruok no osedhi nyime, ka lweny ma kinde ka kinde wuokga e piny no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2017, there were hopes that the country would finally be able to move on from the civil war.
entries.translation: E higa mar 2017, ne nitie geno ni pinyno gikone to ne nyalo tiekre gi weche lweny mag jopiny giwegi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, these hopes were dashed when Gbagbo was acquitted of charges of crimes against humanity by the International Criminal Court.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, geno go ne orumo nono sama Doho Mar Piny Ngima ne ong'ado ni Gbagbo ne ongee ketho mag rocho ratich dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gbagbo's acquittal was seen as a blow to the peace process, and it led to renewed violence in the country.
entries.translation: Wech mane owego Gbagbo no ne oduoko chien okang' mar kelo kwe e pinyno, kendo ne okelo lweny manyien e pinyno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2018, the United Nations Security Council imposed sanctions on Gbagbo and his supporters.
entries.translation: E higa mar 2018, Duol Mochung'ne Arita Kwe e Piny Ngima ne oketo kum gi chike ne Gbagbo kod johera meke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sanctions were aimed at pressuring Gbagbo to end his support for violence in the country.
entries.translation: Kum go ne oketo mondo othung' Gbagbo mondo otiek sir ma omiyo lweny e piny no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sanctions have had some success, and there has been a decrease in violence in Ivory Coast since they were imposed.
entries.translation: Kum go ne okelo olemo moko, kendo lweny osebedo kadok piny e Ivory Coast chakre ne ket kum go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the country is still far from stable.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, piny no podi bor gi yudo kwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different ways to do laundry, from using a traditional washing machine and dryer to more eco-friendly methods like hand washing and line drying.
entries.translation: Nitie yore mang'eny mopogre opogre mag luoko lewni, kochakre gi tiyo gi masin manyachon mar luoko kod thuoyo lewni nyaka yore makonyo e rito aluora kaka luoko lewni gi lwedo kod moyo gi e thol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way to do laundry without using a machine is to hand wash your clothes in a basin or sink.
entries.translation: Yo achiel mar luoko lewni ka okitiyo gi masin en luoko lepi gi lweti e besen kata sink.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To do this, fill the basin with warm water and add a small amount of laundry detergent.
entries.translation: Mi mondo itim mae, ket pi maliet e besen kendo imed sabun mar luoko lewni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Soak your clothes for a few minutes, then scrub them with a washcloth or brush.
entries.translation: Bud lepi kuom dakika matin, bang'e to irudhgi kaitiyo kod otamba mar luoko lewni kata bras.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rinse your clothes thoroughly in clean water, then wring them out.
entries.translation: Law lepi go maber e pi maler, kasto ibigi maber mondo pi owuog.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hang your clothes to dry on a clothesline or drying rack.
entries.translation: Mo lepi e thol kata rak amr moyo lewni mondo githuo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another option is to use a washing machine without a dryer.
entries.translation: Yo moro machielo en tiyo gi masin mar luoko lewni maongee masin mar thuoyo lewni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can save energy and money, but it does require more time and effort.
entries.translation: Mae nyalo kuongo stima kod pesa, makmana ni odwaro thuolo malach kod kinda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To wash clothes in a machine without a dryer, fill the machine with water and add laundry detergent.
entries.translation: Mi mondo iluok lewni e masin maongee masind thuoyo lewni, pong' masindno gi pi bang'e to imed sabund luoko lewni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Set the machine to the appropriate cycle, then start it.
entries.translation: Ket masin mondo oluorre e okang' ma idwaro, bang'e to imok masin ochak luoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the cycle is complete, remove your clothes from the machine and hang them to dry.
entries.translation: Ka masin oseluorre ba ochung', gol lewni e masin mondo imogi e thol githuo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you live in an area with a lot of rain, you may be able to use the rain to help you dry your clothes.
entries.translation: Ka idak e aluora ma koth ng'eny ye, inyalo tiyo gi koth mondo okonyi thuoyo lepi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hang your clothes on a clothesline outside in the rain.
entries.translation: Mo lepi e thol mantie oko e koth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the beginning, there was only darkness.
entries.translation: E chakruok, ne nitie mudho kende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The universe was a vast, empty void.
entries.translation: Piny ne duong' ahinya to ne oongee gimoro amora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, out of the darkness, came a spark.
entries.translation: Bang'e, ei mudho no, ler mar mach ne oneno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This spark was the first sign of life in the universe.
entries.translation: Ler mar mach no ema ne en ranyisi mokuongo mar ngima e piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It grew and expanded, becoming a small ball of fire.
entries.translation: Ne odongre ba obedo malach, ba obedo opira matin mar mach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This ball of fire was the sun.
entries.translation: Opira mar mach ni ne en chieng'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Around the sun, the planets began to form.
entries.translation: E aluora mar chieng', planet ne ochako losre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Earth was the third planet from the sun.
entries.translation: Piny ema ne en planet mar adek kowuok e chineg'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a small, rocky planet with a thin atmosphere.
entries.translation: Ne en planet matin manigi lwanda mang'eny to kor lwasi mare ne tin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the Earth, the first living things began to appear.
entries.translation: E Piny, gik mokwongo mantie gi ngima ne ochako neno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These were simple organisms, such as bacteria and algae.
entries.translation: Magi ne gin chuech matindo, kaka bakteria kod oloha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Over time, these organisms evolved into more complex forms of life, such as plants and animals.
entries.translation: Mos mos, chuech hi ne odongo ba obedo kido mag ngima makorgi tek, kaka yien kod le.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first humans appeared on Earth about 200,000 years ago.
entries.translation: Dhano mokwongo ne oneno e Piny madirom higni 200,000 mokalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Humans have evolved and developed to become the dominant species on Earth.
entries.translation: Dhano osebedo gi lokruok kendo goyo okang' ba obedo gi loch maduong' ewi kido mar yien gi le e Piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The universe is still expanding and evolving.
entries.translation: Piny gi polo podi medo bedo malach kendo bedo gi lokruok maduong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Scientists believe that it will continue to expand for billions of years.
entries.translation: Josayans oyie ni obiro medo yarre kuom higni tara gi gana mabiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eventually, the universe will reach a point where it can no longer expand.
entries.translation: Gikone, piny gi polo biro chopo kama dak omed yarre kendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At this point, the universe will begin to contract.
entries.translation: E okanga' ni, piny gi polo biro chako mich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eventually, the universe will collapse in on itself and disappear.
entries.translation: Gikone, piny gi polo biro lwar kuome en owuon kendo olal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even though the universe may end, the story of life will continue.
entries.translation: To kata kamano ka obedo ni piny gi polo nyalo rumo, sigana mar ngima to biro dhi nyime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm concerned about the environment and the impact that climate change is having on our planet.
entries.translation: Adewo aluora kod gigo ma lokruok mar kor lwasi kelo e piny wa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm also a big fan of technology and gadgets, so I'm always looking for ways to reduce my carbon footprint without sacrificing my lifestyle.
entries.translation: Bende an jahera maduong' mar lony manyasani kod masinde manyasani, omiyo kinde duto amanyo ga yore mag duoko piny muya marach migolo gi gigo ma dhano timo ma okochuna ni aloko yor ngima mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: That's why I'm so excited about renewable and alternative energy sources.
entries.translation: Mano e gima omiyo amor ahinya gi yore mag inyalo tigo kendo mag loso stima kod yore mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Renewable energy is energy that comes from sources that are naturally replenished, such as solar, wind, and water power.
entries.translation: Stima ma inyalo los kendo en stima mawuok e gigo ma ok ochwe kendo medre kendgi, kaka chieng', yamo, kod pi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alternative energy is energy that comes from sources that are not traditionally used for power generation, such as biomass and geothermal energy.
entries.translation: Stima mawuok e yo machielo en stima mawuok e yore ma oktigago ahinya e loso stima, magi gin kaka stima molos gi lee gi yien motop kod stima miloso gi liet mawuok e buo piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Both renewable and alternative energy sources are clean and sustainable, meaning they don't produce greenhouse gases or other pollutants.
entries.translation: Yore mag loso stima ma inyalo los kendo kod yore mamoko gin yore maler kendo manyalo dak, manyiso ni ok gigol muya mochido kata gik moko machido muya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the best ways to make a difference is to switch to renewable energy sources for your home.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom yore mag kelo pogruok en timo lokruok kendo ichak tiyo gi yore mag loso stima ma inyalo ti go kendo e dalani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can do this by installing solar panels on your roof, buying a wind turbine, or signing up for a green power plan from your utility company.
entries.translation: Inyalo timo mae kokalo kuom keto sola e tado mar odi, nyieo gigo ma irundo gi chieng' mondo olos stima, kata ndikri e chenro mar tiyo gi stima ma oknjaw aluora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also reduce your energy consumption by unplugging appliances when you're not using them, turning off the lights when you leave a room, and using energy-efficient appliances.
entries.translation: Bende inyalo duoko piny stima ma itiyo go kokalo kuom golo e mach masinde e saa ma okiti kodgi, simo taya ka iwuok e ot, kod tiyo kod masinde ma okcham mach mang'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The old wooden boat sat on the shore, its sails furled and its hull weathered by the sun and the rain.
entries.translation: Yie motii ma olos gi bao ne obet e dho nam, tanga meke ne oban maber kendo dende ne oti nikech chieng' kod koth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It had seen many years of service, carrying its owners on voyages to far-off lands.
entries.translation: Higni mang'eny osekalo ka itiyo kode, ka oting'o wege ka otero e safar madhi maboyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But now, it was retired, its days of sailing over.
entries.translation: To sani, osewee tiyo kode, odiechienge meke mag tiyo oserumo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young boy named Thomas came to the beach.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro, wuoyi matin miluongo ni Thomas ne obiro e dho nam.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had heard stories about the old boat, and he was eager to see it for himself.
entries.translation: Ne owinjo mbaka mang'eny ewi yie ma oti no, kendo ne en gi siso mare nene en owuon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When he saw the boat, he was amazed by its size and its beauty.
entries.translation: Kane oneno yieno, ne omor ahinya kod duong' kod ber mar yie no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He could imagine himself sailing off on adventures in the vast ocean.
entries.translation: Pache ne nyalo parone kaka ne onyalo tiyo gi yie no ka odhi e safar mopogre e nam ataro no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thomas asked the owner of the boat if he could take a closer look.
entries.translation: Thomas ne openjo wuon yie no kane onyalo onyalo sudo machiegni gi yieno mondo onene maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The owner smiled and said, "Of course you can. Come aboard!"
entries.translation: Wuon yieno ne obuonje kendo owacho ni, "Eeh inyalo. Bi iidhe!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thomas climbed into the boat and sat down in the captain's chair.
entries.translation: Thomas ne oidho yieno ba obet piny e komb jariemb yie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He looked out over the water and imagined himself sailing away to a faraway land.
entries.translation: Ne ong'iyo pi ba pache oparre kaka en owuon oriembo yieno ka odhi kode mabor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The owner of the boat watched Thomas for a moment, then said, "Do you want to learn how to sail?"
entries.translation: Wuon yieno ne ong'iyo Thomas kuom thuolo matin, bang'e to ne openje ni, "Bende idwaro puonjri riembo yie?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thomas' eyes widened "Yes" he said.
entries.translation: Wenge Thomas ne oyawre malach kasto owacho ni "Ee".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The owner of the boat smiled again.
entries.translation: Wuon yieno ne obuonjo kendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Then I'll teach you," he said.
entries.translation: "Abiro puonji," ne owacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Scene: Two friends, Jasmine and Joseph, are sitting at a coffee shop.
entries.translation: Kama gimoro timreye: Osiepe ariyo, Jasmine kod Joseph, obet kama iuseye kahawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jasmine: I'm so glad you could meet me today, Joseph.
entries.translation: Jasmine: Amor ni iromo koda kawuono, Joseph.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I really need your help.
entries.translation: Adwaro kony mari ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Joseph: Anything for you, Jasmine.
entries.translation: Joseph: Adhi timoni gimoro amora ma idwaro, Jasmine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What's going on?
entries.translation: Ang'o matimre?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jasmine: I'm having a really tough time at work.
entries.translation: Jasmine: An gi pek ahinya e tich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm not sure if I'm going to be able to keep my job.
entries.translation: Okan gi adier ka abiro nyalo dhi nyime gi tija.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Joseph: Oh no, Jasmine.
entries.translation: Joseph: Mayie, Jasmine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so sorry to hear that.
entries.translation: Agoyo mos kuom mano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jasmine: It's a long story.
entries.translation: Jasmine: En mbaka mabor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But basically, my boss is really unfair to me.
entries.translation: To ahinya ahinya, jatenda oktimna gima kare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's always picking on me and making me do all the worst jobs.
entries.translation: An ema osiko oyiera ga kendo oketa an ema atimo tije tu maricho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And she's not even giving me a fair chance.
entries.translation: To ok omiya kata thuolo makare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Joseph: That's terrible, Jasmine.
entries.translation: Joseph: Mano gima rach ahinya, Jasmine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I can't believe she's treating you like that.
entries.translation: Okanyal yie ni otimoni kamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jasmine: I know.
entries.translation: Jasmine: Ang'eyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so stressed out about it.
entries.translation: An gi paro mang'eny ewi wachno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I don't know what to do.
entries.translation: Akia gima atim.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Joseph: Well, first of all, you need to take a deep breath and calm down.
entries.translation: Joseph: Kare, mokwongo, ber ka igamo muya mang'eny bang'e to ibed gi chuny mokwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The smell of fresh-baked bread wafted through the air as the baker pulled a tray of golden brown loaves from the oven.
entries.translation: Suya mar mkate ma eka oa ted ne okwako muya esama jated mkate ne ogolo tre mantie gi mkate ma ochier marabuor matartar e oven.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He carefully set them on a cooling rack and smiled, pleased with his work.
entries.translation: Ne ochano gi maber e rak mar kweyogi kendo ne obuonjo, ka omor gi tije.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The loaves were perfectly browned and had a delicious aroma that made his mouth water.
entries.translation: Mkate go ne rabuor maber kendo ne gin gi suya mamit ahinya mane omiyo olaw omol e dhoge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He couldn't wait to try one!
entries.translation: Ne dak orit sama odhi bilo achiel!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baker cut a slice of bread and took a bite.
entries.translation: Jated mkate no ne ong'edo slais mar mkate kasto okayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was even better than he had imagined, with a soft, chewy texture and a rich, flavorful taste.
entries.translation: Ne ober ahinya moloyo kata kaka ne oparo, ne oyom, to onyamre maber kendo ne en gi ndhandh mamit ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He closed his eyes and savored the moment, enjoying the feeling of contentment that came from eating something so delicious.
entries.translation: Ne omiyo wang'e kendo ne omor gi okang' no, ka owinjo mit mar mor mawuok e cham gimoro mamit.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baker knew that he was lucky to have the ability to bake such delicious bread.
entries.translation: Jated mkate no ne ong'eyo ni ne en gi haw maber mar bedo gi nyalo mar loso mkate mamit aduwa kamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He took pride in his work and was always happy to share his creations with others.
entries.translation: Ne omor gi tije kendo kinde duto ne omor gi miyo jomoko gik ma oloso go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The type of fish you choose will depend on your personal preferences and the intended use for the fish.
entries.translation: Kido mar rech ma iyiero biro luwore kod gigo ma ihero in iwuon kaachiel gi gima idwaro timo gi rech no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are looking for a fish that is high in omega-3 fatty acids, then you may want to choose a wild river fish.
entries.translation: Ka imanyo rech ma ng'eny gi asid mantie gi mo ma idendo ni omega-3, to kara inyalo dwaro yiero rech ma achach mowuok e aora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fish are typically lower in contaminants than farm-raised fish.
entries.translation: Rech gi ahinya ahinya gitin gi kwiri moloyo rech ma opidh e kar pidho rech.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, wild river fish can be more expensive and difficult to find.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, rech ma achach mowuok e aora nyalo bedo ni beche tek ahinya to yudogi bee tek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are looking for a fish that is mild in flavor and easy to cook, then you may want to choose a calm lake fish.
entries.translation: Ka imanyo rech ma ndhandhu ne ni diere to oyot tedo, mano inyalo dwaro yiero rech mamuol moyudre e nam.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fish are typically not as high in omega-3 fatty acids as wild river fish, but they are still a good source of protein and other nutrients.
entries.translation: Rechgi ahinya ahinya ok ging'eny gi asid manigi mo ma idendo ni omega-3 kaka rech ma achach mawuok e aora, makmana ni podi gibe gin gi protein gi chiemo mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Calm lake fish are also typically more affordable and easier to find than wild river fish.
entries.translation: Rech ma obolre mawuok e nam bende ng'eny ne beche yot kendo oyot yudo moloyo rech ma achach mogol e aora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are looking for a fish that is low in cost and easy to care for, then you may want to choose a stock pond farm raised variety.
entries.translation: Ka imanyo rech ma beche yot kendo rite bee yot, kare inyalo dwaro yiero rech ma opidh e soko mar pidho rech.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fish are typically raised in controlled environments and are fed a diet that is designed to promote growth.
entries.translation: Rech gi ng'eny ne opidh gi e aluora ma otaa kendo omigi chiemo ma ber gi konyo e dongo margi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stock pond farm raised fish are typically not as high in omega-3 fatty acids as wild river or calm lake fish, but they are still a good source of protein and other nutrients.
entries.translation: Rech ma opidh e soko mar pidho rech ok ng'eny gi omega-3 kaka rech ma achach mogol e aora kata rech mamuol ma omak e nam, makmana ni podi gin gi protein kod chiemo mamoko e okang' maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ultimately, the best type of fish for you will depend on your individual needs and preferences.
entries.translation: Gikone, rech maber kodi biro luwore kod dwaro meki in iwuon kaachiel gi gigo ma ihero.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do some research to learn more about the different types of fish available and choose the one that is right for you.
entries.translation: Tim nonro mondo ing'e weche mathoth ewi yore mopogre mag rech mayudre kendo iyier rech maber kodi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Unsolved mysteries have captured the public's imagination for centuries.
entries.translation: Weche matek ng'eyo mapok oloo okwako paro mar oganda kuom higni mang'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the disappearance of Amelia Earhart to the identity of Jack the Ripper, these cases have left us wondering what really happened.
entries.translation: Kochakre e lal mar Amelia Earhart nyaka e fwenyruok mar Jack the Ripper, kes gi owewa ka waum nono ni ang'o mane otimre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While some of these mysteries may never be solved, they continue to fascinate us because they offer a glimpse into the unknown.
entries.translation: E sama moko kuom weche matiendgi tekgi oknyal tiek, gidhi nyime morowa nikech gimiyowa ga wang'eyo weche machuok e gigo ma ok wang'eyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most famous unsolved mysteries is the disappearance of Amelia Earhart.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gigo mong'ere ahinya e weche matek ng'eyo en lal mar Amelia Earhart.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earhart was an American aviator who became the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic Ocean.
entries.translation: Earhart ne en jariemb ndege mawuok e piny Amerka kendo en ema ne en miyo mokuongo riembo ndege kende kokalo Nam Ataro mar Atlantic.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1937, she set out on an around-the-world flight with navigator Fred Noonan.
entries.translation: E higa mar 1937, ne ochano wuoth mar luoro piny ngima kaen gi Fred Noonan maen jalony mar ng'eyo yore miluwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pair disappeared over the Pacific Ocean on July 2, 1937, and their fate remains unknown.
entries.translation: Ji ariyo go ne olal ewi Nam Ataro mar Pasifik tarik 2 dwe mar Abiriyo higa mar 1937, kendo ongee ng'ama ong'eyo kama gintiee nyaka sani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many theories about what happened to Earhart and Noonan.
entries.translation: Nitie weche mang'eny mosewuok katemo lero gima ne otimre ne Earhart kod Noonan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some believe that they crashed into the ocean, while others believe that they were captured by the Japanese.
entries.translation: Jok moko oyie ni ne gilwar e nam ataro no, e sama moko to oyie ni jo piny Japan ne omakogi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Still others believe that they deliberately disappeared in order to escape the public eye.
entries.translation: Jomoko bende oyie ni ne gilal ka ging'eyo mondo gipond ne oganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mystery of Earhart's disappearance has been the subject of books, articles, and documentaries.
entries.translation: Galagala mar lal mar Earhart osebedo wach maduong' e buge, gigo mondiki, kod weche malero gimoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2017, a team of researchers announced that they had found evidence that Earhart's plane crashed on a remote island in the Pacific Ocean.
entries.translation: E higa mar 2017, kweth mar jotim nonro ne olando ni ne giyudo ranyisi manyiso ni ndek Earhart ne olwar e chula moro e Nam Ataro mar Pasifik.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Giant wolf spiders are the largest species of arachnid in the world, with some individuals reaching lengths of over 12 inches.
entries.translation: Mbui madongo mag ondieg sudhe e kido madongo mogik mag kuom lee mantie gi tielo aboro, moko kuomgi nyalo chopo kata bor mar inje 12.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are found in tropical rainforests around the world, and are known for their aggressive behavior and venomous bite.
entries.translation: Giyudore e gwenge mayudo koth mang'eny e piny ngima, kendo ging'ere kod timgi mager kod kiro sum seche magikacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite their fearsome reputation, giant wolf spiders are actually quite docile creatures.
entries.translation: Ka owere gi ger margi maging'ere go, mbui madongo gi gin chuech mamuol ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are not aggressive towards humans unless they are provoked, and their venom is not typically fatal to humans.
entries.translation: Okgiger gi dhano makmana ka okwinygi, kendo sum margi ahinya ahinya oknyal nego dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, their bite can be quite painful, and can cause swelling, redness, and itching.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, ka gikayi to iwanyo winjo rem ahinya, kendo kama gikayo no nyalo kuot, bedo makwar, kod ili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Giant wolf spiders are excellent climbers, and can use their silk to create webs that can reach up to 30 feet in length.
entries.translation: Mbui madongo gi ber e idho gikmoko, kendo ginyalo tiyo gi thonde gi e loso agaja mag gi ma bor mare nyalo chopo nyaka fut 30.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also very fast runners, and can move at speeds of up to 10 miles per hour.
entries.translation: Bende giringo ga matek ahinya, kendo ginyalo ringo nyaka mail 10 e saa achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Due to their size, speed, and climbing ability, giant wolf spiders are a popular choice for people who want to experience the thrill of riding a giant arachnid.
entries.translation: Nikech duong', ng'wech, kofi nyalo gi mar idho gikmoko, mbui madongo gi ong'ere ahinya ni gin yiero mar ji madwaro lony mar idho kendo wuotho gi le maduong' matiende aboro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to remember that these creatures are wild animals, and should be treated with respect.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, en gima duong' mondo ipar ni chuech gi gin lee mag bungu, kendo ber ka imiyogi luor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are thinking about riding a giant wolf spider, it is important to do your research and make sure that you are properly prepared.
entries.translation: Ka ne iparo mar idho mbui maduong', en gima duong' mondo itim nonro mari maber kendo ine ni itimo ikruok maber moloyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also make sure that you have the proper equipment, such as a harness and a leash.
entries.translation: Bende ber ka ineno ni in gi gigo madwarore, kaka msip mar tweye kod thol mar taye go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you are properly prepared, you can begin your journey by finding a suitable giant wolf spider.
entries.translation: Bang' ka iseiko gikmoko tee madwarore, inyalo chako wuoth mari kochakre kod yudo mbui maduong' maber kodi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have found a spider, you can approach it slowly and gently.
entries.translation: Bang' ka iseyudo mbui, inyalo dhi ire mosmos kendo e yo mamuol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the spider is comfortable with you, you can slowly climb onto its back.
entries.translation: Bang' ka mbui no osebedo ni winjre kodi maber, inyalo idho toke mosmos.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you are on the spider's back, you can hold on tightly and enjoy the ride.
entries.translation: Bang' ka iseidho to mbui no, inyalo make matek kendo iwinj maber sama iwuotho kode.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The spider will use its silk to create a web that will support you as you ride.
entries.translation: Mbui no biro tiyo gi tonde e loso agajaagaja mabiro siri sama iwuotho kode.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Riding a giant wolf spider is an unforgettable experience.
entries.translation: Idho e tok mbui maduong' kendo wuotho kode en okang' no mawiyi dak wil go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a great way to experience the thrill of the wild, and to get up close and personal with one of the world's most fascinating creatures.
entries.translation: En yo maber mar winjo mor mar bungu, kendo chopo machiegni ahinya in iwuon gi achiel kuom chuech mamoro ji e piny ngima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: I'm an actor and a furniture designer. I'm also passionate about flowers, especially those that bloom in the winter.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: An jatugo mar sinema kendo an ng'ama loso ga gik bao. Bende ahero weche maua, ahinya ahinya maua matwi ga maber e kinde koyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Interviewer: What drew you to acting and furniture design?
entries.translation: Ng'ama dayo dhok: Ang'o mane omiyo idonjo e tugo sinema kod loso gik molos gi bao?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: I've always loved performing and creating things.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: Asebedo ka ahero timo kod loso gikmoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acting allows me to express myself creatively, and furniture design allows me to use my creativity to make something beautiful and functional.
entries.translation: Tugo sinema yiena ga mondo anyis pacha kokalo e yor chueyo gikmoko, kendo loso gik molos gi bao miya ga thuolo mar tiyo gi mich mara mar chueyo gikmoko mondo alos gimoro maber kendo matiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Interviewer: What are some of the challenges you've faced as an actor and a furniture designer?
entries.translation: Ng'ama dayo dhok: Moko kuom weche matek ma iserado go kaka jatug sinema kod kaka fundi bao gin mage?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: One of the challenges I've faced as an actor is the lack of diversity in the industry.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: Achiel kuom gigo matek ma aseradho go kaka jatugo sinema en bedo ni gikmoko oktim e yore mopogre opogre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've often been told that I'm not the right type for a role because of my race or ethnicity.
entries.translation: Osenyisa mang'eny ni okaber gi migao moro e tuk sinema nikech range mar denda kata dhoot ma awuokye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a furniture designer, I've faced the challenge of breaking into a male-dominated industry.
entries.translation: Kaka jalos gikmoko gi bao, aserodhno gi weche matek mag donjo kendo goyo okang' maber e tich ma thothne itimo gi joma chuo ni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Interviewer: How have you overcome these challenges?
entries.translation: Ng'ama dayo dhok: Ere kaka iseloyo weche matek gi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: I've overcome these challenges by working hard and never giving up.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: Aseloyo weche matek gi kokalo kuom tiyo matek kod bedo gi kinda maongee weyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Translation has many benefits, including increasing the relative value of content, improving accessibility, and opening up new markets.
entries.translation: Loko dhok nigi ber mang'eny, kaka medo ber mar weche ma ilosoye, bero yudruok mar wach, kod yao chiro manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When content is translated, it becomes accessible to a wider audience, which can lead to increased sales and profits.
entries.translation: Ka olok weche, weche go chopo ne dhano mang'eny mopogre, kendo mae nyalo kelo medruok mar okang' mar uso kod ohala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, translation can help to build relationships with customers in other countries and cultures.
entries.translation: Ewi mano, loko nyalo konyo e gero tudruok maber gi jonyiepo mawuok e pinj moko kata e ogendni mamoko.
