entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By displaying content in multiple languages, businesses can show that they are committed to reaching a global audience.
entries.translation: Kuom nyiso weche e dhok mamoko, ohelni nyalo nyiso ni gichiwre mar chopo ne dhano mayudre e piny ngima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can help to build trust and credibility with potential customers.
entries.translation: Mae nyalo konyo e gero geno e kind jouso gi jonyiepo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some specific examples of how translation has benefited businesses: * A small business that sells handmade jewelry translated its website into Spanish, French, and German.
entries.translation: Magi e moko kuom ranyisi sie mag kaka loko dhok osekonyo ohelni: * Ohala matin mauso gik dusruok molos gi lwedo ne oloko dhok ma otigo e mbui margi ba obet e dho jo Spain, France, kod Jirman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result, it saw a significant increase in sales from international customers * A large corporation that manufactures medical devices translated its product manuals into multiple languages.
entries.translation: Koluwore kod mano, uso ne omedre ahinya kowuok e jonyiepo mawuok e pinje mamoko * Riwruok maduong' maloso ga gige thieth ne oloko dhok malero kaka itiyo gi gige gi kendo gibedo e dhok mang'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This helped to reach people in need who would not have otherwise been able to access the organization's resources.
entries.translation: Mae ne okonyogi chopo ni ji maorem to dak ne giyudo kony kowuok e duondno kane ok olok e dhok magiwinjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Translation is a powerful tool that can help businesses to grow and succeed.
entries.translation: Loko dhok en gino manigi teko manyalo konyo ohelni dongre kendo timo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because we are all created in God's image, and God is the essence of rationality and order.
entries.translation: Mae en nikech waduto te ne ochuewa e kido mar Nyasaye, kendo Nyasaye e gima omiyo paro makare kod chike nitie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we live in accordance with our true nature, we are able to experience peace and harmony.
entries.translation: Ka wadak kaluwore kod chalwa mar adier, wanyalo bedo gi kwe kod bedo e achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, when we allow our thoughts and actions to become chaotic and inconsistent, we experience inner conflict and turmoil.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, ka wayie ne parowa kod timbewa mondo okel anjao kendo gibed mopogre opogre, wabedo gi ywaruok kod gwandruok eiwa wan wawegi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many ways to achieve internal consistency.
entries.translation: Nitie yore mang'eny mag bedo gi chalruok marwa wawegi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way is to live according to our values.
entries.translation: Yo achiel en dak kaluwore kod chikewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we know what is important to us and we make choices that are consistent with those values, we feel a sense of purpose and direction.
entries.translation: Ka wang'eyo gima duong' ne wa kendo watimo yiero maluwore kod chike go, wawinjo ni watimo gima kare kendo wan e yo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to achieve internal consistency is to be honest with ourselves about our strengths and weaknesses.
entries.translation: Yo machielo mar bedo gi chalruok e iyi en bedo ja adiera ne wan wawegi ewi gigo ma wanyalo timo maber kod gigo mawan ye gi pek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we are aware of our true selves, we can make choices that are in alignment with our authentic nature.
entries.translation: Ka wang'ere wan wawegi, wanyalo timo yiero maluwore kod chal marwa mar adier.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, achieving internal consistency is not always easy.
entries.translation: Kuom adier, bedo gi chalruok kuomi kinde duto oken ga gima yot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There will be times when we make mistakes or when we are faced with difficult choices.
entries.translation: Biro bedo kinde ma watimo ketho kata sama wayudo yiero matek timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, if we are willing to strive for consistency, we will eventually find our way back to peace and harmony.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, ka wadwaro mondo wayud chalruok, gikone wabiro yudo yo mawachopo go e kwe gi bedo e achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vimes was having a headache.
entries.translation: Vimes wiye ne bare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was the kind of headache that made you want to tear your hair out, or at least write a strongly worded letter to the makers of whatever it was that had given you the headache in the first place.
entries.translation: Ne en kido mar wich bar mane otimo ne idwaro pudho yie wiyi oko, kata indik barua mantie gi weche motegno kasto ior ne jogo mane oloso gino mane omiyi wichbar no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In this case, the headache was the result of a particularly trying day at work.
entries.translation: E wachni, wichbar ne duoko mane owuok e odiechieng' makore tek e tich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vimes had been investigating a series of robberies, and he was starting to feel like he was getting nowhere.
entries.translation: Vimes ne nono kuo mang'eny mane otimre, kendo ne ochako winjo kagima ongee kama ne odhiye gi nonro no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was tired, he was frustrated, and he just wanted to go home and sleep for a week.
entries.translation: Ne ool, chunye ne onyosre, kendo ne odwaro mana dhi e ot mondo onind juma achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As he was walking back to his office, Vimes passed a small stationery shop.
entries.translation: E sama ne owuotho kodok e ofise, Vimes ne okalo duka matin miusee buge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the window, he saw a sign that said "Best Letters in the City".
entries.translation: E dirisa, ne oneno ranyisi mane wacho ni "Barupe Mabeyo Mogik e Boma".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vimes stopped and stared at the sign for a moment.
entries.translation: Vimes ne ochung' kendo ne orango ranyisi no aming'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He thought about his headache, and he thought about all the letters he had to write.
entries.translation: Ne oparo wichbar mane en go, kendo ne oparo barupe te mane ondiko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He sighed and went into the shop.
entries.translation: Ne oyueyo matek kendo ne odonjo e duka no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The shop was full of all sorts of stationery supplies.
entries.translation: Duka no ne opong' gi kit buge kod kalambe duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were pens, pencils, paper, envelopes, stamps, and even a few typewriters.
entries.translation: Ne nitie kalambe, pensinde, otese, bahase, muuri, kod kata masinde matin mag ndiko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is true that there exist in this world situations that defy all explanation, events so strange and wondrous that they seem to be the stuff of dreams or nightmares.
entries.translation: En adier ni nitie chal mar weche e pinyni madhi ataro mar lero wach duto, gik matimore bee galagala kendo gin gik ma iwuoro nikech gineno kagima gin gik lek kod lek maricho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Such is the case with the story I am about to tell you, a tale of supernatural forces and the strange events that unfolded when they were unleashed upon the world.
entries.translation: Mano chalre gi mbaka ma adwaro nyisou ni, sigana mar teko manigi teko mokalo mar dhano kod gigo magalagala mane ofwenyre e seche mane oyang gi e piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It all began one night, when a group of friends were gathered together for a party.
entries.translation: Gik moko tee ne ochakre otieno achiel, e sama osiepe ne ochokre kanyakla e nyasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were drinking and laughing, enjoying each other's company, when suddenly the lights went out.
entries.translation: Ne gimetho to ginyiero, kagimor gi bedo margi kanyachiel, e sama taya ne osim apoya nono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The room was plunged into darkness, and the only sound was the sound of their own breathing.
entries.translation: Odno ne opong' gi mudho, to dwol kende mane winjre ne en dwol mar yueyo magiyueyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, in the darkness, they saw it: a strange, glowing light.
entries.translation: Kasto, e mudho no, ne ginene: ler magalagala marieny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It seemed to be coming from nowhere, and it was growing brighter and brighter.
entries.translation: Ne oneno ka gima ongee kama ne owuokye, kendo ler mare ne medre ameda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The friends were terrified, but they were also curious.
entries.translation: Osiepe go ne oluor, to kendo ne gidwaro ng'eyo gima timre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They wanted to know what this light was, and where it was coming from.
entries.translation: Ne gidwaro ng'eyo ni ler ni ne en ang'o, kod kama ne owuokye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Slowly, they approached the light.
entries.translation: Mosmos, ne gisudo machiegni gi lerno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As they got closer, they could see that it was coming from a small, glowing sphere.
entries.translation: E sama ne gisudo machiegni, ne ginyalo neno ni ne owuok e gima oluorre matin to rieny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sphere was hovering in the air, and it was surrounded by a faint aura.
entries.translation: Gima oluorre no ne fuyo e yamo, kendo mbi ma oknen maler ne oluore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Dude, I'm so heartbroken right now. My girlfriend of 2 years just broke up with me."
entries.translation: "Omera, an gi chuny lit ahinya sani. Osiepna manyako ma wasebet go higni 2 owere koda."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What happened?"
entries.translation: "Ang'o mane otimre?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I don't know. She just said she wasn't feeling it anymore.
entries.translation: "Akia. Ne owacho awacha ni ne okodwar hera no kendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so confused.
entries.translation: Pacha ochochre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I thought we were happy."
entries.translation: Ne awee ni ne wamor."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm sorry, man.I know how you feel. Heartbreak sucks."
entries.translation: "Mos, osiepa. Ang'eyo kaka iwinjo. Lit mar chuny rach ga ahinya."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It does. I don't know what to do."
entries.translation: "Orach ahinya. Akia gima atim."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Just give yourself some time.
entries.translation: "Miri amiya thuolo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cry it out if you need to.
entries.translation: Ywag orum kapo ni idwaro ywak.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And then, when you're ready, start to move on.
entries.translation: Bang' mano, ka iseikri, wiyi ochak wil kode itim giki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are plenty of other fish in the sea."
entries.translation: Nitie rech moko mang'eny e nam."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I know. But I don't know if I'm ready to date again yet."
entries.translation: "Ang'eyo. Makmana ni akia ka aseikra mar bedo e hera kendo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's okay. You don't have to be ready right away. Just take your time and heal."
entries.translation: "Mano kare. Ok ochuno mondo ibed tiyari sani. Kaw thuolo mondo ichang."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Thanks, man. I appreciate it."
entries.translation: "Erokamano, osiepa. Aduoko erokamano."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "No problem."
entries.translation: "Ongee wach."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Do you think the dowry system is a good thing?
entries.translation: A: Bende iparo ni chenro mar nyombo en gima ber?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I don't think so.
entries.translation: B: Okapar kober dawe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I think it's a form of discrimination against women.
entries.translation: Aparo ni en yo mar buono mine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It puts an unfair financial burden on the bride's family, and it can lead to women being treated as commodities.
entries.translation: Oketo osigo ma okowinjre ne familia mar nyako, kendo onyalo miyo okaw mon kaka gikmoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: But some people say that the dowry system is a way to protect women.
entries.translation: A: To jokmoko wachoga ni chenro mar nyombo no en yo mar keto ne mon arita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I don't think that's true.
entries.translation: B: Okapar kamano en adier.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, I think it can put women in danger.
entries.translation: Kuom adier, aparo ni onyalo keto mon e masira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If a woman's family can't afford to pay a dowry, she may be less likely to be able to find a husband.
entries.translation: Ka familia mar nyako dak nyal nyombo, onyalo bedo gi thuolo matin mar yudo dichuo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if she does get married, she may be more likely to be abused or mistreated by her husband.
entries.translation: To ka okende, chuore nyalo tiyo kode marach kata nyalo sande.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: So what do you think we should do about the dowry system?
entries.translation: A: Koro iparo ni ber ka watimo ang'o ewi chenro mar nyombo no?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I think we should work to abolish it.
entries.translation: B: Aparo ni ber ka watiyo mondo wagole.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We should educate people about the harmful effects of the dowry system, and we should support laws that make it illegal to demand or accept a dowry.
entries.translation: Ber ka wuonjo ji ewi gigo maricho manyalo timre nikech yor nyombo ni, kendo ber ka wasiro chike maketo kum mar kwayo kata yie kao nyombo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I agree. I think the dowry system is a relic of a bygone era.
entries.translation: A: Ayie. Aparo ni chenro mar nyombo no en tim mar kinde machon mane osekalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have been living with type 1 diabetes for over 20 years.
entries.translation: Asebedo ka adak gi kido mar 1 mar tuo mar skar kuom higni mohingo 20.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was diagnosed when I was just 10 years old, and it has been a lifelong journey.
entries.translation: Ne oyud ni an gi tuo no kane an mana ja higni 10, to osebedo safar mabor ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There have been many challenges along the way, but I have also learned a lot about myself and what it means to be a strong, resilient person.
entries.translation: Asebedo gi chandruoge mang'eny, to bende asepuonjra weche mathoth ewiya an awuon kod gima dwarore mimondo ng'ato obed motegno kendo moniano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the biggest challenges I have faced is managing my blood sugar levels.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom chandruoge wa madongo mogik ma asebedo go en tayo okang' mar skar mantie e remo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Diabetes is a condition that affects the way your body turns food into energy.
entries.translation: Tuo mar skar en tuo marocho kaka dendi loko skar bedo teko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you eat, your body breaks down the carbohydrates in your food into glucose, which is then absorbed into your bloodstream.
entries.translation: Ka ichiemo, dendi ng'injo ga kaboaidret mantie e chiembi go to gibedo glukos, ma gikone to donjo ga e rembi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your pancreas releases insulin, a hormone that helps glucose get from your blood into your cells.
entries.translation: Tago mari golo ga insulin, maen homon makonyo ga glukos wuok e rembi kadonjo e nyiriri mag rembi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In people with type 1 diabetes, the pancreas doesn't make enough insulin, or it doesn't make any at all.
entries.translation: Kuom ji mantie gi kido mar 1 mar tuo mar skar, tago margi oklos ga insulin moromo, kata okolos insulin kata matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that people with type 1 diabetes have to take insulin injections to help their bodies use glucose for energy.
entries.translation: Mae nyiso ni ji mantie gi kido mar 1 mar tuo skar nyaka chuogi sandan mar medo insulin mondo okony dendgi tiyo gi teko mar glukos.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Managing my blood sugar levels can be a tricky business.
entries.translation: Tayo okenge mag skar mantie e remo nyalo bedo gino matek timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a lot of factors that can affect my blood sugar, including what I eat, how much I exercise, and how much stress I am under.
entries.translation: Nitie weche mang'eny manyalo ketho skar mantie e remba, weche gi gin kaka gima achamo, kaka agoyo orako, kod paro ma an go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have to constantly monitor my blood sugar levels and make adjustments to my insulin doses as needed.
entries.translation: Ne ochuna mondo ang'i okang' mar skar mantie e remba kendo mondo atim lokruok ne dos maga mag insulin kaka dwarore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flavors dance on your tongue, creating a symphony of delight.
entries.translation: Ndhandhu miel e lewi, kendo loso ka giloso mor mokikre okikre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pineapple is sweet and tart, the apple is crisp and juicy, the stone fruit is juicy and flavorful, and the pear is sweet and refreshing.
entries.translation: Nas no milmil to owach, olemo mar apple no otuo to oting'o pige, olemo mar kidi no nigi pige mamit kendo ong'eny gi ndhandhu, kendo peas winjo luya kata owinjo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flavors are perfectly balanced, and each one complements the others.
entries.translation: Ndhandhu go oipm makare, kendo moro kamoro chiwo gima nyawadgi oremo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The combination is simply irresistible.
entries.translation: Gigo koriw kanyakla to dak iwe dawe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can enjoy this delicious fruit salad on its own, or as a topping for yogurt or ice cream.
entries.translation: Inyalo winjo mit mar alode gi matunda kagin kende, kata kaka chiemo no mimedo ewi aiskrim.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a great addition to a summer picnic or potluck.
entries.translation: Bende en medruok maduong' ne piknik mar dwe kinde ma chieng ger kata kiful.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter how you enjoy it, you are sure to love this fruit salad.
entries.translation: Okodewre gi kaka iwinjo mitne, in gi geno mar hero matunda gi alode monywad gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Did you know that deforestation is one of the leading causes of climate change?
entries.translation: A: Bende ne ing'eyo ni tong'o yien e bungu en achiel kuom gigo madonjo makelo mag lokruok mar kor lwasi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: No, I didn't.
entries.translation: B: Dawe, ne okang'eyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: How does that work?
entries.translation: Otiyo ga nadi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Well, when we cut down trees, we're not just destroying the trees themselves.
entries.translation: A: Kare, ka watong'o yien, ok waketh aketha yien kende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We're also destroying the habitats of countless animals and plants.
entries.translation: Waketho bende kuonde dak mag lee kod yien mang'eny ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And when we lose these habitats, we also lose the benefits that they provide us.
entries.translation: To ka walalo kuonde dak gi, walalo bende ber ma kuonde dak go miyo wa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: Like what?
entries.translation: B: Kaka ang'o?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Well, for example, trees help to regulate the climate.
entries.translation: A: Kuom ranyisi, yien konyo ka e tayo kor lwasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They absorb carbon dioxide from the air and release oxygen.
entries.translation: Gimuonyo ga muya mar kabodioksaid kowuok e muya kendo gigolo muya mar oksijen kaduogo e muya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also help to prevent soil erosion and flooding.
entries.translation: Bende gikonyo e geng'o kaka ofula ketho lowo kod ataro malosre bang' koth chwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And they provide food and shelter for animals.
entries.translation: Bende gimiyo lee chiemo kod kar dak.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: So deforestation has a lot of negative effects.
entries.translation: B: Koro tong'o yien kelo rach mang'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: It does.
entries.translation: A: Okelo ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And it's a problem that's only getting worse.
entries.translation: Kendo en chandruok mamedo mana bedo marach ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Every year, we lose millions of acres of forest to deforestation.
entries.translation: Higa ka higa, walalo eka tara gi tara mar bungu nikech tong'o yien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if we don't do something to stop it, the consequences will be devastating.
entries.translation: To ka ok watimo gimoro mondo wachunge, hinyruoge go biro medo bedo marach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: What can we do to stop it?
entries.translation: B: En ang'o mawanyalo timo mondo wachunge?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: There are a number of things we can do.
entries.translation: A: Nitie gikmoko mang'eny ma wanyalo timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can reduce our demand for wood products.
entries.translation: Wanyalo duoko piny kwan mar gik molos gi yien mawatiyo go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can plant trees.
entries.translation: Wanyalo pidho yien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was fortunate to attend a school that offered a wide range of AP courses and extracurricular activities, which gave me the opportunity to explore my interests and learn about different career paths.
entries.translation: Ne an gi haw mar dhi e skul manetimo kos mang'eny mag AP kod gikmoko mopogre gi somo mitimo e skul, mane omiya thuolo mar timo gigo ma agombo ga timo kendo kod somo yore mopogre mag tich ma asomo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things I learned in high school was how to think critically and solve problems.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gik moko madongo mogik mane asomo e sekondar ne en kaka ng'ato paro matut kendo tieko chandruoge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My AP English and math classes taught me how to analyze text and data, and my science classes taught me how to design and conduct experiments.
entries.translation: Klase meka mag AP mag dho Ingresa kod kwano ne opuonja kaka ng'ato nyalo nono gik mondiki kod weche mochoki, kendo klase meka mag sayans ne opuonja kaka iloso kendo itimo nonro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These skills have been essential in my college courses and my career as a software engineer.
entries.translation: Rieko gi osebedo makonyo ahinya e kos meka mag mbalarieny kod e tija mar injinia mar softwea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important thing I learned in high school was how to work effectively with others.
entries.translation: Gimoro maduong' mane asomo e sekondar ne en kaka inyalo tiyo maber gi jokmoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These skills have been invaluable in my career, where I often have to collaborate with others to solve complex problems.
entries.translation: Ujusi gi osekonya ahinya e tija, kama kinde ka kinde chuna ga mondo ati kanyakla gi jokmoko e loyo chandruoge matek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, my high school experience helped me to develop a strong work ethic and a commitment to excellence.
entries.translation: Mogik, rieko mane asumo e sekondar ne okonya e bero tim makare mar tich kod chiwruok mar timo maber moloyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The challenging academic courses I took taught me the importance of hard work and perseverance, and the extracurricular activities I participated in taught me the value of teamwork and dedication.
entries.translation: Kos mag somo matek mane atimo ne opuonja ber mar tiyo matek kod niano, kendo gigo misomo e skul mopogre gi somo mar klas ne opuonja ber mar tiyo kanyakla gi jokmoko kond chiwruok e tich mitimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These qualities have helped me to succeed in college and in my career.
entries.translation: Kido gi osekonya e goyo okang' e mbalarieny kod e tija.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am grateful for the opportunity to have attended a high school that provided me with such a strong educational foundation.
entries.translation: Aduoko erokamano kuom thuolo mane ayudo mar dhi e skund sekondar mane omiya ohinga maduong' motegno mar somo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I believe that the skills and knowledge I gained in high school have helped me to become a successful college student and a professional.
entries.translation: An gi yie ni ujusi kod lony mane ayudo e skund sekondar osekonya e bedo japuonjre maber e mbalarieny kod tich ma asomo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pottery is a craft that involves making objects out of clay.
entries.translation: Chueyo gikmoko en chuech mar loso gikmoko kitiyo kod lowo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pottery is often used for utilitarian purposes, such as storing food or water, but it can also be used for decorative purposes.
entries.translation: Chueyo gikmoko gi lowo ahinya ahinya itiyo ga go e loso gik ma itiyo go, kaka kano chiemo kata pi, to bende inyalo ti kode bero gikmoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of making pottery begins with gathering clay.
entries.translation: Okang' mar loso gik moko gi lowo chakore ga gi choko lowo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Clay is a natural material that is found in the ground.
entries.translation: Lowo en gino mayudre e piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the clay has been gathered, it is mixed with water and kneaded until it is soft and pliable.
entries.translation: Bang' ka osechok lowo, iruwe gi pi bang'e to iniase nyaka obed mayom kendo manyalo chueyo gimoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The potter then uses a variety of tools to shape the clay into the desired form.
entries.translation: Jachech gi lowo tiyo ga gi gikmoko mopogre opogre mar loso kido mar chuodho no mondo obed kaka idware.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the clay is shaped, it is dried and fired in a kiln.
entries.translation: Bang' ka chuodho no osebedo e kido madwarore, ithuoye kendo ichwake e mach makakni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms are a common occurrence in many parts of the world, and they can have a significant impact on our lives.
entries.translation: Koth machue gi yamo maduong' en gima timre ga mang'eny e kuonde mopogre opogre e piny ngima, kendo ginyalo kelo lokruok maduong' e ngimwa wa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can bring much-needed water to parched land, but they can also cause flooding, mudslides, and other damage.
entries.translation: Ginyalo kelo pi madwarore ahinya e lowo motuo, to kendo giknyalo kelo bende ataro mar pi, lowo masinyre, kod kethruok moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms are caused by the rising of warm air, which causes water vapor to condense and form clouds.
entries.translation: Koth machue gi yamo maduong' ikelo gi muya maliet maidho malo, mamiyo ga pi molokre muya mondo ochokre kendo olos boche polo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the water droplets in the clouds become too heavy, they fall as rain.
entries.translation: Ka pi ma ochokre matindo tindo obedo mapek ahinya, gilwar ga kaka koth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The amount of rain that falls in a rainstorm is measured in inches.
entries.translation: Kwan mar koth machue ga e koth machue gi yamo maduong' ipimo ga gi inje.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A light rainstorm might produce only a few inches of rain, while a heavy rainstorm can produce over a foot of rain.
entries.translation: Koth matin machue gi yamo nyalo golo inje matin kende mag koth, to koth mang'eny machue gi yamo nyalo golo koth mohingo fut achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms can have a variety of effects on our lives.
entries.translation: Koth machue gi yamo nyalo timo gik mopogre opogre e ngima wa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can wash away dirt and debris, making roads and sidewalks impassable.
entries.translation: Ginyalo ywayo chilo gi yugi, kendo mae nyalo timo ndara gi kuonde wuotho kik kalre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also cause power outages and flooding.
entries.translation: Bende ginyalo miyo stima olal kata kelo ataro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Flooding can be especially dangerous, as it can quickly sweep away people and property.
entries.translation: Ataro molos gi koth nyalo kelo hinyruok ahinya, nikech onyalo ywayo ji kod mwandu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the potential dangers, rainstorms can also be beneficial.
entries.translation: Koweyo rach ma onyalo kelo, koth machue gi yamo bende nyalo kelo ber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can help to improve soil quality and water the plants.
entries.translation: Onyalo konyo e bero ber mar lowo kendo kod olo ne yien pi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms can also be a source of entertainment, as people enjoy watching the rain and listening to the thunder.
entries.translation: Koth machue gi yamo bende nyalo kelo mor, e sama ji mor ka neno kaka koth chue kendo giwinjo mor mar polo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eyes are complex organs that allow us to see.
entries.translation: Wang' en fuon mar del mamiyo ga waneno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are located in the front of the head and are protected by the eyelids.
entries.translation: Giyudre e mbele mar wich kendo pien wang' ema ritogi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each eye is made up of three layers: the sclera, the choroid, and the retina.
entries.translation: Wang' ka wang' nigi kidienje adek: sklrea, koroid, kod retina.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sclera is the white part of the eye, the choroid is the dark layer behind the sclera, and the retina is the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.
entries.translation: Sklrea en kama rachar ei wang', koroid en kama rateng' e tok sklera, to retina en kama oluoro ler mayudre etok wang'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The retina contains millions of light-sensitive cells called rods and cones.
entries.translation: Retina nigi tara gi tara mar nyiriri moluoro ler miluongo ni rod kod cone.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rods are responsible for night vision, while cones are responsible for color vision.
entries.translation: Rod itiyo go e neno gotieno, cone to itiyo go e neno range.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When light hits the retina, it is converted into electrical signals that are sent to the brain via the optic nerve.
entries.translation: Ka ler omenyo retina, ler no iloko bedo ranyisi mag sitima ma ioro e obuongo kokalo e fuoni mag wang'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My family has always kept animals.
entries.translation: Familia mara osegabedo ka opidho le.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I was a child, we had a dog, a cat, and a few fish.
entries.translation: Kane an nyathi, ne wan ga gi guok, mbura, kod rech matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I got older, we added a few more animals to the mix, including a rabbit, a guinea pig, and a hamster.
entries.translation: Sama ne adongo, ne wamedo lee matin e lee mane wan godo go, lee mane wamedo ne gin apuoyo, oyeyo machal apuoyo, kod oyeyo ma ipidho e dala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I loved taking care of all of our animals and learning about their different needs.
entries.translation: Ne ahero rango lee mekwa go kendo puonjra dwaro margi mopogre opogre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of my favorite animals that we ever kept was a rabbit named Cocoa.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom lee mane ahero ahinya kuom lee mane wapidho ne en apuoyo miluongo ni Cocoa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cocoa was a brown and white Holland Lop rabbit.
entries.translation: Cocoa ne en apuoyo marabuor gi rachar mar kodhi mar Holland Lop.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was the sweetest animal I've ever met and she loved to be cuddled.
entries.translation: En ema ne en lee maber mogik kuom lee ma asegaromo go kendo ne ohero ka ikwake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was also very smart and could learn tricks like sit, stay, and come.
entries.translation: Bende ne oriek kendo ne onyalo puonjre rieko kaka bed piny, bed kanyo, kod bi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I was playing with Cocoa in the backyard when I noticed that she was chewing on something.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro achiel, ne oyudo atugo gi Cocoa e tok ot sama ne afwenyo ni ne onyamo gimoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I went over to investigate and saw that she was chewing on a piece of fiber from one of our clothes.
entries.translation: Ne adhi nono kendo ne aneno ka onyamo gir pamba moro mowuok e achiel kuom lepwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took the fiber away from her and showed it to my mom.
entries.translation: Ne amaye pamba no kendo ne anyiso minwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My mom explained that rabbits need to eat fiber in order to digest their food properly.
entries.translation: Minwa ne olerona ni apuoche dwarre mondo gicham pamba eka mondo chiemo magichamo oregre maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She said that we should give Cocoa some hay to eat, which is a good source of fiber.
entries.translation: Ne owacho ni ber ka wamiyo Cocoa lum moko motuo mondo ocham, maen achiel kuom gino manitie gi pamba maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I gave Cocoa some hay and she loved it!
entries.translation: Ne amiyo Cocoa lum motuo kendo ne ohere!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: An earthquake is a sudden and violent shaking of the Earth's crust that can cause great damage.
entries.translation: Yiengni mar piny en yiengruok ma apoya kendo mager mar Piny manyalo ketho gikmoko mang'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common cause of earthquakes is the movement of tectonic plates, which are large pieces of the Earth's crust that ride on top of the molten rock beneath the surface.
entries.translation: Gino mamiyo ga piny yiengni ahinya en sama sende mag Piny midendo ni tectonic sudo mosmos ebuo piny, magi gin fuoni madongo dongo mag Piny masudo sudo ga ewi lwanda moleny mayudre e buo piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When these plates move past or collide with each other, they can cause the Earth's crust to break and produce seismic waves.
entries.translation: Sende gi kalre ga kata gituomre ga, ginyalo miyo mondo Piny obarre kendo ogol apaka mag yiengni mar piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These waves travel through the Earth and can cause the ground to shake.
entries.translation: Apaka gi kalo ga e Piny kendo ginyalo miyo piny oyiengni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The magnitude of an earthquake is measured on the Richter scale, which ranges from 0 to 9.
entries.translation: Pek mar yiengni mar piny ipimo e ratil miluongo ni Ritcher, machakre e 0 nyaka 9.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The higher the magnitude, the more powerful the earthquake.
entries.translation: Ka pek ni malo to mano nyiso ni piny ne oyiengni matek ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earthquakes can cause damage in a variety of ways, including ground shaking, landslides, tsunamis, building collapses, fires, and loss of life.
entries.translation: Yiengni mar piny nyalo kelo kethruok mar gikmoko e yore mopogre opogre, magin kaka piny yiengre, sudo mar lowo, tsunami, udi gore piny, mach, kod wito ngima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earthquakes can also trigger other hazards, such as avalanches.
entries.translation: Yiengni mar piny bende nyalo kelo rach mamoko, kaka ridruok mar baraf kowuok ewi got.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The damage caused by an earthquake depends on a number of factors, including the magnitude of the earthquake, the distance from the epicenter, the type of soil, and the construction of buildings.
entries.translation: Kethruok ma okel gi yiengni mar piny luwore gi gik moko mopogre opogre, magin kaka pek mar yiengni mar piny, bor mantie kowuok e kama yiengruok mar piny ne ochakreye, kido mar lowo, kod gedo mar udi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have no idea how the real world works, and you think that everything should be handed to you on a silver platter.
entries.translation: Iongee lony moro amora ewi kaka piny tiyo ga, kendo iparo ni gikmoko tee ber ka imiyi amiya ma okitiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're always complaining about something, and you never seem to be happy with anything.
entries.translation: Kinde duto iywagoriga nikech gimoro, to okinen ga mamor gi gimoro amora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're a bunch of entitled brats, and I'm sick of it.
entries.translation: En ji ma ong'eyo ang'eya ni ber kagiyudo gikmoko tee, to aol gi timno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grow up.
entries.translation: Bed ng'ama duong'.
