entries.english: The world doesn't owe you anything.
entries.translation: Piny ongee gi gopi moro amora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have to work hard to get what you want.
entries.translation: Nyaka iti matek mondo eka iyud gima idwaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There's no such thing as a free lunch.
entries.translation: Ongee gimor amora kaka yudo chiemo ma okichulo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you want something, you have to go out and earn it.
entries.translation: Ka idwaro gimoro, nyaka iwuog idhi oko iti mondo iyude.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stop whining and complaining.
entries.translation: Wek ng'ur wendo we ywagri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not going to get you anywhere.
entries.translation: Ongee kama obiro teriye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have a problem, then solve it.
entries.translation: Ka in gi chandruok moro amora, tieke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't just sit around and cry about it.
entries.translation: Kik ibed abeda kendo iywagri ewi chandruog no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be more mature.
entries.translation: Bedye ng'ama otegno maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Act your age.
entries.translation: Timbe ni ochomreye gi hiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're not children anymore.
entries.translation: Okun nyithindo kendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's time to start acting like adults.
entries.translation: En kinde makoro nyaka uchak bet ka joma dongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm tired of dealing with your childish behavior.
entries.translation: Aol gi timbe mekuu mag nyithindo go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you don't start acting like adults, then I'm going to have to cut you out of my life.
entries.translation: Ka okan uchak timre kaka jomadongo, biro chuna mondo agoluu oko e ngima na.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I don't have time for your nonsense.
entries.translation: Aongee sa mar mila mekuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grow up and start acting like adults, or I'm out of here.
entries.translation: Dong uru kendo uchak timre ka joma dongo, kaok kamano to an awuok kaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was recently cleaning out my attic when I came across a box of old recipes that had been passed down from my grandmother.
entries.translation: Nyocha ne ayueyo ot mayudre e tado mar oda seche mane aromo gi boksi mar buk moti mar yore tedo ma ne danwa ema ne owenwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of them were quite old, dating back to the early 1900s.
entries.translation: Moko kuom gi ne oti ahinya, ne gin mag chakruok mar higni mag 1900.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was curious to see what they were, so I started reading through them.
entries.translation: Ne agombo ahinya neno ni ne gin ang'o, omiyo ne achako somo gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One recipe in particular caught my eye.
entries.translation: Buk achiel moting'o yore tedo ne omora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was for an anti-aging facial mask made with honey, yogurt, and oatmeal.
entries.translation: Ne en mar abuog rombe mar wang' mamiyo ng'ato okti piyo molos kod mor kich, yogat, kod chiemo ma ksung dendo ni oat.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I decided to give it a try, and I was amazed at the results!
entries.translation: Ne ang'ado paro mar teme, to ne amor gi duoko mane owuok!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My skin looked so much smoother and younger after using it.
entries.translation: Pien denda ne neno mayom ahinya kendo ka mar ng'ama tin bang' kane asetiyo kode.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so glad I found this old recipe.
entries.translation: Amor ahinya nikech ne ayudo buk ma oti ni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a real treasure, and I'm sure it will remain in my family for many years to come.
entries.translation: En gima duong' ahinya, an gi adier ni obiro dong' e familia mara kuom higni mang'eny mabiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The veteran sat alone in the hospital room, staring at the blank television.
entries.translation: Jalweny mane oseritaya ne obet kende e od osiptal, ka orango wang' jowi mane ongee gimoro amora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been in the hospital for weeks, and he was starting to go stir-crazy.
entries.translation: Ne osebedo e osiptal no kuom jumbe, kendo wiye ne ochako parre ahinya nikech olorne kamoro achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been in a lot of wars, and he had seen a lot of death and destruction.
entries.translation: Ne osebedo e lwenje mang'eny, kendo ne oseneno thoye kod kethruok mar gikmoko mang'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But nothing had ever prepared him for this.
entries.translation: Makmana ni onge gimoro amora mane osetimo ne ikruok mar mae.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The door to his room opened, and a young woman walked in.
entries.translation: Dhoot madhi e ot mane entieye ne oyawre, to miyo matin ne odonjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was carrying a bouquet of flowers. "Hello," she said. "My name is Sarah.
entries.translation: Ne oting'o maupe mang'eny mochan maber. "Amosi," ne owacho. "Nyinga en Sarah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm a volunteer here at the hospital."
entries.translation: An jachiwre e osiptandni."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The veteran smiled. "It's nice to meet you, Sarah," he said.
entries.translation: Mane en jalweny no ne obuonjo. "Amor ka aromo kodi, Sarah," ne owacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What are you doing here?"
entries.translation: "Ang'o ma itimo kae?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm here to make you laugh," she said. "Laughter is the best medicine, you know."
entries.translation: "An kae mondo amiyi nyiero," ne owacho. "Nyiero en yath maber mogik, kamano."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The veteran laughed. "I'm not sure I can laugh," he said.
entries.translation: Mane en jalweny no ne onyiero. "Aongee gi adier ka anyalo nyiero," ne owacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I've been through a lot."
entries.translation: "Asekalo e mang'eny."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I know," Sarah said. "But I'm going to make you laugh."
entries.translation: "Ang'eyo," Sarah ne owacho. "Makmana ni abiro miyi nyiero."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And she did.
entries.translation: To ne omiye nyiero.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She told jokes and stories, and she even did some magic tricks.
entries.translation: Ne onyungo ne weche to ogoyone mbaka, kendo ne otimone riekni moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The veteran laughed until his sides hurt.
entries.translation: Mane en jalweny no ne onyiero ba bute ne orame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: New Study Finds That Breast Cancer Screenings Can Lead to False Positives
entries.translation: Nonro Manyien Oyudo Ni Pim Mag Kansa Mar Thuno Nyalo Kelo Duoko Manyiso Ni In Gi Tuo To Iongee Go
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A new study published in the journal JAMA Internal Medicine has found that breast cancer screenings can lead to false positives.
entries.translation: Nonro manyien ma ogo e gaset mar JAMA Internal Medicine oyudo ni pim mar kansa mar thuno nyalo kelo duoko manyiso ni in gi tuo to iongee go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study, which was conducted by researchers at the University of California, San Francisco, found that one in five women who underwent a mammogram had a false positive result.
entries.translation: Nonro no, mane otim kot jotim nonro e Mbalarieny ma California, San Francisco, ne oyudo ni miyo achiel e kind mine abich mane otim ne pim mar kansa midendo ni mammogram ne oyudo duoko manyiso ni en gi tuo to oongee go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A false positive result is when a mammogram shows that a woman has breast cancer, when she actually does not.
entries.translation: Duoko manyiso ni in gi tuo to iongee go en sama gir pim miluongo ni mammogram nyiso ni miyo nigi kansa mar thuno, to kara oongee gi tuo no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to unnecessary anxiety and stress, as well as unnecessary medical procedures, such as biopsies.
entries.translation: Mae nyalo kelo paro mang'eny kaachiel gi chenro mang'eny mag thieth maongee tiende, kaka golo sampuli mag pim.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study found that the rate of false positives was higher among women who were younger, had dense breasts, and had a family history of breast cancer.
entries.translation: Nonro no ne oyudo ni okang' mane duoko manyiso ni in gi tuo to iongee go ne ni malo e mine mane tindo, ne nigi thuno machue, kendo ne nigi ng'ato ma osebedo gi kansa mar thuno e anyuola gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The researchers say that these findings are important because they highlight the need for women to understand the risks and benefits of breast cancer screening before they decide whether or not to undergo a mammogram.
entries.translation: Jotim nonro wacho ni duoko gi duong' nikech ginyiso dwaro mar mine ng'eyo rach kod ber mag pim mar kansa mar thuno kapok giyiero mar timo kata weyo timo pim mar mammogram.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study also found that the use of sound waves, known as ultrasound, to screen for breast cancer can help to reduce the number of false positives.
entries.translation: Nonro no bende ne oyudo ni tiyo gi apaka mar duol, mong'ere kaka ultrasound, e pimo kansa mar thuno nyalo konyo e duoko piny kwan mar duoko manyiso ni ng'ato nigi tuo to oongee go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ultrasound is a safe and non-invasive imaging technique that can be used to identify abnormalities in the breast.
entries.translation: Ultrasound en lony mar picha makare ma okkel hinyruok, ma inyalo ti godo e fwenyo gigo magalagala e thuno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A typical day for a person in Nigeria might start with a cup of tea or coffee and a breakfast of bread, eggs, and plantains.
entries.translation: Odiechieng' mapile ne ng'ano e piny Naijeria nyalo chakore gi okombe mar chae kata kahawa kod mkate, tong', kod rabolo e chiemo mokiny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The workday typically starts around 8am and ends around 5pm, with a lunch break in the middle of the day.
entries.translation: Odiechieng tich ahinya ahinya chakre ga saa 2 okinyi kendo rumo saa 11 odhiambo, nitie thuolo mar lanj e dier odiechieng'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After work, people might relax at home with their families, go out to dinner, or attend a cultural event.
entries.translation: Bang' tich, dhano nyalo yueyo e dala gi anyuola gi, ginyalo dhi chamo chiemb otieno kamoro, kata yuoro budho mar kit oganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The evening is often spent socializing with friends and family.
entries.translation: Godhiambo to giyudo ga thuolo mar lalre gi anyuola kod osiepe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The daily routine of a Nigerian can vary depending on their location and lifestyle.
entries.translation: Chenro mapile pile mar ja Naijeria nyalo pogore kaluwore kod kuonde magidakye gi kit ngima gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In rural areas, people may wake up earlier to tend to their farms or livestock.
entries.translation: E gwenge, ji nyalo chiew okinyi ahinya mondo gidhi e puothe gi kata girang jamni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In urban areas, people may have more time for leisure activities.
entries.translation: E boma, dhano nyalo bedo gi thuolo mang'eny mar timo sugli mag yueyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, some aspects of daily life are common across Nigeria, such as the importance of family and community.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, weche moko mag ngima ma pile ka pile chalre e piny Naijeria, kaka duong' mar familia kod gweng'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nigeria is a diverse country with a rich culture, and the daily lives of its people reflect this diversity.
entries.translation: Naijeria en piny mantie gi weche mopogre opogre kod kido mang'eny mag oganda, kendo ngima ma pile ka pile mar joge nyiso weche mopogre opogre gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the bustling cities of Lagos and Abuja to the more rural areas of the country, there is no one-size-fits-all description of what a typical day in Nigeria is like.
entries.translation: Kochakre e gik mang'eny matimre e bombe mag Lagos kod Abuja nyaka e gwenge mag pinyno, ongee weche malero kaka odiechieng' mapile ka pile e piny Naijeria tee chal ga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But one thing is for sure: no matter where you are in Nigeria, you will find people who are warm, welcoming, and eager to share their culture with you.
entries.translation: To gimoro achiel ma ag go gi adier: okodewre kama intie e piny Naijeria, ibiro yudo ji mamor, rwako dhano, kendo nigi siso mar nyisi kit oganda gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Nyasaland African Congress (NAC) was founded in 1944 by Dr. Hastings Kamuzu Banda and other Malawian nationalists.
entries.translation: Dr. Hastings Kamuzu Banda kod Oganda moko ma Malawi mohero pinygi ne ochako Nyasaland African Congress (NAC) e higa mar 1944.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The NAC was the first political party in Malawi to advocate for African independence from British colonial rule.
entries.translation: NAC ema ne en duond bura mokuongo e piny Malawi kendo ne en mar chung' ne yudo loch mar jo Afrika kowuok kuom loch mar jo Briten.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1953, the NAC was banned by the British colonial authorities, but it continued to operate underground.
entries.translation: E higa mar 1953, jotelo mag loch mar jo Briten ne okumo NAC, makmana ni ne odhi nyime tiyo gike apiny piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1961, the NAC was legalized and renamed the Malawi Congress Party (MCP).
entries.translation: E higa mar 1961, ne opwodh NAC kendo ne olok nyinge ba obedo Malawi Congress Party (MCP).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The MCP won the first general elections held in Malawi in 1964, and Dr. Banda became the first Prime Minister of Malawi.
entries.translation: MCP ne oyombo yiero maduong' mokwongo mane otim e piny Malawi e higa mar 1964, kendo Dr. Banda ne obedo Jatend Migepe mokuongo Malawi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1966, Malawi became a republic, with Dr. Banda as the first President.
entries.translation: E higa mar 1966, Malawi ne obedo piny, kendo Dr. Banda ema ne en Ker mokuongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Banda ruled Malawi as a one-party state for 30 years.
entries.translation: Dr. Banda ne obedo jaloch mar Malawi ka pinyno en pinj duond od bura achiel kuom higni 30.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a controversial figure, but he is also credited with modernizing Malawi and bringing it independence.
entries.translation: Ne en jalno ma pache ne kelo gwenyruok, makmana ni kendo ipuoye kuom gero Malawi obed manyasani kendo kelo loch mar pinyno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The physicians, who are members of the Southern Medical Association, say that the firm's building was not properly ventilated and that the employees were exposed to harmful chemicals.
entries.translation: Lakteche, magin jokanyo mag riwruok mar jothieth ma milambo mong'ere kaka Southern Medical Association, wacho ni od riwruogno ne ongee kar rwako gi golo muya maber kendo jotich ma kanyo ne rakore gi kemikal mager.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We were concerned about the health of the employees at this firm," said Dr. Raymond Neal-Kennedy, a spokesman for the SMA.
entries.translation: "Ne wadich ahinya gi ngima mar jotich e kambi ni," Laktar Raymond Neal-Kennedy maen jaloso eloo SMA ne owacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "The building was not up to code and the employees were being exposed to dangerous chemicals. We had no choice but to shut the firm down."
entries.translation: "Odno ne okoluwo okenge madwarore kendo jotich ne rakore gi kemikol mager. Ne waongee yoo moro amora machielo mopogre gi loro kambi no."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The architecture firm, which has not been named, has denied the allegations.
entries.translation: Kambi mar goro udi no, mapok oyang no, okwedo ketho ma ilieko go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The firm's owner, Mr. Ishq Kasawa, says that the building was properly ventilated and that the employees were not exposed to any harmful chemicals.
entries.translation: Wuon kambino, Mr. Ishq Kasawa, wacho ni odno ne nigi kuonde mag rwako gi golo muya maber kendo jotije go ne okrakre gi kemikol moro amora mager.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We are disappointed by the actions of the SMA," said Mr. Kasawa.
entries.translation: "Ne okwamor gi okang' ma SMA ne okao," Mr. Kasawa ne owacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We believe that we have been unfairly targeted. Our building is safe and our employees are healthy."
entries.translation: "Wang'eyo ni ne ochomwa eyo ma ok owinjore. Odwa ni kare kendo jotijewa dhi maber."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The SMA says that it will continue to investigate the matter and that it will take further action if necessary.
entries.translation: SMA wacho ni obiro dhi nyime gi timo nonro ewi wachno kendo ni obiro kao okang' madwarore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Libyan Civil War is an ongoing armed conflict in Libya that began in 2011 with the overthrow of Muammar Gaddafi's government.
entries.translation: Leny Mar Ji Giwegi e piny Libya en dhao madhi nyime mar ji momanre gi gik lweny e piny Libya mane ochakre higa mar 2011 beng' kiro oko piny owacho mar Muammar Gaddafi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2014, the Libyan House of Representatives (HoR) was elected in the eastern city of Tobruk, but the HoR has been unable to exercise effective control over the country.
entries.translation: E higa mar 2014, duond bura mar Libyan House of Representatives (HoR) ne oyier e boma mar Tobruk mayudre ugwe, makmana ni HoR pok onyalo goyo okang' mar tayo pinyno tee.

entries.english: The LNA, led by Khalifa Haftar, has been fighting against the GNA and its allies in the west of the country.
entries.translation: LNA, ka otelne gi Khalifa Haftar, osebedo kagore gi GNA kod osiepene e gwenge ma yimbo mar pinyno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The conflict has led to a humanitarian crisis, with hundreds of thousands of people displaced from their homes.
entries.translation: Dhaono osekelo nok mar kony ma imiyo ji, ka dhano tara gi tara osedar kowuok kama gidakye.

entries.english: The United Nations has called for an immediate ceasefire and the start of a political dialogue.
entries.translation: Riwruok mar Pinje osekwayo mondo lweny no ochung' kendo gichak twak e piny no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The soap opera centers around the lives of the residents of a small town.
entries.translation: Sinema mong'ere kaka soap opera go loso ahinya ewi ngima mar jodak mag boma moro matin.

entries.english: The main character, Constance, is a young woman who is struggling to come to terms with the recent death of her husband.
entries.translation: Jatugo maduong', Constance, en miyo matin makedo matek mondo odhi nyime gi ngima bang' tho mar chuore nyocha nyocha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is left to raise her two young children on her own, and she is struggling to find a way to handle her grief.
entries.translation: Odong' ka opidho nyithinde ariyo matindo kende en owuon, kendo okedo matek mondo oyud yo mar rakre gi kuyo no.

entries.english: One day, Constance meets a man named Frederick at the grocery store.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro, Constance ne oromo gi dichuo miluongo ni Frederick e duka mar uso alode.

entries.english: Frederick is a kind and compassionate man, and he offers Constance his support.

entries.english: Constance begins to develop feelings for Frederick, but she is hesitant to start a new relationship because she is still grieving the loss of her husband.
entries.translation: Constance chako hero Frederick, makmana ni oluor chako hera manyien nikech podi en gi kuyo mar wito chuore.

entries.english: Eventually, Constance decides to give Frederick a chance.

entries.english: She starts dating him, and she quickly falls in love with him.
entries.translation: Ochako mako osiep kode, kendo piyo piyo nono to ohere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Frederick helps Constance to heal from her grief, and he gives her the strength to raise her children on her own.
entries.translation: Frederick konyo Constance yudo kwe nikech kuyo manyocha en go, kendo omiye teko mar pidho nyithinde en kende owuon.

entries.english: Constance and Frederick get married, and they have a happy life together.

entries.english: They raise their children together, and they support each other through good times and bad.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance is grateful for Frederick's love and support, and she knows that she will never be able to thank him enough for everything he has done for her.
entries.translation: Constance duoko erokamano ahinya kuom hera kod kony mar Frederick, kendo ong'eyo ni ok obinyalo duokone erokamano moromo kuom gikmoko duto ma osetimone.

entries.english: The soap opera ends with a message of hope.

entries.english: As the twentieth century drew to a close, computers and electronics were becoming increasingly intertwined.
entries.translation: E sama tielo mar piero ariyo mar higni apar sudo machiegni, kompiuta kod gik matiyo gi stima medo riwre kanyakla.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the early days of computing, these two fields were largely separate.
entries.translation: E higni machon ka eka kompiuta chakre, tielo ariyo gi ne opogre ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Computers were large, expensive machines that were used for scientific and military purposes.
entries.translation: Kompiuta ne gin masinde madongo to bechgi tek mane itiyo go e weche mag sayans kod lweny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Electronics were used in a variety of consumer products, such as radios, televisions, and telephones.
entries.translation: Gik matiyo gi stima ne itiyo go e gikmoko mopogre opogre mitiyo go, kaka nyakalondo, wang' jowi, kod sim.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, as computers became smaller and more affordable, they began to be used in a wider variety of applications.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, kaka kompiuta ne bedo matindo kendo manengo ne ogonyre, ne ochak tiyo kodgi e tije mopogre opogre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This led to a blurring of the lines between computers and electronics.
entries.translation: Mae ne okelo riwni mar lainde e kind kompiuta kod gik matiyo gi stima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most significant developments in the history of computers and electronics was the invention of the personal computer (PC).
entries.translation: Achiel kuom dongruok madongo e sigand kompiuta kod gik matiyo gi stima ne en fwenyruok mar kompiuta mar ng'ato owuon (PC).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The PC was first introduced in the 1970s, and it quickly became a popular tool for both personal and business use.
entries.translation: PC ne ochak tiyo godo e higni mag pier abiryo, to leplep nono ne gibedo kompiuta ma itiyo go e weche mag ng'ato owuon kod mag ohala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PCs were originally designed for use in homes and offices, but they soon found their way into other settings, such as schools and libraries.
entries.translation: PC ne olos mondo oti godo e udi kod ofise, makmana ni bang'e to ne gichopo kuonde mamoko, kaka skul kod laibrari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The PC's portability and versatility made it an ideal tool for a wide range of tasks, from word processing to gaming.
entries.translation: Bedo ni inyalo iting' PC kendo inyalo ti kode e yore mopogre opogre ne omiye obedo gino na inyalo tigo tije mang'eny, kochakre e goyo otas nyaka tugo go tuke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The development of the PC also led to the development of a new industry: the software industry.
entries.translation: Dongruok mar PC bende ne okelo dongruok mar kambi manyien: kambi mar softwea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Software companies created programs that could run on PCs, and these programs quickly became essential tools for PC users.
entries.translation: Kembe mag softwea ne oloso program mane nyalo tiyo e PC, kendo program gi piyo piyo nono ne gibedo gigo madwarore ahinya ne joma tiyo gi PC.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The satisfaction of a perfect touch was something that Aida had never experienced before.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had been with many men, but none of them had ever been able to give her the kind of pleasure that she craved.
entries.translation: Ne osebedo gi chuo mang'eny, kata kamano ongee moro amora mane obedo gi nyalo mar miye mor mane ogombo ga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had often wondered if she was simply too demanding, or if she was just meant to be alone.
entries.translation: Kinde mang'eny ne openjre kabe en ema ne en gi dwaro mang'eny, kose ka en ne ochanre ni obiro bet kende.

entries.english: But then she met Hakim.

entries.english: Hakim was different from any man she had ever met before.

entries.english: He was kind, gentle, and he seemed to understand her in a way that no one else ever had.

entries.english: And when he finally touched her in that special way, she felt a wave of pleasure wash over her that was unlike anything she had ever felt before.

entries.english: It was as if her body had been waiting for his touch all along.

entries.english: She felt complete, whole, and for the first time in her life, she knew what it was to be truly satisfied.

entries.english: The hajj is a once-in-a-lifetime pilgrimage to Mecca, Saudi Arabia, that is required of all Muslims who are physically and financially able to make the journey.
entries.translation: Hajj en wuoth mar lemo mochomo Mecca e piny Saudi Arabia matimre ga chiegni ni dichiel e ngima ng'ato, wuodhni en mar oganda Islam tee ma dendgi oyienigi chopo kendo gin gi pesa manyalo chopogi wuodhno.

entries.english: The pilgrimage is one of the five pillars of Islam, and it is considered to be the most important spiritual journey a Muslim can make.
entries.translation: Wuoth mar lamo no en achiel kuom ohinga abich mag oganda Islam, kendo okawe kaka wuoth maduong' ahinya mar chiemb chuny ma ja Islam nyalo timo.

entries.english: The hajj takes place over five days in the Islamic month of Dhu al-Hijjah.

entries.english: During the hajj, pilgrims perform a series of rituals that commemorate the life of Prophet Muhammad and the prophets who came before him.

entries.english: The hajj is a physically and emotionally demanding journey, but it is also a time for Muslims to come together in worship and to reflect on their lives.
entries.translation: Hajj e safar madwaro chiwruok maber e yor del kod paro, kata kamano kendo en kinde mar oganda Islam biro kanyakla mondo gilem kendo gipar ngima gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a chance to renew their faith and to reaffirm their commitment to Islam.

entries.english: For many Muslims, the hajj is a life-changing experience.
entries.translation: Ne oganda mang'eny mag Islam, hajj en gino manyalo loko ngima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a time to leave behind the stresses of everyday life and to focus on their spiritual journey.
entries.translation: En kinde mar wiyi wil gi paro ma pile ka pile kendo keto paro e safar margi mar chuny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom of the press is the freedom of communication and expression through mediums including printed media and the internet.
entries.translation: Uhuru mar fwambo en uhuru mar loso kokalo kuom yore kaka oboke mogo chapa kod mbui.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a fundamental human right recognized by Article 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and reaffirmed in Article 19 of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights.
entries.translation: En ratiro maduong' mar dhano ma ondik e pend chik namba 19 mar Universal Declaration of Human Rights kendo osir kendo e pend chik namba 19 mar International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The right to freedom of expression is recognized as a necessary precondition for the enjoyment of all other human rights.
entries.translation: Ratiro mar loso oyangi kaka siro ma mor duto manitie e ratiro mamoko oyiengore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom of the press is essential for a healthy democracy.
entries.translation: Uhuru mar fwambo en gima duong' e demokrasia matiyo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It allows citizens to access information and to hold their government accountable.
entries.translation: Omiyo jopiny yudo weche mag piny kendo keto sirkal tesre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also helps to ensure that all voices are heard, and that the public is informed about important issues.
entries.translation: Bende okonyo e neno ni duond jite owinji, kendo ni jopiny nini ng'eyo ewi gik mo chuno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there have been growing threats to freedom of the press around the world.
entries.translation: E higni matin mokalo, gik mathiro uhuru mar fwambo osemedore e pinje mathoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Governments have been using laws to restrict the media, and journalists have been harassed and attacked.
entries.translation: Sirkande osebedo katiyo kod chike e thiro fwambo, kendo jo fwambo oseroki kendo omonji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These threats are a serious concern, and they need to be addressed.
entries.translation: Gigi gin gik malich ahinya kendo onego rang gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must all stand up for freedom of the press.
entries.translation: Nyaka waduto wachung' motegno mar siro uhuru mar fwambo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must defend the right of journalists to report the news without fear of reprisal.
entries.translation: Nyaka wasir ratich jo fwambo mar keyo weche ma ka gi kacha ma onge luoro mar chulo kuor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must also support independent media outlets, and we must encourage people to read and share news from a variety of sources.
entries.translation: Bende nyaka wachung' kod ute fwambo ma ochung' kendgi, kendo nyaka wajiu ji mondo osom kendo oke weche ma ka gi kacha mawuok kuonde ma opogore opogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom of the press is a precious right.
entries.translation: Uhuru mar fwambo en ratiro mogen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must all do our part to protect it.
entries.translation: Nyaka waduto watim korka mar neno ni warite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rising temperatures and changing precipitation patterns are making it more difficult to grow crops in some areas, while at the same time creating new opportunities for agriculture in other areas.
entries.translation: Liet mar piny medore kod ndalo mag koth masiko ka lokore miyo pidho cham kuonde moko bedo matek, to kon chiel omiyo kuonde mamoko yudo thuolo maber mar pur.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The overall effect is that the global agricultural system is becoming more complex and less predictable.
entries.translation: Gima duong' mokelo en ni pur e piny mangima bedo ma iye tek kendo omedo bedo matek koro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most direct effects of climate change on agriculture is the increase in the frequency and severity of extreme weather events.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gik maricho ma lokruok e kor lwasi kelo e pur en medruok e kwan kod oro kata koth mathoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Heat waves, droughts, floods, and storms can all damage crops and livestock, and make it difficult for farmers to get their crops to market.
entries.translation: Liet, oro, oula, kod apaka duto nyalo ketho cham kod jamni, kendo miyo jopur bedo gi pek e chopo chambgi e chiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, these events can cause entire crop yields to be lost, leading to food shortages and price increases.
entries.translation: E seche moko, gigi nyalo miyo jopur lalo nyak duto mag chambgi, gino mamiyo chiemo bedo matin kendo bech chiemo dhi malo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to extreme weather events, climate change is also leading to changes in the average temperature and precipitation patterns.
entries.translation: Mopogore kod gik maricho go, lokruok e kor lwasi bende kelo lokruok e liet kod ndalo mag koth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These changes are making it more difficult to grow some crops in certain areas, while at the same time creating new opportunities for agriculture in other areas.
entries.translation: Lokruoge miyo pidho cham moko bedo matek e gwenge moko, to kuonde mamoko gimiyo thuolo manyien mar pur.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was driving home from work one day when I got cut off by another driver.
entries.translation: Ne ariembo ka adhi ot ka aya tich chieng' moro e sama ne dereva moro ong'ada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was so angry that I started tailgating him and flashing my lights.
entries.translation: Iya ne owang' ahinya ma achako luwe machiegni kendo ne amoro taya to asimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He just kept driving slower and slower, and I was getting more and more frustrated.
entries.translation: Ne odhi nyime riembo gache mos ahinya, kendo iya ne omedo wang'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, I couldn't take it anymore.
entries.translation: Gikone, ne awinjo ka ajok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I pulled up next to him and started yelling at him.
entries.translation: Ne asudo e bathe kae achako dhaone.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He rolled down his window and started yelling back at me.
entries.translation: Ne oyao dirisa mare kendo chako dhaona.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were both so angry that we were shaking.
entries.translation: Iwa ne owang' ahinya wan te ma watetni ateta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The other driver pulled over to the side of the road, and I followed him.
entries.translation: Dereva machielo no ne owuok nyaka e bath ndara, kendo ne aluwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We got out of our cars and started yelling at each other even louder.
entries.translation: Waduto ne wawuok e gechewa kendo chako ywarruok matek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was so close to hitting him that I could smell his breath.
entries.translation: Ne achiegni kode ahinya ma ne anyalo kata ng'weyo muche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just when I thought it couldn't get any worse, a police car pulled up.
entries.translation: E sama ne aparo ni dhi bedo marach moloyo, gach obila ne ochopo kendo chung' bathwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The officer got out of his car and asked us what was going on.
entries.translation: Obila ne owuok oko mar gache kendo penjowa gima ne dhi mbele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We both told him our sides of the story, and he started writing us a ticket.
entries.translation: Ng'ato ka ng'ato ne owacho kore, kendo obila no ne ochako ndiko nwa otiko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I was walking back to my car, I realized that I had learned my lesson.
entries.translation: Sama ne awuotho ka adoke gacha, ne afwenyo ni nitie fwenyruok manyien ma ayudo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Road rage is never worth it.
entries.translation: Ywarruok e ndara onge tiende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not worth getting angry over, and it's not worth getting a ticket.
entries.translation: Onge tiende ich wang', kendo onge tiende yudo otiko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful river that flowed through a lush forest.
entries.translation: E ndalo moro, ne nitiere aora moro mane okaloe bungu moro ma otwere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The river was home to many creatures, including fish, frogs, turtles, and birds.
entries.translation: Aorano ne kar dak ne gik mathoth kaka rech, ogwende, opuge, kod winy.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The river was also a popular spot for humans to swim, fish, and relax.
entries.translation: Dhano bende ne ohero dhi e aorano goyo abal, mako rech, kod yweyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young girl named Lily was playing near the river when she saw a turtle caught in a fishing net.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro, nyako moro ma nying'e Lily ne tugo e tie aorano kane oneno opuk ka omoko ei net mar mako rech.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily knew that she had to help the turtle, so she ran home to get her father.
entries.translation: Lily ne ong'eyo ni nyaka okony opugno, omiyo ne oringo odhi dala omo wuon gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily's father helped her to free the turtle, and the two of them returned to the river.
entries.translation: Wuon Lily ne okonyo golo opugno e nedno, kendo gin ji ariyo negi duoke ei pi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The turtle thanked Lily for saving her life, and Lily promised to always be kind to animals.
entries.translation: Opugno ne ogoyone Lily erokamano kuom reso ngimane, kendo lily nosingore ni obiro bedo ka okonyo le.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily continued to visit the river often, and she always made sure to look out for any animals that might be in danger.
entries.translation: Lily ne osiko ka limo aorano, kendo ne otemo mar manyo le moro amora ma ni matek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Lily saw a group of boys throwing rocks at the fish in the river.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro, Lily ne oneno yawuoi moko ka bayo rech maniye aorano gi kite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily knew that she had to stop them, so she ran up to the boys and told them that what they were doing was wrong.
entries.translation: Lily ne ong'eyo ni nyaka otam yawuoi dhi mbele bayo kite, omiyo ne oringo nyaka ir yawuoi go kendo konogi ni gima ne gitimo no ne rach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boys were surprised to hear this from Lily, but they listened to her and stopped throwing rocks.
entries.translation: Yawuoi go ne obuok winjo wachno kowuok kuom Lily, kata kamano ne giwinje kendo weyo bayo kite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What is the meaning of becoming a queen?" asked the young woman.
entries.translation: "Bendo Ruoth madhako tiende en ang'o?" nyako matin no ne openjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It is to learn to accommodate all that is," said the old woman.
entries.translation: "En ng'eyo ni owinjore rwako duto manitie," dayono ne owacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "To hold in your heart the beauty and the pain, the joy and the sorrow, the light and the darkness.To see the world as it is, and to love it nonetheless."
entries.translation: "Mako e chunyi ber kod rem, mor kod kuyo, ler kod mudho. Neno piny kaka en, kendo here kata kamano."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But how can I do that?" asked the young woman. "The world is so full of suffering."
entries.translation: "Ere kaka anyalo timo mano?" nyako matin no nopenjo. "Piny opong' kod thagruok."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, it is," said the old woman.
entries.translation: "En kamano," dayono ne owacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But it is also full of beauty. And it is our task to find the beauty in the suffering, and to let it transform us.
entries.translation: "Kata kamano bende opong' kod ber. Kendo tijwa en manyo ber ei thagruok, kendo neno ni olokowa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "When you become a queen, you will have power.
entries.translation: "Ka ibedo Ruoth madhako, ibiro bedo kod teko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But power is not a thing to be used for your own gain.
entries.translation: Kata kamano teko ok en gima itiyo godo yudo ber ne in iwuon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a responsibility to be used for the good of others.
entries.translation: En gima itiyo godo mar manyo ber ne jok mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You must learn to use your power to heal the world, not to harm it.
entries.translation: Nyaka ing'e tiyo kod tekoni mar chango piny, tok hinye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You must also learn to be humble.
entries.translation: Bende nyaka ing'e bolruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A queen is not above others, but she is also not below them."
entries.translation: Ruoth madhako ok ni ewi ji, bende ok en e buogi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cricket is a game played with a bat and ball between two teams of eleven players on a field at the centre of which is a 22-yard pitch with a wicket at each end, each comprising two bails balanced on three stumps.
entries.translation: Cricket en tugo ma itugo kod luth kod opira e kind timbe ariyo ma nigi jotugo apar gi achiel e pap manie diere maromo mita 22 keno ni kod wicket koni gi kocha, moting'o bail ariyo mopang' ewi yiende adek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fielding side tries to prevent this by stopping the ball with their own bats, with their hands or with the wicket itself and then throwing the ball back to the bowler.
entries.translation: Tim matugo temo geng'o mano ka gichung'o opirano gi ludhe gi, gi lwetgi kata gi wicket kendo duoko ne ja ba opira opirano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cricket is a game that requires a lot of skill and practice.
entries.translation: Cricket en tugo ma dwaro lony mathoth kod timo orako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be a very rewarding game, but it also takes a lot of hard work.
entries.translation: En tugo manyalo bedo kod ber mathoth e iye, bende odwaro tich matek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you want to be a good cricketer, you need to be honest with yourself about your abilities and be willing to put in the time and effort to train.
entries.translation: Ka idwaro bedo jatug cricket maber, bed ja adier ne in owuon ewi nyalo mari kendo iket thuolo kod tekri e tim orako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vegetarian cuisine encompasses a wide variety of dishes and ingredients that are prepared without the use of meat, poultry, or fish.
entries.translation: Tet ja alode oting'o kit chiemo mathoth ma itedo ma onge tiyo kod ring'o, gwen, kata rech.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While some vegetarians avoid all animal products, including dairy and eggs, others may consume dairy or eggs but not meat.
entries.translation: Kata obedo ni jo alode moko ok cham gik ma ogol kuom le, moting'o ring'o kod tong', moko nyalo chamo chak kata tong', tok ring'o.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vegetarian food can be just as delicious and satisfying as meat-based dishes, and there are a number of ways to incorporate plant-based proteins into your diet.
entries.translation: Chiembe ja alode bende nyalo bedo mana ma mit mana kaka chamo chiemo molos kod ring'o, kendo nitiere yore mathoth ma inyalo keto godo protins mag cham e chiembi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some popular vegetarian proteins include beans, lentils, tofu, tempeh, and seitan.
entries.translation: Moko kuom protins mong'ere mogol kuom cham gin kaka oganda, kamande, tofu, tempeh kod seitan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also a number of meat substitutes available on the market, such as veggie burgers, chicken nuggets, and soy-based hot dogs.
entries.translation: Bende nitiere protins ma nyalo kao kar ring'o, kaka baga molos kod alode, gweno mowang', kod hot dog molos kod soya.
