entries.english: Sometimes, motivation can be hard to come by.
entries.translation: Seche moko, chuny mar tich nyalo koso yudre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But there are a few things you can do to help yourself get started.
entries.translation: Makmana ni nitie gikmoko matin ma inyalo timo mondo iyud chuny mar chako tich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, think about why you're doing the work.
entries.translation: Mokuongo, par gima omiyo itimo tijno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What's your goal?
entries.translation: Dwaro mari en ang'o?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you know what you're working towards, it's easier to stay motivated.
entries.translation: Bang' ng'eyo dwaro mari ma itiyo ne, yot mondo iyud chuny mar tich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, break down the task into smaller steps.
entries.translation: Mar ariyo, pog tijno e okenge matindo tindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will make it seem less daunting and more manageable.
entries.translation: Mae biro timo onen ni okotek ahinya kendo onyalo timre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, give yourself rewards for completing each step.
entries.translation: Mar adek, miri mich mar tieko okang' ka okang'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help you stay on track and motivated.
entries.translation: Mae biro konyi luwo chenro ni kendo bedo gi chuny mar tich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, don't be afraid to ask for help if you need it.
entries.translation: Gikone, kik iluor kwayo kony kapo ni idwaro kony.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sometimes, all you need is a little encouragement to get you started.
entries.translation: Seche moko, gino ma idwaro en jip matin mondo ichak.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grandchild: Thank you, Grandma.
entries.translation: Nyakwaro: Erokamano, Dana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'll try those things.
entries.translation: Abiro temo gigo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grandma: You're welcome, my dear.
entries.translation: Dana: Machiegni, osiepa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm always here for you.
entries.translation: An kae seche tee mondo akonyi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rental cars are a convenient way to get around when visiting a new city or country.
entries.translation: Gache mipango en yo mowinjore mar tiyo godo seche ma ilimo boma kata piny mawendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They offer the flexibility to explore at your own pace and can be a more affordable option than public transportation.
entries.translation: Gikelo yore mopogre opogre mag neno gik mopogre e okang' ma in ma idwaro kendo ginyalo bedo yo manengone ogonyre kopim gi yor wuoth mar oganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When renting a car, it is important to compare prices from different companies and to read the fine print of the rental agreement carefully.
entries.translation: Sama ipango gari, en gima duong' mondo ipim nengo e kembe mopogre opogre kendo isom e yor adimba oboke moting'o winjruok moket e geche mipango go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be sure to ask about any additional fees, such as fuel charges, insurance, or tolls.
entries.translation: Ne ni ipenjo kanitie chudo moro amora mabathe, kaka chudo mar mafuta, insuarans, kata chudo mag tiyo gi ndara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a good idea to take pictures of the car before you drive it away, so that you have proof of its condition in case of any damage.
entries.translation: Bende en paro maber mar goyo mtoka no picha kapok iwuok kode e kambi no, mondo ibed gi gino manyiso chal mar gare no kapo ni okethre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are planning to rent a car for an extended period of time, you may be able to get a better deal by purchasing a rental car package.
entries.translation: Ka ichano mar pango gare kuom thuolo malach, inyalo yudo nengo mogonyre ka inyieo gigo moket kanyakla mikao kamoro achiel esama ipango gare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These packages typically include a set number of days of rental, as well as unlimited mileage and other extras.
entries.translation: Gik ma oket kanyakla gi oting'o kwan mar odiechienge ma ing'adoye gare, kaachiel gi kwan mar bor ma odhiye kod gik mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You may also be able to get a discount if you book your rental car in advance.
entries.translation: Bende inyalo ng'ad ni nengo ka imako chon mtoka ma idwaro ng'ado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When picking up your rental car, be sure to inspect it carefully for any damage.
entries.translation: E sama iyiero mtoka ma idwaro ng'ado, tem ine ni irango mtoka no e yor adimba ka irango ka okethre e yo moro amora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you see any damage, be sure to note it on the rental agreement.
entries.translation: Ka ineno kamoro amora mokethre, ne ni indiko gino e oboke mar yierruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also take pictures of the car before you drive it away.
entries.translation: Bende ber ka igoyo mtoka no piche kapok iwuok kode.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Uganda Martyrs are a group of 23 Anglican and 22 Roman Catholic Christians who were killed between 1885 and 1887.
entries.translation: Ji Mane Onegi Nikech Yie Margi e piny Uganda en kanyakla mar Jokristo 23 mag kanisa mar Anglican kod 22 mag Roman Catholic mane oneg e kind higa mar 1885 kod 1887.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were killed by the king of Buganda, Mwanga II, for refusing to renounce their faith.
entries.translation: Mwanga II mane en ruoth mar Buganda ema ne onego gi nikech ne gitamre weyo yie margi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The martyrs were canonized by Pope Paul VI in 1964.
entries.translation: Ji mane oneg go ne oyang kaka joma ler gi Papa Paul VI e higa mar 1964.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are considered to be among the most important figures in the history of Christianity in Uganda.
entries.translation: Okaw gi kaka ji madongo ahinya e sigana mar Jo Kristo e piny Uganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Uganda Martyrs' Day is celebrated on June 3rd every year.
entries.translation: Odiechieng' mar par Ji Mane Oneg Nikech Yie Margi Uganda itimo ga tarik 3 dwe mar Auchiel higa ka higa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a national holiday in Uganda and is observed by Christians all over the world.
entries.translation: En nyasi mitimo ga e piny Uganda kendo Jokristo tee e piny ngima time ga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The martyrs are remembered for their courage and their willingness to die for their faith.
entries.translation: Ji mane oneg nikech yie gi no iparo ga nikech chir kod bedo moikre mar tho nikech yie margi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are an inspiration to Christians everywhere.
entries.translation: Gimiyo Jokristo tee chuny kamoro amora magin tiee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the upcoming months, I will be honored to receive an award for my work in the field of French language studies.
entries.translation: E dweche mabiro, abiro bedo gi luor mar yudo mich mar tija motudre gi weche mag somo dhok mar jo France.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The award will be presented by the Société Française de Linguistique, a prestigious organization dedicated to the advancement of French language and linguistics.
entries.translation: Michno ibiro chiw gi Société Française de Linguistique, maen riwruok manigi nyadhi kendo mochiwre mar bero dhok mar jo France kod weche somo dhok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am humbled and grateful to be recognized by such a distinguished organization, and I look forward to continuing my work in French language studies.
entries.translation: Abolra kendo agoyo erokamano kuom puoch mane ayudo kowuok kuom duol maduong' kamano, kendo ageno dhi nyime gi tich ma atimo e somo dhok mar jo France.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My research interests lie in the area of historical linguistics, and I have focused my work on the development of French from its origins in the Gallo-Romance dialects of the early Middle Ages.
entries.translation: Gigo madwaro timo e nonro gin gik ma otudre gi somo sigana mar dhok mopogre opogre, kendo aketo pacha e tija mar bero dho France kowuok e kama ne ochakreye e dhok matindo mag Gallo-Romance e kinde mar Higni Machon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am particularly interested in the ways in which French has been influenced by other languages, such as Latin, Germanic languages, and Arabic.
entries.translation: Ahero ahinya ahinya yore mopogre opogre ma dho France osedonjre gi dhok mamoko, kaka Latin, dhok jo Jirman, kod dho Arab.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My research has been published in leading journals in the field of linguistics, and I have presented my work at conferences around the world.
entries.translation: Nonro mara osego e buge madongo e kidieny mar somo dhok mopogre, kendo asedhi e romo mopogre opogre e piny ngima ma awacho tich matimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am based at a university located near the French border, and I have had the opportunity to collaborate with scholars from France and other Francophone countries.
entries.translation: Ayudra e mbalarieny mantie machiegni gi tong' mar France, kendo aseyudo thuolo mar tiyo kanyakla gi josomo mowuok e piny France kod pinje mamoko mawacho dho France.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My research has made a significant contribution to the field of French language studies, and I am proud to have been recognized for my work.
entries.translation: Nonro mara osechiwo kony maduong' e kidieny mar somo dhok mar jo France, kendo amor ni tija oseyudo mich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Akosua Aunty: Hello, children. What can I do for you?
entries.translation: Akosua Anti: Amosou nyithindo. Ang'o ma anyalo timo nu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cousin 1: We need your help with a decision.
entries.translation: Kasin 1: Wadwaro konyni e ng'ado wach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We're all trying to decide whether or not to cheat on a test tomorrow.
entries.translation: Wan duto watemo ng'ado ka onego wakwal kata kik wakwal penj ma kiny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cousin 2: Yeah, we know it's wrong, but we're all really scared of failing.
entries.translation: Kasin 2: Eh, wang'eyo ni ok owinjore, kata kamano wan duto waluor rem.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Akosua Aunty: I understand that you're scared, but cheating is never the answer.
entries.translation: Akosua Anti: Ang'eyo ni uluor, kata kamano kwalo ok e duoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to remember that integrity is one of the most important things in life.
entries.translation: Ber uparni bedo ja adier en achiel kuom gik madongo ahinya e ngima ka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you cheat, you're not just cheating yourself, you're also cheating everyone else who has worked hard to learn the material.
entries.translation: Sama ikwalo penj, oken mana wuondori iwuon kende, bende en wuondo ji duto ma otiyo matek e somo gino.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cousin 1: But what if we really do fail?
entries.translation: Kasin 1: To ka adier warem?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Akosua Aunty: If you fail, then you fail. That's life.
entries.translation: Akosua Anti: Ka irem, to irem. Mano e ngima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But at least you'll know that you did your best and you didn't cheat.
entries.translation: To ober berie nikech ibiro ng'eyo ni ne itemo berni kendo ne ok ikwalo penj.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And that's what matters most.
entries.translation: Kendo mano e gima duong' moloyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cousin 2: You're right, Aunty.
entries.translation: Kasin 2: Iwacho adier anti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to do the right thing, even if it's hard.
entries.translation: Onego watim gima owinjore, kata ka otek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Dance, Henry, dance" the old woman cried "Dance and let the colors of life flow through you.
entries.translation: "Miel, Henry, miel" miyo maduong'no ne owacho "Miel kendo iwe rangi mag ngima okal kuomi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let the music fill your soul and your body will move of its own accord.
entries.translation: We mondo thum opong' chunyi kendo dendi biro miel kende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dance and be free" Henry looked at the old woman with confusion.
entries.translation: Miel kendo ibed thuolo" Henry nene orango miyono gi wuoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had never been a dancer, and he didn't understand why she was so insistent that he should start now.
entries.translation: Pokne obedo ga jamiel nyaka nene, kendo ne ok ong'eyo gima omiyo miyono ne oramo ni ochak sani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But the old woman's eyes were bright and her face was filled with joy, and Henry couldn't help but be drawn in.
entries.translation: To wenge miyo maduong'no ne rieny kendo suche ne opong' kod mor, kendo Henry ne oknyal hepo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He took a deep breath and began to move.
entries.translation: Ne ogamo muya matut kendo chako miel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At first, his movements were awkward and hesitant, but as he continued to dance, he began to relax and let the music take over.
entries.translation: Mokuongo, miende ne ok donji kendo ne ochung' ochung' to kaka ne odhi mbele miel, ne ochako kue kendo weyo thum mondo otere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The colors of the world swirled around him, and he felt a sense of freedom and joy that he had never experienced before.
entries.translation: Rangi mag piny ne ogo rach kuome, kendo ne owinjo ka en thuolo kendo winjo mor ma pokne owinjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the music stopped, Henry was breathless and exhilarated.
entries.translation: Kane thum ochung', Henry ne opong gi mor gi ilo ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He looked at the old woman and smiled "Thank you," he said "I don't know why I didn't dance before.
entries.translation: Ne orango miyo maduong'no kendo buonjo "Erokamano," ne owacho "Ok ang'eyo gima omiyo ne pok amiel ga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “So, what are you looking for in a life partner?”
entries.translation: "Koro irango ang'o kuom ngama nyalo bedo ng'etni ma nyaka chieng'?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The question hung in the air, heavy with expectation.
entries.translation: Penjono ne oliero e kor yamo, ka irito duoko ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took a sip of my drink and glanced across the table at the woman I’d been on a few dates with.
entries.translation: Ne aliso math mara kendo rango miyo mane asedhi godo oko kuom ndalo moko matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was beautiful, with long dark hair, piercing blue eyes, and a smile that could light up a room.
entries.translation: Ne ojaber, yie wiye ne bor to rateng', en gi wenge ma ochikore to rambulu, kendo buonjo mare ne kelo mor e ot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But was she the one for me?
entries.translation: To be ne en ema owinjore na?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I thought about it for a moment.
entries.translation: Ne aparo wachno kuom thuolo matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “I’m looking for someone who is kind, intelligent, and funny,” I said.
entries.translation: "Amanyo ngama chunye ler, riek, to ong'eyo kelo nyiero," ne awacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “Someone who I can connect with on a deep level.”
entries.translation: "Ng'at ma anyalo tudora godo e ondamo mabor."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She nodded “That sounds like a good start,” she said “What about physical attraction? Is that important to you?”
entries.translation: Ne ogoyo wiye "Mano chakruok maber," miyono ne owacho "To ber ma inyalo ne? Mano bende en gima imiyo pek?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I shrugged “It’s not the most important thing,” I said “But it’s definitely a factor.”
entries.translation: Ne aiko goka "Oken gima amiyo pek moloyo," ne awacho "Kata kamano en gima bende arango."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled “I know what you mean,” she said “I’m the same way.”
entries.translation: Ne obuonjo "Ang'eyo gima iwacho," ne owacho "Anbe an kamano."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked for a while longer, about our hopes and dreams, our goals and aspirations.
entries.translation: Ne wadhi loso kuom thoulo mabet lach, kuom geno kod lek magwa, gik ma wadwaro kod gombo timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The more we talked, the more I felt like I was getting to know the real her.
entries.translation: Kaka ne wamedo loso, ne amedo winjo ka gima adhi mbele ng'eyo ngama en adier.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And the more I liked her.
entries.translation: Kendo e kaka ne amedo here.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The recent rise of social media has given rise to a new breed of celebrities: the social media influencer.
entries.translation: Landruok mar mbui mag tudruok okelo jogo ma ong'ere ahinya: jogo manigi huma malach e mbui.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These individuals have amassed large followings on platforms like Twitter, Instagram, and YouTube, and they use their influence to promote products, services, and ideas.
entries.translation: Jogi oseyudo ji mathoth maluwo gi e mbui kaka Twitter, Instagram, kod YouTube, kedo gitiyo gi humbgi e uso mwandu, tije, kod paro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most popular social media influencers in the world is Kim Kardashian.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom jogo manigi huma malach e mbui mag tudruok e piny ngima en Kim Kardashian.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With over 200 million followers on Instagram, Kardashian is a powerful force in the fashion, beauty, and lifestyle industries.
entries.translation: Kaluwore ni en kod ji moheo milion 200 maluwe e mbui mar Instagram, Kardashian nikod huma maduong' e weche mar dusruok, ber, kod rwakruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She has also used her platform to speak out about social issues, such as criminal justice reform and women's rights.
entries.translation: Bende osetiyo kod mbui no e loso ewi weche mag piny, kaka lokruoge mag duonde marango weche jma oketho chik kod ratich joma mine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there is a dark side to the world of social media influencers.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, nitiere rach e tiyo kod jok manigi huma malach e mbui mag tudruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some influencers are paid by foreign governments to spread propaganda and disinformation.
entries.translation: Moko kuom jok manigi huma go ichulo kod sirikande mag pinje ma oko e lando propaganda kod weche mag miriambo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is a serious problem, as it can greatly influence public opinion and undermine democracy.
entries.translation: Ma en gima rach ahinya, nikech onyalo loko pach jopiny kendo thiro demokrasia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2016, it was revealed that Russian trolls used social media to spread propaganda and disinformation during the US presidential election.
entries.translation: E higa mar 2016, ne ofwenyore ni jo Russia ne otiyo kod mbui e lando propaganda kod weche mag miriambo e kinde mag yiero mar ker e piny Amerika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The trolls created fake accounts and used them to post pro-Trump messages and anti-Hillary Clinton messages.
entries.translation: Jogo ne oloso account mane gitiyo kod e lando weche ma pako Trump kod weche mapingo Hillary Clinton.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This had a significant impact on the election, as it helped to sway public opinion in favor of Trump.
entries.translation: Mae ne obedo kod pek e yiero no, nikech ne okonyo tero pach jopiny ir Trump.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cairo, the capital of Egypt, is the largest city in the Middle East and the third largest city in Africa.
entries.translation: Cairo, boma maduong' e piny Misri, e boma maduong' moloyo e kind pinje mag Ugwe ma diere kendo en e boma namba mar adek e duong' e Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is home to some of the world's most famous landmarks, including the Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, and the Egyptian Museum.
entries.translation: En e kama oting'o moko kuom gigo ma ong'ere ahinya kaka Pyramid mag Giza, Sphinx, kod kar kano gige machon mag Misri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other important places in Egypt include Alexandria, Luxor, Aswan, and the Sinai Peninsula.
entries.translation: Kuonde moko madongo e piny mar Misri gin kaka Alexandria, Luxor, Aswan, kod Sinai Peninsula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alexandria is Egypt's second largest city and was once the capital of the Ptolemaic Kingdom.
entries.translation: Alexandria e boma ma namba ariyo kuom duong e piny mar Misri kendo chon ne en boma maduong e piny ruoth mar Ptolemaic.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Luxor is home to the Valley of the Kings, where many of the pharaohs of ancient Egypt were buried.
entries.translation: Luxor ema nikod Valley of the Kings, ma en kama ng'eny jotelo machon mag piny Misri mane idendo ni farao ne oikie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aswan is located on the Nile River and is known for its beautiful scenery and its many ancient temples.
entries.translation: Aswan yudore e aora mar Nile kendo ong'eyore nikech ber mare kod ute lamo machon ma en godo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Sinai Peninsula is located in the eastern part of Egypt and is home to the famous Mount Sinai, where Moses is said to have received the Ten Commandments.
entries.translation: Sinai Peninsula yudore e ugwe mar Misri kendo en e kama got mar Sinai, kama iwacho ni Musa nene oyude chike apar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The gardener's journey began with a simple drive to the local nursery.
entries.translation: Wuodh japur nochakore gi riembo matoka mana matin kodhi e kar nasari mar yiende mantie machiegni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been planning this trip for weeks, ever since he had seen the advertisement in the paper.
entries.translation: Osebedo ka ochano mar timo limbeni kuom thuolo mar wige, chakre ne oneno lendo e oboke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The nursery was offering a 20% discount on all plants, and he was determined to take advantage of the sale.
entries.translation: Nasari ni noduoko piny nengo yiende duto gi 20%, kendo ne oketo e pache ni nyaka okaw thuolo ni makende mar nyiewo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When he arrived at the nursery, he was immediately overwhelmed by the selection of plants.
entries.translation: Kane ochopo e nasari, kanyo gi kanyo noyudo yiende mathoth motame yiero.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were flowers of every color and shape, vegetables of all sizes, and trees that reached for the sky.
entries.translation: Nenitie mauwa man kod kido kod chwech duto, alode madongo gi matindo kod yiende maboyo mane hawo kor polo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He wandered around for hours, admiring the plants and dreaming of the beautiful garden he would create.
entries.translation: Ne owuotho eiye kanyo kuom seche buora, ka orango yiende kendo nobedo gi lek mar kit kaka puothe dhibedo mondisore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, he made his selections and headed to the checkout counter.
entries.translation: Giko, notimo yiero mage kendo nochomo kar chudo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As he was paying for his plants, he noticed a sign that said "Free delivery for orders over $50" He smiled and added a few more plants to his cart.
entries.translation: E seche mane ochulo pes yiende meke, ne oneno ranyisi mane ondiki niya "Wateroni pacho maonge chudo ka inyiewo yiende mabechgi romo $50" Nobuonjo kaeto nomedo yiende moko matin kendo e adita mare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A few days later, the gardener received a delivery of his new plants.
entries.translation: Ndalo machuok bange', japurno noyudo yiende meke manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He eagerly unpacked them and began to plant them in his garden.
entries.translation: Nogonyo gi gisironyo kendo nochako pidho gi e puothe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He worked for hours, carefully placing each plant in the perfect spot.
entries.translation: Notiyo kuom seche buora, ka oketo yien ka yien e bur mowinjore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When he was finished, he stood back and admired his work.
entries.translation: Kanotieko, nochung' gi chien kendo wuoro kaka notimo tich maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The garden was beautiful, and he knew that he would enjoy spending many hours tending to it.
entries.translation: Puothe neneno mondisore kendo nong'eyo ni nodhibedo gi mor mar kawo seche mathoth ka omiyo gi arita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These are just a few of the issues that can plague a car that has been in a minor accident.
entries.translation: Magi gin mana moko kuom weche matin manyalo kelo midhiero ne matoka ma oseyudo masira matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While the damage may not seem significant, it can still be dangerous and expensive to fix.
entries.translation: Kata obedo ni kama okethore nyalo neno ni tin, pod onyalo keto ngima e akerekeke kendo nengo mar lose ni malo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the case of worn or falling apart rubber pieces, this can be a safety hazard.
entries.translation: Kotimore ni raba otii kata oyiech, mae nyalo kelo midhiero maduong' mar arita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rubber is used in a variety of places on a car, including the tires, brake pads, and seals.
entries.translation: Raba itiyogodo e kuonde mathoth e matoka, koriwo tielo, lai mar breg matoka kod sil mag dino.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When rubber becomes worn, it can crack, split, or otherwise deteriorate.
entries.translation: E seche ma raba otii, onyalo barore, yiech kata kethore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a number of problems, such as reduced traction, decreased braking performance, and leaks.
entries.translation: Mae nyalo kelo midhiero moko, kaka duoko piny ngirruok mar matoka e apaya, duoko piny kaka breg matoka tiyo kod kelo chwer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Missing roof rail pieces can also be a safety hazard.
entries.translation: Matoka ka onge gi raba mag reru mag tate, bende kelo midhiero.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Roof rails are designed to help protect passengers in the event of a rollover accident.
entries.translation: Reru mar tado mar matoka olosi mar konyo jowuoth ka matoka oyudo masira mong'ielore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the roof rails are missing, the roof of the car is more likely to collapse in a rollover, which can cause serious injuries or death.
entries.translation: Ka reru mag tado onge, tado mar matoka nyalo nywowore ka matoka ong'ielore, gino manyalo kelo hinyruoge maricho kata tho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A broken fuel tank door lock can also be dangerous.
entries.translation: Raum mar tangi mar mo ka okethore, bende nyalo kelo midhiero.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the fuel tank door cannot be locked, it could come open while the car is moving.
entries.translation: Ka raum mar tangi mar mo oknyal lorore, onyalo yaore e seche ma matoka ringo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could spill fuel onto the road, which could cause a fire or explosion.
entries.translation: Mae nyalo miyo mo chwer e apaya, gino manyalo kelo mach kata muoch.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the safety risks, these types of damage can also be expensive to fix.
entries.translation: Kaachiel gi midhiero mag arita, ng'ikruok machalo gi magi bende muonyo omenda mathoth ka ilosogi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rubber pieces can be difficult to replace, and roof rails and fuel tank door locks can be expensive to repair or replace.
entries.translation: Nyalo bedo matek nyiewo raba manyien, reru mag tado kod raum mag tangi mar mo bende nengo mar loso kata nyiewo manyien ni malo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, it may be more cost-effective to total the car and buy a new one.
entries.translation: Seche moko, nyalo bedo gino makungo ofuko ka iuso matoka kendo inyiewo manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are considering buying a used car that has been in a minor accident, be sure to have it inspected by a qualified mechanic.
entries.translation: Ka in kod paro mar nyiewo matoka ma osetigodo moseyudo masira matin mar apaya, neni orange gi makanika man kod lony.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They will be able to identify any damage that may not be visible to the naked eye, and they can advise you on whether or not the car is safe to buy.
entries.translation: Obiro yango ng'ikruok moro amora ma okinyal neno koda wang', kendo obiro ng'ado ni rieko ka en kare nyiewo matoka no kata ooyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A bicycle is a thing of beauty, sleek and streamlined, its wheels a blur of motion as it glides along the road.
entries.translation: Ndiga en gino maneno ber, mopuch kendo oriere, tiendene neno mondisore e seche ma gikier e apaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what happens when you bring a bike into a small room?
entries.translation: To en ang'o matimore e seche ma ikelo ndiga e kiru mathin?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suddenly, all that grace and efficiency is lost, and the bike becomes a clumsy, awkward intruder.
entries.translation: Apoya nono, ber duto kod yot mare lal, kendo ndiga no koro bedo gino maradhayi kendo magalagala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I once had a bike in a small room.
entries.translation: Nitie kinde mane antie kod ndiga e kiru matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a cramped, dingy apartment in a rundown neighborhood, and the bike took up most of the space.
entries.translation: Ne en ot matin, mothung' e kar dak moro oko mar boma kendo ndiga nekawo thuolo maduong' ei ot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I could barely get through the door without knocking it over, and I had to be careful not to trip over it when I was in the middle of the night.
entries.translation: Nokanyal kaloe dhot mokatwomo ndigano, kendo nechuno ni abed akicha mondo kik okier ma olwar chuny otieno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even though the bike was a nuisance, I couldn't bring myself to get rid of it.
entries.translation: Kata obedo ni ndigano ne okmiya kwe, neonge kuma nanyalo tere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a reminder of a better time, when I was young and free and full of hope.
entries.translation: Noparona ni nitie saa maber, kane pod atin kendo ne an thuolo kapong' kod geno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I would sit on the bike and dream of all the places I could go, all the adventures I could have.
entries.translation: Nanyalo bedo ewi ndiga kaparo kuonde duto mane anyalo dhiye, gigo duto manyien mane anyalo neno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I finally decided to get rid of the bike.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro achiel, gikone to nene ang'ado wach ni agolo ndigano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took it to the curb and put it out for the trash.
entries.translation: Natere thenge kendo akete ei yugi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I watched it being hauled away, I felt a pang of regret.
entries.translation: Kane aneno ka iywaye kendo idhikode, nene aywago ang'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the early 1900s, Americans were introduced to the drug “morphine” through the use of over-the-counter cough syrups.
entries.translation: E chakruok mar hik 1900s, yath mar “morphine” ne ochak mi oganda Joamerka kokalo kuom yadhe amadha mag ahonda mane inyiewo e duke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While this drug was initially used to treat pain, it soon became addictive and led to a rise in the number of drug addicts in the United States.
entries.translation: Kata obedo ni motelo yadhni nitiyogodo mar thiedho rem, bang' ndalo machuok nobedo kaka yath mamero kendo nomiyo kwan mar oganda mane tiyo gi yedhe mamero medore e piny Amerka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most tragic stories of this era is that of the “Kitten Lady”.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom sigana marach magoki e kinde ni ne en mar “Miyo Manohera Nyithi Pusi”.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This woman was a morphine addict who had a litter of kittens.
entries.translation: Miyoni mane opidha nyithi pusi, netiyo gi morphine kaka yath mamero.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loved her kittens very much and would often play with them for hours on end.
entries.translation: Nohero nyithi pusi meke ahinya kendo nonyalo tugo kodgi kuom seche mathoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, her addiction soon took over and she began to neglect her kittens.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, bedo ni notiyo gi yath mamere ne omiye pek kendo nochako bolo nyithi pusi meke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She would leave them for days at a time, only coming back to feed them and give them water.
entries.translation: Seche moko nonyalo weyogi kuom ndalo, noduogo mana miyogi chiemo kod pii modho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The kittens eventually began to suffer from the neglect.
entries.translation: Kaluwore gi mago, nyithi pusi nochako bedo gi pek kaluwore gi bol mane obolgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They became thin and sickly, and their fur began to fall out.
entries.translation: Negidhero kendo negitwore, kaeto yiege gi nochako lwar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One by one, they started to die.
entries.translation: Negichako tho, moro bang' nyawadgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Kitten Lady was devastated by the loss of her kittens, but she was unable to stop her addiction.
entries.translation: Miyo ma Wuon Nyithi Pusi ne chunye ogore kuom wito nyithi pusi mage, kata kamano nokonyal weyo tiyo gi yedhe mamero.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She eventually died of a morphine overdose, leaving her kittens behind.
entries.translation: Giko, notho bang' ka otiyo gi yath mar morphine mokalo dos, kendo noweyo nyithi pusi mage.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This story is a reminder of the dangers of drug addiction.
entries.translation: Sigana ni paronwa rach mabiro kaluwore gi tiyo gi yedhe mamero jii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a reminder of the love and devotion that animals can have for their humans.
entries.translation: Bende oparonwa hera kod bolruok ma le nyalo bedogodo kuom dhano modak kodgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sexual orientation refers to a person's romantic and sexual attraction to others, while gender identity refers to a person's internal sense of being male or female.
entries.translation: Kit chwech luwo kaka ng'ato bedo gi gombo mar hera kata timo hera gi jii mamoko, to yangruok mar kit chwech luwo kaka ng'ato winjo e dende ka en ng'ama dichwo kata dhako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people face discrimination in many areas of life, including employment, housing, and healthcare.
entries.translation: Oganda jo LGBT kalo e akwede e yore mathoth mag ngima, koriwo yor tije, udi kod yore thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also more likely to experience violence and abuse.
entries.translation: Bende gintie e thuolo mamalo mar kaloe monj kod tulo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no one single cause of LGBT identity.
entries.translation: Onge wach achiel mamiyo ng'ato yangore ni en ja LGBT.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people are born with an innate sense of their sexual orientation or gender identity, while others develop these feelings over time.
entries.translation: Nitie jogo ma inyuolo ka gin kod paro ma iye mar kit chwech margi kata yangruok mar chwech margi, to jomamoko to gigi yudo ewi dongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people are just as diverse as the rest of the population.
entries.translation: Oganda jo LGBT gin mana jogo man gi pogruok malach mana kaka jii mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They come from all walks of life and have a wide range of interests and experiences.
entries.translation: Giwuok kuom ogendni mopogore opogore e ngima kendo gin kod gigo mamorogi kendo gigo ma gikaloe mathoth mopogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The medical community recognizes that sexual orientation and gender identity are not mental illnesses.
entries.translation: Migao mar thieth oyango ni kit chwech kod yangruok mar chwech mar ng'ato oken tuwo mar obuongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, the American Psychiatric Association removed homosexuality from its list of mental disorders in 1973.
entries.translation: Adier, Riwruok mar Jolony Mag Tuoche Obuongo ma Amerka nogolo oko bedo ni oganda man gi kit chwech achiel nyalo herore ei kwan mar twoche mag obuongo e higa 1973.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people should be able to live their lives openly and authentically.
entries.translation: Oganda jo LGBT owinjore obedi ni gin thuolo mar dago ngima ka giyangore kendo eyo maratiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They deserve to be treated with respect and dignity.
entries.translation: Gin kod ratiro mar yudo luor kowuok kuom oganda mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In many countries, there are laws that protect LGBT people from discrimination.
entries.translation: E pinje mathoth, nitie chike marito oganda jo LGBT mondo kik gikalie akwede.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Hello, and welcome to your annual checkup.
entries.translation: Laktar: Amosi, kendo machiegni e nonro mari ma higa ka higa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: How are you feeling today?
entries.translation: Kawuono iwinjo nade?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I'm feeling pretty good, all things considered.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Awinjo maber matin, ka ariwo weche duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've been getting a little more sleep lately, and my diet has been pretty healthy.
entries.translation: Asebedo ka anindo kuom thuolo mang'eny machiegni kendo kit chiemba en marito ngima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's great to hear.
entries.translation: Laktar: Mano ber ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm going to start by taking your vital signs.
entries.translation: Adhichako ka akawo ranyisi magi ma wamiyo pek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [The doctor takes the patient's blood pressure, pulse, and temperature.]
entries.translation: [Laktar pimo presa mar remo, gwecho mar adundo kod liet mar dend jatuo.]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Everything looks good here.
entries.translation: Laktar: Pim gi duto nyiso ni in kare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Now, let's talk about your diet.
entries.translation: Koro, walos matin ewi kit chiembi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What are you eating on a typical day?
entries.translation: E odiechieng', in ijachamo ang'o gini?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I usually have a bowl of cereal for breakfast, a sandwich for lunch, and a salad for dinner.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Ajachamo siriol e metho mara ma okinyi, achamo sandwich saa lanch kaeto gotieno achamo alode gi olemo molosi godo salad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also try to eat fruits and vegetables throughout the day.
entries.translation: Bende atemo mondo acham olemo gi alode e odiechieng' mangima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That sounds like a healthy diet.
entries.translation: Laktar: Awinjo ka mano kit chiemo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Are you getting enough exercise?
entries.translation: Bende irieyo fuonde mag dendi moromo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I try to get at least 30 minutes of exercise most days of the week.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Atemo ni arieyo fuonde mag denda kuom dakika 30 e ndalo mathoth mag wik.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I walk to work, and I play basketball once or twice a week.
entries.translation: Awuotho gi tienda kadhi tich kendo atugo basketbol dichiel kata diriyo e wik.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's great. Exercise is an important part of a healthy lifestyle.
entries.translation: Laktar: Mano ber. Rieyo fuonde mag del en gino maber ahinya eyor rito ngima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I know. I'm trying to be more active.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Ang'eyo. Atemo ni mondo aket mahino moloyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is a country in Central Africa with a population of over 80 million people.
entries.translation: Piny Mar Demokrasia mar Kongo (DRC) en piny mantie e Afrika Madiere kendo nigi kwan dhano mahingo milion 80.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the second-largest country in Africa by area, and is endowed with vast natural resources, including copper, cobalt, diamonds, and gold.
entries.translation: En e piny mar ariyo kuom lach e Afrika, kendo en kod mwandu mathoth mantie e lowo, koriwo kopa, kobalt, kite mag almas kod mula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the DRC has been plagued by conflict for decades, which has had a devastating impact on its people and economy.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, piny DRC osebedo gi tungni kuom higni mathoth, gino mosethiro marach oganda kod ochumi mar pinyno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first major conflict in the DRC was the First Congo War, which lasted from 1996 to 1997.
entries.translation: Tulo mokwongo mapek e piny DRC neen Lweny Mokwongo e Piny Kongo, mane obedo chakre 1996 nyaka 1997.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This war was fought between the government of Mobutu Sese Seko and a rebel group led by Laurent Kabila.
entries.translation: Ma neen lweny ekind sirikal mar Mobutu Sese Seko kod jolwenj apiny piny mane otelnigi kod Laurent Kabila.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kabila eventually succeeded in overthrowing Mobutu and taking power.
entries.translation: Giko to Kabila nothicho oko Mobutu kendo ne okawo loch.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, Kabila's rule was short-lived.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, Kabila nokobudho e telo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1998, he was overthrown by a new rebel group led by Jean-Pierre Bemba.
entries.translation: Higa 1998, nothiche e telo gi jolwenj apiny piny ka otelnegi kod Jean-Pierre Bemba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This led to the Second Congo War, which lasted until 2003.
entries.translation: Mae nokelo Lweny Mar Ariyo mar Kongo, mane ogore nyaka higa 2003.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Second Congo War was the deadliest conflict in modern African history, and resulted in the deaths of over 5 million people.
entries.translation: Lweny Mar Ariyo mar Kongo ne e tulo marachie moloyo e historia mar Afrika ma sani, kendo nokelo tho mar mahingo oganda milion 5.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The DRC has also been plagued by political instability.
entries.translation: DRC bende osebedo gi tungni mar siasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Last week, my uncle was out in the field harvesting corn when he spotted a snake slithering across the ground.
entries.translation: Wik mokalo, wuora nenitie e puodho ka oridho bando eka noneno thuol karingo piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He decided to take a closer look, and as he got closer, he realized that it was a huge rattlesnake!
entries.translation: Ne ong'ado ni osud machiegni mondo onene, kendo kaka nomedo sudo machiegni, nofwenyo ni ne en thuol maduong'!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He quickly backed away, but the snake was already on the move.
entries.translation: Ne ochikore chien mapiyo, kata kamano, thuolno ne osechako luwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It headed straight for my uncle, who started to run.
entries.translation: Nochomo wuora tir, kendo wuora nochako ringo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ran as fast as he could, but the snake was gaining on him.
entries.translation: Noringo matek ahinya, kata kamano thuolno nechiegni kode ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just when it seemed like the snake was going to catch him, my uncle tripped and fell.
entries.translation: E seche mane chalo kagima thuol nedhi make, wuora nokier kendo nolwar piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He landed in a big pile of manure, and the snake slid right past him.
entries.translation: Nolwar ewi owuoyo mathoth kendo thuol nokier mokale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My uncle was so relieved that he had escaped, but he was also covered in manure.
entries.translation: Wuoro nene oyudo fuong'ruok ni noyombo thuol, bende noume gi owuoyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The plastic bag is a ubiquitous object in our modern world.
entries.translation: Ofuku mag plastik gin gigo mayudore kuonde duto e pinywa masani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is used for everything from carrying groceries to picking up dog poop.
entries.translation: Itiyo kodgi e timo gikmoko duto chakre ting'o alode nyaka ting'o oko mar guok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what is the true cost of this seemingly innocuous item?
entries.translation: Kata kamano, nengo mar adier mar mwandu ni machalo ni onge gi midhieroni en mane?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Plastic bags are made from a type of plastic called polyethylene, which is derived from fossil fuels.
entries.translation: Ofuko mag plastik olosi kowuok kuom kit plastik miluongo ni polithin, ma igolo kuom mwandu mantie e bwo lowo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The production of plastic bags requires a great deal of energy, and it also releases harmful pollutants into the environment.
entries.translation: Loso mar ofuku mag plastiki dwaro teko mathoth mar sitima, kendo bende ogolo muya maricho machido alwora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once plastic bags are discarded, they can take hundreds of years to decompose.
entries.translation: Ka osewiti ofuku mag plastik, ginyalo kawo higni miche mar mondo ging'injre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that they can accumulate in landfills and oceans, where they can harm wildlife and pollute our water supply.
entries.translation: Mae tiende ni ginyalo chokore e piny kod ei pii namb ataro, kama ginyalo kelo midhiero ne ngima lee kendo chido pii mawayudo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Plastic bags are also a major source of litter.
entries.translation: Ofuko mag plastik gin achiel kuom gigo madongo machido alwora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be found on beaches, in parks, and even in our own neighborhoods.
entries.translation: Giyudore e dhonembe, ei kwonde yueyo kod kata kuonde mawadakie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Litter is unsightly and can be a hazard to wildlife.
entries.translation: Chilo oken gimaber neno kendo nyalo kelo midhiero ne lee mag bungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The plastic bag is a symbol of our throwaway culture.
entries.translation: Ofuku mag plastik en gino manyiso tim marwa mar wito gikmoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We use them for a few minutes and then discard them, never giving a thought to the environmental consequences.
entries.translation: Watiyo kodgi kaeto wawito gi bang' dakika matin, ka ok warango midhiero magikelo e alwora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to find ways to reduce our use of plastic bags.
entries.translation: Owinjore wamany yore mag duoko piny kwan ofuku mag plastiki ma watiyogodo.

entries.english: In the end, it was a photo finish, but the winner was clear: a young woman with long, flowing hair and a determined expression on her face.
entries.translation: Gikone, ne en ng'wech ma jaloch ne inyalo mana yangi ka itiyo gi picha, kata kamano jaloch nene oyangore: miyo mapod tin man kod yier wich maboyo kendo neneno ja siniani.

entries.english: She had won the gold medal, and she had made her country proud.

entries.english: As she stood on the podium, her national anthem played, and she waved to the cheering crowd.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had achieved her dream, and she had shown the world that anything is possible if you work hard and never give up.

entries.english: All over the world, athletes were competing in their respective sports, all with the same goal in mind: to win.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some would succeed, and some would fail, but all would have their stories to tell.

entries.english: Organ Trafficking: A Growing Problem Organ trafficking is a serious problem that affects people around the world.
entries.translation: Ohand Loko Fuonde Mag Del: Midhiero Motucho mar ohand Fuonde Mag Del en midhiero maduong' ma chando ji mathoth e piny mangima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Every year, thousands of people are tricked, coerced, or kidnapped into giving up their organs.
entries.translation: Higa ka higa, dhano alufe gi alufe iwuondo, ichuno kata indhiyo mar mondo gichiw fuonde mag dendgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These organs are then sold to wealthy people who can afford to pay for them.
entries.translation: Bang'e to fuonde gi iuso ne ji momewo manyalo chulo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Organ trafficking is a lucrative business.
entries.translation: Ohand fuonde mag del en ohala maduong' ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The black market price for a single organ can range from \$100,000 to \$1 million.
entries.translation: Nengo mar chiro mar apiny piny mar fuonde achiel kende nyalobedo e kind \$100,000 nyaka dola milion \$1.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes it a very attractive option for criminals who are looking to make a quick buck.
entries.translation: Mae miyo obedo yonro mayuayo ahinya jo mahundu mamanyo yor chamo mayom.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Organ trafficking is often carried out by organized crime groups.
entries.translation: Ohand fuonde mag del ithoro loki gi girube mopangi mag jomahundu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These groups use a variety of methods to recruit victims, including force, fraud, and deception.
entries.translation: Grube gi tiyo kod yore mathoth mag ndiko jokanyo, koriwo achune, oledhi kod wuondo ji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Victims are often lured into the country with promises of a job or a better life.
entries.translation: Jogo makaloe gigi iwuondo kendo donjo e pinyno bang' miyo gi geno mar yudo tije kata ngima maber moloyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once they are here, they are held captive and forced to give up their organs.
entries.translation: Kagisechopo kae, to indhiyo gi kendo ichuno gi mondo gichiw fuonde mag del mag gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Organ trafficking can have devastating consequences for victims.
entries.translation: Ohand fuonde mag del nyalo bedo gi midhiero maricho ahinya ne jogo makaloe gigo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Not only do they suffer physical and psychological trauma, but they may also die from the surgery.
entries.translation: Koweyo sand mag del kod paro, bende ginyalo wito ngimagi e seche ma iyang'o gi mar golo fuonde go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, organ trafficking can spread diseases such as HIV and hepatitis.
entries.translation: Bende, ohand fuonde mag del nyalo medo nyayo landruok mag kute makelo ayaki, HIV kod hepataitis.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fight against organ trafficking is a complex one.
entries.translation: Lwenj kedo gi ohand fuonde mag del en lweny matek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no single solution that will work in every case.
entries.translation: Onge yor konyruok achiel manyalo tiyo e kinde duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young girl named Mary was combing her hair when she saw a louse.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro achiel, nyako moro matin manyinge Mary neyuoyo wiye kane eka noneno nyuogo.

entries.english: She was horrified, and she ran to her mother for help.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her mother told her that there were many traditional remedies for lice, and that she would try the one that required the least amount of action.
entries.translation: Min mare nonyise ni nitie yore mathoth mag nyadala mag tieko midhiero mar nyuogo, kendo nonyalo temo achiel kuom yore manedwaro ni otim gik matin kende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first thing her mother did was to boil a pot of water.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, she added a handful of dried rosemary leaves and let them steep for a few minutes.
entries.translation: Bang'e, nomedo it oboke matin, motwo mar rosemary kendo weyo ochwakre kuom dakika machuok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After the water had cooled, her mother poured it into a bowl and told Mary to sit down.
