entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She then used a comb to wet Mary's hair with the rosemary water.

entries.english: The lice started to die, and Mary was able to pick them out of her hair with ease.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her mother was so happy that she had been able to help Mary without having to take any drastic measures.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knew that Mary would be able to sleep soundly that night, knowing that she was free of lice.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next day, Mary's mother went to the store and bought a bottle of lice shampoo.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She told Mary that it was important to use the shampoo to kill any remaining lice, and that she should follow the directions on the bottle carefully.

entries.english: Work is worship is a principle that states that all work, no matter how menial or insignificant it may seem, is sacred.
entries.translation: Tich en lamo en chik mawacho ni tije duto gi tije makende, gibed mitimo gi teko mathoth kata maneno matin maromo nade.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a belief that every task we perform, from cooking dinner for our children to cleaning the house, is an opportunity to honor God and our fellow man.
entries.translation: Nitie yie ni tije duto ma watimo, chakre tendo chiemb otieno ne nyithindo nyaka lwoko ot, en thuolo mar nyiso lwor ne Nyasaye kod dhano wetewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we work with this mindset, we approach our tasks with a sense of reverence and respect.
entries.translation: Ka watiyo gi paro machalo kaka mae, watimo tije mekwa gi lwor makende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We take pride in our work and do our best to do it well.
entries.translation: Wabedo gi nyadhi e tijwa kendo watemo matek mar time maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We also become more mindful of the people who will benefit from our work, and we are more likely to go the extra mile to make sure that it is done well.
entries.translation: Bende wabedo gi paro malong'o kuom oganda mabiro yudo ber kuom tijwa, kendo nitie thuolo ni wadhi goyo okang' machielo mar neno ni tijno otim maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Working as worship can also help us to connect with our families and communities.
entries.translation: Tiyo kaka lamo bende nyalo konyowa mar bedo gi tudruok gi familia kod oganda magwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we cook dinner for our children, we are not only providing them with nourishment, but we are also spending time with them and teaching them about the importance of food and family.
entries.translation: Ka watedo chiemb otieno ne nyithindwa, koweyo miyogi yor yieng'o, bende wabedo gi thuolo kodgi kendo puonjo gi kuom ber mar chiemo kod familia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we clean the house, we are not only making our living space more comfortable, but we are also creating a sense of order and peace.
entries.translation: Ka watimo ler e ot, koweyo keto alwora ma wadake bedo mayom ne ngima marwa, bende wabedo gi bidhruok kod kwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Work is worship is a powerful principle that can transform our lives and our relationships.
entries.translation: Tiyo en lamo en chik manigi teko ahinya manyalo kelo lokruok e ngima kod tudruoge magwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we work with this mindset, we can find meaning and purpose in even the most mundane tasks.
entries.translation: Kawatiyo gi paro machalo gi magi, wanyalo yudo tiend tich kod gimo momiyo watime kata obed ni ochalo nade.

entries.english: "Don't judge a book by its cover" is a popular saying that means one should not make assumptions about something based on its outward appearance.
entries.translation: "Kik ing'ad buch gimoro ka irange gi wang'i" en ngero marahuma ma tiende en ni ng'ato okowinjore ong'ad wach kuom paro moparo apara kaluwore gi kaka gimoro neno gioko.

entries.english: This can be applied to people, places, and things.
entries.translation: Wachni nyalo tiyo kuom dhano, kuonde kod gikmoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, you might meet someone who has a bad reputation, but after getting to know them, you realize that they are actually a kind and gentle person.
entries.translation: Kuom ranyisi, inyalo romo gi jalmoro ma nyinge rach ahinya, kata kamano bang' ng'eye matut, ifwenyo ni en ng'at mang'uon kendo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Or, you might see a building that looks old and rundown, but when you go inside, you find that it is actually a beautiful and historic place.
entries.translation: Kata, inyalo neno ot maneno motii hinya, kata kamano, kidonjo e iye, ifwenyo ni en kama nyasi kendo manigi ranyisi mag historia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many reasons why it is important not to judge things by their appearance.
entries.translation: Nitie gigo mathoth mamiyo okowinjore mar ng'ado buch gikmoko kuom neno gi gioko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, it can lead to making incorrect assumptions.
entries.translation: Mokwongo, onyalo miyo ibed gi paro mokgin adier.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, it can prevent us from seeing the true value of something.
entries.translation: Mar ariyo, onyalo ging'onwa neno ber mar adier mar gimoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, it can create unnecessary conflict and division.
entries.translation: Mar adek, onyalo kelo yuaruok kod pogruok maonge tiende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next time you are tempted to judge something by its appearance, take a moment to pause and reflect.
entries.translation: Kinde machielo ka gimoro obiro e pachi ni ing'ad ne gimoro bura kuom kaka inene, kuong ichung' mondi kendo ipar matut.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ask yourself if you are really making an informed decision, or if you are simply letting your biases cloud your judgment.
entries.translation: Pinjri kabende itimo yiero makare, kata ka iyiene paro mari otelni e ng'ado wach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remember, there is more to a person, place, or thing than meets the eye.

entries.english: Acid rain is caused when chemicals like sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxide are released into the air by power plants, factories, and cars.
entries.translation: Kodh asid biro ka kuonde dag sitima, kembe kata matokni ogolo kemikol kaka sulfur dioxide kod nitrogen oxide kadhi e kor lwasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These chemicals react with water in the atmosphere to form acids, which then fall to the ground in rain, snow, or fog.
entries.translation: Kemikol ruwore gi pi ekor yamo mar loso asid, ma kaeto chwe kaka koth, baraf kata ang'weng'o.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acid rain can damage trees by making their leaves more acidic.
entries.translation: Kodh asid nyalo ketho yiende kuom keto it yiende bedo gi asid ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can cause the leaves to turn yellow and fall off, which can weaken the tree and make it more susceptible to disease.
entries.translation: Mae nyalo miyo it yiende lokore ma ratong' kaeto gilwar piny, manyalo miyo yiende bedo mayom yom kendo bedo manyalo yudo twoche mathoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acid rain can also kill fish and other aquatic life by making the water too acidic.
entries.translation: Kodh asid bende nyalo nego rech kod gigo mamoko modak e pi kuom miyo pi bedo gi asid mang'eny mokalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, acid rain can damage buildings and statues by corroding the materials they're made of.
entries.translation: Kaachiel gi mago, kodh asid bende ketho udi kod gigo mochwe ka oketho gigo mane otigodo e loso gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that can be done to reduce acid rain.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One is to switch to cleaner energy sources, such as solar and wind power.
entries.translation: Mokwongo en chako tiyo gi yore magolo teko maler, kaka sola kod teko mar yamo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another is to install pollution controls on factories and power plants.
entries.translation: Machielo en keto rageng' mag thiro chido mar alwora ne kembe kod dag golo mach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And finally, we can all do our part by driving less, recycling more, and using energy more efficiently.
entries.translation: To giko, waduto wanyalo temo kar nyalowa kuom duoko piny riembo matoka, duoko gikmotii e kembe mondo olos kendo kod tiyo gi teko sitima eyoo makare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So the next time you see a rainstorm, think about acid rain.

entries.english: "College student's experiences with beer": As a college student, I have had my fair share of experiences with beer.

entries.english: Some of these experiences have been positive, while others have been less than ideal.
entries.translation: Moko kuom gigo masekaloe osebedo gigo mabeyo, ka moko to osebedo mago ma okbeyo ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, one experience that I will never forget is the time I got "prison beer" delivered to my dorm room.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, achiel kuom gigo ma wiya okanowil godo en kinde mane "bia mar jotwech" okelna e dhoda mar kama naninde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It all started when I was hanging out with some friends one night, and we decided to order a pizza.
entries.translation: Gigi duto nochakore kane watoyo ngona gi osiepena moko otieno moro achiel, kane ang'ado mar keto oda mar pizza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We placed our order online, and within minutes, we received a notification that our pizza was being delivered.
entries.translation: Ne waketo oda e mbui kendo bang' dakika machuok, newayudo ote machuok ni pizza marwa nosechopo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, when the delivery guy showed up, he was not carrying a pizza.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, kane jalno mane oor nochopo, ne okoting'o pizza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, he was carrying a case of beer.
entries.translation: To, noting'o kret man kod bia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were all confused, but the delivery guy explained that he had gotten our order mixed up with another order.
entries.translation: Waduto ne gino ochando pachwa, kata kamano ne olero ni oda marwa ne ogwenyore ne gi oda machielo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He said that the other person had ordered a case of beer, and he had accidentally delivered it to us instead.
entries.translation: Nowacho ni jalno machielo noketo oda mar kret mar bia, mak mana ni nokelonwa godo ka okia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were all a little hesitant at first, but we eventually decided to keep the beer.
entries.translation: Waduto ne wadikore mokwongo, giko to ne wang'ado wach ni kik oduok bia go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After all, it was free beer.
entries.translation: Nikech bende negin bia mane wayudo nono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We opened the case of beer and started drinking.
entries.translation: Ne wayawo kret mar bia kendo wachako metho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The beer was actually pretty good, and we all had a great time.
entries.translation: Bia nenigi ndhadhu maber kendo waduto ne wayuome ka wawinjo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My colleague was a hard worker, but she was always getting passed over for promotions.
entries.translation: Nyawadwa ne en ng'atno matiyo matek, kata kamano ne iweye oko seche duto mane ichoro jotich e lemo mag kar tich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was told that she needed to "work harder" or "be more visible," but it seemed like no matter what she did, she couldn't get ahead.
entries.translation: Nonyise ni owinjore "oti matek ahinya" kata "obed kama onenore ahinya," kata kamano, nenenore ni kata notim ang'o, nokonyal dhi nyime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The manager was also a problem.
entries.translation: Maneja mare bende noketo pek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was always micromanaging everyone, and he was quick to criticize.
entries.translation: Ne oluwo kaka ng'ato ka ng'ato timo tije kendo ne ohero kwedo ng'ato mapiyo ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He didn't seem to care about the employees' work-life balance, and he expected them to be available 24/7.
entries.translation: Ne nenore ni nokokao mapek yor tich to kod ngima ma pile ka pile mar jotich, kendo en nodwaro ni gibedi e tich seche duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My colleague eventually reached her breaking point.
entries.translation: Giko to nyawadwa nochopo kama nokonyal kalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She couldn't take the stress of the job anymore, and she knew that she wouldn't be able to advance her career there.
entries.translation: Paro mang'eny nomiyo okonyal dhi nyime gi tije kendo, omiyo nong'eyo ni nokonyal dhi nyime gi tije mare kanyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She gave her two weeks' notice and started looking for a new job.
entries.translation: Nochiwo barua mar weyo tich e thuolo mar wige ariyo kendo nochako manyo tich manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She found a new job that was a much better fit for her.
entries.translation: Noyudo tich manyien mane en tich maber kode moloyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pay was better, the hours were more reasonable, and the manager was supportive and understanding.
entries.translation: Chudo mare ne ber, seche mag tich bende nowinjore kendo meneja mare nemiye sir kendo ne en kod winjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's much happier now, and she's glad that she made the decision to leave her old job.
entries.translation: Koro sani en gi mor mang'eny moloyo kendo omor ni nong'ado wach ni mondo owe tije machon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm not sure what the manager is doing now, but I hope that he's learned his lesson.
entries.translation: Okan gi adier kuom gino ma maneja machon timo sani, kata kamano an gi geno ni opuonjore wach moro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He can't treat his employees like that and expect them to stay.
entries.translation: Okonyal timo ne jotije marach kamano kendo ogen ni gidhi nyime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If he wants to keep good people, he needs to change his ways.
entries.translation: Kodwaro bedo gi ji mabeyo, owinjore olok kaka otimo gikmoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for my colleague, she's doing great in her new job.
entries.translation: Kuom nyawadwa no, en odhi maber e tije motiyo sani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's getting the recognition that she deserves, and she's finally able to advance her career.
entries.translation: Oyangi tije motimo kaka owinjore kendo giko to koro onyalo dhiro nyime yore mar tich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's a great example of what happens when you stand up for yourself and refuse to put up with a bad situation.
entries.translation: Sigande en ranyisi maber mar gino matimre ka ingirori kendo tamruok dhi nyime gi yore maricho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Funny pictures and videos are a dime a dozen these days, but some of them stand out from the rest.
entries.translation: Pichni kod vidio mamoro ji tinde yudore mathoth ahinya, kata kamano moko kuomgi to beyo maloyo mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These are the ones that are so relatable or absurd that they make us laugh out loud.
entries.translation: Magi gin mago mayuayo pachwa machiegni ahinya kata magalagala mamiyo wanyiero matek ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One example is a recent video that went viral of a cat trying to fit into a small box.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom ranyisi en vidio manyocha olandore ahinya mar pusi mane temo donjo ei boksi matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The cat is clearly struggling, but it keeps trying, and the whole thing is just so funny.
entries.translation: Nenore ayanga ni pusi no kaloe pek, kata kamano omedo temo, kendo tipono moro wang' aduwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another example is a picture of a dog wearing a hat that is way too big for it.
entries.translation: Ranyisi machielo ne tipo manyiso ka guok orwako ogudu maduong' mohewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog looks so ridiculous that it's impossible not to laugh.
entries.translation: Guogno neno eyoo makelo mor kendo okinyal koso ma okinyiero.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These types of funny pictures and videos are often shared on social media, and they can quickly become a "meme" A meme is a humorous image, video, or piece of text that is copied and shared online.
entries.translation: Kit tipo kod vidio machal gi magi mag kelo mor ithoro keti e mbui mag oganda, kaeto mapiyo gibedo gino miluongo ni "meme" Meme en tipo, vidio kata andiko ma okaw kendo oor e mbui.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Memes often use familiar images or phrases, and they can be used to express a wide range of emotions.
entries.translation: Meme thoro bedo pichni kata weche ma wang'eyo, kendo inyalo ti kodgi kaka yor nyiso mor kata ich wang' kata kuyo moro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One thing that must happen when a funny picture or video goes viral is that it is shared with others.
entries.translation: Gimoro achiel manyaka timre seche ma tipo kata vidio mamoro ji olandore en ni ji mamoko bende temo mondo ochopne ji mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is what makes memes so popular.
entries.translation: Mae e gimamiyo meme bedo gi huma malach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People see a funny picture or video, and they want to share it with their friends so that they can laugh too.
entries.translation: Oganda neno tipo kata vidio mamoro ji, kendo gidwaro ni mondo ochopne osiepe gi mar mondo gibende ginyier.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is why memes can spread so quickly across the internet.
entries.translation: Mano emomiyo meme nyalo landore mapiyo ahinya kuonde duto e mbui.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world, standing at 8,848 meters above sea level.
entries.translation: Got Everest e godno maborie mogik e piny mangima, ka bor mare en mita 8,848 kokalo kor pi namb ataro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas.
entries.translation: Entie kama iluongo ni Mahalangur Himal piny mar Himalaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mountain is a popular destination for mountaineers, and many people attempt to summit it each year.
entries.translation: Godno nigi huma mar limbe ma itimone gi jogo malwenyo gode, kendo oganda temo mondo ochope ewiye malo higa ka higa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the climb is dangerous, and many people have died trying to reach the top.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, lwenye en gino maketo ngima ekind akuru gi asumbi, kendo thoth oganda osethoo kagitemo chopo e wiye malo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first recorded attempt to summit Everest was made in 1921 by a British expedition led by George Mallory.
entries.translation: Jolimbe ma piny Ingeresa kane otelnegi kod George Mallory emane otemo mokwongo chopo ewi godno mar Everest e higa 1921.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mallory and his climbing partner Andrew Irvine disappeared during their attempt, and their bodies were not found until 1999.
entries.translation: Mallory kod nyawadgi mane gilwenyo godo got, Andrew Irvine nolal e kinde mane gitemo chopo ewi Got, kendo ringre mag gi nokoyudi nyaka 1999.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1953, Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay became the first people to successfully summit Everest.
entries.translation: E higa 1953, Edmund Hillary kod Tenzing Norway nobedo jogo mane okwongo chopo ewi god Everest malo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Since then, thousands of people have followed in their footsteps.
entries.translation: Chakre kanyo, oganda mathoth bende osetimo kamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The climb to the summit of Everest is a long and arduous journey.
entries.translation: Lwenyo got Everest nyaka malo en safar mabor kendo matek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It typically takes climbers about two months to complete the journey, and they must overcome a number of challenges along the way.
entries.translation: Pile ojakawo jogo ma lwenyo gode madirom dweche ariyo mar tieko wuodhno, kendo nyaka girom gi midhiero moko e seche ma gidhi e wuodhni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These challenges include altitude sickness, extreme weather conditions, and the risk of falling.
entries.translation: Midhiero gi chalo kod bedo ma tuwo kaluwore gi bor mar kor lwasi, hali marach ahinya mag kor lwasi kod lworo mar podho piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the dangers, the climb to the summit of Everest is a rewarding experience.
entries.translation: Kata obedo ni nitie gigo maketo ngima ekind akuru gi asumbi, lwenyo nyaka ewi Everest en gino mamoro jalweny gode.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: The telescope is used to look at objects in space.
entries.translation: Miyo: Teleskop kata nyong'ong' itiyogodo mar rango gikmoko e kor lwasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Child: Can I look through it?
entries.translation: Nyathi: Bende anyalo ng'icho katiyo kode?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: Sure, but be careful not to bump it.
entries.translation: Miyo: Kamano, kata kamano bed motang' kik idhanje.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The child looks through the telescope and sees a bright star.
entries.translation: Nyathino ng'iyo teleskop kendo oneno sulwe marieny maler.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Child: Wow, it's so beautiful!
entries.translation: Nyathi: Aha, ondisore manade!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: Yes, it is. The stars are so far away, but with a telescope, we can see them up close.
entries.translation: Miyo: Kamano, ondisore. Sulwe ni mabor ahinya, kata kamano, ka watiyo gi nyong'ong', wanyalo nenogi machiegni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The child looks at other objects in space, including planets and moons.
entries.translation: Nyathino rango gigo mantie e kor lwasi, koriwo planede kod dweche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are amazed by how small and insignificant they feel compared to the vastness of the universe.
entries.translation: Owuoro kaka en owuon otin kendo othechore ka opime kod kaka kor lwasi oyayore malach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Child: I can't believe how big space is.
entries.translation: Nyathi: Awuoro kaka kor lwasi duong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: It is, but it's also full of amazing things.
entries.translation: Miyo: Oduong', bende en kod gikmoko mathoth mamoro wang'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was worried that I might have contracted Lyme disease, but I went to the doctor and he said that I didn't have anything to worry about.
entries.translation: Ne an kod lworo ni nenyalo bedo ni nayudo tuo mar Lyme, kata kamano nadhi ka laktar kendo nowacho ni okowinjore abed kod lworo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He told me that the rash was probably just a reaction to the tick's saliva.
entries.translation: Nonyisa ni gwonyo no chalo ni nowuok kaluwore gi olap okuodo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was relieved to hear that I didn't have Lyme disease, but I was still a little bit concerned about the rash.
entries.translation: Nawinjo fuong'ruok kanawinjo ni naonge tuo mar Lyme, kata kamano pod ne an gi kihondko matin nikech gwonyo no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The doctor told me that it would go away on its own, but it took a few weeks for it to completely disappear.
entries.translation: Laktar nonyisa ni gwonyo no nedhilal kende, kata kamano nokawo wige moko mondo olal chuth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the meantime, I tried to keep the rash clean and dry.
entries.translation: E seche go, natemo mondo aket gwonyo no obed maler kendo motwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also applied some over-the-counter hydrocortisone cream to help relieve the itching.
entries.translation: Bende nanyiewo yath moro e duka mar krim miluongo ni hydrocortisone mar duoko piny ilo mar gwonyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rash was itchy and unsightly, but it didn't cause me any other problems.
entries.translation: Gwonyo no ne ilo kendo noneno marach, kata kamano nokomiya pek moro amora machielo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm just glad that I didn't have Lyme disease.
entries.translation: Mor mara en ni naonge kod tuwo mar Lyme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you find a tick attached to your body, it's important to remove it as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Ka okuodo okayo dendi, ber mondo igole mapiyo kaka nyalore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can use a pair of tweezers to grasp the tick as close to the skin as possible and pull it straight out.
entries.translation: Inyalo tiyo kod makas mar mako okuodo no machiegni gi pien dendi kaka nyalore kendo ipudhe oko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't twist or jerk the tick, as this could cause the head to break off and remain in your skin.
entries.translation: Kik iwir kata iywa tiweyo okuodo, nikech timo kamano nyalo miyo wiye ochodi kendo dong' ei pien dendi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you've removed the tick, wash the area with soap and water.
entries.translation: Ka isegolo okuodo, lwoki kanyo gi sabun kod pi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also apply a topical antibiotic ointment to help prevent infection.
entries.translation: Bende inyalotiyo gi mo makende man kod yath mar konyo geng'o kik igam tuwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to watch for signs of Lyme disease after being bitten by a tick.
entries.translation: Ber mondo ibed akicha ne ranyisi mag tuo mar Lyme bang' ka okuodo okayi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These symptoms can include fever, headache, fatigue, muscle aches, and a characteristic rash.
entries.translation: Ranyisi gi nyalo riwo del mahore, wich bar, olo mar del, jony e leche kod kit gwonyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you develop any of these symptoms, see your doctor right away.
entries.translation: Ka ibedo gi ranyisi moro amora kuom magi, ne laktar mapiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lyme disease is a serious illness, but it can be treated with antibiotics.
entries.translation: Tuo mar Lyme en tuo marach ahinya, kata kamano inyalo thiedhe kitiyo gi yedhe mag geng'o tuoche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Early diagnosis and treatment is important to prevent serious complications.
entries.translation: Pim mitimo chon kod yudo thieth en yo maber mar geng'o bedo gi pek mogajore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions about ticks or Lyme disease, talk to your doctor.
entries.translation: Ka in kod penjo moro amora kuom okuodo kata tuo mar Lyme, los kod laktar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Three women are sitting at a table, talking about their cats.
entries.translation: Mon adek obedo but mesa, ka giloso kuom pusi mag gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance: My cat, Sangeetha, is always there to greet me at the door when I come home from work.
entries.translation: Constance: Pusi mara ma nyinge Sangeetha, rita ga pile ka pile edhot mar mondo orwaka ot kaseya tich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ayanda: Me too! I have two cats of my own. They make me feel wanted.
entries.translation: Ayanda: An bende! An kod pusi ariyo mameka awuon. Gimiyo awinjo ni nitie jogo mohera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance: I know what you mean. Sangeetha always makes me feel better when I'm having a bad day.
entries.translation: Constance: Ang'eyo tiend wach miwacho. Sangeetha miyo ajabedo gi mor kinde ka kinde ka an kod odiechieng' marach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aditi: I've always wanted a cat, but I'm allergic.
entries.translation: Aditi: An asebedo kadwaro pusi kinde ka kinde, kata kamano denda ok orwako gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ayanda: That's too bad. Cats are really great companions.
entries.translation: Ayanda: Mano rach ahinya. Pusi gin osiepe madongo ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aditi:I know! I've always admired people who have cats. They seem to have such a special bond with their pets.
entries.translation: Aditi: Ang'eyo! Asebedo kahero ngima mar jogo man kod pusi. Gineno jogo man kod tudruok makende gi le gi magihero ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance: I think it's because cats are very independent animals. They don't need you to take care of them every minute of the day.
entries.translation: Constance: Aparo ni en nikech pusi gin le mohero chung' kar kendgi ahinya. Okochuno ni nyaka irit gi seche duto e odiechieng'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But they still love you and enjoy your company.
entries.translation: Kata kamano pod giheri kendo giwinjo maber ka in kodgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The history of Ethiopia is long and complex, with a rich and varied culture.
entries.translation: Sigand piny Ethiopia rabora kendo winjo tek, en gi kido kod timbe mathoth kendo mopogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The earliest evidence of human settlement in Ethiopia dates back to the Paleolithic period, with the discovery of stone tools and other artifacts.
entries.translation: Ranyisi machon ahinya ni dhano nodak e piny Ethiopia yudore e kinde midendo ni Paleolithic, mane stunde mag kite kod gigo mamoko mochwe nofwenyore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first major civilization in Ethiopia was the Aksumite Empire, which flourished from the 1st century BC to the 8th century AD.
entries.translation: Lony mokwongo maduong' e piny Ethiopia ne en Loch Aksumite, mane obedo chakre senchari 1 BC nyaka senchari mar 8 AD.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Aksumites were a powerful trading empire that controlled much of the trade between Africa and the Middle East.
entries.translation: Oganda Aksumite ne gin jo ohala maratipo ahinya mane ni kod teko maduong' e ohala e kind Afrika kod pinje jo Arabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also built many impressive monuments, including the Great Stelae of Aksum.
entries.translation: Bende ne gigero gorofe mabeyo mathoth, koriwo The Great Stelae of Aksum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After the fall of the Aksumite Empire, Ethiopia was ruled by a series of different kingdoms and dynasties.
entries.translation: Bang' podho mar Loch Aksumite, Ethiopia ne otelne gi kingi kod anyuola mag kingi mopogore opogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 16th century, Ethiopia was invaded by the Ottoman Empire, but the Ethiopians were able to defeat the Ottomans and maintain their independence.
entries.translation: E senchari mar 16, Ethiopia nomonji gi Loch Ottoman, kata kamano Jo Ethiopia nohewo jo Ottoman kendo ne girito loch margi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 19th century, Ethiopia was ruled by Emperor Tewodros II, who is considered one of the greatest Ethiopian rulers.
entries.translation: E senchari mar 19, Ethiopia notelne gi Kingi Tewodros II, mabende ineno kaka achiel kuom jotelo madongo ahinya mane otelone piny Ethiopia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tewodros II was a strong and ambitious ruler who sought to unite Ethiopia and to modernize the country.
entries.translation: Tewodros II ne en jatelo motegno kendo mane nigi paro mag kinde ma nyime manotemo riwo oganda jo Ethiopia kendo kelo lony manyasani e piny no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also fought against European colonialism, and he is remembered for his famous letter to Queen Victoria of England, in which he demanded that she stop interfering in Ethiopian affairs.
entries.translation: Bende nogore gi loch jo Wagunda, kendo ipare kuom barua marahuma mane ondiko ne Nyar Kingi ma Victoria mar Ingeresa kama nokone ni mondo owe donjore e weche mag piny Ethiopia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salesperson: What kind of style are you looking for?
entries.translation: Jauso: Apenji, idwaro loso machalo nade?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Customer: I'm mostly interested in something neutral and understated.
entries.translation: Janyiewo: An ahero ahinya gimoro mantie e diere kendo mapuch.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salesperson: We have a few options that might work. This one is made from wool and has a simple geometric pattern.
entries.translation: Jauso: Wantie gi achiel ariyo manyalo mori. Mae olosi kod pien mayom kendo otimne goro mar kwan mayot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Customer: I like that. It's perfect for my living room.
entries.translation: Janyiewo: Ahero mano. Ondisore gi kor budho mar oda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salesperson: Great! I'm happy to help. We can also deliver and install the rug for you if you'd like.
entries.translation: Jauso: Mano ber! Amor ni akonyi. Bende wanyalo teroni nyaka odi kendo pedhoni kapedno e dier odi ka diher.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Customer: That would be great. I'm willing to pay a little extra for that.
entries.translation: Janyiewo: Manyo nyalo bedo maber malich. Ayie chulo kata gimoro matin mondo utimna kamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salesperson: No problem. We'll get started on that right away.
entries.translation: Jauso: Onge wach. Wachako timo kamano mana sani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Customer: Thank you.
entries.translation: Janyiewo: Erokamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sickness has been a part of human life since the beginning of time.
entries.translation: Bedo matuo osebedo gino mantie e ngima dhano chakre chakruok piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the common cold to the bubonic plague, countless diseases have ravaged our species, causing pain, suffering, and death.
entries.translation: Chakre bedo gi homa nyaka tuoche mag adhonde magalagala, tuoche tara gi gana osechamo chwech, kelo rem, pek kod thoo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But where did these illnesses come from?
entries.translation: To tuoche gi newuok kanye?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One popular myth about the origin of sickness is that it was caused by a curse from the gods.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom weche ma wachore ma okoyangi kuom chakruok mag tuoche en ni ne ochakore kaka kuong' mag nyiseche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: According to this myth, the gods were angered by the behavior of humans, so they sent down a plague to punish them.
entries.translation: Kaluwore gi wachno ma okoyangi, nyiseche nenigi ich wang' kaluwore gi timbe mag dhano, omiyo negioro tuoche magalagala mondo otiek dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This myth is found in many cultures around the world, and it often features a similar story: the gods are angered by something humans have done, so they send down a plague to teach them a lesson.
entries.translation: Weche gi ma okoyangi iyudo e kido kod timbe mathoth e piny mangima, kendo gijabedo e sigana machalre: nyiseche igi owang' gi gimoro ma dhano otimo, omiyo gioro tuoche magalagala mar mondo omi dhano kum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While this myth is certainly a powerful story, there is no evidence to support it.
entries.translation: Kata ka obedo ni wechegi ma okoyangi gin sigana man kod teko, onge ranyisi manyalo siro gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, most scientists believe that sickness is caused by natural factors, such as bacteria and viruses.
entries.translation: Adier en niya, thoth jolony mag sayans oyie ni twoche inyalo kel gi gigo mantie e alwora, kaka kute mag baktiria kata midhusi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These pathogens are always present in our environment, and they can cause disease when they enter our bodies.
entries.translation: Kute gi yudore e alwora magwa e kinde duto, kendo ginyalo kelo tuoche ka gidonjo e dend dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, the myth of the gods' curse is just one of many stories about the origin of sickness.
entries.translation: Chutho, weche mawachore ma okoyangi ni nitie kuong' mar nyiseche en mana achiel kuom sigana mathoth kuom chakruok mar tuoche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many other myths and legends that attempt to explain why we get sick.
entries.translation: Nitie weche mamoko mathoth ma okoyangi matemo fuono gimomiyo wabedo matuo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I can't believe we're going to be learning how to cook Indian food today," said 10-year-old Priya excitedly.
entries.translation: Priya ma en ja higni 10, nowacho ka en gi mor ahinya niya "Amor ni kawuono wadhi puonjore kaka itedo chiemb Johindi".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's delicious," said Priya "It's usually very flavorful, with a lot of spices. And there are so many different dishes to choose from."
entries.translation: "Omit," Priya nowacho "Ojabedo gi ndhadhu ahinya, ka ong'adi eiye gigo mathoth mar miye ndhadhu. Kendo nitie kit chiemo mathoth mopogore ma inyalo yiero."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The class arrived at the kitchen, and Ms. Singh began to set up.
entries.translation: Jopuonjre nochopo e kar tedo kendo Ms. Singh nochako chano gikmoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Today, we're going to be making a simple dish called dal makhani," she said.
entries.translation: "Kawuono, wadhi tedo chiemo mayot tedo miluongo ni dal makhani," nowacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's a type of lentil soup that's very popular in India."
entries.translation: "En kit kado mar dengu ma nigi huma malach ahinya e piny India."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Singh showed the class how to measure out the ingredients and cook the lentils.
entries.translation: Ms. Singh nonyiso jopuonjre kaka ipimo gige tedo kendo kaka itedo dengu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The students helped each other chop vegetables and stir the pot.
entries.translation: Jopuonjre nene okonyore e ng'ado alot kendo rudo e agulu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As they worked, they chatted about their favorite foods and what they were looking forward to trying in India.
entries.translation: E seche mane gitiyo, negigoyo mbaka kuom chiemo ma gihero kod kit chiemo mane gigeno bilo e piny India.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the dal makhani was finished, the students sat down to eat.
entries.translation: Bang' tieko tedo dal makhani, jopuonjre nobet piny mondo gichiem.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My favorite season is the one in which all is green, the trees are in full bloom, and the birds are singing.
entries.translation: Kinde mahero ahinya en kinde ma aluora duto ralum, yiende dongo ahinya kendo winy wer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a time of new beginnings, as the world wakes up from its winter slumber and begins to grow and change.
entries.translation: En kinde mag chakruoge manyien, nikech piny chiewo kowuok e kinde mag koyo kendo chako dongo kendo lokore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I love to spend this time outdoors, enjoying the fresh air and sunshine.
entries.translation: Ahero kawo thuolo mara kabet oko mar ot, ka ayueyo muya maler kendo nyango goya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is nothing quite like taking a walk in the woods on a spring day, breathing in the scent of the flowers and listening to the birdsong.
entries.translation: En gino makelo mor ka iwuotho kama idakie e kinde ma mauwa mag yiende lwar piny, kendo iyueyo muya mang'we mamit mawuok kuom maua kendo iwinjo kaka winy wer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a time of hope and renewal, and I always feel invigorated by it.
entries.translation: En kinde mar yudo geno kod chakruok manyien, kendo awinjoga ka ayudo teko kendo e kindegi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The days are getting longer and the nights are getting shorter, and the sun is shining brighter.
entries.translation: Odiechieng' bedo malach kendo otieno bedo machuok, kendo chieng' rieny maler ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flowers are blooming and the trees are budding, and the air is filled with the sound of birdsong.
entries.translation: Mauwa thiewo maber to yiende golo bedegi manyien, kendo wende mag winy opong'o kor lwasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The world is coming alive again after a long winter's sleep, and it is a beautiful sight to behold.
entries.translation: Piny yepo kendo bang' bedo e kinde malach mar koyo kendo en gino mamoro wang' ka ineno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spring is a time of new beginnings, and I am always excited to see what the new season will bring.
entries.translation: Kinde ma mauwa lwar en kinde mag chakruoge manyien, kendo an amor pile ka pile mar neno ber mabiro e kinde manyien ni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I love to watch the plants grow and change, and I enjoy seeing the animals come out and play.
entries.translation: Ahero neno ka gigo mopidhi e lowo dongo kendo lokore, kendo ahero neno ka chiaye wuok oko kendo tugo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spring is a time of hope and renewal, and I always feel invigorated by it.
entries.translation: Kinde ma yiende lwaro mauwa en kinde mag geno kod chakruok manyien, kendo awinjoga ka ayudo teko manyien ekindegi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The assassination of Mohamed Bouazizi was a major turning point in the Tunisian Revolution.
entries.translation: Nek mar Mohamed Bouazizi ne okelo lokruok maduong' e Lwenj Loko Loch ma Tunisia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bouazizi was a 26-year-old street vendor who set himself on fire in December 2010 in protest of police harassment and corruption.
entries.translation: Bouazizi ne en ja ohand chumbu mane en ja higni 26 mane uso e wang' apaya kendo nowang'ore gi mach duwe mar Disemba 2010 ka ong'ur kaka obila netiyo gi teko gi marach kendo bedo ni negin jomibadhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His death sparked a wave of protests across Tunisia that eventually led to the overthrow of President Zine El Abidine Ben Ali.
entries.translation: Tho mare nochiero ng'anyo mathoth e piny Tunisia ma gikone nomiyo othul oko Ker Zine El Abidine Ben Ali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bouazizi's death was widely seen as a symbol of the Tunisian people's frustration with the government's economic policies and its authoritarian rule.
entries.translation: Tho mar Bouazizi nonenore kaka ranyisi ni oganda piny Tunisia ne ool gi chike mag ochumi mane oketi gi sirikal to kod tiyo gi loch mar agoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The protests that followed his death were met with violent repression by the government, but they ultimately succeeded in toppling Ben Ali.
entries.translation: Ng'anyo mane otim kaluwore gi tho mare ne othir gi teko mathoth kowuok kuom sirikal, kata kamano, giko to jong'anyo nothicho oko Ben Ali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Tunisian Revolution was a major turning point in the Arab world.
entries.translation: Loko loch e Piny Tunisia nokelo lokruok maduong' e pinje jo Arabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It inspired other uprisings in the region, and it led to the overthrow of several authoritarian regimes.
entries.translation: Nokelo muoch mar ng'anyo mamoko e aluora no, kendo miyo thoth telo mag agoko ne othichi oko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The revolution also had a significant impact on Tunisian society.
entries.translation: Loko loch bende nomulo malach ahinya oganda ma Tunisia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It led to the adoption of a new constitution, and it ushered in a new era of democracy and freedom.
entries.translation: Nomiyo gikalo chike manyien, kendo bang'e ne girwako kit telo mar demokrasia kod ouru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bouazizi's death is a reminder of the importance of human rights and the need for political change.
entries.translation: Tho mar Bouazizi en gino maparonwa ber mar rito ratiro mag oganda kod dwaro bedo gi lokruok e weche mag siasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His sacrifice helped to bring about a more just and democratic Tunisia.
entries.translation: Chiwruok mare ne okonyo kelo ratiro kod demokrasia e piny Tunisia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gift-giving is an important part of Chinese culture, and there are many different rules and customs to follow.
entries.translation: Chiwo mich en gino maduong' ahinya e kido gi timbe mag Jochaina, kendo nitie weche kod chike mopogore ma iluwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Whenever you are invited to a Chinese person's home, it is customary to bring a gift.
entries.translation: Ka ogweli e pacho mar Jachaina, en gino mochuno ni nyaka iter mich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The type of gift you bring will depend on the occasion and the relationship you have with the host.
entries.translation: Kit mich ma itero biro luwore gi nyasi kod wat mantie e kindi gi wuon nyasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if you are attending a birthday party, you might bring a gift of flowers or fruit.
entries.translation: Kuom ranyisi, ka ogweli e nyasi mar hingo odiechieng' nyuol, inyalo tero mauwa kata olemo kaka mich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are visiting a friend's home, you might bring a small gift, such as a bottle of wine or a box of chocolates.
entries.translation: Ka itimo limbe e par osiepi, inyalo tero mich matin, kaka boksi moting'o amuna kata boksi moting'o chokolet.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to wrap the gift nicely and to present it with both hands.
entries.translation: Ber mondo ium mich mari mong'ith kendo ichiwe gi lweteni ariyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you receive a gift, it is customary to open it immediately and to express your appreciation.
entries.translation: Ka omiyi mich, ochuno ni nyaka iyawe kanyo gi kanyo kendo iduok erokamano kuom mich momiyi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also reciprocate by giving a gift of equal value whenever you are invited to someone's home.
entries.translation: In bende nyaka itim makori kuom chiwo mich ma nengone rom gi momiyi saa asaya ma ogweli e par ng'ato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are unsure of what to give, you can always ask a friend or family member for advice.
entries.translation: Ka okin gi adier gi gino minyalo chiwo, inyalo penjo osiepi kata anyuondi mondo ong'adni rieko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The young woman held her hand out to the man, her eyes pleading.
entries.translation: Miyono mapod tin norieyo bade ne jalno, ka wengene nyiso ni osecho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Please," she said. "I need your help."
entries.translation: "Asayi," nowacho. "Daher mar yudo kony mari."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man looked at her, his expression hard.
entries.translation: Jalno nene orange, koneno mager.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I don't know what you're talking about," he said.
entries.translation: Nowacho niya, "An akia ni iwuoyo ewi ang'o".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm from Toronto," she said. "I was kidnapped and brought here.
entries.translation: "An awuok Toronto," miyono nowacho. "nondhiya kendo olal koda mokela kae.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I need to get back home."
entries.translation: Daher mar dok pacho."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man shook his head. "Get out of here before I call the police."
entries.translation: Jalno nokino wiye. "Wuog kaye kapok aluongo obila."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman's heart sank.
entries.translation: Miyono chunye nobet gi bwok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was so close, but it looked like she was going to be caught again.
entries.translation: Ne en machiegni ahinya, kata kamano ne nenore ni idhi ndhiye kendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She turned to run, but the man grabbed her arm. "I said get out of here!" he shouted.
entries.translation: Nolokore mondo oringi, kata kamano jalno nondhiyo bade. "Awacho ni mondo iwuog kae!" nowacho kogoyo koko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman struggled, but the man was too strong.
entries.translation: Miyono notemo gwenye, kata kamano jalno nomake matek ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He pulled her close and slapped her across the face.
entries.translation: Jalno noyuaye machiegni kendo nopamo wang'e ariwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "You're not going anywhere," he said. "You're my property now." The woman cried out in pain and fear.
entries.translation: "Onge kuma idhiye," nowacho. "Koro in mwandu mara." Miyono noywak malit kuom rem kod lworo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She didn't know what to do.
entries.translation: Nokong'eyo gimonyalo timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was trapped.
entries.translation: Nodinne ei otegu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Action films have undergone a major transformation in recent years.
entries.translation: Sinema mag dhao osetimnegi lokruoge madongo e higni matin mokalo machien kae.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gone are the days of simple, one-dimensional heroes and villains.
entries.translation: Kinde osekalo mane nitie mana joloch ma wang' achiel kod jonjore ma wang' achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today's action films are more complex, with characters who undergo significant transformations over the course of the film.
entries.translation: Sinema manyasani nigi weche motudore mapek ahinya, gi jotugo mabedo gi lokruoge mathoth e thuolo duto mar sinema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This transformation is often a reflection of the film's themes, which can range from the importance of family to the power of love.
entries.translation: Lokruoge gi thoro nyiso thuond weche mantie e sinema, ma chakore e ber mar onyuola nyaka teko mar hera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Several recent action films have featured this type of transformation.
entries.translation: Sinema mathoth moselosi e kinde machuok mokalo osebedo ni kit lokruoge gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the film "The Batman," for example, the title character goes from being a vengeful vigilante to a symbol of hope for the city of Gotham.
entries.translation: Kuom ranyisi, e sinema miluongo ni "The Batman", jatugo maduong' lokore kowuok kuom bedo janjore mohero chulo kworo kendo obedo ranyisi mar geno e boma maduong' mar Gotham.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In "Black Panther," T'Challa must learn to embrace his role as king of Wakanda, even though it means giving up some of his personal freedoms.
entries.translation: E sinema mar "Black Panther," T'Challa nyaka puonjre rwako tije kaka kingi mar Wakanda, kata obedo ni odhiwito ouru moko mane en godo chon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And in "Captain Marvel," Carol Danvers must learn to control her powers and use them for good.
entries.translation: Bende e "Captain Marvel," Carol Danvers nyaka puonjre kaka onyalo diko teko mage kendo tiyo gi teko mare e timo gigo makare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These films show that action films can be more than just mindless violence.
entries.translation: Sinema gi gin ranyisi ni sinema mag dhao nyalo bedo gi ber moloyo mana tulo maonge tiende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also be used to explore complex themes and characters.
entries.translation: Bende inyalo ti kodgi mar nyiso thuond weche matek kod jotugo ma kit gi tek yango.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The debate of man vs. machine is a long-standing one, with no easy answer.
entries.translation: Twak mantie kuom dhano kipimo gi kompiuta en twak mosebedo aming'a, kendo oonge gi dwoko mayot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the one hand, machines are becoming increasingly sophisticated and capable, and they are already performing many tasks that were once thought to be the exclusive domain of humans.
entries.translation: Konchiel, kompiuta medo bedo gi riekni mathoth kod ng'eyo matut, kendo kuom sani gitiyo tije mathoth mane ong'ere ni gin tije mana ma dhano kende emanyalo timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the other hand, humans have a unique set of skills and abilities that machines are unlikely to ever replicate, such as creativity, empathy, and intuition.
entries.translation: Komachielo, dhano ni kod rieko makende kendo gi nyalo ma kompiuta okane nyal bedogodo, kaka biro gi paro manyien, bedo gi chuny matur kod rieko mar wich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the key areas where machines are rapidly outpacing humans is in the field of artificial intelligence (AI).
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gigo madongo ma kompiuta goye okang' mapiyo maloyo dhano en eyor rieko miloso gi kompiuta (AI).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI is a branch of computer science that deals with the creation of intelligent agents, which are systems that can reason, learn, and act autonomously.
entries.translation: AI en achiel kuom bad somo mag sayans mar kompiuta momakore gi loso mise mag rieko, magin sistembe manyalo bedo gi rieko, nyalo puonjore kendo timo tijegi giwegi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI is already being used in a wide range of applications, from self-driving cars to medical diagnosis.
entries.translation: AI itiyogodo e timo tije mathoth sani, chakre e loso matokni mariembore kendgi nyaka e yor timo pim mag yor thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And as AI continues to develop, it is likely to become even more powerful and capable.
entries.translation: Kendo kaka AI medo dongore, nitie thuolo ni odhimedo bedo gi teko kod nyalo maduong' moloyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are also a number of areas where humans are likely to retain a significant advantage over machines.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, nitie kuonde mathoth ma dhano biro dhi nyime gi bedo gi teko mahingo kompiuta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, humans are much better at dealing with ambiguity and uncertainty.
entries.translation: Kuom ranyisi, dhano nyalo pogo weche maneno machal to okchal adier kendo yango onge mar adier e wach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
