entries.english: We can also draw on our experience and intuition to make decisions in complex situations.
entries.translation: Dhano bende nyalo tiyo gi lony kod paro mar wich e ng'ado wach e seche ma weche tek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And finally, humans have a unique capacity for creativity and innovation.
entries.translation: Giko, dhano nigi nyalo makende mar loso paro manyien kod loso gikmoko manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Two men, one in his 30s and one in his 50s, are sitting at the bar, drinking.
entries.translation: Chwo ariyo, achiel ma hike en 30 gi wiye kod nyawadgi ma hike en 50 gi wiye, obedo e baa, gimetho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Young Man: So, I heard that the new head of the liquor board is really cracking down on local stores.
entries.translation: Jal Matin: Koro, nawinjo ni jatelo manyien mochung' ne bod mar weche kong'o timo apedha mager ne dukni mag kong'o e aluora ka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Old Man: Yeah, I heard that too. They're saying that he's going to be doing random inspections of bars and restaurants to make sure that they're not selling liquor to minors.
entries.translation: Jal Maduong': Kamano, nawinjo wachno an bende. Wachore ni obiro timo apedha apoya e baa kod kuonde toyo ngona mar bedo gi adier ni kuondego ok usi amuna ne nyithindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Young Man: That's a good thing.
entries.translation: Jal Matin: Mano wach maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I mean, it's not fair to the responsible businesses that are following the rules when some other places are just selling liquor to anyone who walks in the door.
entries.translation: Awachoni, oken gimaber ni nitye ohelni maluwo chike to ohelni mamoko to uso mana andiwo ne ng'ato ang'ata madonjo kuno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Old Man: I agree. But I'm also worried about how it's going to affect my business.
entries.translation: Jal Maduong': Ayie kodi. Kata kamano an kod kihondko kaka wachno dhimulo ohanda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I mean, I'm a good guy. I don't sell liquor to minors.
entries.translation: Awachoni, an ng'at maber. Okaus kong'o ne nyithindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I'm also not going to let some government bureaucrat tell me who I can and can't sell liquor to.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, okanyal yiene josirikal mondo oyangna ng'at manyalo usone gi mokanyal usone kong'o.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Young Man: I get what you're saying. But you have to be careful.
entries.translation: Jal Matin: Awinjo wach miwacho. Kata kamano nyaka ibed motang'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Family planning in India has been a topic of debate for many years.
entries.translation: Wach mar komo nyuol e piny India osebedo thor wach kuom higni mathoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1976, the Indian government passed the controversial National Emergency Act, which imposed a forced sterilization program on men and women.
entries.translation: Higa 1976, sirikal ma India nokalo Chik mar Weche Mapoyore, mane oketo chenro manechuno ni nyaka chwo jomachwo gi mon sandan mar komo nyuol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This program was met with widespread resistance and eventually overturned by the Indian Supreme Court.
entries.translation: Chenro ni nopingi gi oganda mathoth kendo gikone to Doho Maduong' Mogik e piny India nowite oko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, the Indian government has taken a more progressive approach to family planning.
entries.translation: E higni matin mokalo, sirikal mar India oseketo okenge mabeyo mag yore komo nyuol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2010, the government launched the National Family Planning Program, which provides free contraception and sterilization services to all Indian citizens.
entries.translation: E higa 2010, sirikal noyawo ayanga Chenro Mar Komo Nyuol e Pinyno, mane chiwo yedhe kod sandan mar komo nyuol maonge chudo ne oganda duto ma India.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The program has been successful in reducing the fertility rate in India, but it still faces challenges, such as a lack of awareness and access to services.
entries.translation: Chenro ni osetimo maber e duoko piny yor nyodo e piny India, kata kamano pod en gi pek, machalo gi onge mar ng'eyo ewi chenro no kod koso yudo yore go mag komo nyuol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important challenges to family planning in India is the lack of awareness about the benefits of family planning.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom pek maduong' ahinya ne chenro mar komo nyuol e piny India en koso ng'eyo ewi ber mar komo nyuol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many Indian couples believe that it is their duty to have as many children as possible.
entries.translation: Thoth jomanie keny e piny India ong'eyo ni gin kod ting' mar nyuolo nyithindo mathoth kaka nyalore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This belief is often reinforced by cultural and religious norms.
entries.translation: Wachni yudo sir kuom kido gi timbe kaachiel gi yore mag lamo mag oganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another challenge to family planning is the lack of access to services.
entries.translation: Pek machielo en koso yudo yore mag komo nyuol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In rural areas, there are often few or no family planning clinics.
entries.translation: E kor gwenge, thothne onge kuonde thieth mag komo nyuol kata ka nitie, to mana matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes it difficult for couples to access the services they need.
entries.translation: Mae kelo pek ne jii mantie e keny mar yudo yore komo nyuol mowinjore giyudi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite these challenges, the Indian government is committed to providing family planning services to all its citizens.
entries.translation: Kata obedo ni nitie pek gi, sirikal mar India oketo mahino mar chiwo yore komo nyuol ne oganda duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Science is a systematic enterprise that builds and organizes knowledge in the form of testable explanations and predictions about the natural world.
entries.translation: Sayans en gino mochan magero kendo pango rieko e yorno ma inyalo timne pim kendo pwodo weche mabiro nyime ewi piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In its broadest sense, science encompasses all human knowledge and activity motivated by a desire to understand the natural world and its phenomena.
entries.translation: Ka irange matut, sayans oriwo rieko duto mag dhano kod gigo maluwore gi gombo mar yudo winjo matut kuom piny kod gik matimore e piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Science is also often seen as a particular body of knowledge derived from such investigation, as well as a method of discovery.
entries.translation: Sayans bende ithoronen kaka kuku mar rieko mawuok kuom nonro ma kamago, kaachiel kod yor fwenyo weche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The earliest roots of science can be traced to Ancient Greek philosophy, particularly the works of Aristotle, who attempted to explain natural phenomena through observation and reason.
entries.translation: Kuku machon ahinya mar sayans yudore e filosofia machon mar Jogirik Machon, ahinya nonro mag Aristotle, mane otemo lero gigo matimre e piny kokalo kuom neno gi wang' kod paro mar gimomiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Science has had a profound impact on human society, leading to the development of new technologies, medicines, and understanding of the natural world.
entries.translation: Sayans osemulo oganda kuom yore madongo, ma osemiyo olosi teknoloji manyien, yedhe kod bedo gi winjo mar piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It has also played a role in shaping social and political thought.
entries.translation: Bende osebedo gi thuolo mar bidho paro mar oganda kod siasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, science is a major part of modern life, and it continues to play an important role in the advancement of knowledge and understanding.
entries.translation: Kawuono, sayans nigi mise e ngima ma nyasani, kendo omedo dhinyime gi kawo thuolo maduong' e dongruok mar rieko kod winjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I'm so behind on my work!
entries.translation: A: An chien ahinya e tich matimo!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have a paper due tomorrow, and I haven't even started it.
entries.translation: An gi penj ma owinjore ochoki kiny, to pok achake kata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: Oh no! What are you going to do?
entries.translation: B: Eh yawa! Koro idhi timo nang'o?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I don't know.
entries.translation: A: Okang'eyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I guess I'll just have to stay up all night and finish it.
entries.translation: Apani chuno ni nyaka abedi piny ei otieno mangima mondo atieke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: That sounds like a terrible idea.
entries.translation: B: Mano oken paro maber ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You'll just end up being more tired and stressed, and you won't do your best work.
entries.translation: Gikone to idhi mana medo ol kendo bedo gi paro, kendo okidhitimo tijno maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I know, but I don't have any other choice.
entries.translation: A: Ang'eyo, mak mana ni onge gimachielo manyalo timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: There is always another choice.
entries.translation: B: Kinde duto nitie gino machielo ma ng'ato nyalo timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You could start working on it now, and take breaks throughout the day.
entries.translation: Inyalo chako timo tijno sani, kaeto ibedo gi thuolo mag yueyo e odiechieng' mangima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Or, you could ask for an extension from your professor.
entries.translation: Kata, inyalo kwayo mondo japuonj mari omedi ndalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I don't know if I can ask for an extension.
entries.translation: A: Okang'eyo kabende anyalo kwayo mondo omeda ndalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've already asked for one this semester, and I don't want to seem like I'm not taking my classes seriously.
entries.translation: Nasega kwayo ndalo dichiel e semesta ni, kendo okadwar mondo onen ni ok amiyo somo mara pek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: Well, you have to do something.
entries.translation: B: Kare, nyaka itim gimoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can't just keep procrastinating.
entries.translation: Okinyal dhi nyime gi choro gikmoko seche te.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're going to end up failing your class.
entries.translation: Giko to okidhitimo maber e somo mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The year is 1920, and the place is New York City.
entries.translation: Higa en 1920, e boma Maduong' mar New York.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flapper era is in full swing, and young women are enjoying their newfound freedom.
entries.translation: Kinde mag yore manyien mag rwakruok ochuoyo chieng' kendo mon winjo maber e ouru manyien magiyudo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are dressing in short skirts and bobbed hair, smoking cigarettes, and drinking cocktails.
entries.translation: Girwako skede machiek kendo yie wigi olosi stael miluongo ni bob, giywayo ndawa kendo gimadho juis mag olemo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also dating more freely than ever before.
entries.translation: Bende gitimo osiep gi chwo ka gin thuolo maloyo kinde mokalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One such flapper is named Josephine.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom nyidendi matimo gigi nyinge Josephine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is a beautiful young woman with a sharp wit and a rebellious streak.
entries.translation: En nyadendi mapod tin mariek ahinya kendo nigi kido mar ng'anyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is not interested in finding a husband, but she does enjoy the attention of men.
entries.translation: En chunye okdwar manyo dichwo, kata kamano ohero ka chwo manye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Josephine is at a party when she meets a young man named Jack.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro, Josephine nobedo e kar nyasi moro kane oromo gi ojana ma nyinge Jack.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jack is everything that Josephine is not.
entries.translation: Jack opogore gi Josephine e weche duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is conservative, polite, and serious.
entries.translation: En jalno maling', mamuol kendo mokohero oyuma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But there is something about him that Josephine finds attractive.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, nitie wach moro kuome mamiyo Josephine ohere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jack and Josephine begin dating, and they quickly fall in love.
entries.translation: Jack gi Josephine chako bedo johera kendo mapiyo piyo gichako herore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They spend their days dancing at the bars and their nights talking for hours on end.
entries.translation: Gikawo odiechienge mathoth ka gimiel e ba kendo gotieno ka giloso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Josephine has never felt this way about anyone before.
entries.translation: Josephine poknowinjo kamae kuom ng'ato angata e kinde mokalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But Jack is not the only man in Josephine's life.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, Jack okene dichwo kende ma Josephine nigodo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is still friends with her former boyfriend, Tom.
entries.translation: Pod en osiep gi wuoyi mane jaherane e kinde machon ma nyinge Tom.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tom is a good man, and he loves Josephine very much.
entries.translation: Tom en ng'at maber kendo ohero Josephine ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Egypt faces a number of challenges, including:
entries.translation: Piny Misri kaloe pek moko, moriwo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A rapidly growing population. Egypt's population is expected to grow from 100 million today to 140 million by 2050.
entries.translation: * Medruok mapiyo e kwan oganda. Kwan oganda ma Misri igeno ni dhimedore kowuok milion 100 kawuono nyaka milion 140 kochopo 2050.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will put a strain on the country's resources, including its food supply, water supply, and infrastructure.
entries.translation: Mae dhimiyo pinyno bedo gi ting' mapek, e yore mag yudo chiemo, pi kod yore mag apida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A widening gap between the rich and the poor. Egypt has a high Gini coefficient, which measures inequality.
entries.translation: * Medruok e pogruok e kind jogo momewo kod jogo modhier. Misri ni kod kwan mamalo mar gino midendo ni Gini, matiende en ni bedo ni onge rom.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that the wealth is concentrated in the hands of a few, while the majority of the population lives in poverty.
entries.translation: Mae tiende en ni mwandu yudore mana elwet ji matin kende, ka thoth oganda odak e ngima mar dhier.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * High unemployment. Egypt's unemployment rate is around 12%.
entries.translation: * Kwan mamalo mar oganda maonge tije. Kwan mar oganda maonge tije e piny Misri chopo 12%.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is especially high among young people.
entries.translation: Kwan ni nimalo moloyo kuom ojende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A lack of economic opportunity. Egypt's economy is heavily reliant on tourism and agriculture.
entries.translation: * Bedo maonge thuolo mag ochumi. Ochumi ma piny Misri oyiengore ahinya e sekta mag limbe kod pur.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These sectors are vulnerable to external shocks, such as the global financial crisis and the Arab Spring.
entries.translation: Sekta gi yudo pek kantie bwok moya oko, kaka bedo ni piny mangima kaloe midhiero mag omenda kod Tungni mag Pinje jo Arabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Political instability. Egypt has experienced a number of political upheavals in recent years, including the overthrow of Hosni Mubarak in 2011 and the subsequent military coup in 2013.
entries.translation: * Tungni mag siasa. Piny Misri osekaloe tungni mathoth mag siasa e higni machuok mokalo, koriwo thulo oko e loch Hosni Mubarak higa 2011 bang'e to jolweny noloko loch e higa 2013.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This instability has made it difficult for the government to implement reforms and improve the economy.
entries.translation: Bedo gi tungni osetamo sirikal kelo lokruoge kendo bero ochumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vehicle repair and maintenance is essential for keeping your car in good condition and preventing costly repairs down the road.
entries.translation: Tero matoka mondo olosi en gino maber mar miyo matoka mari bedo maber kendo miyo okitii gi omenda mathoth kilose bang' ndalo mathoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things you can do to maintain your vehicle, such as changing the oil and filters regularly, checking the tire pressure, and keeping the fluids topped up.
entries.translation: Nitie gikmoko minyalo timo mar loso matoka mari, kaka loko ne oil kod filta kinde ka kinde, ng'iyo muya mantie e tielo kod medo mo gi pi motiyogodo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're not comfortable doing these things yourself, you can take your car to a qualified mechanic.
entries.translation: Ka okihero mar timo gigi in iwuon, inyalo tero matoka mari ne makanika man kod lony.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When it comes to vehicle repair, there are a number of different paths you can take.
entries.translation: Ka idwaro loko ne matoka mari gikmoko, nitie gikmoko mopogore minyalo timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can go to a dealership, an independent repair shop, or a chain repair shop.
entries.translation: Inyalo limo duka miuse, duka mana mar loko gikmoko kata duka manigi bedene mar loko gikmoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each type of shop has its own advantages and disadvantages.
entries.translation: Kit duka ka duka ni kod ber kata rach mare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dealerships typically have the most experience working on specific makes and models of cars, but they can also be more expensive than other options.
entries.translation: Duke mag uso matokni manyien ni kod lony mararieya e kit matokni mopogore opogore, kata kamano bende ginyalo bedo ni nengo margi nimalo mahingo kuonde mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Independent repair shops are often less expensive than dealerships, but they may not have the same level of expertise.
entries.translation: Duke mochung' kendgi mag loko gikmoko kuom matoka jabedo ma nengo gi nipiny kopim gi duke mag uso matokni manyien, kata kamano, nyalobedo ni lony margi okrom.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chain repair shops typically offer a middle ground between dealerships and independent repair shops, with competitive prices and a variety of services.
entries.translation: Duke man kod bedegi, mag loko gikmoko kuom matokni gin jogo mantie e diere e kind duke mag uso matokni manyien kod duke mochung' kendgi maloko gikmoko kuom matokni, ka gin gi nengo moyueyo kod savises mathoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter which path you choose, it's important to find a reputable shop that you can trust.
entries.translation: Obedi ni ikawo yo mane, ber mondo imany duka makare ma inyalo yiego.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can do this by asking for recommendations from friends or family, or by doing some online research.
entries.translation: Inyalo timo kamano kuom penjo osiepe kata anyuondi kata kuom timo nonro matin e mbui.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [A group of people are gathered in a large room. They are all wearing white robes and have their heads bowed.]
entries.translation: [Oganda mathoth ochokore e ot maduong'. Giduto girwako kandho marochere kendo gikulo wigi piny.]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [A man in a black robe walks up to the front of the room.]
entries.translation: [Dichwo ma orwako kandho marateng' wuotho nyaka nyim ot.]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Man: "We are gathered here today to exercise our right to free speech.
entries.translation: Dichwo: "Wachokore kae kawuono mondo wanyis ratiro marwa mar bedo gi thuolo mar loso maonge obadho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are here to protest the injustice that is being done to our people.
entries.translation: Wan kae mar ng'ayo kaluwore gi chocho ratiro mag ogandawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are here to demand that our voices be heard.
entries.translation: Wan kae mar neno ni duondwa owinji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [The people raise their heads and look at the man.]
entries.translation: [Oganda go ting'o wigi malo kendo girango dichwo no.]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Man: "We are not here to cause violence.
entries.translation: Dichwo: "Ok wan kae mar kelo tulo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are not here to destroy property.
entries.translation: Ok wan kae mar ketho mwandu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are here to exercise our right to be heard.
entries.translation: Wan kae mar nyiso ratiro marwa mondo duondwa owinji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [The people begin to chant, "We want to be heard! We want to be heard!"]
entries.translation: [Oganda chako gweyo, "Wadwaro ni mondo owinjwa! Wadwaro ni mondo owinjwa!"]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Man: "We will not be silenced! We will not be ignored! We will not be denied our rights!
entries.translation: Dichwo: "Okbitamwa e loso! Okbiketwa thenge! Okbitamwa e ratiro magwa!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [The people continue to chant.]
entries.translation: [Oganda go medo gweyo.]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Man: "We are the people! We are the future! We will not give up!
entries.translation: Dichwo: "Wanie oganda! Wanie kiny! Chunywa okbithoo!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The museum was a treasure trove of history, artifacts, and stories.
entries.translation: Miusiam ne en kar kano mwandu machon kaka historia, gigo mochwe kod sigana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the ancient Egyptian mummies to the modern-day paintings, there was something for everyone to enjoy.
entries.translation: Chakre sanamu machon mag piny Misri nyaka goro masani, nentie gimoro mane nyalo moro ng'ato ka ng'ato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most interesting exhibits was the collection of old toys.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gigo mane inyiso mane yuayo wang' negin gige tugo machon mag nyithindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were dolls from the Victorian era, toy soldiers from the Civil War, and even a set of wooden blocks from the early 1900s.
entries.translation: Nentie doli mane nitie e kinde mag Victoria, doli mag jolweny mane ogore e Lweny mar Oganda, to kod bepe mane olosi e higni mag 1900.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each toy had its own story to tell, and it was fascinating to see how they had changed over time.
entries.translation: Doli ka doli nitie gi sigana mare, kendo en gimakelo mor mar neno kaka gilokore bang' thuolo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the toys that caught my eye was a small wooden car.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom doli mane omako wang'a ne en matoka matin mar bao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was made in the 1950s, and it was in perfect condition.
entries.translation: Nolose e higni mag 1950 kendo ne en e hali maber ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The paint was still bright, and the wheels were still smooth.
entries.translation: Rangi mane owiche ne pod pichni kendo tiende mage nepod poth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I picked it up and examined it closely.
entries.translation: Nakawe kendo arange machiegni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a simple toy, but it was also very well-made.
entries.translation: Ne en doli ma ok ogajore ahinya, kendo nolose bende maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I wondered who had played with this car all those years ago.
entries.translation: Nawuoro ng'atno mosetugo gi matoka ni kuom higni go duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What were their dreams and aspirations?
entries.translation: Lek gi gombo mare mag ndalo mabiro negin ang'o?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What did they think the future held?
entries.translation: Noparo ni en ber mane manebiro e ndalo ma nyime?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I put the car back in its display case and continued on my way.
entries.translation: Nadwoko matoka no kama nagole kendo nadhinyime gi wuodha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I walked through the museum, I thought about all the things that had changed in the world since these toys were made.
entries.translation: Kane omedo wuotho e miusiam, naparo gikmoko duto moselokore e piny chakre nelosi doli go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Islam is a religion that emphasizes surrender to the will of God.
entries.translation: Din mar salam en din mamiyo pek wach mar weyo weche duto ne dwaro mar Nyasaye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This concept of surrender, or "Islam" in Arabic, is often misunderstood as meaning submission or defeat.
entries.translation: Paro mar weyo weche duto, kata "Islam" gi dho Jo Arabu, ikao ga marach ni tiend en tur kata yie loch.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, in Islam, surrender is actually seen as a positive act, a way to achieve peace and happiness.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, e din jo salam, weyo weche ineno kaka gino maber, kaka yorno mar yudo kwe kod mor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When a Muslim surrenders to God, they are not giving up their own free will.
entries.translation: Ja Salam ka oweyo weche ne Nyasaye, oken ni ogoyo bade piny nyalo mare owuon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rather, they are acknowledging that God is the one who has the power to control all things, and that by surrendering to His will, they are actually finding true freedom.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, onyiso ni Nyasaye emani kod teko ewi gikmoko duto kendo weyo weche ne dwaro Nyasaye, gibedo thuolo eyo mar adier.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This concept of surrender is beautifully illustrated in the story of the Prophet Muhammad.
entries.translation: Paro mar weyo weche ni onyisi mondisore e sigand Jaote Muhammad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Muhammad was first called to be a prophet, he was very afraid.
entries.translation: Okwongo kane oluongi Muhammad mondo obed jaote, ne oluor ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He didn't want to be responsible for spreading God's message.
entries.translation: Nokodwar bedo gi ting' mar bedo jaote mar wach Nyasaye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, after much prayer and reflection, Muhammad eventually surrendered to God's will.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, bang' lamo kod paro matut, giko to Muhammad ne oweyo weche duto ne dwaro Nyasaye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He realized that it was not his own strength that would allow him to succeed, but the strength of God.
entries.translation: Nofwenyo ni oken teko mare en owuon mane nyalo miyo otim gimoro, mak mana teko Nyasaye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Muhammad's story is a reminder that surrender is not about giving up.
entries.translation: Sigand Muhammad paronwa ni weyo weche oken tho mar chuny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I grew up in a small village in the middle of nowhere.
entries.translation: Nadongo e gweng' e piny moro man mabor ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were only a few hundred people living there, and everyone knew everyone else.
entries.translation: Nentie mana oganda miche matin mane odak kanyo, kendo ng'ato ka ng'ato nong'eyo nyawadgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We had a small school, a general store, and a post office.
entries.translation: Newan kod sikul matin, duka maduong' kod apis mar posta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pace of life was slow and relaxed, and there was always time to stop and chat with a neighbor.
entries.translation: Ngima nedhi mana mos kendo mokwe, kendo nentie thuolo mar chung' kendo goyo mbaka gi ja libamba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I was 18, I moved to the city to go to college.
entries.translation: Kane achopo higni 18, nadhi e boma maduong' mondo nadhi e kolej.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At first, I was overwhelmed by the noise, the traffic, and the crowds.
entries.translation: Mokwongo, koko, gache mantie e apaya kod dhano mane chokore mathoth nobara ndasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It took me a while to adjust to city life, but eventually I came to love it.
entries.translation: Nokawa thuolo mondo ang'i gi ngima mar boma maduong', giko to koro nahere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I found that there were endless opportunities in the city, and I made some lifelong friends.
entries.translation: Nafwenyo ni nentie thuolo mathoth mokrum e boma maduong', kendo nabedo gi osiepe moko ma wasebedogo kinde duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After college, I got a job in the city and stayed there for a few years.
entries.translation: Bang' kolej, nayudo tich e boma maduong' kendo nadak kanyo kuom higni moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But eventually, I started to miss the slower pace of life in the village.
entries.translation: Giko, nachako gombo ngima madhi mos mantie e gweng'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I wanted to be able to raise a family in a place where I knew everyone and everyone knew me.
entries.translation: Nadwani mondo familia mara odongi kama ang'eyo ji te to kendo ji te bende ong'eya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So a few years ago, I moved back to the village where I grew up.
entries.translation: Omiyo higni matin mokalo, nadar adok e gweng' kama nadonge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was like coming home.
entries.translation: Nechalo dok pacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm now raising my family in the same small house where I grew up, and I'm so happy to be back.
entries.translation: Koro sani familia mara dongo e ot matin kama ne adonge, kendo amor ahinya mar duogo pacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a time long past, there lived a blind beggar who made his living by demonstrating the art of soil sculpting.
entries.translation: Chon ahinya, nenitie jal moro ma mwofu kendo mane kwecho ma yuto mare ne en nyiso kit chwecho mag gikmoko kitiyo gi lo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He would sit on the street corner, surrounded by his tools and materials, and invite passersby to watch him work.
entries.translation: Nobedo kamoro modiyore e bath yo, ka en gi gige mag tich kendo nolwongo jii manekalo mondo onene kaka notiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With his deft fingers, he would mold the soil into intricate shapes, creating animals, plants, and even entire landscapes.
entries.translation: Kotiyo kod lith lwetene mane tiyo maler, nonyalo chweyo gikmoko mamoro wang', kochweyo le, yiende kod gigo duto mantie alwora marwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His work was so beautiful that it was said to bring tears to the eyes of even the most hardened cynic.
entries.translation: Tije nemoro wang' ahinya ma newachore ni nomiyo nyaka ji mane okoyie gi tij jomoko nechwero pi wang' gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young woman named Amara was walking through the market when she saw the blind beggar.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro achiel, miyo moro matin manyinge Amara newuotho ei chiro eka noneno jalno mane kwecho kendo ne en mwofu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was immediately captivated by his work, and she stopped to watch him for a long time.
entries.translation: Kanyo gi kanyo tij jalno namako wang'e kendo nochung' aming'a ka orange.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When he was finished, she approached him and asked if she could learn how to sculpt soil.
entries.translation: Kane jalno otieko, miyono nodhi ire kendo nopenje kabende nonyalo puonje chwecho gi lo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The beggar smiled and told her that he would be happy to teach her.
entries.translation: Jalno mane kwecho nobuonjo kaeto nonyise ni nenyalo bedo mor mare mar puonje.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Amara spent the next few weeks learning from the beggar.
entries.translation: Amara nokawo thuolo mar wige machuok ka jalno mane kwecho ne puonje.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He taught her the basics of soil sculpting, and he showed her how to create different shapes and textures.
entries.translation: Nopuonje weche mayot mako mag kaka ichwecho gi lo, kendo nonyise kaka iloso kit goro mopogore opogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Amara was a quick learner, and she soon became very skilled at the art.
entries.translation: Amara ne en nyano mamako gigo mopuonje mapiyo kendo bang' ndalo matin, nobedo gi lony ahinya e chwecho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, the beggar told Amara that it was time for her to demonstrate her skills.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro achiel, jalno mane kwecho nokone Amara ni thuolo nosechopo mondo Amara bende onyis lony mare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vigilante justice is a term used to describe the act of taking the law into one's own hands, typically by meting out punishment to those who have been deemed to have committed crimes.
entries.translation: Yor ratiro mar sungusungu en wach mitiyogodo mar lero tim mar kawo chik e lwedo, kokalo kuom miyo kum jogo ma wachore ni otimo njore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While vigilante justice may seem like a quick and easy way to get justice, it can often lead to more problems than it solves.
entries.translation: Kata obedo ni yor ratiro mar sungusungu ineno kaka yorno mayot kendo mar yudo ratiro mapiyo, othoro kelo midhiero mathoth maloyo kaka oloso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the biggest problems with vigilante justice is that it is typically not done in a fair and impartial manner.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom midhiero madongo ahinya mag yor ratiro mar sungusungu en ni kinde duto oktime eyo maratiro kendo marango kuonde duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vigilantes are often motivated by anger and emotion, which can lead them to make rash decisions and take actions that are not in the best interests of everyone involved.
entries.translation: Sungusungu thothne gin jogo man kod ich wang' manyalo miyo ging'ado weche mapiyo kendo kawo chik e lwetgi ma oken mang'iyo pach ji te mawach oyudo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Additionally, vigilantes often lack the training and experience necessary to properly handle criminals.
entries.translation: Bende, sungusungu onge kod tiegruok gi lony midwaro mar kedo gi jonjore kaka owinjore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to situations where innocent people are harmed or even killed.
entries.translation: Mae nyalo kelo hali mag hinyruoge kata tho ne oganda mawach ok omako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another problem with vigilante justice is that it can quickly spiral out of control.
entries.translation: Midhiero machielo mikelo gi yor ratiro mar sungusungu en ni onyalo bedo mohore moknyal duok chien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When one person takes the law into their own hands, it sends a message to others that they can do the same.
entries.translation: Sama ng'atachiel okawo chik e lwete, ooro ote ne ji mamoko ni kata gin ginyalo timo kamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a cycle of violence and retribution that can be difficult to stop.
entries.translation: Mae nyalo kelo tulo kod chulo kuoro ma nyalobedo matek chungo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the long run, vigilante justice is rarely effective in deterring crime.
entries.translation: Giko, yor ratiro mar sungusungu oken yono makare mar geng'o njore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, it can often have the opposite effect, making criminals more likely to commit crimes in the future.
entries.translation: Kuom adier, onyalo mana medo midhiero, komiyo jonjore bedo e thuolo mamalo mar timo njore e kinde mabiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Son, did you know that there's a new array of craters on the moon?
entries.translation: Wuoda, be ing'eyo ni nitie sulwe mathoth manyien mayudore e dwe?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Scientists say that they were formed by a series of impacts from asteroids and comets.
entries.translation: Jolony mag Sayans wacho ni sulwe go nolosi kaluwore gi rado e kind sulwe mag asteroid gi komet.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The largest crater is about 100 miles across and is named after the Greek god of war, Ares.
entries.translation: Sulwe maduong' mogik nigi bor madirom mail 100 kendo nomiye nying mar nyasach lweny mar jo Greece, Ares.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The craters are so bright that they can be seen from Earth with the naked eye.
entries.translation: Sulwe go rieny ahinya kendo gineno ka intie e Piny kae kirango gi kod wang'i.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They stand out against the dark surface of the moon like silver coins on a black velvet cloth.
entries.translation: Gineno maber kagin e kor dwe koma rateng' ti ka gichalo jegejege mag mula mantie e law marateng' mar velvet.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Water is essential for life.
entries.translation: Pi en gino maduong' e ngima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It makes up over 60% of our body weight and is involved in many important bodily functions, such as regulating body temperature, transporting nutrients and oxygen to cells, and removing waste products.
entries.translation: Pi kawo thuolo mar 60% mar pek mar dendwa kendo itiyo kode e yore mathoth mag del, kaka duoko piny liet mar del, tero nyinyo mag chiemo gi muya e sels mag del kod golo oko chilo e del.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Water also helps to lubricate joints and protect organs and tissues.
entries.translation: Pi bende konyo e keto fuondi bendo mayom kendo rito fuondi gi tishu mag del.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many reasons why we should conserve water.
entries.translation: Nitie gik mathoth mamiyo owinjore wakung pi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One reason is that water scarcity is a growing problem around the world.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gigo en ni pi tin kendo omedo bedo midhiero e piny mangima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In many parts of the world, people do not have access to clean water, and even in areas where water is plentiful, it is becoming increasingly scarce due to climate change.
entries.translation: Kuonde mathoth e piny mangima, oganda onge kod pi maler, to kata mana kuonde mantie pi moromo, pi medo mana dok piny kaluwore gi lokruok e kor lwasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another reason to conserve water is that it is a valuable resource.
entries.translation: Wach machielo mamiyo owinjore wakung pi en ni pi en mwandu man kod nengo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It takes a lot of energy to treat and transport water, and it is important to use water wisely so that we do not waste this precious resource.
entries.translation: Kawo teko mathoth mar thiedho kendo goyo pi, kendo en gimaber mondo watigi pi eyo makare mondo kik wakethi mwandu ni makende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many things we can do to conserve water.
entries.translation: Nitie gik mathoth ma wanyalo timo mar mondo wakung pi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can take shorter showers, fix leaky faucets, and water our lawns less often.
entries.translation: Wanyalo luokore gi pi matin, loso kuonde motuch kendo duoko piny kaka waolo pi e mauwa magwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also choose to buy products that are made with recycled water.
entries.translation: Bende wanyalo yiero mar nyiewo gikmoko molosi ka itiyo gi pi moketi maler kendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By making small changes in our daily lives, we can help to conserve water and ensure that this vital resource is available for future generations.
entries.translation: Kuom timo lokruoge matindo e ngima marwa ma pile, wanyalo konyo kungo pi kendo neno ni mwandu ni yudore ne oganda ma ndalo mabiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Floods are a natural disaster that can cause widespread damage and loss of life.
entries.translation: Muomruok mar pi en midhiero manyalo kelo kethruok maduong' mar mwandu kod tho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are often caused by heavy rainfall or snowmelt that exceeds the capacity of a river or other waterway, resulting in the overflow of water onto land.
entries.translation: Ithoro kele gi kodhe machwe mang'eny kata lungruok mar baraf makalo nyalo mar aoche kata yore mamoko mag pi, kaeto miyo pi muomo nyaka e puothe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Floods can also be caused by dams or levees breaking, or by tsunamis.
entries.translation: Muomruok mar pi bende nyalobedo ka yewni kata aoche omuomo, kata ka sunami otimore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common types of floods are river floods, which occur when a river overflows its banks, and flash floods, which occur when a large amount of rain falls in a short period of time.
entries.translation: Thothne pi ma muomore timore ga e aoche, ma timore ka aora omwomo giko mage, kod pi ma muomore bang' koth, ma timore ka koth ochwe mang'eny ahinya e kinde machuok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Floods can also occur in coastal areas due to storm surges, which are large waves that are pushed inland by strong winds.
entries.translation: Muomruok mar pi timore e dhowedhe mag nam chumbi kaluwore gi kodhe mapek, ma ikelo gi apaka madongo ma ichoro ei piny gi yembe mapek ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Floods can cause a wide range of damage, including loss of life, property damage, and environmental damage.
entries.translation: Muomruok pi nyalo kelo midhiero mang'eny, koriwo tho, kethruok mwandu kod kethruok e alwora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also disrupt transportation and communication, and lead to food and water shortages.
entries.translation: Bende ginyalo chocho yore mag wuoth kod tudruok, kendo kelo nok mar chiemo gi pi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The resulting loss of homes and livelihoods can force people to relocate, which can lead to social and economic problems.
entries.translation: Bang' wito kuonde jot kod yor ngima, nyalo chuno ni oganda odar, gino manyalo kelo midhiero mag oganda kod ochumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Our archive contains over 100 million records, including census records, birth records, death records, and marriage records.
entries.translation: Kar keno marwa ni kod rekod mahingo milion 100, koriwo rekod mag kwan oganda, rekod mag nyithindo minyuolo, rekod mag tho kod mago mag keny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We also have a large collection of family group sheets and manuscripts.
entries.translation: Bende wan kod oboke mag kidienje mag kanyakla mag familia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To search for your ancestors, you can use our surname search tool.
entries.translation: Mondo imany kwereni, inyalo tiyo gi yor menyo kindiko nying anyuola mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This tool allows you to search by surname, first name, and date of birth.
entries.translation: Yorni konyi menyo ka indiko nying anyuola, nying mokwongo kod tarik mar nywol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also search by location.
entries.translation: Bende inyalo menyo ka indiko nying kama imanyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have found your ancestors, you can view their records.
entries.translation: Ka iseyudo kwereni, inyalo rango rekod mag gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also print copies of their records.
entries.translation: Bende inyalo goyo chapa mar rekod mag gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We also offer a subscription service that allows you to access our entire archive.
entries.translation: Bende wan kod savis mar ndikruok mamiyi thuolo mar yudo gigo duto ma wakano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This service is perfect for genealogists who are looking for a comprehensive collection of records.
entries.translation: Savis ni nikare ne jolony mag weche dongruok anyuola ma manyo kama nitie rekod mochoki malach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions about our archive or our surname search tool, please do not hesitate to contact us.
entries.translation: Ka in kod penjo moro amaora kuom kar keno marwa kata yorwa mar manyo nyinge anyuola, wakwayi ni mondo itudri kodwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are here to help you find your ancestors.
entries.translation: Wan kae mar konyi iyudi kwereni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Juan who loved tacos.
entries.translation: Chon ahinya, nentie ojana matin mane nyinge Juan mane ohero chamo tong' motedi gi ring'o eiye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He loved them so much that he would eat them for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
entries.translation: Nohero chiemo no ahinya omiyo nonyalo chame gokinyi, saa lanj kod otieno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Juan's mother decided to make him a special taco.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro, min Juan nong'ado wach ni odwaloso ne chiemo no eyo makende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She filled it with all of his favorite ingredients: ground beef, lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, and sour cream.
entries.translation: Nolose ka oketo gikmoko ma Juan ohero: ring'o moregi, alot mar lettuce, nyanya, mor alenya kod krim mawach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juan was so excited for his taco that he could barely wait to eat it.
entries.translation: Juan ne omor aduwa kuom chiembe mar taco kendo neen gi siso mar chame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Juan finally took a bite of his taco, he was amazed at how delicious it was.
entries.translation: Giko to kane okayo chiembe mar taco, nowuoro kaka nomit.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flavors of the meat, vegetables, and cheese all combined perfectly to create a taste that Juan had never experienced before.
entries.translation: Ndhadhu mar ring'o, alot kod mor alenya duto noriwore maber mar loso ndhadhu ma Juan nepok ochamo nyaka nene.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ate every bite of his taco, and then he asked his mother to make him another one.
entries.translation: Nochamo chiemo no te, kendo nokwayo mamane mondo otedne machielo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juan's mother was happy to make him another taco, and she even let him help her in the kitchen.
entries.translation: Min Juan nomor mar tedone machielo, kendo noyiene mondo okonye e tije mag jikon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juan learned how to measure the ingredients, how to cook the meat, and how to assemble the tacos.
entries.translation: Juan nopuonjore pimo gigo mitedogodo, kaka itedo ring'o kod kaka iriwo chiemb taco.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had so much fun helping his mother that he decided that he wanted to be a chef when he grew up.
entries.translation: Nowinjo maber ka okonyo min mare omiyo ne ong'ado wach ni doher bedo jalony e weche mag tedo ka osepong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juan continued to love tacos throughout his childhood.
entries.translation: Juan nodhi nyime gi hero taco e ngima mare duto ka en nyathi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ate them at home, at school, and at restaurants.
entries.translation: Nochamogi ka en pacho, ka en e sikul kod ei otel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The federal government is considering adding a new species of colorful fish to the list of protected species.
entries.translation: Sirikal maduong' ni kod chenro mar riwo kit rech manyien man kod rangi mathoth e kwan mag kit chwech momii arita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fish, known as the "rainbow mouth" fish, is found only in a small area of the Pacific Ocean.
entries.translation: Rechno, mong'ere kaka rech man kod "dho lihudu", yudore mana kama tin ahinya e Nam Ataro mar Pacific.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is named for its bright colors and distinctive mouth, which is shaped like a rainbow.
entries.translation: Nomiye nying kaluwore gi rangi marieny kod dhoge makende, machal gi lihudu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The members of the Fish and Wildlife Service are divided on whether or not to add the rainbow mouth fish to the list of protected species.
entries.translation: Jokanyo mag Bad Migao Marito Rech kod Lee Mag Bungu pokobedo e winjruok kuom ka owinjore oketi rechni ma dhoge chalo lihudu kaka achiel kuom chwech ma omii arita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some members argue that the fish is not in danger of extinction and does not need federal protection.
entries.translation: Moko kuom jokanyo wacho ni rechno oknie okang' mar lal kendo onge tiende miye arita mar sirikal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others argue that the fish is unique and should be protected from overfishing.
entries.translation: Moko bende wacho ni rechno en rech makende ma owinjore omi arita mondo kik jolupo luwe morum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The decision of whether or not to add the rainbow mouth fish to the list of protected species is likely to be a difficult one.
entries.translation: Nyalo bedo matek ng'ado wach ewi ka bende owinjore oketi rech ma dhoge chalo gi luhudu kaka achiel kuom chech momii arita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Feel the warmth of the blanket seeping into your body, and let your muscles relax.
entries.translation: Winj liet mar baranget ka oumo dendi ka inindo, mondo omii leche magi ogonyre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Close your eyes and take a deep breath.
entries.translation: Mi wang'i kendo igam muya iye matek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inhale through your nose and exhale through your mouth.
entries.translation: Ywa muya iye kokalo e umi kendo iywe muya oko kokalo e dhogi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Repeat this several times, letting your mind clear and your body become still.
entries.translation: Nwotimo kamae ding'eny, ka iweyo pachi mondo obed makare kendo dendi thal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As you relax, imagine yourself in a beautiful place.
entries.translation: E seche ma dendi gonyore, ket e pachi ni in kama ondisore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It could be a beach, a forest, or a mountaintop.
entries.translation: Onyalobedo e dho wath, ei bungu kata ewi got malo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Whatever place you choose, make it a place where you feel happy and at peace.
entries.translation: Obed ni iyiero kanye, neni en kama iwinjoe ka in gi mor kod kwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: See the sights, hear the sounds, and smell the smells of your chosen place.
entries.translation: Rang gigo manenore, chik iti iwinji duol kendo iwinjo suya mar kama iyierono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Feel the sun on your skin and the breeze in your hair.
entries.translation: Winji ka chieng' goyo pien dendi kendo ka yamo kudho yiege wiyi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let yourself relax in this place for as long as you like.
entries.translation: We dendi ogonyre ka in kanyo kuom thuolo ma in emihero.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you're ready to return to the present, take a few deep breaths and open your eyes.
entries.translation: Ka isehikori mar duogo kaka pile, ywa muya kendo kaeto iyaw wang'i.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You'll feel refreshed and rejuvenated, ready to take on the day.
entries.translation: Ibirowinjo maber kendo yudo teko manyien, mar rakri gi odiechiengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is just one example of a relaxation technique that you can use to relieve stress and improve your overall well-being.
entries.translation: Mae en mana achiel kuom yore mag keto dendi ogonyre ma inyalo tiyogodo mar golo paro mathoth kendo bero ngima mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many other relaxation techniques available, so find one that works for you and make it a part of your daily routine.
entries.translation: Nitie yore mamoko mathoth mag gonyo del, omiyo many yorno maber kodi kendo item obedi gino mitimo pile.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With a little practice, you'll be able to relax on command, whenever you need to.
entries.translation: Ka idhinyime gi time kinde ka kinde, ibirobedo e okang' mar keto dendi gonyore, seche duto ma idwaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to remember that dog attacks are rare, and that most dogs are well-behaved and loving creatures.
entries.translation: En gino maber mondo ipar ni monj mitimo gi guogi en gino mok thor timore, kendo thoth guogi gin le ma timbegi beyo kendo ohero ji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are certain circumstances that can increase the risk of a dog attack, such as if the dog is not properly trained, if it is feeling threatened, or if it is in a confined space.
