entries.translation: Kata kamano, nitie gikmoko ma kotimre to nyalo miyo guok monjo ng'ato, kaka, ka guok okoyudo tiegruok mowinjore, ka gimoro obuogo ngima mare kata ka entie e kama olorne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the case of the recent dog attack in which a grandmother was killed, it appears that the dog was not properly trained and that it was feeling threatened by the grandmother's presence.
entries.translation: Kaka e gino ma nyocha otimore mane dayo moro owite ngimane, nenore ni guok nokoyudo tiegruok mowinjore kendo nowinjo buok e ngima mare kuom bedo dayono machiegni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog was a large, powerful breed that had been adopted from a shelter just a few months before the attack.
entries.translation: Guogno ne en koth guok maduong' kendo maratego mane oresi kowuok kama nojote dweche matin kapok ne otimo monjno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The grandmother had been visiting her son and his family, and she was sitting on the couch when the dog suddenly attacked her.
entries.translation: Dayono notimo limbe ne wuode gi familia mare, kendo nobet e kom e seche mane guogno omonje apoya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog bit her multiple times on the head and neck, and she died at the scene.
entries.translation: Guok nokayo wiye gi ng'ute ding'eny, kendo notho e kama monjno motimoree.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog's owner has said that he was unaware of any history of aggression in the dog, and that he believes the attack was triggered by the grandmother's sudden movement.
entries.translation: Wuon guogno owacho ni nokong'eyo sigana moro amora mar gero kuom guogno, kendo en oyie ni guogno nomojo dayono nikech dayono nochapni apoya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to note that even well-trained dogs can become aggressive if they are not properly socialized or if they are feeling threatened.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, ber mondo wapar ni kata mana guogi ma oyudo tiegruok makare nyalobedo makech ka okopuonj gi bedo machiegni gi ji kata ka giwinjo bwok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This tragic incident highlights the importance of responsible dog ownership.
entries.translation: Masira marach ni oyango ber mar bedo jopith mag guogi maluwo chik.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hamid Al-fitr, the famed storyteller, tells of a time when he was injured in battle.
entries.translation: Hamid Al-fitr, ja gano sigana marahuma, loso kuom kinde mane oyudo hinyruok e lweny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I was a young man, just a green recruit, when I first saw battle.
entries.translation: "Ne an wuoyi matin, mana kurutu manyien, kane akwongo neno lweny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fighting was fierce, and I was quickly overwhelmed.
entries.translation: Lwenyno neger, kendo nogoya rame bang' thuolo matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was struck down by a blow to the head, and I lay on the ground, bleeding and dazed.
entries.translation: Napodho piny bang' ka ng'ato orodha e wiya, kendo nanindo piny e lo, ka achwer remo kendo pacha nolal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I lay there, I thought about my life and how it might end.
entries.translation: E seche mane an piny kanyono, naparo ngimana kendo kaka nonyalorumo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I thought about my family and friends, and how they would miss me.
entries.translation: Naparo anyuola kod osiepe maga, kod kaka gibiro gomba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also thought about the rank I had aspired to, and how it would now be impossible for me to achieve.
entries.translation: Bende naparo lemo mane olap dhoga ndong'ne, kod kaka koro nedhibedo matek mondo ayude.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I closed my eyes and prepared for death.
entries.translation: Namiyo wang'a kendo narito tho mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then, I heard a voice.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, nawinjo dwol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was the voice of an old man, and he was saying, "Don't give up.
entries.translation: Neen dwond jaduong' moro, kendo nowacho ni, "Kik chunyi tho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're not done yet" I opened my eyes and saw the old man standing over me.
entries.translation: Pokitieko" Nayawo wengena kendo naneno jaduong' no kochung' buta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a healer, and he had come to help me.
entries.translation: Ne en jathieth, kendo nobiro mar konya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He treated my wounds, and he gave me some words of encouragement:
entries.translation: Nothiedho adhonde maga, kendo nomiya weche moko mane ojiwa:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't let this injury define you,' he said.
entries.translation: Kik iyie mondo hinyruok oketi piny,' nowacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "You're still a warrior, and you still have a lot to offer the world.
entries.translation: "Pod in jalweny, kendo pod in gi ting' maduong' ne piny mangima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Health and fitness are important for feeling your best and living a long, happy life.
entries.translation: Ngima makare kod del man kare gin gigo mabeyo mar mondo iwinj maber kendo idag aming'a ka in gi mor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A healthy diet and regular exercise can help you maintain a healthy weight, reduce your risk of chronic diseases, and improve your mood and energy levels.
entries.translation: Chamo chiemo man gi ngima kod rieyo del kinde ka kinde nyalo konyo keto kilo mari obed mowinjore, duoko piny thuolo mar yudo twoche mag adundo, kod bero rang'iny mar mor kod teko mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eating a healthy diet means eating plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains.
entries.translation: Chamo chiemo man gi ngima tiende en ni ichamo olemo alode kod kothe moromo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also means limiting unhealthy fats, processed foods, and sugary drinks.
entries.translation: Bende tiende en ni duoko piny mo mokber gi ngima, chiemo molosi e kembe kod madho gigo man kod skari mang'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Regular exercise can include activities such as walking, running, swimming, biking, or dancing.
entries.translation: Rieyo del kinde ka kinde nyalo riwo gigo kama wuotho, ringo, goyo abal, riembo ndiga kata mielo thum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to get at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity or 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic activity each week.
entries.translation: Ber mondo irie dendi kuom ka tin to dakika 150 kitimo gigo madwaro teko manie diere kata dakika 75 kitimo gigo madwaro teko mathoth e wik ka wik.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also do muscle-strengthening activities at least twice a week.
entries.translation: Inyalo timo gigo mamiyo leche bedo motengno ma katin to diriyo e wik.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you make healthy choices for your health and fitness, you are not only improving your own life, but you are also setting a positive example for others.
entries.translation: Kitimo yiero makare mar ngima ne ngima gi dendi, koweyo bero ngima mari, bende ibedo kaka jalno ma ji mamoko puonjore kuome.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By making healthy choices, you are helping to create a healthier community and a healthier world.
entries.translation: Kuom timo yiero makare, ikonyo e keto oganda bedo gi ngima maber kendo piny mangima bedo maber moloyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most recent major news event in Eritrea was the 2018 Eritrean–Ethiopian peace agreement.
entries.translation: Wach manyien maduong' ahinya mayande otimore e piny Eritrea ne en ogirimiti mar kwe e kind piny Eritrea gi Ethiopia e higa 2018.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This agreement ended a 20-year war between the two countries and resulted in the reopening of borders and the resumption of trade.
entries.translation: Ogirimiti ni notieko lweny ma nosebedo kuom higni 20 e kind pinje ariyogo kendo kelo yepo mag kiewo mekgi kod charuok kendo mar ohala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a significant step forward for regional stability and peace.
entries.translation: Ne en okang' maduong' ahinya mar kelo kwe gi ngirruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another recent development is the 2019 Eritrean presidential election.
entries.translation: Wach machielo manyocha otimore ne en yiero mar ker ma Eritrea e higa 2019.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Isaias Afwerki, who has been president of Eritrea since 1993, was re-elected for a fifth term with 99% of the vote.
entries.translation: Isaias Afwerki, ma osebedo ker ma Eritrea chakre 1993, noyier kendo e thuolo mare mar abich ka noyudo kwan atamalo 99% mag ombulu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The election was widely criticized by international observers as not being free or fair.
entries.translation: Yierono ne ose ahinya gi joneno manewuok e pinje maoko kaka yiero mane okotimore eyo ma ratiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to these major events, there have also been a number of smaller news stories in Eritrea over the past few years.
entries.translation: Koweyo weche madongo mane otimore gi, bende piny Eritrea osebedo gi weche manyien matindo tindo kuom higni mosekalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These include the 2016 closure of the United Nations office in Eritrea, the 2017 release of several political prisoners, and the 2018 visit of Pope Francis to the country.
entries.translation: Magi onywando loro mar apis mar Riwruok Piny Mangima e higa 2016 e piny Eritrea, weyo thuolo jotwech mathoth mag weche siasa e higa 2017 kod limbe mane Papa Francis otimo e pinyno e higa 2018.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Overall, the past few years have been a period of relative stability and progress for Eritrea.
entries.translation: Chutho, higni matin mokalo osebedo kinde man kod kwe gi dongruok e piny Eritrea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country has made significant steps towards peace and reconciliation with its neighbors, and there have been some positive developments on the human rights front.
entries.translation: Pinyno osegoyo okang' maduong' eyor manyo kwe kod ng'uono e kinde gi libamba mage, kendo nitie okang' maber mosegoyo e rito ratiro mag dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The distribution of beauty services and spas is changing, with a growing number of men seeking out these services.
entries.translation: Kuonde ma iyude savis mag dusruok kod spa lokore, ka sani kwan mar jomachwo mamanyo savis gi omedore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the United States, the number of male spa-goers has increased by 30% in the past five years, and men now account for 20% of all spa visits.
entries.translation: E piny Amerka, kwan jomachwo madhi e spa omedore gi 30% e higni abich mokalo kendo sani chwo okawo 20% mar ji duto madhi e spa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the demand for male beauty services grows, spas are starting to cater more specifically to men's needs.
entries.translation: Kaka savis mag dusruok mag jomachwo medore, spa osechako manyo yore mag dusruok mana mag chwo kende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes offering a wider range of services, such as beard trims and massages, as well as creating a more masculine environment.
entries.translation: Mae oriwo chiwo savis mopogore opogore, kaka lielo yiege tik kod timo masaj, kachiel gi keto alwora ma thoro dewo jomachwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some spas are even offering men-only days or hours, so that men can feel comfortable getting pampered without feeling self-conscious.
entries.translation: Moko kuom spa ni kata gi odiechienge kata saa mana mag chwo kende, mar mondo jomachwo owinj maber ka idusogi maonge kibaji moro amora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The growth of the male beauty market is a sign of a changing attitude towards men's grooming.
entries.translation: Dongruok e chiro mar dusruok jomachwo en ranyisi mar lokruok e paro ma ji nigodo kuom dusruok jomachwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A brave little robin was flying through the forest when he saw a group of birds gathered around a large tree.
entries.translation: Akuru moro matin ma jachir nefuyo ei bungu eka noneno winy moko kochokore e yien maduong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He landed on a branch nearby and listened to what they were saying.
entries.translation: Nopiyo ebad yien mane ni machiegni kendo nochiko ite mar winjo gino mane giwacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We've been investigating this tree for weeks," said a raven.
entries.translation: "Wasebedo ka watimo nonro kuom yien ni kuom wige mathoth," agak nowacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We're not sure what's causing it to lean so precariously!" said a little sparrow.
entries.translation: "Ok wang'eyo gimomiyo oyiengore gi bathe eyo marach ahinya!" ochinjo matin nowacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But we're worried that it's going to fall and hurt someone!" cried an eagle.
entries.translation: "Kata kamano wan kod luoro ni odhi podho kendo hinyo ng'ato!" ating'a noywak.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The robin looked at the tree and saw that it was indeed leaning very heavily to one side.
entries.translation: Akuru norango yien no kendo neneno ni adier ne oyiengore ahinya nyakonchiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He knew that he had to do something to help, but he didn't know what.
entries.translation: Nong'eyo ni nyaka notim gimoro mar konyo, kata kamano nokia ni otim ang'o.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suddenly, an idea came to him.
entries.translation: Apoya, paro nobiro ne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He flew down to the ground and gathered a large load of leaves.
entries.translation: Nofuyo nyaka piny e lo kendo nochoko it obok mathoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He then flew back up to the tree and started to stuff the leaves into the hole where the roots were exposed.
entries.translation: Kaeto ne ofuyo kodok e yien kendo nochako keto it obok ei bugo kama tiende yien nonyiedhore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The birds below watched in amazement as the robin worked.
entries.translation: Winy mane ni piny kanyo neno ka dhogi omoko seche ma akuru netiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They couldn't believe that such a small bird could have so much strength.
entries.translation: Nokgiyie ni winyo matin kamano nenyalobedo gi teko mathoth ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few hours, the robin had filled the hole completely.
entries.translation: Bang' seche matin, akuru nosepong'o bugono thich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The tree was now standing upright and stable.
entries.translation: Yien koro nochung' tir kendo motegno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The other birds cheered and thanked the robin for saving the day.
entries.translation: Winy mamoko nopamo kendo dwoko erokamano ne akuru kuom konyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The world is a very different place than it was just a few decades ago.
entries.translation: Piny sani opogore ahinya ka ipime gi kaka ne en higni moko mokalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nationalism has taken hold in many countries, and people are more divided than ever.
entries.translation: Wach mar kedo ne piny ongirore e pinje mathoth, kendo barruok nitie ekind oganda ahinya maloyo chon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In one country, a group of nationalists have taken control of the government and are using their power to suppress dissent.
entries.translation: E piny moro, kanyakla mar jogo makedo ne pinygi osekawo thuolo e sirikal kendo gitiyo gi teko margi mar thiro jogo mopogore kodgi e paro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They have banned all forms of media that they deem to be "unpatriotic," and they have arrested and even killed people who speak out against the government.
entries.translation: Giloro ute fwambo duto ma ineno kaka mago ma "ok kedi ne dwaro mar piny gi," kendo gisemako kendo nego oganda mawacho weche madhi ataro gi sirikal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young woman named Rebecca is walking home from school when she is stopped by a group of nationalist soldiers.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro achiel, nyadendi mapod tin ma nyinge Rebecca wuotho kodhi pacho kowuok sikul eka kanyakla mar jolweny makedo ne piny nochunge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They accuse her of being a traitor, and they take her to a secret prison.
entries.translation: Negiwacho ni en andhoga, kendo negitere e od ang'ech mopondo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rebecca is tortured and interrogated, but she refuses to give up any information.
entries.translation: Isando Rebecca kendo idayo dhoge, kata kamano otamore chiwo weche midwaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After several weeks, Rebecca is finally released from prison.
entries.translation: Bang' wige mathoth, nowe Rebecca thuolo kowuok e od ang'ech.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is weak and malnourished, but she is determined to fight back against the nationalists.
entries.translation: Dende nyap kendo okoso chiemo, kata kamano oketo mahino mar gore gi jogo makedo ne piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She joins a resistance movement, and she becomes a valuable asset to the cause.
entries.translation: Odonjo e riwruok mar jomobalo, kendo obedo jalno mogen e kedo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rebecca uses her knowledge of technology to help the resistance communicate and coordinate their attacks.
entries.translation: Rebecca tiyo kod rieko mar teknoloji mar konyo riwruok mar jomobalo e yor tudruok kod chano monj.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She also uses her skills as a hacker to infiltrate the nationalists' computers and steal their data.
entries.translation: Bende otiyo gi riekni mage kaka achuth mar weche mbui mar donjore e kompiuta mar jokedo ne piny kendo okwalo weche mag gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vast archives of military photos have been digitized and made available online, allowing researchers to study them from anywhere in the world.
entries.translation: Pichni mathoth mag lweny mokan oseketi e yor dijitol kendo yudore e mbui, miyo jotim nonro nyalo rango gi ka gin kamoro amora e piny mangima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This has led to a number of new discoveries, as researchers are able to compare photos from different sources and identify previously unknown individuals.
entries.translation: Mae osekelo fwenyruok mar gikmoko manyien, nikech jotim nonro ni kod thuolo mar pimo pichni mawuok kuonde mopogore opogore kendo yango dhano mane okoyangi e kinde mokalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In one case, researchers were able to identify a soldier who had been missing for over 70 years using photos from a military archive.
entries.translation: Kuom ranyisi, jotim nonro nenyalo yango jalweny mane oselal kuom mahingo higni 70 kagitiyo gi piche mane owuok e kar keno mar jolweny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The soldier's family was overjoyed to finally learn what had happened to him, and they were able to hold a proper funeral for him.
entries.translation: Anyuola mar jalweny no nemor aduwa mar fwenyo gino mane otimorene, kendo neginyalo miye yik makare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Poetry is a universal language that transcends time and place.
entries.translation: Poem en dhok mawinjore e piny mangima kendo okalo kinde kata kama indike.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be used to express emotions, tell stories, and explore complex ideas.
entries.translation: Itiyo kode e nyiso mor kata kuyo, gano sigana kod fuono tiend weche matek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a translator, I have the privilege of helping to bring poetry to new audiences by rendering it in another language.
entries.translation: Kaka jalok weche, an kod thuolo mar konyo kelo poem ne jowinjo manyien ka andike gi dhok machielo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is a challenging but rewarding task, as I must not only convey the literal meaning of the poem, but also its beauty and power.
entries.translation: Mae en tich matek kata obedo ni en gi ochudo maber, nikech kiweyo golo tiend wach kaka ondike e poem, bende nyaka indike ka inyiso sironyo gi teko mare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things to consider when translating poetry is the rhythm and meter.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gigo madongo ahinya manyaka ing'i ka iloko dho poem en ka bende owerore kendo ka bor mare donjore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These elements are essential to the poem's overall effect, and they can be difficult to reproduce in another language.
entries.translation: Magi e gik madongo mabero poem mangima, kendo nyalobedo matek mar loko gi e dhok machielo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, I may need to adjust the rhythm or meter slightly in order to make the poem flow more naturally in the target language.
entries.translation: Seche moko, chuna ni nyaka aloki werruok kata bor mar weche matin mondo poem obedi manyalo werore makare e dhok maloke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, I always take care to preserve the poem's original meaning and intent.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, ajabedo motang' mar neno ni tiend wach kod ote mar poem okolal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important consideration is the use of figurative language.
entries.translation: Wach machielo maduong' ma nyaka ng'i en tiyo gi dhok mopondo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Poets often use metaphors, similes, and other figures of speech to create vivid imagery and add depth to their work.
entries.translation: Poem thoro tiyo gi ngeche, pimo gimoro gi machielo kod yore mamoko mag loso eyo moken achiel ka achiel mar keto tipo mar wach e pach jawinjo kendo medo tut mar tije.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When translating these devices, I must find equivalents in the target language that will have the same impact on the reader.
entries.translation: Ka aloko weche gi, nyaka amany weche machalo gi mago e dhok maloke mabiro miyo jasomo yudo wachno machal gi kaka en e dhok mokwongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dolls and doll accessories are a popular way for children to play and learn.
entries.translation: Doli kod gige doli gin yorno man gi huma mar nyithindo puonjore kendo tugo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dolls can represent people, animals, or even imaginary creatures.
entries.translation: Doli nyalo bedo manyiso dhano, le kata mana chwech mothuogi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be dressed up in different clothes, given different furniture to play with, and placed in different settings.
entries.translation: Inyalo rwaknegi lewni mopogore opogore, inyalo migi kombe mopogore mag tugo kendo inyalo ketgi eyore mopogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Children can use dolls to act out stories, explore different roles, and learn about the world around them.
entries.translation: Nyithindo nyalo tiyo gi doli mar nyiso tuke mag sigana, mar nyiso kit jotugo mopogore opogore kendo puonjore kuom piny moluoro gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, a child might use a doll to pretend to be a doctor, a teacher, or a firefighter.
entries.translation: Kuom ranyisi, nyathi nyalotiyo gi doli mar wuondore ni en laktar, japuonj kata jakedo gi muoch mach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not just about what you wear, but how you wear it.
entries.translation: Oken mana ni irwako ang'o, to irwake nade.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're always slouching and your clothes are rumpled, it shows that you don't care about yourself.
entries.translation: Ka ithoro bet abeta kendo irwako lewni ma owewni to ojony, mano nyiso ni okimiyo weche magi pek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People will notice and they'll make assumptions about you.
entries.translation: Dhano biro fwenyo kendo gibiro ng'ado wach kuomi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They might think that you're lazy or unkempt.
entries.translation: Ginyalo paro ni in ng'at ma ng'oyong'oyo kata mokohero ler.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They might even think that you're not a good person.
entries.translation: Ginyalo kata paro ni okin ng'at maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, there are times when we all wear shabby clothes.
entries.translation: Adier, nitie seche moko ma waduto warwako lewni mogar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Maybe we're just running errands or we're doing chores around the house.
entries.translation: Samoro wadhi mana timo gimoro kamoro kata watimo mana tije mag ot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But if you find yourself wearing shabby clothes all the time, it's time to take a look at yourself.
entries.translation: Kata kamano ka iyudori ka irwako lewni mogar seche duto, ber mondo koro ikaw thuolo mondo irangri in iwuon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Are you really happy with the way you look?
entries.translation: Bende imor adier gi kaka ichalo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If not, then it's time to make a change.
entries.translation: Ka okimor, kare seche ochopo ma nyaka itim lokruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Start by taking some time to think about your personal style.
entries.translation: Chaki ka ikawo thuolo kiparo ewi stael mari in iwuon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What kind of clothes do you feel good in?
entries.translation: Gin kit lewni mage ma iwinjo maber ka irwako?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What kind of clothes make you feel confident?
entries.translation: Gin kit lewni mage ma iwinjo ka in gi chir ka irwako?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you know what you like, start shopping for clothes that fit your personality.
entries.translation: Ka iseng'eyo gigo mihero, chak nyiewo lewni madonjo gi kiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's also important to make sure that your clothes are clean and well-fitting.
entries.translation: Bende ber mondo ine ni lepi ler kendo oromi maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If they're rumpled or stained, it will only make you look worse.
entries.translation: Ka gijuothore kata ka gichido, ibero mana neno marach mokalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Take the time to iron your clothes and make sure they fit properly.
entries.translation: Kaw thuolo mari mar yuoyo lepi gi pas kendo ine ni giromi maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, don't be afraid to experiment with different styles.
entries.translation: Giko, kik iluor mar temo sitael mopogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You might be surprised at what you find.
entries.translation: Inyalo wuoro kaka idhichalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are so many different ways to dress, so don't be afraid to try new things.
entries.translation: Nitie yore mathoth mag rwakruok, koro kik iluor temo yore manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The more you experiment, the more likely you are to find a style that you love.
entries.translation: Kaka imedo temo, ekaka ibedo e thuolo maber mar yudo stael mihero.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you dress well, it shows that you take pride in yourself.
entries.translation: Ka irwakori maber, nyiso ni in kod nyadhi kuom kaka ichalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also makes you feel more confident.
entries.translation: Bende miyo ibedo gi chir moloyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So if you're looking for a way to boost your self-confidence, start by taking a look at your wardrobe.
entries.translation: Omiyo ka imanyo yo mar jiwo chir mari in iwuon, chak gi rango kaka kabat mari mar lewni chalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A few new clothes can make a big difference.
entries.translation: Lewni matin manyien nyalo kelo pogruok maduong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ghana is a country with a rich and diverse culture, and its traditional customs are a major part of that.
entries.translation: Ghana en piny man kod kido gi timbe mathoth kendo mopogore, kendo kweche machon gin achiel kuom kido gi timbe go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important customs is the naming ceremony, which is held for a newborn child.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom kweche madongo ahinya en nyasi mar chiwo nying ma itimo ne nyathi ma kidoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The ceremony is typically presided over by a traditional priest or elder, and it involves the naming of the child, as well as prayers and blessings for the child's future.
entries.translation: Nyasi no ithoro chung'ie gi jayalo machon kata jaduong', kendo oriwo miyo nyathi nying, kod lamo gi gwedho ndalo mabiro mag nyathi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important custom is the funeral ceremony, which is held for a deceased person.
entries.translation: Kwero machielo maduong' en nyasi mar tho, ma itimo ne ng'ato mong'ielo orengo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The ceremony is typically very elaborate and involves music, dancing, and food.
entries.translation: Nyasi ni thorobedo gi weche mathoth koriwo goyo thum, miel kod chiemo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The deceased person is typically buried with their belongings, and a shrine is often built in their honor.
entries.translation: Ng'at mong'ielo orengo iyiko ga gi mwandu mage, kendo kar lamo igero mar nyise lwor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ghana is also home to a number of traditional festivals, such as the Odwira festival, which is held in the Ashanti region.
entries.translation: Ghana bende en piny ma nyasi mathoth machon timore, kaka nyasi mar Odwira, ma itimo kama ong'ere ni Ashanti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The festival is a time for celebration and thanksgiving, and it involves traditional music, dancing, and food.
entries.translation: Nyasi no en thuolo mar mor kod dwoko erokamano, kendo oriwo thum, miel kod chiemo machon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, some traditional customs in Ghana have been adapted to modern life.
entries.translation: E higni matin mokalo, moko kuom kweche machon mag Ghana osenywandi e ngima manyasani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, some naming ceremonies now include electronic devices such as computers and projectors.
entries.translation: Kuom ranyisi, moko kuom nyasi mag chiwo nying sani oriwo gige elektronik kaka kompiuta kod projekta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This allows for the ceremony to be more interactive and engaging for the participants.
entries.translation: Maye chiwo chuolo mar nyasi mondo obedi mayuayo ji mathoth kendo moro jokanyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Overall, traditional customs in Ghana are a major part of the country's culture, and they continue to be practiced today.
entries.translation: Chutho, kweche machon mag piny Ghana gin achiel kuom gigo madongo e kido kod timbe mag pinyno, kendo oganda dhinyime gi timogi nyaka kawuono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Klaus was a heavy smoker.
entries.translation: Klaus ne en jaywa ndawa maduong' ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He smoked a pack of cigarettes a day, and he had been doing so for over 20 years.
entries.translation: Noywayo paket achiel mar ndawa e odiechieng', kendo nosebedo kotimo kamano kuom mahingo higni 20.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He knew that smoking was bad for his health, but he couldn't seem to quit.
entries.translation: Nong'eyo ni ywayo ndawa nokber gi ngima mare, kata kamano weyo nenore ni notame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Klaus was walking down the street when he saw a strange man.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro achiel, Klaus newuotho e apaya eka noneno ng'ato mane wendo e wang'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man was wearing a long white coat and had a strange device in his hand.
entries.translation: Ng'atno norwako kabut marabora to rachar kendo ne en gi gimoro magalagala e lwete.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Excuse me," Klaus said. "What are you doing?"
entries.translation: "Apenji," Klaus nowacho. "Itimo ang'o?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm a scientist," the man said. "I'm working on a new device that will help people quit smoking."
entries.translation: "An ja sayans," jalno nowacho. "Atemo loso masin manyien mabiro konyo jogo maywayo ndawa mondo owe timno."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Really?" Klaus said "That's amazing!"
entries.translation: "Adier?" Klaus nowacho "Mano wach maber!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, it is," the man said.
entries.translation: "Kamano, ober ahinya," jalno nowacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "This device will send you to another space where you will be able to see the effects of smoking on your health."
entries.translation: "Masind ni biroteri kamachielo ma inyalo nenoe midhiero mag ywayo ndawa e ngima mari."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That sounds incredible," Klaus said. "I'd like to try it."
entries.translation: "Mano wach manimba manade," Klaus nowacho. "Daher mar temo tiyo kode."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man smiled. "Very well," he said. "Just step into this device and I'll start the process."
entries.translation: Jalno nobuonjo. "Kare," nowacho. "Donj adonja ei masind ni kendo adhiyawe mondo ochak tich."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Klaus stepped into the device and the man closed the door behind him.
entries.translation: Klaus nodonjo ei masind no kendo jalno noloro dhode.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a beautiful day for a picnic, so my family and I decided to go to the park.
entries.translation: Ne en odiechieng' maber gi wuok oko, omiyo an kachiel gi familia mara ne wang'ado mar dhi e kar yweyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We packed a lunch and set out early in the morning.
entries.translation: Newahiko chiemo mar saa lanj kendo newawuok gokinyi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we got to the park, we found a nice spot to spread out our blanket and eat our lunch.
entries.translation: Kane wachopo kar yweyo, newayudo kamoro maber mane wapedhe baranget marwa mondo wacham lanj marwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We had sandwiches, chips, fruit, and cookies.
entries.translation: Newan kod sandwije, chips, olemo kod biskude.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After we ate, we played some games and just enjoyed spending time together.
entries.translation: Bang' chiemo, newatugo tuke moko kendo winjo maber kawan kanyakla.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We didn't think about anything except having fun.
entries.translation: Nokwapar wach moro amora mopogore gi winjo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a perfect day.
entries.translation: Ne en odiechieng' manimba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This hotel is a great choice for those looking for a central location in Lisbon.
entries.translation: Magawa ni en yiero maber ahinya ne jogo mamanyo kama nitie edier boma ma Lisbon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is located just a short walk from the city center and the waterfront, and it offers stunning views of the port.
entries.translation: Ogere mana kama iwuotho matin kiwuok e chuny boma kendo edho wach, to en kod kama inenogodo pot maber ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rooms are spacious and well-appointed, and the staff is friendly and helpful.
entries.translation: Udi mantie e iye dongo kendo oketgi mondisore, jotije bende jombola kendo konyo ji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hotel is also very quiet, which is ideal for those who want to get a good night's sleep.
entries.translation: Magawa no nitie kama okwe, ober gi jogo madwaro ni mondo onindi mokwe ei otieno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rooms are soundproofed, and the hotel is located in a quiet area away from the hustle and bustle of the city center.
entries.translation: Udi oketie gigo mageng'o koko, kendo magawa nitie kama okwe mabor gi kikruok matimore e chuny boma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Recycling is a vital process that helps to protect the environment and conserve natural resources.
entries.translation: Tiyo gi yugi mar loso mwandu manyien kendo en gino makonyo rito alwora kendo rito mwandu mag piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By recycling, we can reduce the amount of waste that goes to landfills and incinerators, conserve energy, and save money.
entries.translation: Ka watiyo gi yugi e loso mwandu manyien, wanyalo duoko piny kwan mag gigo miwito e yugi kata e masin mar wang'o yugi, rito teko kod kungo omenda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of recycling begins with the collection of recyclable materials.
entries.translation: Chakruok mar loso mwandu manyien en choko gigo ma inyal losi kendo mondo obed manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These materials are then sorted and processed into raw materials that can be used to create new products.
entries.translation: Bang'e to iyieko gigo kendo iketo gi gibedo gigo mitiyogodo e loso mwandu ma inyal koro tigodo e loso mwandu manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, plastic bottles can be recycled into new plastic bottles, aluminum cans can be recycled into new aluminum cans, and paper can be recycled into new paper products.
entries.translation: Kuom ranyisi, duoko chupe mondo olosgo kendo chupe manyien mag plastik, okepe mag aluminium inyalo losgo kendo okepe manyien mag aluminium kendo otese bende inyalo losgo kendo gigo miloso gi otese.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Recycling has many benefits.
entries.translation: Loso mwandu kitiyo gi yugi nigi ber mathoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It helps to reduce the amount of waste that goes to landfills and incinerators, which can help to protect the environment and conserve natural resources.
entries.translation: Okonyo e duoko piny kwan mar yugi miwito kod miwang'o e masin mar wang'o yugi, mano nyalo konyo e rito alwora kod kungo mwandu mag piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Recycling also conserves energy, as it takes less energy to produce products from recycled materials than it does from raw materials.
entries.translation: Loso mwandu kitiyo gi yugi bende kungo teko, nikech okawo teko matin mar loso mwandu kowuok kuom yugi maloyo gigo michako losi manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, recycling can save money, as it can reduce the need to extract and process raw materials.
entries.translation: Bende, tiyo gi yugi e loso mwandu manyien nyalo kungo pesa, nikech onyalo duoko piny dwaro mar thodho kendo loso mwandu makoreka ihango.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The launch of new recycling programs in most countries has ended the color-coded recycling system.
entries.translation: Yepo mar chenro manyien mag loso mwandu kitiyo gi yugi e pinje mathoth otieko sistem mar loso mwandu kitiyo gi yugi mane iyango kitiyo gi rangi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because the new programs are designed to accept all recyclable materials, regardless of their color.
entries.translation: Mae en kamano nikech chenro manyien ni olosi mar kawo yugi duto miloso bedo mwandu manyien, ka okodewo rangi margi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The new programs are also more efficient, as they use automated sorting systems to process recyclable materials.
entries.translation: Chenro manyien gi bende tiyo maber ahinya, nikech gitiyo gi sistembe ma otomatik mag yieko yugi mondo olosi obedi mwandu manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flowers were expensive, but I didn't care.
entries.translation: Nengo mauwa ne ni malo, kata kamano nokadewo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I had to have them.
entries.translation: Ne nyaka anyiew mauwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were the most beautiful flowers I had ever seen, and I knew they would make her happy.
entries.translation: Neginie mauwa mane beyo ahinya maseneno nyaka nene, kendo nang'eyo ni negidhi miye mor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I bought a dozen roses, all different colors.
entries.translation: Nanyiewo dasan mar mauwa mag roses, rangi duto mopogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I arranged them in a vase and set them on the table next to her bed.
entries.translation: Nachano gi ei agulu kendo naketo gi e mesa mantie ebath ng'ango mare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled when she saw them. "They're beautiful," she said. "Thank you."
entries.translation: Nobuonjo kane onenogi. "Gibeyo," nowacho. "Erokamano."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I smiled back. "You're welcome." I sat down next to her bed and took her hand.
entries.translation: Abende nabuonjo kode. "Machiegni." Nabedo ebath ng'ango mare kendo namako lwete.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She looked up at me with her big, brown eyes.
entries.translation: Noranga gi wengene madongo to rabuor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm so glad you're here," she said. "I'm glad I'm here too," I said.
entries.translation: "Amor ahinya ni ichopo kae," nowacho. "An bende amor mar biro kae," Nawacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked for a long time.
entries.translation: Newaloso kuom thuolo malach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked about our dreams, our hopes, and our fears.
entries.translation: Newaloso kuom lek, geno kod kihondko magwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked about the future.
entries.translation: Newaloso kuom ndalo mabiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When it was time for me to go, she gave me a hug.
entries.translation: Kane seche ochopo mar mondo adhi, nokwaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Thank you for coming," she said. "I love you."
entries.translation: "Erokamano kuom biro," nowacho. "Aheri."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I love you too," I said.
entries.translation: "An bende aheri," Nawacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I kissed her on the forehead and then I left.
entries.translation: Nanyodhe e pat wiye kaeto nawuok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cork flooring is a popular choice for many homeowners because it is durable, stylish, and easy to maintain.
entries.translation: Tael mar bao en yiero man kod huma ne thoth weg pacho nikech obudho, ondisore kendo rite yot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to know how to properly care for cork flooring in order to extend its lifespan and keep it looking its best.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, ber mondo wang'e ni yorno mowinjore mar rito tael mar bao mondo imed ndalo mage kendo ikete onen maber ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things you can do to care for your cork flooring is to sweep, dust, or vacuum it regularly.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gigo madongo minyalo timo mondo irit tael magi mag bao en ywecho, golo buru kata kudho gi yamo mondo obed maler kinde ka kinde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help to remove dirt and debris that can build up on the surface of the flooring and cause it to become damaged.
entries.translation: Mae birokonyo e golo chilo kod yugi manyalo chokore e dier ot kendo miyo tael okethre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have pets, it is especially important to vacuum your cork flooring regularly to remove pet hair and dander.
entries.translation: Ka in kod le mipidho mihero, ber ahinya mondo ikudhi tael magi mag bao mondo igol yier gi chilo mag gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to sweeping, dusting, or vacuuming, you should also occasionally wipe your cork flooring with a damp mop.
entries.translation: Koweyo ywecho, luoko kata kudho, bende owinjore ni iywe tael mar bao dichiel ka kadichiel kitiyo gi law mang'ich matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help to remove any dirt or grime that has been missed by the vacuum cleaner.
entries.translation: Mae biro konyo mar golo chilo moro amora mane masin mari mar kudho yugi nokogolo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to use a damp mop and not a wet mop, as too much water can damage the cork flooring.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, ber mondo iti gi law mang'ich matin to ok modhiek gi pi, nikech pi mang'eny ahinya nyalo ketho tael mar bao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any spills on your cork flooring, it is important to clean them up as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Ka gimoro opukoreni e tael mar bao, ber mondo iywe gino mapiyo kaka nyalore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Use a clean cloth to blot up the spill and then wipe the area with a damp mop.
entries.translation: Ti gi law maler mar chodho gino mopukore kaeto iywe kanyo kitiyo gi law mang'ich matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the spill is sticky, you may need to use a mild detergent to clean it up.
entries.translation: Ka gimopukore en gino ma mien, inyalo tiyo gi sabun mondo iywe tael mar bao obed maler.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to protect your cork flooring from scratches and dents.
entries.translation: Bende ber mondo igeng' tael mari mar bao mondo gik gwarre kata barore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To do this, you can place felt pads under furniture legs and avoid dragging heavy objects across the floor.
entries.translation: Mondo itim kamae, inyalo keto plastik etiend kombe gi mesni mondo ogeng' ywayo gikmoko mapek e dier ot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also avoid using sharp objects on your cork flooring, as this can damage the surface.
entries.translation: Bende kik iti kod gikmoko mabitho e tael mar bao, nikech mae nyalo ketho dier ot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By following these tips, you can help to keep your cork flooring looking its best for years to come.
entries.translation: Ka iluwo yore gi, inyalo konyo keto dier odi mar tael mag bao maneno mondisore kuom higni mathoth mabiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the tips above, there are a few other things you can do to care for your cork flooring.
entries.translation: Koweyo yore mowachi malo kanyo go, nitie gikmoko kendo matin minyalo timo mar rito dier odi mar tael mag bao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, avoid using harsh chemicals on your cork flooring, as these can damage the surface.
entries.translation: Mokwongo, kik iti kod kemikol mager e dier odi mar tael mag bao, nikech mano nyalo kethe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, do not expose your cork flooring to direct sunlight for long periods of time, as this can cause the color to fade.
entries.translation: Mar ariyo, kik iket tael magi mag bao chieng' ogo aching' kuom thuolo malach, mae nyalo miyo rangi mare ruchore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, if you are planning to move your furniture around, be careful not to drag it across the floor, as this can also damage the surface.

entries.english: By following these tips, you can help to extend the life of your cork flooring and keep it looking its best for years to come.
entries.translation: Ka iluwo yore gi, inyalo konyo choro ngima mar tael magi mag bao kendo keto gi ginen mondisore kuom higni mathoth mabiro.

entries.english: Refrigerators and freezers are essential appliances for keeping food and beverages fresh.

entries.english: The refrigerant then passes through the condenser coils, where it releases the heat to the outside air * Thermostat: This controls the temperature inside the refrigerator and freezer.
entries.translation: Pi mar refrigerant kalo ei koil mag kondensa, kama ogolo liet kadhi e yamo ma oko *Thamostat: Mae pimo liet ei frij kod frisa.

entries.english: The total amount of heat that a refrigerator or freezer can remove from its contents is called the cooling capacity.
entries.translation: Kar rom duto mar liet ma frij kata frisa nyalogolo eiye idendo ni nyalo mar kweyo gikmoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The cooling capacity is measured in British thermal units (BTUs) per hour.
entries.translation: Nyalo mar kweyo gikmoko ipimo gi gino miluongo ni British thermal units (BTU) kuom thuolo mar saa.

entries.english: Refrigerators and freezers are typically rated by their total cooling capacity.

entries.english: The history of Burkina Faso is long and complex, but one of the most important events in the country's history was the 1983 coup d'état that brought Thomas Sankara to power.
entries.translation: Sigana mar piny Burkina Faso bor kendo ogajore, kata kamano achiel kuom gigo madongo e sigand pinyno ne en loko loch mane otimore 1983 kama Thomas Sankara nokawe loch.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sankara was a young military officer who was deeply committed to social justice and economic development.
entries.translation: Sankara ne en jalweny mapod tin mane en jakedo maduong' ne weche mag ratich oganda kod dongruok mar ochumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He quickly implemented a series of radical reforms, including nationalizing banks and industry, redistributing land, and promoting women's rights.
entries.translation: Mapiyo, noketo e tim moko kuom lokruoge madongo, koriwo keto bengi kod kembe e lwet sirikal, pogo kendo lope kod kedo ne ratiro mag jomamine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sankara's policies were popular with many Burkinabés, but they also alienated powerful interests, both within the country and abroad.
entries.translation: Thoth jo Burkinabés magin oganda piny Burkina Faso norwako lokruoge mag Sankara, kata kamano negipogore e weche dwaro loch, ei piny gi nyaka e pinje mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1987, Sankara was assassinated in a coup d'état led by Blaise Compaoré.
entries.translation: E higa 1987, Sankara nonegi e loko loch mane otelne gi Blaise Compaoré.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Compaoré ruled Burkina Faso for 27 years, during which time he reversed many of Sankara's reforms and established a repressive authoritarian regime.
entries.translation: Compaoré notelo ne piny Burkina Faso kuom higni 27, e thuolo mane ogwenyo lokruoge mane Sankara okelo kendo noketo loch mar agoko manethiro oganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2014, Compaoré was overthrown in a popular uprising, and Burkina Faso is currently in a fragile state of transition.
entries.translation: E higa 2014, Compaoré ne othul oko e telo e tulo mane oyudo huma, kendo Burkina Faso kuom sani en piny ma lokruok mar loch mare ng'au ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the challenges it faces, Burkina Faso has a long history of resilience and progress.
entries.translation: Kata obedo ni gikalo e weche mapek, Burkina Faso nigi sigana mabor mar dhil kod dongruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country has a rich culture and a strong sense of national identity.
entries.translation: Piny no ni kod kido kod timbe mogundho kendo giyangore motegno kaka oganda piny achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Burkinabés are a proud people who are determined to build a better future for themselves and their children.
entries.translation: Oganda ma piny Burkina Faso gin jogo man kod nyadhi kendo ni kod mahino mar loso kinde mabiro margi kod nyithindgi obed makare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the sun began to set, a young boy named Raman made his way home from school.

entries.english: As he walked, he noticed a stray dog following him.
entries.translation: Seche mane owuotho, nofuenyo ni guok moro mane olal ne luwe.

entries.english: The dog was dirty and skinny, but it had a friendly face.

entries.english: Raman felt sorry for the dog, so he decided to take it home with him.

entries.english: When Raman got home, he told his parents about the dog.

entries.english: They were hesitant at first, but they eventually agreed to let him keep the dog.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raman named the dog Buddy, and they quickly became best friends.

entries.english: Buddy was always there for Raman, no matter what.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was there to greet him at the door when he came home from school, and he was there to comfort him when he was feeling down.
entries.translation: Norite e dhot mar rwake pacho koduogo kowuok sikul, kendo nojamiye jipo e seche ma nokowinj maber.

entries.english: One day, Raman was playing in the park when he fell and scraped his knee.

entries.english: He started to cry, and Buddy came running over to lick his wound.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog's gentle tongue helped to soothe Raman's pain, and he soon forgot all about his injury.

entries.english: Raman and Buddy shared many happy years together.

entries.english: They went on walks, played fetch in the park, and cuddled up on the couch together.
