entries.english: The sci-fi movie industry has been on a downward slide in recent years, with fewer and fewer films being produced.
entries.translation: Sekta mar vidio mag weche mothuogi osebedo kadok piny e higni matin mokalo, ka filim mana matin ema iloso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of reasons for this decline, including the rise of superhero movies and the increasing popularity of streaming services.
entries.translation: Nitie weche mathoth momiyo dok chien ni nobedo, koriwo medruok e vidio mag superhero kod medruok e huma mar yore mag nyiso vidio achiel kachiel kowuok e mbui.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Superhero movies have become increasingly popular in recent years, thanks to the success of franchises like the Marvel Cinematic Universe and the DC Extended Universe.
entries.translation: Vidio mag Superhero osebedo ka huma margi medore e higni matin mokalo, kaluwore gi timo maber mar ohelni machalo kaka Marvel Cinematic Universe kod DC Extended Universe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These films offer audiences a mix of action, adventure, and spectacle that is often lacking in sci-fi films.
entries.translation: Vidio gi miyo joneno ndhadhu mar dhao, neno gik manyien kod tipo maber ma pile okyudre e vidio mag weche mothuogi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Streaming services have also had a negative impact on the sci-fi movie industry.
entries.translation: Yore mag nyiso video achiel kachiel kowuok e mbui bende oseduoko piny sekta mar vidio mag weche mothuogi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These services offer a wide variety of content, including sci-fi films, at a relatively low cost.
entries.translation: Yore gi ni kod thuond weche mathoth, koriwo vidio mothuogi, e nengo mapiny kopim gi yore mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes it more difficult for sci-fi films to compete in theaters, where they are often priced at a premium.
entries.translation: Mae miyo vidio mothuogi bedo gi pek e piem kuonde minyisoe tuke, kama ojanyisgie e chudo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these factors, the sci-fi movie industry is in need of a major shake-up.
entries.translation: Kaluwore gi weche gi, dwaro nitie mar timo lokruoge madongo e sekta mar vidio mothuogi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Imagine being able to enjoy your life without the constant fear of these debilitating conditions.

entries.english: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are a common problem, especially for women.
entries.translation: Twoche mag yor oko matin (UTI) gin midhiero mathoth, ahinya ne jomamine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can cause a variety of symptoms, including pain, burning, and frequent urination.
entries.translation: Ginyalo kelo ranyisi mopogore opogore, koriwo rem, wang' kata dhi oko matin kinde ka kinde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, UTIs can lead to more serious problems, such as kidney infections.
entries.translation: Seche moko, UTI nyalo kelo midhiero madongo ahinya, kaka twoche mag nyarogno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bladder stones are another common problem.
entries.translation: Kite mag dag lach gin midhiero machielo mathoth ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can cause pain, difficulty urinating, and blood in the urine.
entries.translation: Ginyalo kelo rem, pek eyor dhi oko matin, kod remo e lach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, bladder stones can block the urethra, which can lead to a life-threatening emergency.
entries.translation: Seche moko, kite mag dag lach nyalo dino yor lach, manyalo miyo ibed gi midhiero mabuogo ngima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kidney diseases are a serious problem that can affect people of all ages.

entries.english: They can cause a variety of symptoms, including fatigue, nausea, and vomiting.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, kidney diseases can lead to kidney failure, which is a fatal condition.
entries.translation: Seche moko, twoche mag nyarogno nyalo miyo nyarogno tamre tiyo, ma en hali marach ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are suffering from any of these conditions, there is help available.

entries.english: There are a variety of treatments available for UTIs, bladder stones, and kidney diseases.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With proper treatment, you can get relief from your symptoms and prevent further complications.

entries.english: Don't let these conditions control your life.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the item is returned by post, the customer must return the item within 14 days of purchase and the item must be in the same condition as it was when it was purchased.
entries.translation: Ka mwandu oduoki kokalo e posta, nyaka janyiewo duok mwanduno ei ndalo 14 bang' nyiewo kendo mwandu nyako bedi ni nitie e hali machal gi mane entie e seche mane inyiewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The customer will then be sent a refund or exchange.
entries.translation: Bang'e to ibiro orne janyiewo pesa kata wilo ne mwandu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The customer is responsible for the cost of returning the item.
entries.translation: Janyiewo biro chung' ne garama mar duoko mwandu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For more information, please contact the market stall manager.
entries.translation: Mondo iyud weche mathoth, wakwayi ni itudri gi maneja mar kar uso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Therapist: So, you're here because you're having some conflict with your roommate.
entries.translation: Jahocho: Koro, ibiro kae nichek in kod tungni e kindi gi jalno midak godo e ot achiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Client: Yeah, it's been really tough. We're just not getting along.
entries.translation: Jamany thieth: Kamano, osebedo matek ahinya. Ok wawinjre kata matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Therapist: Can you tell me a little bit more about what's been going on?
entries.translation: Jahocho: Bende inyalo miya ler matin kuom gino mosebedo kadhi nyime?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Client: Well, it started a few months ago when she started taking medication for her anxiety.
entries.translation: Jamany thieth: Eh, nochakore dweche matin mokalo kane ochako mwonyo yedhene mag duoko piny kihondko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's like a switch flipped.
entries.translation: Nyalobedo ni swich moro noloki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's become really irritable and short-tempered.
entries.translation: Olokore mobedo jalno ma chwanyruok mare yot kendo iye wang' piyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's snapping at me all the time, and it's starting to take a toll on our relationship.
entries.translation: Osebedo kowuoyo koda marach seche duto, kendo gino koro osechako rocho ng'iyo marwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Therapist: It sounds like this is a really difficult situation for you.
entries.translation: Jahocho: Awinjo ka mae en midhiero matek ahinya kuomi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Client: It is. I don't know what to do.
entries.translation: Jamany chieth: En kamano. Okang'eyo gino manyalo timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've tried talking to her about it, but she just gets defensive and says that I'm not being understanding.
entries.translation: Asetemo loso kode ewi wachno, kata kamano en okoyie richo kendo owacho ni an ok akaw weche gi pek mowinjore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Therapist: It's understandable that you're feeling frustrated.
entries.translation: Jahocho: En gimawinjore ni iwinjo ka wachni ogoyo chunyi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not easy to be on the receiving end of someone's anger.
entries.translation: Ok en gimayot ka ng'ato keto kuomi ich wang' mare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Christianity is a religion based on the life and teachings of Jesus Christ.
entries.translation: Din mar Kristo en din moyiengore e ngima kod puonj mag Yeso Kristo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is one of the world's major religions, with over 2 billion followers.
entries.translation: En achiel kuom din madongo e piny mangima, ka en gi oganda bilion 2 maluwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Christians believe that Jesus is the Son of God and that he came to earth to save people from their sins.
entries.translation: Jokristo nigi yie ni Yeso e Wuod Nyasaye kendo nobiro e piny mar waro oganda e richo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also believe that he rose from the dead and ascended into heaven.
entries.translation: Bende gin kod yie ni nochier kowuok kuom jomotho kendo dhi e polo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The importance of love for Jesus is central to Christianity.
entries.translation: Duong' mar hera mar Yeso en mise mongirore e ngima Jokristo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Christians are called to love God with all their heart, soul, mind, and strength.
entries.translation: Jokristo idwaro ni mondo oher Nyasaye gi chuny gi, ropgi, pach gi kod teko gi duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also called to love their neighbors as themselves.
entries.translation: Bende idwaro ni mondo giher jolibamba gi kaka giherore giwegi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This love is not just a feeling, but a way of life.
entries.translation: Hera ni oken mana kaka ng'ato winjo, kata kamano en yor ngima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is expressed through acts of kindness, compassion, and forgiveness.
entries.translation: Inyise kokalo kuom timbe machalo kaka bedo mang'uon, neno oruma kod ng'uono ne jogo matimo negi marach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we love Jesus, we are not only showing our love for him, but we are also showing our love for God.
entries.translation: Ka wahero Yeso, koweyo nyiso hera ma wangodo kuome, bende wanyiso hera marwa ne Nyasaye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because Jesus is the perfect expression of God's love for us.
entries.translation: Mae en kamano nikech Yeso e ranyisi maber mar hera ma Nyasaye nigodo kuomwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we love Jesus, we are opening ourselves up to receive God's love into our hearts.
entries.translation: Ka wahero Yeso, wabedo e thuolo maber mar rwako hera mar Nyasaye e chunywa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The love of Jesus is a powerful force that can transform our lives.
entries.translation: Hera mar Yeso en teko mapek ahinya manyalo loko ngima marwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can give us hope, strength, and peace.
entries.translation: Onyalomiwa geno, teko kod kwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can help us to forgive others and to love ourselves.
entries.translation: Onyalo konyowa ng'uono ne jomoko kendo waherre wawegi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young boy visited a museum with his parents.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro achiel, ojana moro matin netimo limbe e miusiam kachiel gi jonyuolne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was amazed by all the different things he saw, from ancient artifacts to modern art.
entries.translation: Ne owuoro ahinya gigo mopogore mane oneno, chakre kit chwech machon nyaka chwech ma nyasani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He especially loved the dinosaur exhibit, and he could have spent hours just looking at the skeletons and fossils.
entries.translation: Nohero kar nyiso le mar dinoso ahinya, kendo nonyalo kawo thuolo mar seche mathoth mana ka orango skeleton kod choke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As he was admiring a particularly large dinosaur skull, he heard a voice behind him. "That's a Tyrannosaurus rex," the voice said.
entries.translation: Skeleton moro maduong' mar dinoso nomako wang'e ahinya, nowinjo duol moro bang'e. "Mano iluongo ni Tyrannosaurus rex," duol no nowacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It was one of the largest and most fearsome predators to ever walk the Earth."
entries.translation: "En achiel kuom le mane duong' ahinya kendo mane oluor mogik mosedak e Piny."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy turned around and saw a man standing next to him.
entries.translation: Wuoyi no nolokore kendo noneno dichwo moro kochung' e bathe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was tall and thin, with a long beard and a kind face. "Are you a paleontologist?" the boy asked.
entries.translation: Norabora to orandere, gi yiege tik mabocho to noneno mamuol. "In jalony e weche mag choke machon?" wuoyi no nopenjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, I am," the man said. "I've been studying dinosaurs for many years."
entries.translation: "Kamano, mano e tija," dichwo no nowacho. "Asebedo kasomo dinoso kuom higni mathoth."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy was excited to meet a real paleontologist, and he asked him many questions about dinosaurs.
entries.translation: Wuoyi ni nemor mar rado gi jalony adier mar weche choke machon, kendo nopenje penjo mathoth kuom dinoso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man answered all of his questions patiently, and the boy learned a lot about these fascinating creatures.
entries.translation: Jalno nodwoko penjo mage kuom horruok, kendo wuoyi no nopuonjore mathoth kuom le ma sigand gi mako dhok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a while, the boy's parents called him over, and he said goodbye to the paleontologist.
entries.translation: Bang' kinde machuok, jonyuol wuoyi no noluonge mondo odhi, kendo nogone jalonyno oriti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom: A Personal Perspective
entries.translation: Bedo thuolo: Kaka Anene Awuon
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom is a word that has been used and abused by so many people, in so many contexts, that it has almost lost its meaning.
entries.translation: Bedo thuolo en wach ma inyalotigodo maber kendo inyalotigodo marach gi oganda mathoth, e yore mathoth, omiyo ochopo kama tiende odwalal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But for me, freedom is a very simple thing.
entries.translation: To kuoma, bedo thuolo en gino mayot ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the ability to live my life on my own terms, without being controlled or oppressed by others.
entries.translation: En kaka anyalo dago ngima mara kaka an emadwaro, maonge achune kata thir gi ji mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was born into a time and place where women were not considered to be fully equal to men.
entries.translation: Nonyuola e kinde kod kamoro ma jomamine nokokaw kaka jogo marom chutho gi jomachwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were expected to stay at home, raise children, and take care of our husbands.
entries.translation: Nidwaro ni wadong' e pacho, wapidh nyithindo kendo warit chwowa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I never wanted to live that kind of life.
entries.translation: Kata kamano nokadwa dago ngima machal kamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I wanted to be free to pursue my own dreams, to learn and grow, and to make a difference in the world.
entries.translation: Nadwani abed thuolo mar luwo lek maga awuon, puonjora kendo dongora, kendo timo gimoro mopogore e piny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was fortunate to have parents who supported my ambitions.
entries.translation: Ne an jahawi kuom yudo jonyuol mane oriwo lwedo lek maga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They encouraged me to go to college, to get a job, and to live my life on my own terms.
entries.translation: Negijiwa mondo adhi e kolej, ayud tich, kendo adag ngima mana kaka an ema adwaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And I am grateful for the opportunities that I have had to travel, to meet new people, and to learn about different cultures.
entries.translation: Aduoko erokamano ne thuolo mane ayudo mag dhi limbe, romo gi ji manyien kendo puonjruok kido kod timbe mopogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I know that not everyone is as lucky as I was.
entries.translation: Kata kamano ang'eyo ni ok gin ji duto man gi hawi kaka ne angodo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are still many people in the world who are denied their freedom, simply because of their race, their gender, or their religion.
entries.translation: Pod nitie oganda mathoth e piny ma otuon thuolo margi, mana nikech kit chal mar pien dendgi, kit chwech margi kata yor din margi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A hospital is a healthcare institution providing patient treatment in an inpatient setting.
entries.translation: Osiptal en kar thieth mamiyo jotwo thieth bang' rwako gi e wod.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inpatient care is provided by hospital inpatient departments, emergency departments and outpatient clinics.
entries.translation: Osiptende man kod kidieny mar rwako jotwo e wod, kidienje mag weche mapore kod klinik mag jogo mithiedho to dok pacho ema chiwo thieth mag rweko e wod.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hospitals are usually staffed by professional and registered nurses, physicians, and other health professionals.
entries.translation: Osiptende bedo ga gi jolony kod nases, lakteche kod jolony mamoko mag yore thieth machik oyango.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A hospital can also include a number of support departments, such as medical records, pharmacy, laboratory, radiology, and rehabilitation.
entries.translation: Osiptal bende nyalo bedo gi kidienje mamoko mag kony, kaka kidieny mar rekod mag thieth, od yath, laboratori, radioloji kod kar loko tim.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hospitals are often classified by the type of care they provide, such as general hospitals, specialty hospitals, and psychiatric hospitals.
entries.translation: Osiptende ojaketi e kidienje kaluwore gi kit thieth ma gichiwo, kaka osiptende madongo, osiptende makende kod osiptende mag thieth mag obuongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: General hospitals provide a wide range of services, including medical, surgical, obstetrical, and pediatric care.
entries.translation: Osiptende madongo chiwo yore mathoth mag thieth, koriwo thieth mag twoche duto, bero, thieth mag jomamine mayach kod thieth mag nyithindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Specialty hospitals focus on a particular type of care, such as cancer care, cardiac care, or orthopedic care.
entries.translation: Osiptende makende rango mana kit thieth achiel, kaka thieth mag kansa, thieth mag twoche adundo kod thieth mag choke mag del.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Psychiatric hospitals provide care for people with mental illness.
entries.translation: Osiptende mag obuongo chiwo thieth ne oganda man kod twoche mag wich malokore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hospitals are an important part of the healthcare system.
entries.translation: Osiptende gin mise madongo e sistem mangima mar chiwo thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They provide care for a variety of illnesses and injuries, and they play a vital role in the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of disease.
entries.translation: Gichiwo thieth ne twoche kod hinyruoge mopogore opogore, kendo gikawo thuolo maduong' e geng'o, pimo kod thiedho twoche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hospitals also provide education and training for healthcare professionals, and they conduct research to improve the quality of care.
entries.translation: Osiptende bende chiwo puonj kod tiegruok ne jolony e yore mag thieth, kendo gitimo nonro mar bero rang'iny mar thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The history of hospitals dates back to ancient times.
entries.translation: Sigana mar osiptende nochakore e kinde machon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first hospitals were established in India, China, and Greece.
entries.translation: Osiptende mokwongo noger e piny India, China kod Greece.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the Middle Ages, hospitals were often run by religious organizations.
entries.translation: E Higni Madiere, osiptende nejabedo ebwo riwruoge mag dinde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first time I tried embroidery, I was determined to make a small, intricate design.
entries.translation: Kane akwongo temo twang'o lewni, na aketo mahino mar loso disain matin mondisore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I chose a pattern with lots of tiny stitches, and I started working on it with great enthusiasm.
entries.translation: Nayiero patan man kod tweng'o mathoth matindo tindo, kendo nachako lose gi ilo maduong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, after a few hours, I realized that I was making a mistake.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, bang' seche machuok, nafwenyo ni natimo marach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The stitches were too small and tight, and my hand was cramping up.
entries.translation: Natwang'o matindo kendo moridore matek ahinya kendo lweta netho kalandhidhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I decided to put the project aside and try something else.
entries.translation: Nang'ado mar keto chenro no thenge kendo temo gimachielo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next time I tried embroidery, I chose a larger pattern with looser stitches.
entries.translation: Kane atemo kendo tweng'o, nayiero patan madongo man gi tweng'o mogonyore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This made a big difference!
entries.translation: Mae nokelo pogruok maduong'!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was able to work on the project for longer periods of time without getting tired, and the stitches were easier to make.
entries.translation: Nanyalo tiyo e projekt no kuom thuolo malach ma ok aol, kendo neyot ahinya mar riwo usi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was also able to create a more beautiful result.
entries.translation: Bende nanyalo loso tweng'o mane neno mondisore ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're new to embroidery, I recommend starting with a larger pattern with looser stitches.
entries.translation: Ka iwendo e twang'o lewni, arwayi ni ichaki gi patan madongo gi tweng'o mogonyore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will make it easier to learn the basic stitches and techniques.
entries.translation: Mae biro keto yot e puonjruok yore mokwongo mochuno mag tweng'o.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you've mastered the basics, you can start experimenting with smaller patterns and tighter stitches.
entries.translation: Ka isemako weche mochuno mokwongo, inyalotimo tiegruok gi patande matindo tindo kod usi moridore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The capital and largest city in Malawi is Lilongwe.
entries.translation: Boma maduong' kendo malach mogik e piny Malawi en Lilongwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malawi is a diverse country with a rich culture and history.
entries.translation: Malawi en piny malach kendo ni kod sigana kod kido gi timbe mathoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most important places in Malawi include Lake Malawi, the Shire River, and the Nyika Plateau.
entries.translation: Moko kuom kuonde madongo ahinya e piny Malawi oriwo Lake Malawi, Shire River kod Nyika Plateau.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lake Malawi is the third-largest lake in Africa and is home to a wide variety of fish and other wildlife.
entries.translation: Lake Malawi e nam mar adek kuom duong' e Afrika kendo en kod kit rech mathoth mopogore kachiel gi le mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Shire River is a major tributary of the Zambezi River and is an important source of water for irrigation and transportation.
entries.translation: Shire River en achiel kuom aoche madongo maolo pi ei Zambezi River kendo en yorno maduong' mar pi miolo e puothe to kod yor wuoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Nyika Plateau is a highland region in northern Malawi and is home to a variety of wildlife, including elephants, lions, and leopards.
entries.translation: Nyika Plateau nitie ewi got nyandwat mar Malawi kendo en pacho ne kit le mathoth, koriwo liech, sibuoche kod kweje.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most important historical figures in Malawi include David Livingstone, John Chilembwe, and Hastings Kamuzu Banda.
entries.translation: Moko kuom jogo mahumbgi lach e sigand Malawi oriwo David Livingstone, John Chilembwe kod Hastings Kamuzu Banda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Livingstone was a Scottish missionary and explorer who was instrumental in the abolition of the slave trade in Africa.
entries.translation: Livingstone ne en jamisenar manewuok e piny Scotland kendo janeno gik manyien mane nie thuolo manyime e kwedo ohand dhano e Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chilembwe was a Malawian Baptist minister who led an uprising against British colonial rule in 1915.
entries.translation: Chilembwe ne en jayalo mar din Baptist ma Malawi mane otelo ne ng'anyo mar kwedo tend jowagunda ma Ingeresa e higa 1915.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Banda was the first president of Malawi and ruled the country from 1964 to 1994.
entries.translation: Banda ema ne en ker mokwongo mar Malawi kendo notelo ne pinyno chakre 1964 nyaka 1994.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Golden Temple, a shimmering monument to human vanity and folly, stands as a testament to the destructive power of desire.
entries.translation: The Golden Temple, ma en ot marieny manyiso richo kod fuwo mar dhano, ochung' kanyiso teko mar kethruok mikelo gi gombo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a place where dreams are made and broken, where hopes are raised and dashed, and where love and hate, life and death, are all inextricably intertwined.
entries.translation: En kama lek bedoe to okchop kare, geno bedo malo kendo chako dok piny, kendo kama hera gi sigu, ngima gi tho, gin weche madutore mapek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The temple was built by a wealthy maharaja who wanted to create a place where he could worship his god in peace.
entries.translation: Od lamo ni noger gi jamwandu ma maharaja manedwaro ni oket kama nonyalo lamoe nyasache gi kwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the temple quickly became a magnet for pilgrims from all over the world, and it soon became a place of commerce and trade.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, od lamoni mapiyo nolokore kendo yuayo jogo mane dhi safar mag kuonde lamo maboyo kowuok kuonde duto e piny magima, kendo nobedo kar loko ohala bang' ndalo matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The maharaja's dream of a peaceful place of worship was quickly shattered, and the temple became a place of greed, corruption, and violence.
entries.translation: Lek mar maharaja mar keto kamoro mokwe mar lamo nokochopo kare, kendo kar lamo ni nobedo kar wuoro, mibadhi kod tulo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young man named Amritsar arrived at the temple.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro achiel, jal moro matin manyinge Amritsar nochopo e kar lamo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a simple man with a simple dream: to find peace and happiness.
entries.translation: Ne en jal ma nokodewo weche mathoth mane ni kod lek mare: mar manyo kwe gi mor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, Amritsar soon found that the temple was no place for peace.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, Amritsar nofwenyo mapiyo ni kar lamo ni noken kar kwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was drawn into the vortex of greed and corruption, and he eventually lost everything he had.
entries.translation: Noyudore e gogo mar wuoro kod mibadhi, kendo giko ne olalo gimoro amora mane en godo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Amritsar's story is a cautionary tale about the dangers of desire.
entries.translation: Sigand Amritsar en sigana mar miwa siem kuom rach mar bedo gi gombo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a reminder that the things we crave most may not be what is best for us.
entries.translation: Oparonwa ni gigo ma wagombo ahinya seche moko okgin gigo mabeyo kodwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hey there, how's it going?
entries.translation: Amosi, idhi nade?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm just your friendly neighborhood Uber driver, here to take you wherever you need to go.
entries.translation: An jalimbamba moheri ma en dereba mar Uber, an kae mar teri kamoro amora ma idwa dhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, where are we headed today?
entries.translation: Koro, wachomo kanye kawuono?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm glad you asked about integrity.
entries.translation: Amor ni ipenjo wach ewi bidhruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's one of the most important things in life, in my opinion.
entries.translation: En achiel kuom gigo madongo ahinya e ngima, gi pacha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's all about doing the right thing, even when it's hard.
entries.translation: Tiende ni nyaka watim gigo makare, kata ka otek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It means being honest, trustworthy, and ethical.
entries.translation: Tiende ni nyaka ibed ja adieri, ng'ano ma yiego yot kendo mobidhore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I think integrity is so important because it helps us build trust with others.
entries.translation: Aparoni bidhruok en gimaduong' ahinya nikech omiyo jomamoko yie kodi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When people know that we're honest and trustworthy, they're more likely to open up to us and share their thoughts and feelings.
entries.translation: Ka oganda ong'eyo ni wan jo adieri kendo yie kodwa yot, ginyalobedo thuolo kodwa kendo nyisowa pachgi kod kaka giwinjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: That can make for a richer and more fulfilling life.
entries.translation: Mano nyalo kelo ngima makare kendo mamoro chuny ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, it's not always easy to do the right thing.
entries.translation: En adier ni, oken gimayot mar timo gikmoko kare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sometimes, we might be tempted to lie or cheat in order to get ahead.
entries.translation: Seche moko, wabedo e tem mar riambo kata badhruok mondo wakal mayot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But if we want to live a life of integrity, we have to be willing to stand up for what we believe in, even when it's difficult.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, kawadwaro ngima mar bidhruok, nyaka wayie chung' gi gino ma wayiego, kata ka otek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know that integrity is something that you value, too.
entries.translation: Ang'eyo ni bidhruok en gino ma in bende imiyo pek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: That's why I'm so glad you're my passenger today.
entries.translation: Mano emomiyo an gi mor ni in jawuoth mara kawuono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fufu is a starchy, doughy food made from pounded plantains or cassava.
entries.translation: Fufu en kit chiemo makuot kendo ni kod nyinyo mar stach miloso gi rabolo kata mwogo moyoki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a staple food in many West African countries, and is often served with soups or stews.
entries.translation: En chiemo maduong' e pinje ma Afrika ma Ugwe, kendo itoke kachiel gi kado kata gimichame godo e bathe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fufu is typically made by pounding the plantains or cassava in a large mortar and pestle until they are smooth and pasty.
entries.translation: Fufu ojalosi ka iyoko rabolo kata mwogo ei pany maduong' nyaka obed mayom kendo mayware.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The resulting fufu is then shaped into balls or logs and served.
entries.translation: Kendo fufu mowuok iketo bedo machal opiche kata yiende kendo itoko gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fufu is a very filling food, and it is often eaten as a main course.
entries.translation: Fufu en chiemo mayieng'o ji ahinya, kendo ojachame kaka chiemo maduong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a good source of carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals.
entries.translation: Bende okelo nyinyo mag kabohaidret, vitamin kod minerol e del.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fufu is a traditional food that has been eaten in West Africa for hundreds of years.
entries.translation: Fufu en chiemo ma nyadala ma osecham e Afrika ma Ugwe kuom higni miche gi miche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a part of the culture and identity of many West African societies.
entries.translation: En achiel kuom kido gi timbe kod yangruok mar oganda mathoth mag Afrika ma Ugwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person A: There is a lack of originality in the perfume and fragrance industry. The perfumes all smell the same, and they don't really say anything about me.
entries.translation: Ngato A: Sekta mar loso pafium mang'we mamit tinde oklosi gikmoko morijinol. Pafium duto ng'we machal kendo onge gima giwacho malich kuoma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person B: I know what you mean. I've been looking for a unique perfume that will make me stand out from the crowd, but I haven't had any luck.
entries.translation: Ng'ato B: Ang'eyo gimiwacho. Asebedo kamanyo pafium makende mabiro miyo abedo makende ekind oganda, to otama yudo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person A: I think we should start our own perfume company. We could create fragrances that are truly original and that reflect our personality.
entries.translation: Ng'ato A: Apani owinjore wayaw kambi marwa wawegi mar pafium. Wanyalo loso pafium ma orijinol kendo manyiso kitwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person B: That's a great idea! I'm so excited to get started.
entries.translation: Ng'ato B: Mano paro mopuch ahinya! An adwani mondo wachake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person A: We could call it "Back to Australia". It would be a tribute to our home country and a celebration of our unique scents.
entries.translation: Ng'ato A: Wanyalo miye nying mar "Back to Australia". Onyalobedo rapar ne piny mane onyuolwae kendo hingo godo suya magwa makende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person B: I love it! I can't wait to start creating fragrances that will make Australia proud.
entries.translation: Ng'ato B: Idimbe! Daher mar chako loso pafium mabiro miyo piny Australia bedo gi nyadhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Suez Canal was a major engineering feat that connected the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea.
entries.translation: Suez Canal ne en tij apida mane otudo Nam Ataro mar Mediterranean kod Nam Makwar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was built by the French and opened in 1869.
entries.translation: Nogere gi Jofaransa kendo noyawe e higa 1869.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The canal was a vital trade route for Egypt and the rest of the world.
entries.translation: Yorno ne en yo maduong' mar ohala ne Misri kod piny mangima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also allowed for the movement of troops and supplies, which was important during wartime.
entries.translation: Bende noyawo yo ne jolweny gi gige lweny, mae nokonyo e kinde mag lweny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1956, Egypt nationalized the Suez Canal, which led to the Suez Crisis.
entries.translation: E higa 1956, Misri noketo Suez Canal obedo e lwet sirikal, gino mane okelo Midhiero mar Suez.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The crisis was a major international incident that was eventually resolved through a United Nations peacekeeping force.
entries.translation: Midhiero no ne en midhiero maduong' mar piny mangima ma gikone nolosi kokalo kuom jolweny mag arita kwe mag Riwruok mar Piny Mangima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Suez Canal is still a vital trade route today and is one of the most important waterways in the world.
entries.translation: Suez Canal pod en yo maduong' mar ohala kawuono kendo en achiel kuom yore mag pi madongo e piny mangima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a young man named Rajiv who lived in a small village.
entries.translation: Chon gi lala, ne nitie ojana moro mane nyinge Rajiv mane odak e gweng' matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a poor man, and he and his mother often went hungry.
entries.translation: Ne en jachan, kendo en kachiel gi min mare ne githoro nindo kech.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Rajiv decided to go into the forest to find some food.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro, Rajiv nong'ado wach ni odhi ei bungu mondo omanyie chiemo moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As he was walking through the forest, Rajiv came across a strange tree.
entries.translation: Kane owuotho ei bungu no, Rajiv noneno yien moro mawendo e wang'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The tree was covered in golden apples, and Rajiv had never seen anything like it before.
entries.translation: Yien no neni kod olemo mag mula, kendo Rajiv nepok oneno gimachalo kamano nyaka nene.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He reached up to pick an apple, but as soon as he touched it, the tree spoke to him.
entries.translation: Ne ong'adore mar mondo opon olemo, to kaka ne lwete ochopo momako olemo no, yien noloso kode.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Do not touch my apples," the tree said. "They are not for you."
entries.translation: "Kik imul olemo maga," yien no nowacho. "Nikech ok gi magi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But Rajiv was hungry, and he didn't listen to the tree.
entries.translation: Kata kamano Rajiv ne ni kech kendo nokochiko ite ne gima yien newacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He picked an apple and took a bite.
entries.translation: Nopono olemo kendo nokayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As soon as he did, he felt a strange change come over him.
entries.translation: Kaka nokaye, nowinjo ka en gi pogruok magalagala e dende duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He felt stronger and more powerful, and he knew that he had done something wrong.
entries.translation: Nowinjo ka otegno kendo ne en gi teko mathoth moloyo, kendo nong'eyo ni notimo gimoro mokber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I am the Golden Apple Tree," the tree said. "And now that you have eaten my apple, you will be cursed.
entries.translation: "Anie Yien Mar Olemo mar Mula," yien no nowacho. "Kendo nikech koro isechamo olemo mara, ibiro kwong'i.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You will never be satisfied with what you have, and you will always be searching for more."
entries.translation: Gigo ma in godo ok noromi ngang', kendo ibiro bedo kimanyo moko kinde ka kinde."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And so it was.
entries.translation: Kendo nobedo kamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Open-air markets are a popular attraction in many cities and towns.
entries.translation: Chirni man e pap gin kuonde mamako wang' e bombe mathoth madongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They offer a variety of goods and services, from fresh produce to handmade crafts.
entries.translation: Gin kod mwandu gi savises mopogore opogore, chakre mwandu mowuok manyien e puothe nyaka gigo malosi gi lwet dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Visitors can find a bargain on everything from clothes to souvenirs.
entries.translation: Jolimbe nyalo mino nengo mar gimoro amora chakre lewni nyaka gi mwandu molosi gi mula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Open-air markets are also a great place to people-watch and enjoy the local culture.
entries.translation: Chirni gi bende gin kuonde mabeyo ma ji nenoe kendo yudo mor kokalo kuom kido gi timbe mag oganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the best things about open-air markets is the atmosphere.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gigo mabeyo ahinya kuom chirni manie pap en luasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They're usually bustling with activity, and there's always something to see and do.
entries.translation: Gik mathoth timore eiye, kendo kinde duto nitie gino minyalo neno kendo timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You'll hear the sound of vendors calling out to customers, the smell of fresh-baked bread and pastries, and the sight of people haggling over prices.
entries.translation: Ibirowinjo duond jouso kaluongo jonyiewo, suya mar makate mitendo kendo neno oganda matimo winjruok ewi nengo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another advantage of open-air markets is the variety of goods and services available.
entries.translation: Ber machielo mar chirni manie pap en mwandu kod savises mopogore opogore mayudore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can find everything from fresh produce to handmade crafts.
entries.translation: Inyalo yudo gimoro amora chakre mwandu mawuok e puothe nyaka mago molosi gi lwet dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And because the vendors are independent businesses, they're often willing to negotiate prices.
entries.translation: To nikech jouso gin ohelni mochung' kar kendgi, gihikore kinde duto mar timo winjruok e nengo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So if you're looking for a bargain, an open-air market is the place to be.
entries.translation: Omiyo ka imanyo kar mino nengo, chiro manie pap en kama ber kodi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, no discussion of open-air markets would be complete without mentioning the food.
entries.translation: Bende, onge kaka wach ewi chirni maoko nyalorumo ka ok olos ewi chiemo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These markets are a great place to sample local cuisine.
entries.translation: Chirni gi gin kuonde mabeyo mag yudo chiemo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You'll find everything from grilled meats to fresh seafood to traditional desserts.
entries.translation: Ibiroyudo chiemo duto chakre ring'o mothol nyaka rech manumu moya e nam to kod chiemo ma nyachon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ambedkar was born into a Dalit family, a group of people who were considered to be untouchables in the caste system of India.
entries.translation: Ambedkar nonyuol e familia mar Dalit, kidieny mar oganda mane okaw kaka jogo mane nigiteko ahinya e sistem mar loch mar familia e piny India.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He faced discrimination and hardship throughout his life, but he never gave up on his dream of equality for all Indians.
entries.translation: Ne okaloe akwede kod pek e ngima mare duto, kata kamano chunye nokotho e lek mare mar yudo ratiro marom ne Jo India duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ambedkar was a brilliant student and went on to earn a doctorate in law from Columbia University in the United States.
entries.translation: Ambedkar ne en japuonjre maneriek ahinya kendo nomedo somo moyudo osimbo mar doktret e weche mag chike kowuok e Mbalariany mar Columbia e piny Amerka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also studied at the London School of Economics and became a barrister.
entries.translation: Bende nosomo London School of Economics kendo bedo okil.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After returning to India, Ambedkar became a leading figure in the Indian independence movement.
entries.translation: Bang' dok India, Ambedkar nobedo jalno mane ni nyime e kedo ne ouru mar piny India.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a member of the Indian National Congress, but he eventually broke away from the party and formed his own political organization, the Scheduled Castes Federation.
entries.translation: Ne en jakanyo mar chama mar Indian National Congress, kata kamano ne obarore moweyo chama no kendo loso riwruok mare owuon mar siasa, Scheduled Castes Federation.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ambedkar was also a key figure in the drafting of the Constitution of India.
entries.translation: Ambedkar bende ne oketo mahino e ndiko Katiba mar piny India.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animal cruelty is the intentional infliction of pain, suffering, or death upon an animal.
entries.translation: Mahundu mitimo ne le en tim ma ng'ato keto godo rem, sand kata nego le kong'eyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can take many forms, from physical abuse to neglect.
entries.translation: Inyalotime e yore mathoth, chakre sand mimiye mag del kata bol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animals may be beaten, kicked, burned, starved, or even killed for no reason other than human entertainment.
entries.translation: Le inyalo go, gwe, wang', tuon chiemo kata negi maonge gimomiyo makmana mar moro dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animal cruelty is a serious problem that affects millions of animals every year.
entries.translation: Mahundu mitimo ne le en midhiero maduong' mamako milionde mag le higa ka higa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is illegal in most countries, but enforcement is often lax.
entries.translation: En ataro mar chik e thoth pinje, kata kamano chikne okotegno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many organizations that work to prevent and stop animal cruelty, but more needs to be done.
entries.translation: Nitie riwruoge mathoth matiyo mar neno ni mahundu mitimo ne le orumo, kata kamano pod nitie mathoth mowinjore otim.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can all help to stop animal cruelty by being more aware of the issue and by speaking out against it.
entries.translation: Waduto wanyalo konyo mar tieko tim mar mahundu mitimo ne le kuom bedo gi ng'eyo ewi wachno kendo golo duol mager mar kwedo timno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also choose to buy from businesses that do not support animal cruelty and to support organizations that work to protect animals.
entries.translation: Bende wanyalo yiero mar nyiepo kuom ohelni ma okriw lwedo mahundu mitimo ne le kendo riwo lwedo riwruoge matemo mar rito le.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animal cruelty is a terrible thing that happens every day.
entries.translation: Mahundu mitimo ne le en gino marach chutho matimore pile ka pile.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can all help to make a difference by speaking out against it and by supporting organizations that work to stop it.
entries.translation: Waduto wanyalo konyo kelo lokruok kuom kwedo timno kendo riwo lwedo riwruoge matiyo mar thiro timno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because the average age of a woman's first menstrual period is 12 years old, and the average age of menopause is 45 years old.
entries.translation: Mae en kamano nikech higa mantie ediere mar neno malo mar ng'at mamiyo en higni 12, to higa mantie ediere mar wuoke ria en higni 45.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that a woman has approximately 33 years to bear children.
entries.translation: Mae nyiso ni miyo ni kod madirom higni 33 mar nyuolo nyithindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, fertility begins to decline in a woman's mid-thirties, and by the time she is 40, her chances of conceiving naturally are significantly reduced.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, tong' mar nyodo mar ng'at mamiyo chako dok piny e dier hike mar piero adek, kendo ka ochopo higni 40, thuolo mare mar bedo mayach eyo ma aching' dok piny ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of factors that can contribute to a woman's declining fertility, including age, smoking, obesity, and certain medical conditions.
entries.translation: Nitie weche mathoth manyalo miyo tong' mar nyodo mar miyo dok piny, koriwo hike, ywayo ndawa, pek mar del kod chal mamoko mag yore thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a woman ages, her eggs become less healthy and more likely to have chromosomal abnormalities.
entries.translation: Kaka hik ng'at mamiyo medore, e kaka ngima mar tong' mage medo dok piny kendo ekaka omedo bedo gi kromosom mokodhi kare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can increase the risk of miscarriage, stillbirth, and birth defects.
entries.translation: Mae nyalo kete e thuolo mamalo mar iye wuok, nyathi tho e iye kata midhiero mag nyuol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Smoking can also damage a woman's fertility by reducing blood flow to the uterus and ovaries.
entries.translation: Ywayo ndawa bende rocho tong' mar ng'at mamiyo ka odwoko piny ringo mar remo kadhi e ofuko kod tong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Obesity can lead to hormonal imbalances that can interfere with ovulation.
entries.translation: Bedo gi del mapek nyalo miyo homon mag miyo gwenyore kendo chocho chenro mar loso tong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And certain medical conditions, such as polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and endometriosis, can also make it difficult for a woman to conceive.
entries.translation: Kod chal moko mag yore thieth, kaka polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) kod endometriosis, nyalo mono miyo bedo mapek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are a woman who is over 30 and are thinking about having children, it is important to talk to your doctor about your fertility.
entries.translation: Ka in ng'at mamiyo ma hiki okalo 30 to iparo mar manyo nyithindo, ber mondo ilos gi laktar mari ewi weche mag tong' magi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that you can do to improve your chances of conceiving, including losing weight if you are overweight or obese, quitting smoking, and getting regular exercise.
entries.translation: Nitie gigo mathoth ma inyalo timo mar bero thuolo mari mar bedo mapek, koriwo duoko piny pek mar dendi ka in kod kilo mathoth kata mokalo madwarore, weyo ywayo ndawa kod rieyo dendi kinde ka kinde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your doctor may also recommend fertility medications or other treatments to help you conceive.
entries.translation: Laktar mari bende nyalo ndikoni yedhe mag yore tong' magi kata thieth mamoko mar konyi ibed mapek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to remember that there are many other ways to have a family, even if you are unable to conceive naturally.
entries.translation: Bende ber mondo ipar ni nitie yore mamoko mathoth mag bedo gi familia, kata ka okinyal yudo nyathi eyo ma aching'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Adoption and surrogacy are two options that you may want to consider.
entries.translation: Kawo kendo pidho nyathi ng'ato kaka mari iwuon kod chulo ng'ato mondo oting' ich bang'e ikawo nyathi gin yore ariyo ma inyalo temo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With the help of modern medicine, there are many ways to have a family, no matter what your age or fertility.
entries.translation: Ka oti gi yedhe manyasani, nitie yore mathoth mag bedo gi familia, okodewo ni in gi higni adi kata tong' magi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elephants are the largest land animals on Earth and can weigh up to 15,000 pounds.
entries.translation: Liech ginie le madongo mogik e Piny kendo kilo margi dirom paund 15,000.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are herbivores and their diet consists mainly of leaves, bark, and fruit.
entries.translation: Gichamo lum kendo chiemo margi oriwo oboke, opoklo mag kor yien kod olemo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elephants have a long trunk that they use for many purposes, including drinking, bathing, and gathering food.
entries.translation: Liech ni kod um maboyo ma gitiyogodo e timo gikmoko mathoth, koriwo modho pi, lwok kod choko chiemo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also use their trunks to communicate with each other and to defend themselves from predators.
entries.translation: Bende gitiyo gi um gi mar loso gi jowetegi to kod geng'o kwinyo mag wasik gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elephants live in herds and are very social animals.
entries.translation: Liech dak e kidienje kendo gin le mohero bedo kanachiel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They form strong bonds with each other and care for their young.
entries.translation: Gibedo gi tudruok motegno gi jowete gi kendo girito nyithindgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elephants are also very intelligent animals and have been known to use tools.
entries.translation: Liech bende gin le mariek ahinya kendo ging'ere kaka le matiyo gi tulsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Unfortunately, elephants are threatened by habitat loss and poaching.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, ngima liech nitie ekind akuru gi asumbi kaluwore gi kethruok mar kuonde gi mag dak kod jonjore mapedho gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are many conservation efforts underway to protect these amazing animals.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, nitie mahino mathoth madhi nyime mag rito le gi mabeyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Up until that point, it had been a fairly standard fairy tale, with the princess living a sheltered life in her tower and the prince coming to rescue her.
entries.translation: Nyaka chop kanyo, osebedo sigana makare mag ndalo machon, ka nyar kingi odak ngima mayom ei ode to wuod kingi biro mondo orese.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But once she steps outside, the story takes on a whole new tone.
entries.translation: To ka osewuok oko, sigana no kendo lokore bedo gimoro nono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The princess is immediately confronted with a harsh and unforgiving world.
entries.translation: Nyar kingi no yudo ka piny nigi weche mager kendo mapek ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is forced to learn how to survive on her own, and she quickly discovers that she is not as helpless as she thought she was.
entries.translation: Ochune ni mondo opuonjre kaka onyalo dak kende owuon, kendo ofwenyo ni kare oken marach ahinya kaka noparo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She meets a variety of interesting characters along the way, and she learns a lot about herself and the world around her.

entries.english: The Mali Empire was a West African empire that reached its peak in the 13th and 14th centuries.

entries.english: Sundiata Keita, the founder of the Mali Empire, led his army to victory over the forces of the Ghana Empire.
entries.translation: Sundiata Keita, jalno mane ochako Loch mar piny Mali, notelo ne jolweny e loyo jolweny mag Loch piny Ghana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This victory gave Sundiata Keita control of the gold mines of the Sahel region, and helped to establish the Mali Empire as a major power in West Africa.
