entries.translation: Loch mane giyudo nomiyo Sundiata Keita obedo gi duol ewi kuonde kunyo midila mag Sahel, kendo konyo keto Loch mar piny Mali kaka loch maduong' e piny Afrika ma Ugwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important event in Mali's history was the reign of Mansa Musa.
entries.translation: Gino machielo maduong' e sigand Mali ne en loch mar Mansa Musa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mansa Musa was the third ruler of the Mali Empire, and he reigned from 1312 to 1337.
entries.translation: Mansa Musa ne en jatelo mar adek e Loch mar piny Mali kendo notelo chakre 1312 nyaka 1337.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a Google spreadsheet, an absolute reference will always refer to the same cell, regardless of where it is copied or moved to.
entries.translation: E oboke mar Google spreadsheet, namba mokloki bang kopo kata midendo ni kinde duto biro bedo e sel achiel machal, kokodewo kama okopee kata ochoree.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Absolute references are useful for cells that contain data that you do not want to change when you copy or move the formula.
entries.translation: Nembni mokloki bang' kopo itiyogodo ei sel man kod data ma okidwar ni mondo oloki seche ma ikopo kata choro fomiula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if you have a formula that calculates the total sales for each month, you would want to use an absolute reference for the cell that contains the starting date.
entries.translation: Kuom ranyisi, ka in kod fomiula magoyo kwan mar uso duto mag dwe ka dwe, inyalo tiyo kod namba mokloki e sel man kod tarik mane ichake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This way, the formula will always refer to the same cell, even if you copy it to a different row or column.
entries.translation: E yorno, fomiula no kinde duto biro nyiso sel achiel machal, kata ka ikopo ma indike e roo kata kolam mopogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can create an absolute reference by adding a dollar sign ($) to the row number and column letter of the cell reference.
entries.translation: Inyalo loso namba mokloki kuom medo sain mar dola ($) e namba mar roo kod leta mar kolam mar namba mar sel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, the absolute reference for the cell A1 would be $A$1.
entries.translation: Kuom ranyisi, namba mokloki mar sel A1 biro bedo $A$1.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also use absolute references to reference a range of cells.
entries.translation: Inyalo tiyo kod nembni mokloki mar keto renj mag sels.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To do this, add a dollar sign to the row number and column letter of each cell in the range.
entries.translation: Mondo itim kamano, medi sain mar dola e nyim namba mar roo kod leta mar kolam mar sel ka sel e kwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, the absolute reference for the range A1:B1 would be $A$1:$B$1.
entries.translation: Kuom ranyisi, namba mokloki mar renj mar A1:B1 biro bedo $A$1:$B$1.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Absolute references are a powerful tool that can be used to make your formulas more flexible and easier to use.
entries.translation: Nembni mokloki gen tul mong'ith ahinya ma inyalo tigodo e loso fomiula meki bedo mayot sudo kendo yot tiyogodo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By understanding how to use absolute references, you can create formulas that will work even when you copy or move them to different locations.
entries.translation: Ka iwinjo tiend kaka itiyo kod nembni mokloki, inyalo loso fomiula mabiro tiyo kata ka ikopo kata choro nembni kama opogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some additional tips for using absolute references:
entries.translation: Magi gin moko kuom weche mabalang' mag tiyo gi nembni mokloki:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Use absolute references for cells that contain data that you do not want to change.
entries.translation: * Ti kod nembni mokloki e sel man kod data ma okidwar loko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Use relative references for cells that contain data that you do want to change.
entries.translation: * Ti kod nembni mipimo gi mamoko e sel man kod data ma idwaro loko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Be careful when using mixed references, which are references that contain both absolute and relative references.
entries.translation: * Bed motang' sama itiyo kod nembni mokikore, magin moriwo nembni mokloki kod nembni malokore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Use the F4 key to toggle between absolute, relative, and mixed references.
entries.translation: * Dii F4 mondo iloki kind nembni mokloki, malokore kod mokikore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By following these tips, you can use absolute references to create powerful and flexible formulas that will make your work in Excel easier and more efficient.
entries.translation: Ka iluwo weche gi, inyalo tiyo gi nembni mokloki e loso fomiula mabeyo kendo malokore mabiro miyo itim tiji ei Excel eyo mayot kendo mayom moloyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because they do not feed on blood.
entries.translation: Mae en kamano nikech ok gicham remo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, they feed on nectar from flowers.
entries.translation: To, gichamo mo mawuok e mauwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Female mosquitoes, on the other hand, do feed on blood.
entries.translation: Komachielo, suna ma dhako to chamo remo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They need blood in order to produce eggs.
entries.translation: Gidwaro remo mar mondo ginyuol tong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Male mosquitoes are attracted to light, so they are often found near windows and doors.
entries.translation: Suna machwo ohero kama ler nitie, omiyo githoro yudore machiegni gi dirisa kod dho udi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also attracted to the smell of sweat and CO2.
entries.translation: Bende gihero suya mawuok kuom kuok kod muya mar CO2.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Female mosquitoes are attracted to the same things, but they are also attracted to the smell of certain chemicals in human blood.
entries.translation: Suna mamon ohero gigo machalo kamano bende, mak mana ni gihero suya mar kemikol moko mantie e remb dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When a female mosquito bites a human, she injects saliva into the skin.
entries.translation: Suna madhako ka okayo dhano, ong'udho olaw e pien dend dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This saliva contains anticoagulants, which prevent the blood from clotting.
entries.translation: Olaw ni ni kod kemikol mamiyo remo oknyal two.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mosquito then sucks up the blood.
entries.translation: Kaeto suna no nyodho remo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bites can cause itching and swelling.
entries.translation: Pien del kama suna okayo nyalo kuot kata bedo mailo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, they can also cause an allergic reaction.
entries.translation: Seche moko, ginyalo miyo ng'ato bedo gi gwonyo mag alaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common type of allergic reaction to mosquito bites is hives.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gwonyo mag alaji mawuok kuom kecho mar suna en kabondo bondo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hives are red, raised bumps that appear on the skin.
entries.translation: Kabondo bondo en ka pien del olokore makwar kendo okuot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be itchy or painful.
entries.translation: Ginyalo bedo ma ilo kata malit.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In rare cases, mosquito bites can cause more serious problems.
entries.translation: Seche moko, kecho mar suna nyalo kelo midhiero maricho ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, some people can develop an infection at the site of the bite.
entries.translation: Kuom ranyisi, jokomo nyalo gamo twoche kokalo gi kama suna okayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, mosquito bites can even lead to death.
entries.translation: Seche moko, kecho mar suna nyalo kata kelo tho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The best way to avoid mosquito bites is to wear long sleeves and pants when you are outdoors.
entries.translation: Yo maber mar geng'o kecho mar suna en rwako law mabade boyo kod long' ka in oko mar ot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also use insect repellent.
entries.translation: Bende owinjore iti kod yadh garo suna gichien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you do get bitten by a mosquito, you can apply a cold compress to the bite to relieve the itching and swelling.
entries.translation: Ka suna okayi, inyalo tiyo kod gimang'ich mondo oduokni piny ilo kod kuot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also take an over-the-counter antihistamine to relieve the symptoms of an allergic reaction.
entries.translation: Bende inyalo mwonyo yath mar antihistamine minyiewo e duka mar dwoko piny midhiero mag alaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquitoes are important carriers of disease.
entries.translation: Suna gin gigo madongo e yor ting'o twoche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can transmit a variety of diseases, including malaria, dengue fever, and yellow fever.
entries.translation: Ginyalo lando twoche mathoth, koriwo maleria, del ma hore kod athung'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquitoes are responsible for the deaths of millions of people each year.
entries.translation: Suna ema iseyo kuom tho mar oganda milionde mothoth higa ka higa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that can be done to control mosquito populations.
entries.translation: Nitie gigo minyalo tim mar dwoko piny kwan mar suna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way is to reduce the number of places where mosquitoes can breed.
entries.translation: Achiel en dwoko piny kwan mar kuonde ma suna nyalo toyo e tonge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be done by draining standing water and clearing away vegetation.
entries.translation: Mae inyalo tim kuom duono pi magudore kod fywacho buya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to control mosquito populations is to use insecticides.
entries.translation: Yo machielo mar dwoko piny kwan mar suna en tiyo gi yedhe mag nego kute.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Insecticides can be used to kill mosquitoes both indoors and outdoors.
entries.translation: Yedhe mag nego kute inyalo tigodo mar nego suna ei ot nyaka oko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquitoes are a major public health problem.
entries.translation: Suna gin madhiero maduong' mar yore mag ngima mar oganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are a number of things that can be done to control mosquito populations and reduce the risk of mosquito-borne diseases.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, nitie gigo minyalotim mar thiro kwan suna kendo dwoko piny twoche mikelo kowuok kuom suna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He taught that all beings are caught in a cycle of birth, death, and rebirth, and that this cycle is perpetuated by our attachments to things in the world.
entries.translation: Nopuonjo ni dhano duto yudore e yor nyuol, tho kendo nyuol manyien, kendo yorni itego gi kaka wamako gikmoko motegno e pinyni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These attachments can be to anything, from material possessions to ideas and beliefs.
entries.translation: Gik ma wamako gi nyalo bedo gimoro amora, chakre mwandu nyaka paro kata gigo ma ng'ato oyiego.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we are attached to something, we become possessive and controlling, and we suffer when we lose or cannot have what we want.
entries.translation: Seche ma wamako gimoro motegno, gigo kawo pachwa kendo wabedo jo ngunya, kendo mabedo gi achiedh nade ka wawito gimoro kata ka gimwadwaro otamowa yudo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Buddha taught that the way to end suffering is to let go of our attachments.
entries.translation: Jo Budha ne puonjo ni yor tieko achiedh nade en weyo gigo ma wamako motegno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is not easy, but it is possible through meditation and other spiritual practices.
entries.translation: Mae oken gimayot, kata kamano onyalore kokalo kuom winjruok kod timbe mamoko mag yore lamo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we let go of our attachments, we become free from the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth, and we can experience true peace and happiness.
entries.translation: Ka waweyo gigo ma wamako motegno, wabedo thuolo ma weche mag nyuol, tho kod nyuol manyien ok chandwa, kendo wabedo gi kwe kod mor mar adier.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things to remember when trying to let go of our attachments is that we are not our possessions.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gigo madongo mar paro seche ma itemo thegori gi gigo ma wamako motegno en ni okwan mwandu magwa wawegi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are not our ideas or beliefs.
entries.translation: Paro kata gigo ma wayie kuomgi ok e gima wan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are simply beings who are experiencing the world through our senses.
entries.translation: Wan mana dhano ma kalo e weche mag piny kokalo kuom sens magwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we can see ourselves in this way, it becomes easier to let go of the things that we think we need to be happy.
entries.translation: Ka wanenore e yorni, bedo mayot mar weyo weche ma waparo ni wadwaro mondo wabed mamor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Letting go of our attachments does not mean that we have to give up everything.
entries.translation: Weyo gigo ma wamako motegno ok onyiso ni nyaka wawere gi gikmoko duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It simply means that we need to be able to let go of things when it is time.
entries.translation: En mana ni owinjore mondo wawee gikmoko ka kinde ochopo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to be able to let go of the things that are no longer serving us, and we need to be able to let go of the things that we are attached to out of fear or insecurity.
entries.translation: Owinjore wawere gi gikmoko ma ok konywa, kendo owinjore wawere gi gikmoko ma wamako motegno nikech bedo gi luoro kata kihondko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we can let go of our attachments, we open ourselves up to a new world of possibilities.
entries.translation: Ka wawere gi gikmoko ma wamako motegno, wabedo thuolo kendo yore manyien yudore e piny mangima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We become free to live our lives in a way that is true to ourselves, and we become free to experience the joy and happiness that is our birthright.
entries.translation: Wabedo thuolo mar dago ngima marwa e yor adieri kendo wabedo thuolo mar yudo mor kod ilo ma en ratiro marwa chakre nyuol marwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trains have been a vital part of transportation for centuries.
entries.translation: Gach okolo osebedo yorno maduong' ahinya mar wuoth kuom higni buora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are a safe, efficient, and reliable way to travel long distances.
entries.translation: Arita margi ber, gi yom kendo yo ma inyalo gen mar dhi wuodhe maboyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the railroad industry requires regular updates to keep pace with the changing needs of passengers.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, sekta mar gach okolo dwaro lokruoge ma kinde ka kinde mar mondo odhi gi kaka dwaro mag jowuoth lokore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important updates that trains need is the installation of new safety features.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom gigo madongo mowinjore oloki e gach okolo en keto yore manyien mag arita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there have been a number of high-profile train accidents, which have highlighted the need for better safety measures.
entries.translation: E higni matin mokalo, masira abich madongo mag gach okolo osetimore, mano oseketo ayanga dwaro mar keto okenge mabeyo mag arita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: New safety features such as positive train control (PTC) can help prevent accidents by automatically stopping trains that are traveling too fast or that are about to collide with another train.
entries.translation: Yore manyien mag arita machalo kaka yor tayo gach okolo abidha (PTC) nyalo konyo geng'o masira kuom ng'uko kendgi geche okolo maringo ng'wej airititi kata mago machiegni tuomore gi mamoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important update that trains need is the installation of new technology.
entries.translation: Lokruok machielo mowinjore otim e gach okolo en keto teknoloji manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the past, trains were powered by steam engines.
entries.translation: E kinde mokalo, geche okolo ne iriembo gi injni mag muya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, steam engines are inefficient and pollute the environment.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, injni mag muya thoro kethore kendo gichido alwora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, most trains are powered by diesel engines or electric motors.
entries.translation: Kawuono, thoth geche okolo tiyo kod injni mag diesel kata mota mag sitima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These engines are more efficient and environmentally friendly.
entries.translation: Injni gi tiyo maber kendo girito alwora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to safety and technology updates, trains also need to be updated to accommodate the needs of passengers.
entries.translation: Kachiel gi keto yore manyien mag arita kod teknoloji, geche okolo bende owinjore oketi manyien mondo ginywandi dwaro mag jowuoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there has been an increase in the number of passengers who travel by train.
entries.translation: E higni machuok mokalo, kwan mar jawuoth matiyo gi gach okolo osemedore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This has led to overcrowding on trains, which can make for a less comfortable and enjoyable experience.
entries.translation: Mae osemiyo dhano dhungore e geche mag okolo, gino mamiyo yorno koro okbedi mofuyanga kendo mayom tiyogodo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had always been a talented painter, but after her loss, she found that she was no longer interested in painting pretty landscapes or still lifes.
entries.translation: Osegabedo jalno man kod mich mar wicho rangi, kata kamano bang' thono, nofwenyo ni nokohero kendo wicho kit chwech kata ngima mokwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, she began to create dark, brooding works of art that reflected her inner turmoil.
entries.translation: To, nochako wicho gigo ma rotenge ti mag kuyo mane nyiso kit lit ma iye mane en godo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of her most famous paintings, "The Death of My Son," is a stark and disturbing image of a young boy lying in a coffin.
entries.translation: Achiel kuom goro mage man gi huma ahinya "Tho Mar Wuoda," en tipo ma ok ber mar wuoyi matin monindo e sanduk.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy's face is peaceful, but his body is twisted and contorted in pain.
entries.translation: Lenda wang' wuoyi no nyiso kwe, kata kamano dende ogwenyore kendo nigi lit.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The painting is full of symbolism, and it is clear that Mary is using her art to process her grief and anger.
entries.translation: Goro no ni kod gimochung'ne, kendo en gimoyongore ni Mary tiyo gi goro mar nyiso lit kod ich wang' ma en godo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mary's shift in artistic style was not without its critics.
entries.translation: Nenitie jogo mane kuro lokruok e kit goro mar Mary.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people accused her of being exploitative and insensitive.
entries.translation: Jomoko ne wacho ni notiyo kode eyo marach kendo nokodewo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others said that her paintings were too depressing and that they should not be shown in public.
entries.translation: Jomoko newacho ni goro mage nekelo kuyo ahinya kendo ni okowinjore onyis gi ne oganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, Mary refused to back down.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, Mary notamore dok chien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She believed that her art was important, and she wanted to share it with the world.
entries.translation: Ne en gi yie ni goro mare ne ber, kendo nodwaro ni mondo piny duto onene.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mary's work eventually found an audience, and she became one of the most respected artists of her time.
entries.translation: Tij Mary giko to noyudo jogo mane nenogi, kendo nobedo achiel kuom jogoro mane omi luor ahinya e kinde mage.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her paintings are now considered to be masterpieces, and they are still studied and admired by people all over the world.
entries.translation: Goro mage sani okaw kaka mago manimba, kendo pod isomogi kendo giyuayo oganda e piny mangima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mary's story is a reminder that art can be a powerful tool for expression.
entries.translation: Sigana mar Mary en mar paronwa ni goro en yorno maduong' mar nyiso pachwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be used to process grief, anger, and other difficult emotions.
entries.translation: Inyalo ti kode e kaloe kuyo, ich wang, kod gigo mamoko matek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also be used to communicate important messages about the human condition.
entries.translation: Bende inyalo ti kode e oro ote madongo kuom kaka dhano winjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mary's paintings are a testament to the power of art, and they continue to inspire people to this day.
entries.translation: Goro mag Mary gin ranyisi mar teko mar goro, kendo gimedo miyo oganda mijing'o nyaka kawuono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sudan is a country in northeastern Africa.
entries.translation: Sudan en piny mantie nyandwat ma yo wuok chieng' ma Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is bordered by Egypt to the north, Libya to the northwest, Chad to the west, the Central African Republic to the southwest, South Sudan to the south, Ethiopia to the southeast, and Eritrea to the east.
entries.translation: Ogoyo tong' gi piny Misri yo nyandwat, Libya yo nyandwat ma ugwe, Chad yo ugwe, Piny mar Afrika Madiere yo milambo ma ugwe, Sudan ma Milambo yo milambo, Ethiopia yo milambo ma wuok chieng' kod Eritrea yo wuok chieng'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sudan has a population of over 40 million people and a land area of over 1.8 million square kilometers.
entries.translation: Sudan ni kod kwan oganda mahingo milion 40 kod lach mar piny mahingo kilomita milion 1.8 skweya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sudan's history is long and complex.
entries.translation: Sigand Sudan bor kendo ogajore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The area has been inhabited by humans for thousands of years, and the first known civilization in Sudan was the Kingdom of Kush, which flourished from around 750 BC to 350 AD.
entries.translation: Pinyno osebedo gi dhano modakie kuom higni alufe gi alufe, kendo kinde mokwongo mag chanruok e piny Sudan ne en Loch Kingi mar jo Kush, mane otelo chakre 750 BC nyaka 350 AD.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kush was a powerful kingdom that controlled much of the Nile River valley.
entries.translation: Kush ne en loch kingi mane ni kod teko ahinya kendo notelo kamalach e hoho mar Nile River.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 7th century AD, Sudan was conquered by the Arabs, who brought Islam to the region.
entries.translation: E senchari mar 7 AD, Sudan ne omaki gi oganda jo Arabu, mane okelo din mar salam e pinyno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sudan was ruled by a series of Arab sultanates for centuries, until it was conquered by Egypt in 1821.
entries.translation: Sudan notelni gi sultande buora mag Arabu kuom higni mathoth, nyaka kane omake gi Misri e higa mar 1821.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Egypt ruled Sudan until 1885, when it was conquered by the Mahdi, a religious leader who led a rebellion against Egyptian rule.
entries.translation: Piny Misri ne otelo ne Sudan nyaka 1885, eka ne okawe gi Mahdi, jatelo mar din mane otelo ne ng'anyo mar kwedo tend jo Misri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mahdi's rule was short-lived, and Sudan was reconquered by the British in 1898.
entries.translation: Telo mar Mahdi nobedo mana matin, kendo Sudan ne okaw gi jo Ingeresa e higa 1898.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My dear daughter, I know you've been wondering about the nature of light and darkness.
entries.translation: Nyara mahero, ang'eyo ni isebedo ka in gi parruok ewi chal mar ler kod mudho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a big question, and one that scientists have been trying to answer for centuries.
entries.translation: En wach maduong' kendo mano ma jo sayans osebedo ka temo mano duoko mare kuom higni mathoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I think I can give you a simple explanation that will help you understand it a little better.
entries.translation: Kata kamano aparo ni anyalo miyi ler mayot mabiro konyi winjo tiende matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light is a kind of energy that travels in waves.
entries.translation: Ler en kit teko maringo kaka apaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can see light because it enters our eyes and stimulates the retina, which is a light-sensitive tissue at the back of the eye.
entries.translation: Wanyalo neno ler nikech odonjo e wang'wa kendo yawo kama iluongo ni retina, ma en tisu mar fwenyo ler e tok wang'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The retina sends signals to our brain, which interprets them as images.
entries.translation: Retina oro ote nyaka e obwongo marwa, ma kaeto loko ote go bedo tipo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Darkness is the absence of light.
entries.translation: Mudho en bedo ni onge ler.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When there is no light, we can't see anything.
entries.translation: Seche ma onge ler, ok wanyal neno gimoro amora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light and darkness are two opposites, but they're also two sides of the same coin.
entries.translation: Ler kod mudho gin gikmoko ariyo mopogore, kata kamano gin weche ariyo motudore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light is needed for us to see, but darkness is also important.
entries.translation: Ler dwarore mondo omi wanen, mudho bende ber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Darkness helps us to rest and sleep.
entries.translation: Mudho konyowa mar yudo yweyo kendo nindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also creates a sense of mystery and wonder.
entries.translation: Bende okonyo kelo paro gigo mokoyangore kod miwuoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So next time you're outside at night, take a moment to appreciate the darkness.
entries.translation: Omiyo e kinde machielo kiwuok oko gotieno, kaw thuolo mondo inee ber mar mudho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's just as important as light, and it has its own beauty.
entries.translation: En gino maber mana kaka ler, kendo en gi ber mare owuon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Esteban was a concerned father.
entries.translation: Esteban ne en wuoro man kod kihondko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His daughter, Marcela, was listening to music that he didn't approve of.
entries.translation: Nyare, manyinge Marcela, newinjo thum mane okopuodho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The lyrics were explicit and violent, and he didn't want his daughter exposed to that kind of material.
entries.translation: Weche manitie e thumno nochido kendo mag tulo, kendo nokodwa ni nyare mondo owinj gik machalo kamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He tried to talk to her about it, but she just shrugged him off.
entries.translation: Notemo mondo olos kode ewi wachno, kata kamano nokodewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He didn't know what else to do.
entries.translation: Nokong'eyo ni nonyalo timo ang'o machielo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Esteban was listening to the radio when he heard a song that he thought Marcela would like.
entries.translation: Chieng' moro, Esteban newinjo redio kane owinjo thum mane oparo ni Marcela nenyalo hero.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a catchy tune with a positive message.
entries.translation: Ne en thum mamit man kod puonj mabeyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He decided to burn a copy of the song and give it to her.
entries.translation: Ne ong'ado ni odhi dabo kanda mar thumno mondo omiye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When she got home from school, he gave her the CD and told her to listen to it.
entries.translation: Kane ochopo pacho kowuok sikul, nomiye CD kendo onyise ni mondo owinje.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Marcela was surprised by the gift, but she was also intrigued.
entries.translation: Marcela nobuok gi mich no, bende nobedo gi paro moro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She put the CD in her stereo and listened to the song.
entries.translation: Noketo CD ie thumbe kendo nowinjo wendno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She liked it so much that she listened to it over and over again.
entries.translation: Nohero wendno ahinya kendo nowinje kinde ka kinde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next day, Esteban asked Marcela what she thought of the song.
entries.translation: Kiny ne, Esteban nopenjo Marcela gima noparo ewi wendno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She told him that she loved it and that it had made her think about things in a new way.
entries.translation: Nonyise ni ohere kendo nomiyo oparo gikmoko eyo mopogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Esteban was thrilled.
entries.translation: Esteban nomor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He knew that he had made a difference in his daughter's life.
entries.translation: Nong'eyo ni otimo gimoro mar loko ngima mar nyare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From that day on, Marcela listened to more positive music.
entries.translation: Chakre chieng' no, Marcela newinjo mana thumbe mabeyo lilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Human African Trypanosomiasis is primarily found in rural Africa and is transmitted through the bite of the tsetse fly.
entries.translation: Tuo mar Human African Trypanosomiasis yudore ahinya e gwenge mag Afrika to omako ng'ato ka maugo okaye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Have you recently travelled to sub-Saharan Africa?
entries.translation: Bende isedhi wuoth machiegni e milambo mar Sahara mar Afrika?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's crucial to see a doctor to get a proper diagnosis.
entries.translation: En gima duong' mondo inen laktar mondo ing'e ni in gi tuo mane.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They will likely ask you detailed questions about your symptoms, medical history, travel history, and lifestyle.
entries.translation: Onyalo penji penjo mang'eny kuom ranyisi magi, thieth machon,wuoth misegadhie gi kit ngima maidak.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They might also recommend some tests, like blood work, to rule out other potential causes.
entries.translation: Bende onyalo wacho ni itim pim, kaka pimo remo mondo ong'e ni en ang'o ma kelo tuo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do not self-treat or attempt to diagnose yourself with sleeping sickness.
entries.translation: Kik ithiedhri in iwuon kata temo ng'ado ni in gi tuo mar nindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a serious disease that requires specialized medical care and specific medications.
entries.translation: En tuo marach madwaro thieth gi yedhe makende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trying to treat it yourself could delay a proper diagnosis and treatment for the real cause of your symptoms.
entries.translation: Temo thiedhori in iwuon nyalo miyo ilew ng'eyo ni en tuo mane kod thieth mar gima kelo ranyisi magi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, to manage your fatigue and sleep disturbances, your first and most important step is to schedule an appointment with your doctor as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Omiyo, mondo itiek olo kod chandruok nindo, okang' mari mokuongo kendo maduong' en pango romo gi laktar mari mapiyo kaka nyalore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Explain your concerns and be honest about your symptoms.
entries.translation: Pim kibaji ma in godo to iwach adier kuom ranyisi magi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are the best resource to help you figure out what's going on and recommend the right course of action.
entries.translation: En e ng'at maber moloyo manyalo konyi ng'eyo gima dhi nyime to gi wachoni okang' makare ma inyalo kawo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the meantime, try to practice good sleep hygiene: maintain a regular sleep schedule, create a relaxing bedtime routine, and avoid caffeine and alcohol before bed.
entries.translation: Gi sani, tem ibed gi chenro maber mar nindo: pang saa mari mar nindo obed machal kinde ka kinde,bed gi chenro mar dhi nindo mamiyo iyueyo, to kik imadh kahawa gi kong'o kapok idhi nindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My female friend complains of bleeding, neck pain and thinks she has Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic Fever and asks, I hope it is not a dreadful thing?
entries.translation: Penjo: Osiepna manyako yuagore ni remo chuerne, en gi rem e ng'ute to oparo ni en gi tuo mar Liet mar Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic to openjo, Ageno ni oken gima rach ahinya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your friend to immediately go to a hospital or doctor.
entries.translation: Duoko: Ng'is osiepni ni odhi sanosano e suptal kata ir laktar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic Fever (CCHF) is a serious viral disease and requires prompt medical attention.
entries.translation: Liet mar Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic (CCHF) en tuo mar midhusi marach to oduaro thieth mapiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not something to take chances with.
entries.translation: Oken gima ikao mayot kamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trying to self-diagnose or treat it is dangerous.
entries.translation: Temo ng'ado ni in gi tuo mane kata thiedhori in iwuon nyalo kelo masira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While bleeding and neck pain can be symptoms of CCHF, they are also symptoms of many other illnesses, some far less serious.
entries.translation: Kata obedo ni chuer remo gi rem e ng'ut nyalo bedo ranyisi mag CCHF, gin ranyisi mag tuoche moko mang'eny, moko ma ok richo ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A doctor will be able to determine what's actually causing her symptoms and provide appropriate treatment.
entries.translation: Laktar nyalo fwenyo ni en ang'o siesie makelo ranyisi mage ba ochiw thieth mowinjore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Reassure her that getting checked out is the best course of action, regardless of the cause.
entries.translation: Jiwe ni dhi e pim e okang' maber mogik ma onyalo kawo, ma ok odewo ni ang'o mokele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Early diagnosis and treatment are crucial for CCHF and many other conditions.
entries.translation: Dhi e pim gi yudo thieth chon en gimaduong' ne CCHF gi tuoche moko mang'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My male neighbor complains of jaundice, fever, bleeding and thinks he has Yellow Fever and asks, What are the causes
entries.translation: Penjo: Wadwa ma dichuo modak machiegni koda ywagore ni dende lokore ratong', en gi liet, remo chuer to oparo ni en gi tuo mar Yellow Fever to openjo, gik makele gin ang'o
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: While your neighbor's symptoms do overlap with Yellow Fever, it's crucial to understand that self-diagnosing is dangerous, especially with a serious illness like Yellow Fever.
entries.translation: Duoko: Kata obedo ni ranyisi wadu modak machiegni kodi chalo gi mag Yellow Fever, en gima duong' mondo ong'e ni ng'ado ni en gi tuo mane en owuon nyalo kelo masira, moloyo to gi tuo marach kaka Yellow Fever.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He needs to see a doctor immediately for proper testing and diagnosis.
entries.translation: Onego onen laktar sanosano mondo opime e yo makare to ong'e ni tuo en mane.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Yellow fever is caused by the yellow fever virus, which is spread through the bite of an infected Aedes aegypti mosquito.
entries.translation: Yellow fever ikelo gi midhusi mar yellow fever, ma landore ka suna mar Aedes aegypti mankode okayo ng'ato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These mosquitoes also transmit diseases like Zika and Dengue.
entries.translation: Suna gi bende lando tuoche kaka Zika gi Dengue.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not contagious from person to person.
entries.translation: Ok olandre koa kuom ng'ato nyaka ir ng'at machielo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Essentially, the only cause of Yellow Fever is infection with the yellow fever virus transmitted by the bite of an infected mosquito.
entries.translation: Pile, gimoro achiel makelo Yellow Fever en yudo midhusi mag yellow fever ka suna manikode okayi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There's no other way to contract it.
entries.translation: Onge yo moro machielo mar yude.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to reiterate that your neighbor needs professional medical attention.
entries.translation: En gima duong' mondo anuo ni wadu modak machiegni kodi dwarore oyud thieth moa kuom jolony.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His symptoms could be from a number of other illnesses, some serious, and delaying proper diagnosis and treatment can have serious consequences.
entries.translation: Ranyisige nyalo bet ni okel kod tuoche moko mang'eny, moko marach, to lewo ng'eyo ni en tuo mane gi yudo thieth nyalo kelo masira marach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My female classmate complains of fever, chills, headache and thinks she has Malaria and asks, Malaria is more common with people coming from Mozambique.
entries.translation: Penjo: Jaklasa manyako yuagore ni en gi liet, koyo, wichbar to oparo ni en gi Maleria to openjo, Maleria mako ahinya joma oa wuoth e piny Mozambique.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So are you from there and how do you know you got it?
entries.translation: Koro ia kanyo to ing'eyo nade ni in kode?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: "I understand you're not feeling well and are worried about malaria.
entries.translation: Duoko: "Awinjo ni okiwinj maber to in gi kibaji e wi maleria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's definitely important to take symptoms like fever, chills, and headache seriously.
entries.translation: En gima duong' chutho mondo ikaw ranyisi kaka liet, koyo kod wichbar kaka gima lich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, I can't diagnose you, and self-diagnosing can be risky.
entries.translation: Kata kamano, okanyal ng'ado ni in gi tuo mane, to ng'ado ni in gi tuo mane in iwuon nyalo kelo masira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lots of illnesses share those symptoms.
entries.translation: Tuoche mang'eny nigi ranyisigo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for your question about where I'm from and my health, I’d prefer not to share personal details.
entries.translation: To penjo mari kuom kama awuokie gi ngimana, okadwar ng'iso ng'at machielo weche kuoma an awuon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most important thing right now is for you to see a doctor to figure out what's going on and get the right treatment.
entries.translation: Gima duong' gi sani en ni inen laktar mondo ing'e gimatimore to iyud thieth makare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can run tests to determine if it’s malaria or something else and give you the best advice.
entries.translation: Onyalo timo pim mondo ong'e ka en malaria kata gimachielo mondo ong'adni rieko maber mogik.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Delaying proper medical care can be harmful, so please make an appointment as soon as possible."
entries.translation: Lewo yudo thieth makare nyalo kelo hinyruok, omiyo kiyie to chan dhi neno laktar mapiyo kaka nyalore,"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My female classmate complains of fever, chills and thinks she has Malaria and asks, "What specific precautions or measures should I take to prevent malaria recurrence?"
entries.translation: Penjo: Jaklasa ma nyako yuagore ni en gi liet, koyo to oparo ni en gi Maleria to openjo, "Gin okenge kata atua mage siesie mag ritruok ma anyalo kao mondo ageng' duogo mar maleria?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your classmate that it's crucial she doesn't self-treat and sees a doctor immediately for diagnosis and treatment.
entries.translation: Duoko: Ng'is jaklasi ni en gima duong' mondo kik othiedhre en owuon to onen laktar sanosano mondo ong'e tuo to oyud thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malaria can be serious, even fatal, if not treated promptly.
entries.translation: Maleria nyalo bedo gima rach, onyalo kata kelo tho, ka okothiedhe mapiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suspecting malaria isn't the same as having a confirmed diagnosis.
entries.translation: Chich ni inkod maleria oken gimoro achiel gi ng'eyo gadier ni in kod maleria bang' pimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once she has seen a doctor and if she is diagnosed with malaria and completes her prescribed medication, these are some precautions she can take to prevent recurrence:
entries.translation: Ka oseneno laktar to osepime moyud maleria ba otieko yath mondikne, nitie okenge ritruok ma onyalo kawo ma geng'o tuo duogo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Continue preventative medication as prescribed: Her doctor may prescribe medication to be taken regularly during and after travel to malaria-endemic areas.
entries.translation: Dhi nyime gi yedhe mondik mag geng'o tuo: Laktar mare nyalo ndiko ne yath motiyogo kinde ka kinde sama odhi e wuoth kata sama owuok e wuoth kuonde ma maleria ng'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s crucial to adhere to the prescribed regimen.
entries.translation: En gima duong' ahinya mondo otiek yath mondikne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bite prevention is paramount:
entries.translation: Geng'o suna kik kayi en gimaduong':
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sleep under insecticide-treated mosquito nets (ITNs): Ensure the net is properly tucked in and has no holes.
entries.translation: Nind e bwo ned geng'o suna manigi yath (ITNs): Nen ni nedno oso maber e otanda to ok otuch.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Wear long-sleeved clothing and long pants, especially during dawn and dusk: Mosquitoes are most active during these times.
entries.translation: Rwak lewni mabedegi boyo gi longe, moloyo to kogwen gi godhiambo: Suna ng'eny ahinya seche gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Use insect repellents containing DEET (diethyltoluamide), picaridin, or IR3535: Follow the instructions on the product label.
entries.translation: Ti gi yadh riembo koko manigi DEET (diethyltoluamide),picaridin, kata IR3535: Luw chike mondik e kor yath.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consider using mosquito coils or insecticide-treated vaporizers indoors.
entries.translation: Par tiyo gi koil mag suna kata veporaisa manigi yadh koko ei ot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eliminate mosquito breeding grounds around her home: This includes removing standing water from flower pots, buckets, and other containers.
entries.translation: Tiek kuonde ma suna nyuolore e aluora mar ot: Mae oriwo golo pi mokudore ei agulni mag maua, ndope kod kontena moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be aware of potential relapse symptoms and seek immediate medical attention if they occur: Even after treatment, malaria parasites can sometimes persist in the liver and cause a relapse.
entries.translation: Bed king'eyo ranyisi mag ka tuo oduogo mondo imany thieth sanosano ka giwuok: Kata bang' thieth, kute mag maleria seche moko nyalo dong' e chuny ba mi tuo duog.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Again, the most important first step is to encourage her to seek immediate medical attention.
entries.translation: Kendo, okang' mokuongo maduong' mogik en jiwe mondo omany thieth sanosano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't delay!
entries.translation: Kik ilew!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: What precautions should I take to prevent the spread of typhoid fever to others, particularly my household members or close contacts?
entries.translation: Penjo: Gin okenge ritruok mage ma anyalo kao mondo ageng' landruok mar liet mar taifoid kuom jomoko, moloyo joma adak godo e ot kata joma ni machiegni koda?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Typhoid fever is a serious bacterial infection that can spread easily to others through contaminated food and water or close contact.
entries.translation: Liet mar taifoid en tuo marach ma ikelo gi kute manyalo landore mayot kuom jomoko kokalo kuom chiemo gi pi manigi kute kata joma in go machiegni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here's a breakdown of the precautions:
entries.translation: Eki okenge ritruok:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Handwashing: This is the single most important measure.
entries.translation: Luoko lwedo: Mae en okang' achiel maduong' mogik.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thorough handwashing with soap and water, especially after using the toilet and before handling food, removes bacteria and prevents transmission.
entries.translation: Luoko lwedo maler ahinya gi sabun gi pi, moloyo bang' dhi e cho gi kapok imulo chiemo, golo kute to geng'o landruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Disinfecting Contaminated Surfaces: Typhoid bacteria can survive on surfaces.
entries.translation: Keto yath kuonde ma kute nitie: Kute mag Taifoid nyalo dak e pado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Regularly disinfecting frequently touched surfaces like countertops, doorknobs, and bathroom fixtures with a household disinfectant helps prevent spread.
entries.translation: Keto yath e pado mimulo kinde ka kinde kaka wi kabat, lwedo dhoudi, gi gik moger ei baf kitiyogi yadh nego kwiri mitiyogo ei ot konyo geng'o landruok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Food Handling Precautions: Individuals with typhoid fever should not prepare or serve food for others while they are ill and for a period after recovery as determined by a healthcare professional.
entries.translation: Okenge Ritruok mag Mulo Chiemo: Joma nigi taifoid ok onego olos kata toko chiemo ne jomoko sama gituo nyaka kinde moko bang' chango, kaka jalony thieth biro ng'ado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This prevents contamination of food.
entries.translation: Mae konyo kute kik donj e chiemo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid Sharing Personal Items: Sharing personal items like towels, utensils, and drinking glasses can spread the bacteria.
entries.translation: Kik Iriw Gi Jomoko Gik Ma Itiyogo in Iwuon: Riwo gi jomoko gik mitiyogo in iwuon kaka taulo, sende, kod glese modho nyalo lando kute.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each individual should use their own dedicated items.
entries.translation: Ng'ato ka ng'ato onego oti gi gike en owuon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vaccination: Typhoid vaccines are available and can provide substantial protection against the disease.
entries.translation: Chanjo: Chanjo mag taifoid yudore kendo nyalo geng'oni tuo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vaccination is recommended for travelers to areas where typhoid is common and for individuals with close contact with a typhoid carrier.
entries.translation: Chanjo dwarore kuom joma dhi e wuoth kuonde ma taifoid en tuo mapile to gi ji masiko but joma nigi taifoid.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Prompt Treatment: Getting prompt medical treatment with appropriate antibiotics helps shorten the duration of illness and reduces the risk of complications and spread to others.
entries.translation: Thieth Mapiyo: Yudo thieth mapiyo gi yedhe antibayotik konyo duoko piny kinde ma tuo siko to duoko piny nyalruok mar chandruoge gi landruok kuom jomoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's also crucial to complete the full course of antibiotics even if symptoms improve.
entries.translation: En gima duong' mondo itiek dos mar antibayotik kata ka ranyisi osechako rumo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My male coursemate complains of fever, chills, sweats and thinks he has Malaria and asks, I have had malaria for the 3rd time this year, Is there any preventive measures that can be taken?
entries.translation: Penjo: Jal madichuo ma wasomogodo kos achiel ywagore ni owinjo liet, koyo, luya tuchne to oparo ni en gi Maleria to openjo, asebedo gi maleria didek e higa ni, Bende nitie okang' mar geng'e ma inyalo kaw?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: "It sounds pretty rough dealing with what you think is malaria multiple times.
entries.translation: Duoko: "En gima pek ahinya bedo gi gima iparo ni en maleria ding'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's definitely worth getting checked out by a doctor each time to confirm the diagnosis and get the right treatment, because recurring fevers can be a sign of other things too.
entries.translation: Ber ka laktar rangi kinde te mondo ong'e tuo to iyud thieth makare, nikech liet del malal to duogo nyalo bedo ranyisi mar gik mamoko bende.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-treating can sometimes mask the real problem.
entries.translation: Thiedhori in iwuon seche moko nyalo umo tuo madier.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for prevention, there are a few things you can do, especially if you're in an area where malaria is common.
entries.translation: Mondo igeng'e, nitie gik moko matin ma inyalo timo, moloyo ka in kama maleria ng'enyie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Using mosquito nets, especially ones treated with insecticide, is really important.
entries.translation: Tiyogi nede mag geng'o suna, to moloyo nede mothiedh gi yadh kute, en gima duong' ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Also, wearing long sleeves and pants, particularly during dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are most active, can help.
entries.translation: Bende, rwako lewni ma bedegi boyo gi longe, moloyo kogwen to gi godhiambo sama suna ng'eny ahinya, nyalo konyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also insect repellents containing DEET or picaridin that are effective.
entries.translation: Nitie bende yedhe riembo koko manigi DEET kata picaridin matiyo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can assess your individual risk and make sure you're aware of any potential side effects."
entries.translation: Onyalo rango masira manyalo wuokie to kendo onen ni ing'eyo midekre mabathe manyalo wuok."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your neighbor he needs to see a doctor immediately to get a proper diagnosis and treatment.
entries.translation: Duoko: Ng'is wadu modak machiegni kodi ni onego one laktar sanosano mondo ong'e ni en gi tuo mane to oyud thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rift Valley Fever can be serious, and self-treating is dangerous.
entries.translation: Tuo mar Liet mar Hoho mar Okak nyalo bedo marach, to thiedhori in iwuon nyalo kelo masira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While waiting for medical attention, he should take the following precautions to minimize the risk of spreading the disease (if it is indeed RVF):
entries.translation: Sama orito mondo oyud thieth, onego okaw okenge mag geng'ruok maluwogi mondo oduok piny nyalruok mar lando tuo ( ka po ni gadier en RVF):
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bite prevention: This is paramount.
entries.translation: Geng'o kecho mar suna: Mae duong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should use mosquito repellent containing DEET, picaridin, or IR3535 liberally.
entries.translation: Onego oti gi yath mang'eny mar riembo suna manigi DEET, picaridin, kata IR3535.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should wear long sleeves, long pants, and socks whenever possible, especially during dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are most active.
entries.translation: Onego oruak lewni ma bede gi boyo, longe, kod soks seche te ka nyalore, moloyo to kogwen gi godhiambo sama suna ng'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito netting around his bed would also be helpful.
entries.translation: Keto net mar geng'o suna oluor otanda mare bende nyalo konyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eliminate standing water around his home where mosquitoes breed (e.g., flower pots, buckets, discarded tires).
entries.translation: Ogol pi ma okudore e aluora mar ode kama suna nyuolore ( kaka, agulu mag maua, ndope, tiende nyamburko ma owit).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animal contact precautions: Avoid contact with any animals, especially livestock, that appear sick or are dead.
entries.translation: Ritruok mondo kik omul le: Kik omulre gi le moro amora, moloyo to jamni, manenore ni tuo kata ma otho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If he must handle animals (e.g., he's a farmer), he should wear protective clothing, including gloves and a mask.
entries.translation: Ka ochuno mondo omul le ( kuom ranyisi ka en japur), onego oruak lewni marito dende, koriwo glof gi abuog rombe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should not slaughter any animals himself and should report any suspicious animal deaths to the local veterinary authorities.
entries.translation: Ok onego oyang' le moro amora en owuon to onego ochiw lupot mar tho moro amora ma ochich go mar le ir jotelo mag thiedho le.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raw milk should not be consumed – it must be pasteurized.
entries.translation: Kik omadh chak ma ok ochwak- nyaka chwake.
