entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hygiene: Frequent handwashing with soap and water is crucial, especially after handling animals or animal products.
entries.translation: Ler: Luoko lwedo kinde ka kinde gi sabun gi pi en gima duong', moloyo bang' mulo le kata chiemo moa kuom le.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid touching his eyes, nose, and mouth with unwashed hands.
entries.translation: Kik omul wang'e, ume kata dhoge gi lwedo ma ok oluok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should also practice good hygiene when coughing or sneezing, covering his mouth and nose with a tissue or his elbow.
entries.translation: Bende onego orit ler sama ofuolo kata ojir, ka oumo dhoge gi ume kod otas mar tisu kata okumbo mare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should avoid sharing personal items like towels, eating utensils, and drinking glasses.
entries.translation: Ok onego oriw gike motiyogo en owuon, kaka taulo, sende gi glese mag modho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Isolation (to a reasonable extent): While complete isolation might not be necessary at this stage (before a diagnosis), he should limit close contact with others as much as possible until he sees a doctor.
entries.translation: Bedo kar kende ( e yo ma winjore ): Kata obedo ni bedo kar kende chuth nyalo bet ni ok dwarore e okang ni ( ka podi ok oyang ni tue en mane), onego oduok piny bedo machiegni gi jomoko kaka nyalore nyaka onen laktar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is particularly important for pregnant women, who are at higher risk of severe complications from RVF.
entries.translation: Mae en gima duong' to moloyo kuom mine ma yach, ma nigi nyalo maduong' mar yudo masira koa kuom tuo mar RVF.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emphasize to your neighbor again that these are precautionary measures and do not replace the need to see a doctor immediately.
entries.translation: Med paro ni wadu modak machiegni kodi kendo ni magi gin okange mag ritruok to ok ni gikao kar dwaro mar neno laktar sanosano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A blood test is needed to confirm the diagnosis and appropriate treatment will be necessary.
entries.translation: Biro dwarore mondo opim remo mondo oyang ni en tuo mane to thieth makare ibiro chiw.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Also, if he suspects he has RVF, he needs to inform local health authorities so they can monitor the situation and take appropriate public health measures.
entries.translation: Bende, ka po ni ochich ni en gi RVF, onego ong'is jotend thieth makanyo mondo giluw wachno to gikaw okenge ma owinjore mag ngima mar oganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Yes, absolutely.
entries.translation: Duoko: Kamano, adier chuth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While malaria is a possibility, especially with travel to a malaria-endemic region, several other illnesses can cause fever, chills, and headache.
entries.translation: Kata obedo ni maleria nyalo bet, to moloyo ka isedhi wuoth kama maleria ng'enyie, tuoche mamoko mang'eny bende nyalo kelo liet, koyo gi wichbar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Depending on where she traveled, some of the possibilities include:
entries.translation: Kaluwore gi kuonde ma osedhie wuoth, gik manyalore oriwo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other mosquito-borne illnesses: Dengue fever, Zika virus, Chikungunya virus, and West Nile virus all share similar symptoms with malaria.
entries.translation: Tuoche mamoko ma ikelo gi suna: Liet mar Dengue, Midhusi mag Zika, Midhusi mag Chikungunya, gi Midhusi mag Nile ma Imbo duto nigi ranyisi machal gi mag maleria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Viral infections: Influenza, common cold, COVID-19, and other viral infections can cause these symptoms.
entries.translation: Tuoche ma ikelo gi Midhusi: Athung'a, homa, KOVID-19, to kod tuoche moko mikelo gi midhusi nyalo kelo ranyisi gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bacterial infections: Typhoid fever, urinary tract infections, and bacterial pneumonia can also present with fever, chills, and headache.
entries.translation: Tuoche ma ikelo gi kute: Liet mar taifoid, tuoche mag yor lach, to kod numonia mikelo gi kute bende nyalo bedo gi ranyisi mag liet, koyo gi wichbar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tick-borne illnesses: Lyme disease, Rocky Mountain spotted fever, and other tick-borne illnesses can cause these symptoms, though headache is less prominent in some.
entries.translation: Tuoche ma ikelo gi okuodo: Tuo mar Lyme, tuo mar Liet mar Rocky Mountain gi tuoche mamoko ma ikelo gi okuodo nyalo kelo ranyisi gi, makmana ni wichbar tin kuom moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Heat stroke/heat exhaustion: If she was in a hot climate and exerted herself, this could be a cause.
entries.translation: Strok mar liet/olo ma ikelo gi liet: Ka po ni ne en kama kor lwasi liet to ne otiyo tije mapek, mae nyalo bedo gima kele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other less common infections: Depending on the region of travel, things like leptospirosis or brucellosis could be considered, although these are less common.
entries.translation: Tuoche mamoko ma ok mapile: Kaluwore gi kama ne odhie wuoth, gik moko kaka leptospirosis kata brucellosis bende inyalo rang, kata kamano magi ok thor timore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's crucial that she tell her doctor exactly where she traveled and what she did there (e.g., hiking, swimming in fresh water, eating street food).
entries.translation: En gima duong' ni ong'is laktar mare ni en kanye siesie mane odhie wuoth to gi gima nene otimo kanyo ( kuom ranyisi, wuotho, goyo abal e pi maliw, chamo chiemo ma itedo e ndara).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This information will help the doctor narrow down the possibilities and order the appropriate tests.
entries.translation: Weche gi biro konyo laktar ong'e ni onyalo bet ang'o to obiro chiko mondo otim pim mowinjore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important she doesn't self-treat and seeks professional medical advice.
entries.translation: En gima duong' ni kik othiedhore en owuon to omany kony mar jolony e thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your friend to see a doctor immediately to get tested and treated if he does have malaria.
entries.translation: Duoko: Ng'is osiepni ni onen laktar sanosano mondo opime kendo othiedhe ka en gi maleria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not something to mess around with.
entries.translation: Oken gima itugo go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for his question about prevention, here's what you can tell him:
entries.translation: To e wi penjo mare kuom geng'e, magi e gik ma inyalo ng'ise:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malaria prevention is multi-pronged and depends heavily on where he's travelling, as different regions have different mosquito species and resistance patterns.
entries.translation: Geng'o maleria oriwo gik mang'eny to luwore ahinya gi kama odhie wuoth, nikech kuonde mopogore nigi kido mag suna mopogore gi kido mar winjo teko yath mopogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should consult a travel health specialist or his doctor for personalized recommendations, but generally speaking, here are the key precautions:
entries.translation: Onego otwag gi jalony e weche ngima mar wuotho kata laktar mare mondo ong'adne rieko, to kata kamano, magi e yore ritruok madongo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Antimalarial medication: This is crucial.
entries.translation: Yadh geng'o maleria: Mae gima duong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are several different types, and the best one for him will depend on his destination, medical history, and other factors.
entries.translation: Nitie kido mang'eny mopogore, to maber kode mogik biro luwore gi kama odhie, thieth mane oseyudo chon, to kod weche moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A doctor needs to prescribe this, and it's often taken before, during, and after the trip.
entries.translation: Laktar onego ondikne yadhni, to ihinyo ti kode kapodi ng'ato podi okodhi e wuoth, sama en e wuoth, kata bang' wuoth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do not self-medicate.
entries.translation: Kik ithiedhri in iwuon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bite prevention: This is the cornerstone of malaria prevention and includes:
entries.translation: Geng'o suna kik kayi: Mae en gima duong' mar geng'o maleria to oriwo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Insect repellent: Use repellents containing DEET (20-50%), picaridin (20%), or IR3535 (20-30%).
entries.translation: Yadh riembo suna: Ti gi yath manigi DEET (atamalo 20-50), picaridin (atamalo 20), kata IR3535 (atamalo 20-30).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Apply to exposed skin and clothing, following product instructions.
entries.translation: Wir yath e pien del maneno gi lawi, kailuwo chike tiyo gi yadhno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Long-sleeved clothing and pants: Wear loose, light-colored clothing that covers most of your body, especially during dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are most active.
entries.translation: Lewni ma bedegi boyo gi longe: Rwak lewni mombekore, manigi rangi marieny ma umo dendi chiegni te, to moloyo kogwen gi godhiambo sama suna ng'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Treat clothing with permethrin insecticide for added protection (don't apply directly to skin).
entries.translation: Ket yadh koko manigi permethrin e lewni mondo iyud arita momedore (kik ikete achiel ka achiel e pien dendi).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito nets: Sleep under insecticide-treated mosquito nets, ensuring they are properly tucked in and have no holes.
entries.translation: Nede geng'o suna: Nind e bwo nede geng'o suna manigi yath, to inen ni isoyogi maber ei otanda to ok gituch.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito-proof accommodation: Stay in places with screened windows and doors, or use air conditioning to keep mosquitoes out.
entries.translation: Kuonde dak ma onge suna: Dag kuonde ma dirisni kod dhoudi nigi gima geng'o suna, kata iti gi masin ma loko liet e ot mondo suna odong' oko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consider mosquito coils or vaporizers if needed.
entries.translation: Ti gi koil mag suna kata masin mar veporaisa ka dwarore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Environmental control: While this is more of a public health measure, being aware helps.
entries.translation: Rito aluora: Kata obedo ni mae en okang' mar rito ngima oganda, ng'eyo ber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Minimizing standing water around accommodations can reduce breeding grounds for mosquitoes.
entries.translation: Duoko piny pi mokudore e aluoro kuonde dak nyalo duoko piny kuonde ma suna nyuolore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be aware of symptoms: Even with precautions, there's a small risk of contracting malaria.
entries.translation: Ng'e ranyisi: Kata ka iritori, nitie nyalruok ni inyalo yudo maleria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Knowing the symptoms (fever, chills, sweats, headache, muscle aches, fatigue, nausea, vomiting) is crucial.
entries.translation: Ng'eyo ranyisi (liet, koyo, luya, wichbar, rem e fuonde, olo, chuny malepo, ng'ok) en gima duong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If he develops any of these during or after travel to a malaria-endemic area, he should seek medical attention immediately.
entries.translation: Ka oyudo moro amora kuom ranyisigi sama en e wuoth kata bang' wuoth kama maleria ng'enyie, onego omany thieth sanosano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Early diagnosis and treatment are essential.
entries.translation: Ng'eyo tuo gi yudo thieth duong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Again, emphasize to your friend that seeing a doctor right away is the most important step right now for his health.
entries.translation: Kendo, nuo ni osiepni ni neno laktar sanosano en okang' maduong' ahinya gi sani e ngimane.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These prevention tips are for future trips.
entries.translation: Yore geng'o gi gin mag wuodhe mag ndalo mabiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My male neighbor complains of fever, rash and thinks he has Dengue Fever and asks, "What specific precautions should I take to prevent dengue fever complications?"
entries.translation: Penjo: Wadwa ma dichuo modak machiegni koda ywagore ni owinjo liet, dende oruodho to oparo ni en gi liet mar Dengue to openjo, "Gin yore ritruok mage ma onego aluw mondo age'ng chandruoge mag tuo no?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your neighbor that since he suspects dengue fever, it's crucial he see a doctor immediately for proper diagnosis and management.
entries.translation: Duoko: Ng'is wadu modak machiegni kodi ni nikech ochich ni en gi liet mar dengue, en gima duong' mondo onen laktar sanosano mondo ong'e tuo to oyud thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dengue can be dangerous, and complications can arise quickly.
entries.translation: Dengue nyalo bedo marach, to chandruoge nyalo medero piyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-treating is risky.
entries.translation: Thiedhori in iwuon nyalo kelo masira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While waiting for his appointment, he should:
entries.translation: Sama orito neno laktar, onego:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rest: This helps the body fight the infection.
entries.translation: Oyue: Mae konyo del kedo gi tuo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He needs to avoid strenuous activities.
entries.translation: Onego kik otim tije matek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hydrate: Drink plenty of fluids, like water, electrolyte solutions, or broths, to prevent dehydration, which is a common dengue complication.
entries.translation: Medo pi e dende: Omodh gik mang'eny, kaka pi, pige manigi chumbi, kata kado, mondo kik obed maonge pi e dende, ma en chandruok ma dengue kelo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid sugary drinks.
entries.translation: Kik omadh gik manigi sukar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pain Relief: He can take over-the-counter pain relievers like acetaminophen (Tylenol) to manage fever and pain.
entries.translation: Duoko rem piny: Onyalo tiyo gi yedhe minyiewo kaka acetaminophen (Tylenol) mondo othiedh liet gi rem.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Absolutely avoid ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin), aspirin, and naproxen (Aleve) as these can increase the risk of bleeding, a serious dengue complication.
entries.translation: Chutho kik oti gi ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin), asprin gi naproxen (Aleve) nikech magi nyalo medo nyalruok mar chwero remo, ma en chandruok maduong' mikelo gi dengue.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Monitor for Warning Signs: He should watch closely for any warning signs like severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding gums, rapid breathing, or fatigue/restlessness.
entries.translation: Rang Ranyisi:Onego orang ahinya ranyisi kaka rem mager mar ich, ng'ok seche te, lak machwero remo, yweyo piyopiyo, kata olo/dak obed mos.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If any of these occur, he should seek immediate medical attention, potentially going to the emergency room.
entries.translation: Ka moro amora kuom magi otimore, onego omany thieth sanosano, kanyalore kar thieth ma apoya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These could indicate severe dengue.
entries.translation: Magi nyalo nyiso ni en gi dengue.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito Control: Even though he's already likely infected, he should prevent further mosquito bites to avoid spreading dengue to others.
entries.translation: Geng'o suna: Kata obedo ni nyalore ni osemako tuo, onego ogeng' suna kik kaye kendo mondo kik dengue landore kuom jomoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means using mosquito repellent, wearing long sleeves and pants, and sleeping under a mosquito net.
entries.translation: Mae tiende ni oti gi yadh riembo suna, rwako lewni ma bedegi boyo kod longe, gi nindo e bwo ned geng'o suna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emphasize again that he needs to see a doctor as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Nwone kendo ni dwarore mondo onen laktar mapiyo kaka nyalore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This advice is not a substitute for professional medical care.
entries.translation: Paro mochiwgi ok kaw kar thieth michiwo gi jolony.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: It's important to preface this by saying I am not a medical professional.
entries.translation: Duoko: En gima duong' mondo achak giwacho ni okan jalony e weche thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your friend needs to see a doctor, not ask the internet, especially since she believes she has multiple diseases.
entries.translation: Osiepni dwarore ni onen laktar, ok penjo mbui, moloyo nikech oparo ni en gi tuoche mang'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-diagnosing zoonotic diseases is particularly dangerous as some can be serious if left untreated.
entries.translation: Ng'ado in iwuon ni in gi tuoche mayudore koa kuom le rach moloyo nikech moko nyalo bedo marach ka owe ma ok othiedh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I can give some general information, but it should not be taken as medical advice.
entries.translation: Anyalo chiwo weche e yo malach, to okonego kawe kaka ng'ado rieko e weche thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To answer her question properly, she needs to provide more information to a doctor.
entries.translation: Mondo aduok penjone maber, onego owach weche go ne laktar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, some common zoonotic diseases and associated risk factors include:
entries.translation: Kata kamano, tuoche moko mayudore koa kuom le gi gik makelogi oriwo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Common Zoonotic Diseases & Associated Risk Factors:
entries.translation: Tuoche Mapile Mayudore Koa Kuom Le Gi Gima Kelogi:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lyme disease: Transmitted by ticks.
entries.translation: Tuo mar Lyme: Maikelo gi okuodo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include spending time in wooded or grassy areas, having pets that go outdoors, and not performing regular tick checks.
entries.translation: Gik manyalo kele oriwo bedo kuonde manigi yien kata lum, bedo gi le mag ot mawuotho oko, gi dak ma okirango kinde ka kinde ka okuodo nitie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rocky Mountain spotted fever: Also tick-borne.
entries.translation: Tuo mar Liet mar Rocky Mountain: Bende ikelo gi okuodo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Similar risk factors to Lyme disease.
entries.translation: Gik makele chalo gi gik makelo tuo mar Lyme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Toxoplasmosis: Caused by a parasite often found in cat feces and undercooked meat.
entries.translation: Toxoplasmosis: Ikelo gi njokla mayudore e oko mar paka gi ring'o ma okochiek maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pregnant women and individuals with weakened immune systems are at higher risk.
entries.translation: Mon mayach gi joma teko mar del kedo gi tuo ni piny nigi nyalruok maduong' mar mako tuo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gardening and handling cat litter are risk factors.
entries.translation: Tiyo e puodho gi rito nyithind paka gin gik manyalo kelo tuo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rabies: Transmitted through the bite of an infected animal (e.g., bats, raccoons, skunks).
entries.translation: Rebis: Ikelo ka le manigi tuo okayo ng'ato ( kuom ranyisi, hanyinya, ogwang', kod ongwangakech).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include contact with wildlife, especially if the animal is behaving strangely.
entries.translation: Gik makele oriwo mulruok gi le mag bungu, moloyo ka le no timore magalagala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salmonella and Campylobacter: Bacterial infections often acquired through contact with contaminated food (especially poultry, eggs, and unpasteurized milk), reptiles, or contaminated water.
entries.translation: Salmonella kod Campylobacter: Tuoche mikelo gi kute mayudore e chiemo ( moloyo gwen, tong' kod chak ma okochwak), le manigi ligakla motuo, kata pi manigi kute.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ringworm: A fungal infection that can be transmitted from animals (especially cats and dogs) to humans through direct contact.
entries.translation: Mbaha: En tuo mar obuoch ma ikelo koa kuom le (moloyo paka gi guogi) ka gimulore achiel kachiel gi dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Psittacosis (Parrot Fever): A bacterial infection spread by birds, particularly parrots, parakeets, and pigeons.
entries.translation: Psittacosis (Liet mar Kasuku): Tuo mikelo gi kute malondore koa kuom winy, moloyo kasuku, osogo gi akuru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include handling infected birds or inhaling dust from their droppings.
entries.translation: Gik makele oriwo rito winy manigi tuo kata ywayo muya mar buru manigi oko margi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Leptospirosis: A bacterial infection spread through contact with the urine of infected animals (e.g., rodents, livestock).
entries.translation: Leptospirosis: Tuo mar kute malandore koa kuom lach mar le manigi tuo ( kuom ranyisi, oyeyo, jamni).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include exposure to contaminated water or soil.
entries.translation: Gik makele oriwo tiyo gi pi manigi kute kata lowo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Prevention:
entries.translation: Geng'o:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: General preventative measures for zoonotic diseases often include:
entries.translation: Okange mag geng'o tuoche mikelo gi le oriwo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Regular handwashing: Especially after handling animals, their food, or waste.
entries.translation: Luoko lwedo kinde ka kinde: Moloyo to bang' mulo le, chiembgi kata oko margi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Safe food handling: Cook meat thoroughly, wash fruits and vegetables, and avoid unpasteurized dairy products.
entries.translation: Loso chiemo e yo maber: Chwak ring'o maber, luok olemo gi alode, to kik iti gi chak ma ok ochuak.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tick checks: After spending time outdoors, thoroughly check yourself, your children, and your pets for ticks.
entries.translation: Rango okuodo: Bang' riyo oko, rangri maber, nyithindi, gi le mag ot kadipo ni okuodo nitie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remove them promptly and correctly.
entries.translation: Golgi mapiyo e yo makare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vaccinations: Vaccinate your pets against rabies and other diseases.
entries.translation: Chanjo: Mi le ni mag ot chanjo mar geng'o rebis gi tuoche moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also human vaccines for some zoonotic diseases (e.g., rabies).
entries.translation: Bende nitie chanjo mag dhano mag geng'o tuoche mikelo koa kuom le (kuom ranyisi, rebis).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pest control: Control rodent and insect populations in and around your home.
entries.translation: Geng'o le matindo: Geng' oyeyo gi koko ei ot gi aluora mar dalani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid contact with wildlife: Do not handle or feed wild animals.
entries.translation: Kik imulri gi le mag bungu: Kik imul kata pidho chiemo le mag bungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be cautious around unfamiliar animals, especially those exhibiting unusual behavior.
entries.translation: Bed motang' ka in but le ma ikia, moloyo to le matimore magalagala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Protective clothing: Wear long sleeves, pants, and closed-toe shoes in areas where ticks or other disease-carrying insects may be present.
entries.translation: Lewni mag rito del: Rwak lewni ma bedegi boyo, longe, gi wuoche maumo tiendeni ka in kuonde ma okuodo gi koko moko majoting' tuo nyalo betie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Use insect repellent containing DEET.
entries.translation: Ti gi yadh riembo koko manigi DEET.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Again, this is not medical advice.
entries.translation: Kendo, mae oken ng'ado rieko mar thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your friend needs to consult a doctor.
entries.translation: Osiepni dwarore otwag gi laktar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her concerns about having multiple zoonotic illnesses warrant professional medical evaluation.
entries.translation: Kibaji ma en go kuom bendo gi tuoche mang'eny mikelo gi le dwaro ni odhi otimne pim mar thieth gi jolony.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's possible her symptoms have a different underlying cause altogether.
entries.translation: Nyalore ni ranyisi mage ikelo gi gimoro machielo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Encourage her to seek medical attention as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Jiwe mondo odhi omany thieth mapiyo kaka nyalore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My female classmate complains of fever, chills and thinks she has Malaria and asks, What is the best way to treat malaria?
entries.translation: Penjo: Jaklasa manyako ywagore ni en gi liet, koyo to oparo ni en gi Maleria to openjo, En yo mane maber mogik mar thiedho maleria?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: She needs to see a doctor immediately.
entries.translation: Duoko: Onego onen laktar sanosano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malaria is a serious illness and requires a proper diagnosis and prescription medication.
entries.translation: Maleria en tuo marach to odwaro ni opime maber to ochiw yath mondik gi laktar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-treating can be dangerous and delay effective treatment, leading to complications.
entries.translation: Thiedhori in iwuon nyalo kelo masira to olew thieth maber, makel chandruoge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tell her to go to a doctor or clinic as soon as possible to get tested and receive the appropriate care.
entries.translation: Ng'ise odhi ir laktar kata klinik mapiyo kaka nyalore mondo opime to oyud thieth makare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your neighbor that he absolutely should not attempt to self-treat suspected onchocerciasis with over-the-counter supplements.
entries.translation: Duoko: Ng'is wadu ni kik otem chuth thiedho onchocerciasis en owuon gi yedhe minyiewo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are no over-the-counter supplements that prevent or treat river blindness.
entries.translation: Onge yedhe minyiewo manyalo geng'o kata thiedho tuo mar bedo muofu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His symptoms (severe itching, blindness) are serious and warrant immediate medical attention from a qualified doctor.
entries.translation: Ranyisi mage (del mailo marach, bedo muofu) rach ahinya to dwarore odhi omany thieth sanosano kuom laktar molony.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He needs to be properly diagnosed and, if he does have onchocerciasis, receive the appropriate prescription medication.
entries.translation: Onego tim ne pim makare, to ka po in en gi onchocerciasis, oyud yath makare mondik gi laktar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Delaying proper medical care can lead to permanent vision loss and other serious complications.
entries.translation: Lewo yudo thieth makare nyalo miyo olal chuth nyalo mar neno gi chandruoge moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should see a doctor as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Onego onen laktar mapiyo kaka nyalore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: No, schistosomiasis is not a genetic disease and cannot be passed directly from parents to their children through genes.
entries.translation: Duoko: Ooyo, schistosomiasis oken tuo mar kodhi dhano to okonyal landore achiel kachiel koa kuom jonyuol nyaka ir nyithindgi kokalo kuom kodhi dhano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a parasitic infection caused by flatworms called schistosomes.
entries.translation: En tuo mikelo gi njokla mag oniambo miluongo ni schistosomes.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You get it by coming into contact with contaminated freshwater where the parasite larvae live.
entries.translation: Iyude ka imulo pi maliw mani kode kama tong njokla nitie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These larvae penetrate the skin and develop inside the body.
entries.translation: Tong' gi donjo kokalo e pien del to gidongo ei del.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, while family members might be at higher risk if they share the same contaminated water source, it's due to shared environmental exposure, not inheritance.
entries.translation: Omiyo, kata obedo ni joot nyalo bedo gi thuolo maduong' mar yude ka po ni gitiyo gi pi manikode, ikele gi gik miriwo mayudore ei aluora, ok koa kuom anyuola.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should definitely see a doctor to get diagnosed and treated properly, as untreated schistosomiasis can lead to serious long-term health issues.
entries.translation: Chutho onego onen laktar mondo opim tuo to kendo oyud thieth makare, nikech schistosomiasis nyalo kelo chandruok mag ngima masiko kuom ndalo mang'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dear John,
entries.translation: Moher John,
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remember, managing your health is a team effort. Please don't hesitate to contact my office if you have any questions or concerns between appointments.
entries.translation: Par ni, rito ngimani en tijwa kanyakla. Yie mondo itudri gi ofisa ka in gi penjo kata chandruok moro amora ka podi okochopo chieng' neno laktar kendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sincerely,
entries.translation: Gi luor,
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Phommavong
entries.translation: Laktar Phommavong
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Schneider: Good afternoon, Emily. I see you're here to discuss your history of pregnancy loss. Can you tell me a bit more about what's been going on?
entries.translation: Laktar Schneider: Osaore Emily, Aneno ni ibiro ka mondo wawuo kuom wach mosebedo ka timoreni mar ich wuok. Inyalo lerona maber kuom gima osebedo ka timore?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emily: Well, I've had three miscarriages in the past two years. It's been really hard.
entries.translation: Emily: Ee, ich osewuok nyadidek e higni ariyo mokalo. Osebedo matek ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Schneider: I'm so sorry to hear that, Emily. That must be incredibly difficult. Can you tell me a little about your eating habits and exercise routine?
entries.translation: Laktar Schneider: Agoyo mos ahinya kuom mano Emily. Mano nyaka bed ni en gimatek ahinya. Inyalo lerona maber kuom kit kaka ichiemoga kod chenro mari mar orako mag rieyo del?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emily: I try to eat healthy, but I don't always have much of an appetite. And I run cross country, so I exercise a lot.
entries.translation: Emily: Atemo chamo chiemo mabeyo mag ngima, makmana ni seche moko abedo ma onge gi gombo mar chiemo. Kendo aringo ng'wech mag safar mabor, omiyo, atimo orako mag rieyo del mang'eny ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Schneider: Okay. And have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?
entries.translation: Laktar Schneider: Kare. Bende iseneno lokruok moro amora kuom pek mar dendi ndalo machiegni?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emily: I've lost a few pounds, but nothing major. I've always been pretty thin.
entries.translation: Emily: Asegolo kilo matin, to ok gimaduong’ ahinya. Asebedo modhero pile.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Schneider: I see. Have you had regular periods?
entries.translation: Laktar Schneider: Aneno. Bende isebedo kiyudo dwe mari e yo mochanre kaka onego obed?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emily: Not really. They're pretty irregular, and sometimes I skip months.
entries.translation: Emily: Ooyo. Ok gibi e yo ma owinjore, kendo seche moko dweche kalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Schneider: Okay. Based on what you're telling me, I'm concerned that your weight and exercise level might be impacting your fertility. It's possible that you're not getting enough nutrients to support a pregnancy.
entries.translation: Laktar Schneider: Kare. Kaluwore gi gima ilerona, an gi kibaji ni pek mar dendi kod okang' ma itimogo orako mag rieyo del nyalo chocho nyalo mari mar nyuol. Nyalo bedo ni ok iyud chiemo maber moromo ritoni ich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emily: Really? I didn't think being thin could cause miscarriages.
entries.translation: Emily: Adier? Ne ok apar ni dhero nyalo miyo ich wuok.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emily: Okay, I'm willing to try anything. I just want to have a baby.
entries.translation: Emily: Kare, aikora mar temo gimoro amora. Adwaro mana yudo nyathi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Schneider: I understand. We'll do everything we can to help you. Let's get those tests ordered and set up an appointment with the nutritionist.
entries.translation: Laktar Schneider: Awinjo. Wabiro timo duto ma wanyalo mondo wakonyi. We watim pimgo kendo wachan mar neno jalony e weche chiemo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Hello, this is CareConnect Telehealth. My name is Juan. How can I help you today?
entries.translation: Jatich: Msawa, mae en CareConnect Telehealth. Nyinga Juan. Anyalo konyi nade kawuono?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: Hi Juan, this is Riaan Steyn. I need a liver biopsy, like, yesterday! I'm on vacation here and I'm feeling terrible.
entries.translation: Jagoyo simo: Msawa Juan, an Riaan Steyn. Adwaro ni opim chunya, mapiyo ahinya! An e rusa kae to awinjo marach ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: I'm so sorry to hear you're not feeling well, Riaan. Can you tell me a little bit more about what's going on?
entries.translation: Jatich: Agoyo mos ahinya ni ok iwinj maber, Riaan. Bende inyalo nyisa mang'eny e wi gima dhi nyime?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: I understand how frustrating that must be, Riaan. Let me see what I can do to help. Can you confirm your date of birth and current location for me?
entries.translation: Jatich: Awinjo kaka mano bedo marach, Riaan. We ane gima anyalo timo mondo akonyi. Bende inyalo nyisa tarik mari mar nyuol kod kama intie sani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: Sure, it's January 1st, 1970. And I'm staying at the Grand Hotel in downtown Seattle.
entries.translation: Jagoyo simo: En Januari tarik 1, 1970. Kendo antie e Grand Hotel e taon mar Seattle.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Okay, thank you. Just to clarify, have you had any previous liver problems or biopsies?
entries.translation: Jatich: Kare, erokamano. Mondo walere maber, bende isegabedo gi chandruok mar chuny kata pim mag chuny?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: No, nothing like this before. I'm usually healthy as a horse!
entries.translation: Jagoyo simo: Ooyo, onge gima kamae mane osegatimre. Pile angimaga ahinya!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: That sounds great. Thank you so much, Juan.
entries.translation: Jagoyo simo: Mano ber. Erokamano ahinya, Juan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: You're very welcome, Riaan. Please hold for just a moment while I connect you.
entries.translation: Jatich: Arwaki, Riaan. Riti matin sama atudi gi laktar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Hello Riaan, this is Dr. Otieno. I understand you're experiencing some abdominal pain and nausea, and you're concerned about needing a liver biopsy.
entries.translation: Laktar: Msawa Riaan, an Laktar Otieno. Awinjo ni iyi rami kendo chunyi lewi, kendo idwaro ni opim chuny mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: Yes, that's right. I'm really worried about it.
entries.translation: Jagoyo simo: Ee, en kamano. An gi kibaji ahinya kuom wachno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: Okay, sounds good.
entries.translation: Jagoyo simo: Mano ber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: (The conversation continues with the doctor asking more specific questions about Riaan's symptoms and medical history.)
entries.translation: (Twak dhi nyime ka laktar penjo penjo momedore kuom ranyisi mag Riaan kod weche mag thieth.)
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Check-in Instructions:
entries.translation: Chike mag donjo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Welcome, Mr. Ly. We understand you might have some reservations about seeing a doctor today, and we appreciate you coming in. Please know that your health and well-being are our top priorities.
entries.translation: Orwaki, Migosi Ly. Wawinjo ni iyalo bedo gi luoro moro e wi neno laktar kawuono, kendo waduoko erokamano ni ibiro. Yie ing'e ni ngimani gi ber mari e gima duong' nwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 1. Please have a seat in the waiting area. The doctor will be with you shortly.
entries.translation: 1. Yie ibed piny kama ji riote. Laktar biro neni machiegni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. While you wait, please review and sign the consent forms provided. If you have any questions or concerns about the forms, please don't hesitate to ask the front desk staff.
entries.translation: 2. Sama irito, yie inon kendo iket sei e oboke mag yie ma omiyi. Ka in gi penjo moro amora kata kibaji e wi obokego, yie ipenj jotich manitie e desk mani nyime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. We encourage you to be open and honest with the doctor about your medical history and any concerns you may have. Your input is valuable in helping us provide the best possible care.
entries.translation: 3. Wajiwi mondo ibed thuolo kendo ja adiera gi laktar e wi weche mag thieth machon kod luoro moro amora ma inyalo bedogo. Paro mari ber e konyowa chiwo thieth maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. If you feel uncomfortable at any point during your appointment, please let the doctor or nurse know immediately. We want to ensure you feel safe and respected throughout your visit.
entries.translation: 4. Ka iwinjo ka ok iwinj maber sa asaya e kinde ma ineno laktar, yie inyis laktar kata nas kanyo gi kanyo. Wadwaro mondo iwinj ka oriti maber kendo omiyi luor e kinde duto ma ibiro limowa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thank you for choosing our clinic for your healthcare needs. We look forward to working with you to address your congenital heart defect and improve your overall health.
entries.translation: Erokamano kuom yiero klinik marwa ne dwaro mag ngima mari. Warito tiyo kodi mondo wageng' tuo mar adundoni kendo mondo wakel ber e ngimani duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Office Worker: Good afternoon, Ms. Neumann. How are you today?
entries.translation: Jatij ofis: Osaore, Mikayi Neumann. Idhi nade?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Neumann: I'm doing alright, just a bit busy. I actually need a prescription refill for laparoscopy.
entries.translation: Mikayi Neumann: Adhi maber, mak mana ni adich matin. Adwaro ni mondo omedna yath mar thieth mar laparoskopi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Office Worker: Oh, I understand. Let me check your file. I see you had a laparoscopy procedure performed by Dr. Masangu a few months ago. Was it successful?
entries.translation: Jatij ofis: Oo, awinjo. We ane mondo arang fail mari. Aneno ni nene otimni chenro mar laparoskopi gi Laktar Masangu dweche moko mokalo. Bende notimore maber?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Neumann: Yes, everything went well. But I need a refill for the pain medication prescribed after the surgery.
entries.translation: Mikayi Neumann: Ee, gigo duto nodhi maber. Kata kamano ne adwaro ni mondo omedna yath mar rem ma nondikna bang' yeng'o.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Office Worker: I can definitely help you with that. Do you recall the name of the medication?
entries.translation: Jatij ofis: Anyalo konyi gi mano. Bende inyalo paro nying yadhno?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Neumann: It was Vicodin, I believe.
entries.translation: Mikayi Neumann: Aparo ni ne en Vicodin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Neumann: Oh, I see. How long will that take?
entries.translation: Mikayi Neumann: Ooo, awinjo. Mano biro kawo kinde marom nade?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Office Worker: It shouldn't take too long. Dr. Masangu is usually pretty quick with these requests. I'll send him a message right now and let you know as soon as I hear back.
entries.translation: Jatij ofis: Ok obi kawo seche mang'eny. Laktar Masangu timoga mapiyo ahinya gi kwayo bila gi. Abiro orone ote sani kendo abiro nyisi mapiyo ka ayudo duoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Neumann: Okay, thank you. I'd appreciate that.
entries.translation: Mikayi Neumann: Kare, erokamano. Aduoko erokamano kuom mano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Office Worker: No problem at all. While we wait, is there anything else I can help you with? Perhaps schedule a follow-up appointment?
entries.translation: Jatij ofis: Onge wach. Sama warito, bende nitie gimoro machielo ma anyalo konyigo? Ka chano odiechieng' mar limbe machielo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Neumann: Actually, yes. I was wondering if I could schedule a check-up in a few weeks just to make sure everything is still healing properly.
entries.translation: Mikayi Neumann: Adier, ee. Ne apenjora ka anyalo chano odiechieng' mondo oranga e jumbe matin mabiro mondo wane ka be gimoro amora pod chango maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Office Worker: Absolutely. Let me see what we have available. How about Tuesday, the 15th at 10:00 AM?
entries.translation: Jatij ofis: Adier. We ane odiechieng' mayudore. To tich Ariyo, tarik 15 saa 4:00 okinyi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Neumann: That works perfectly for me.
entries.translation: Mikayi Neumann: Mano ber na ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Office Worker: Great! I'll get that scheduled for you. And I'll keep you posted on the prescription refill.
entries.translation: Jatij ofis: Ber! Abiro chano ni mano. Kendo abiro nyisi okang' ma weche medi yath osechopoe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Neumann: Thank you so much for your help.
entries.translation: Mikayi Neumann: Erokamano ahinya kuom kony mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Office Worker: You're welcome, Ms. Neumann. Have a wonderful day.
entries.translation: Jatij ofis: Arwaki, Mikayi Neumann. Bed gi odiechieng' maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: All right, Ms. Moyo, the doctor will be in shortly. Can you tell me a little more about this chest pain you're experiencing? When did it start?
entries.translation: Nas: Kare, Nyadendi Moyo, laktar biro donjo machiegni. Bende inyalo wacho na maler kuom rem mar kor ma iwinjo? Ne ochakore karang'o?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Moyo: Oh, honey, it started this morning, right after breakfast. Just a tightness, you know? Like something sitting on my chest. And it hasn't let up since.
entries.translation: Nyadendi Moyo: Oo, jaherana, ne ochakore okinyini, mana bang' chiemo mar okinyi. Mana ridruok, ing'eyo? Ka gima gimoro obet e kora. Kendo pok oweya chakre sechego.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: I see. And on a scale of one to ten, with ten being the worst pain imaginable, how would you rate it?
entries.translation: Nas: Awinjo. To kapimo e rapim mar achiel nyaka apar, ka apar e rem malit ahinya manyalore, inyalo pime nade?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Moyo: I'd say about a six or a seven. It's not excruciating, but it's definitely uncomfortable. And I've been feeling a bit short of breath too, especially when I try to walk around.
entries.translation: Nyadendi Moyo: Anyalo wacho ni auchiel kata abiriyo. Ok en rem malit ahinya, kata kamano en gima omiyo ok awinj maber. Kendo asebedo ka awinjo ka muya remna matin bende, to moloyo ka atemo wuotho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Okay, thank you for sharing that. Do you have any history of heart problems in your family?
entries.translation: Nas: Ber, erokamano kuom nyisa mano. Bende in gi sigana moro amora mar chandruok mar adundo e anyuola mari?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Moyo: Well, my daddy had a heart attack when he was in his fifties, and my aunt had high blood pressure. But I've never had any trouble myself, knock on wood.
entries.translation: Nyadendi Moyo: Wuonwa ne otho gi tuo mar chuny kane en gi higni mag piero abich, kendo waya ne nigi presa mamalo mar remo. To an pok abedo gi chandruok moro amora, haw maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Understood. And are you taking any medications currently?
entries.translation: Nas: Awinjo. Bende imuonyo yath moro amora sani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Moyo: Just my blood pressure pills and some vitamins. Oh, and I take ibuprofen for my knees sometimes.
entries.translation: Nyadendi Moyo: Mana yedhena mag presa mar remo kod vitamin moko. Oh, kendo amuonyo ibuprofen nikech chongena seche moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Okay, good to know. The doctor will want to check your blood pressure and listen to your heart and lungs. We might also need to run some tests, like an EKG, to get a better look at what's going on.
entries.translation: Nas: Kare, ber ng'eyo. Laktar biro dwaro pimo presani mar remo kendo winjo adundoni kod obo. Wanyalo dwaro timo pim moko bende, kaka EKG, mondo wanen maber gima timore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Moyo: Whatever you think is best, dear. I just want to make sure it's nothing serious. Being a bit... bigger, I worry about these things more, you know?
entries.translation: Nyadendi Moyo: Gimoro amora ma iparo ni ber, jahera. Adwaro mana bedo gi adiera ni ok en gima rach. Bedo... maduong' matin, an gi kibaji kuom gigi moloyo, ing'eyo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Preparing for Your Lumpectomy
entries.translation: Ikruok ne Yeng'o mar lampektomi
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your upcoming lumpectomy is an important step in managing your health. Because of your complex medical history, careful preparation and adherence to instructions are vital for a successful surgery and recovery.
entries.translation: Yeng'o mari mabiro mar lampektomi en okang' maduong' ahinya e rito ngimani. Nikech ngimani matek mar thieth, ikruok matut kendo luwo chike en gima duong' ahinya mondo yeng'o odhi kare kendo mondo ichang.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Medication Management
entries.translation: Rito Yath
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Continue taking your prescribed medications as directed, unless specifically instructed otherwise by your doctor.
entries.translation: Dhi nyime tiyogi yedhe mondikni kaka ochiki, mak mana ka laktar ema omiyi chike moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inform your doctor immediately of any changes in your medications or new supplements you start taking.
entries.translation: Nyis laktar mari mapiyo ahinya ewi lokruok moro amora e yedhegi kata yedhe manyien ma ichako tiyogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stop taking blood thinners (such as aspirin, warfarin, or clopidogrel) as instructed by your doctor. This may be several days before your surgery.
entries.translation: Wek tiyogi yedhe mamiyo remo weyo poto (kaka aspirin, warfarin, kata clopidogrel) kaka laktar ochiki. Ma nyalo bedo ndalo manok kapok oyang'i.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have diabetes, carefully monitor your blood sugar levels and follow your doctor's instructions regarding insulin or other medications on the day of surgery.
entries.translation: Ka in gi tuo mar sukar, ng'i motang' rom mar sukar e rembi kendo iluw chike laktar ewi insulin kata yedhe mamoko chieng' ma iyang'i.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dietary Restrictions
entries.translation: Gik ma Ok Onego Icham
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do not eat or drink anything after midnight the night before your surgery. This includes water, coffee, and gum.
entries.translation: Kik icham kata madho gimoro amora bang' sa auchiel otieno kapok oyang'i. Ma oriwo pi, kahawa, kod gam.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You may take your morning medications with a small sip of water if instructed by your doctor.
entries.translation: Inyalo muonyo yedhe mokinyi gi pi matin ka laktar ochiko kamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Smoking and Alcohol
entries.translation: Ndawa kod Kong'o
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stop smoking at least 24 hours before your surgery. Smoking can increase the risk of complications and slow down healing.
entries.translation: Kik imadh ndawa saa 24 kapok oyang'i. Madho ndawa nyalo kelo chandruok kendo miyo chango dhi mos.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid alcohol for at least 24 hours before surgery. Alcohol can interact with anesthesia and medications.
entries.translation: Kik imadh kong'o saa 24 kapok oyang'i. Kong'o nyalo ketho yadh anasthesia gi yedhe moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Transportation and Support
entries.translation: Yore Wuoth kod Kony
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Arrange for a responsible adult to drive you home after your surgery. You will not be able to drive yourself.
entries.translation: Tim chenro mondo ng'ato maduong' ma inyalo gen oriembi dhi dalau bang' yeng'o. Ok ibinyalo riembo mtoka in iwuon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Have someone stay with you for the first 24 hours after surgery to help with any needs you may have.
entries.translation: Yie mondo ng'ato obed kodi saa 24 mokwongo bang' yeng'o mondo okonyi gi gima idwaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What to Bring
entries.translation: Gik ma Onego Ibi Godo
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your insurance card and photo ID.
entries.translation: Kadi mari mar okumba kod Opande mari man gi picha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A list of your current medications and dosages.
entries.translation: Chenro mar yedhe ma itiyogo sani kod dos.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Any relevant medical records or test results.
entries.translation: Rekods mamoko mag thieth kata duoko mag pimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Comfortable clothing to wear home.
entries.translation: Lewni ma yot ma inyalo rwako ka idhi dala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Post-Surgery Care
entries.translation: Ritruok Bang' Koseyang'i
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Follow your doctor's instructions regarding wound care, pain management, and activity restrictions.
entries.translation: Luw chike laktar mari ewi rito adhola, rito rem, kod gik ma ok onego itim.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Attend all follow-up appointments as scheduled.
entries.translation: Dhi inen laktar kaka ochan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Report any signs of infection, such as fever, redness, or swelling, to your doctor immediately.
entries.translation: Chiw lupot ne laktar mari sanosano kuom kido moro amora mag tuo, kaka midhusi, liet, kuonde marakwar, kata kuonde maokuot.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By strictly adhering to these instructions, you can help ensure a safe and successful lumpectomy and recovery. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact your doctor's office.
entries.translation: Ka iluwo chike gi kaka dwarore, inyalo konyo mondo yeng'o mari mar lumpektomi odhi kare kendo ichang maber. Ka in gi penjo kata gimoro amora machandi, yie mondo itudri gi ofis laktar mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor Elena Vasquez: Good morning, Mr. Santiago. I see you're back again for another infection. How have you been feeling lately?
entries.translation: Laktar Elena Vasquez: Oyaore, Migosi Santiago. Aneno ni iduogo kendo gi tuo machielo. Isebedo ka iwinjo nade ndalo machiegni?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Arthur Santiago: Not so good, Doctor. It feels like I can't catch a break. Just when one clears up, another one starts. I'm tired all the time.
entries.translation: Migosi Arthur Santiago: Ok maber ahinya, Laktar. Nenore ni ok anyal yudo thuolo mar yueyo. Sama achiel orumo, machielo chakore. Aol seche duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor Nnaji: I understand your frustration, Arthur. Let's take a look at your history. It seems you've had pneumonia twice this year already, and several sinus infections.
entries.translation: Laktar Nnaji: Awinjo chandruokni, Arthur. We warang weche machon mag thieth mari. Nenore ni isebedo gi numonia diriyo higani, kendo isebedo gi tuo mar sinus ding'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Santiago: That's right. And don't forget the urinary tract infection last month. It's been a rough year.
entries.translation: Migosi Santiago: Mano en adier. Kendo kik wiyi wil gi tuo mar yor lach dwe mokalo. En higa mosebedo matek ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor Nnaji: I see. Have you noticed any other symptoms besides the infections? Any weight loss, night sweats, or unusual lumps?
entries.translation: Laktar Nnaji: Awinjo. Be iseneno ranyisi moko mopogore gi tuochego? Be iselalo kilo, luya tuchni gotieno, kata kuot moro amora ma ok mapile?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Santiago: Well, I have lost a bit of weight, maybe ten pounds or so without trying. And sometimes I wake up sweating at night, but I thought it was just the room being too warm.
entries.translation: Migosi Santiago: Ee, aselalo kilo matin, nyalo bedo ni aselalo kilo apar kama ma ok atemo. Kendo seche moko achiew ka luya tuchna gotieno, to ne aparo ni ot e ma liet ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Santiago: What kind of underlying issue are you thinking of, Doctor? Is it serious?
entries.translation: Migosi Santiago: En chandruok mane ma iparo, Laktar? Be en marach?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Santiago: Okay, Doctor. Whatever you think is best. I just want to feel better.
entries.translation: Migosi Santiago: Kare, Laktar. Gima iparo ni ber. Adwaro mana winjo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Santiago: Thank you, Doctor Nnaji. I appreciate your help.
entries.translation: Migosi Santiago: Erokamano, Laktar Nnaji. Amor gi kony mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor Nnaji: You're welcome, Arthur. Take care.
entries.translation: Laktar Nnaji: Orwaki, Arthur. Ritri maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know I should have come sooner, but... I was scared. Scared of what you'd say, scared of what it means. But I can't hide it anymore. Please, Doc, tell me what's happening to me. Tell me there's something you can do.
entries.translation: Ang'eyo ni dine abiro chon, to... ne aluor. Ne aluor gima ibiro wacho, ne aluor ni tiend gino en ang'o. To koro ok anyal pande. Akwayi, Laktar, nyisa gima timorena. Nyisa ni nitie gima inyalo timo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Hello, Officer Reyes. It's good to see you. How are you feeling today?
entries.translation: Laktar: Misawa, Ofisa Reyes. Amor neni. Iwinjo nade kawuono?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Officer Reyes: Honestly, Doctor Endo, I'm not feeling great. I've been battling a nasty cold for a few days now, and it just won't seem to let up.
