entries.translation: Ofisa Reyes: Adier, Laktar Endo, ok awinj maber ahinya. Asebedo ka an gi tuo mar athung’a kuom ndalo manok koro, kendo nenore ni ok odwar weya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I'm sorry to hear that. Colds can be tough, especially when you're trying to juggle work and a new baby. How's breastfeeding going with your little one, Sofia?
entries.translation: Laktar: Mos kuom mano. Athung'a nyalo bedo matek, to ahinya ka itiyo to in nyaka gi nyathi mayom. Dhodho nyathi teri nade, Sofia?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Officer Reyes: It's been going okay, but I'm worried that my cold might affect my milk supply or pass on the illness to her.
entries.translation: Ofisa Reyes: Osebedo kadhi maber, kata kamano aluor ni athung'ana nyalo mona golo chak kata nyalo miye tuono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Officer Reyes: That's a relief to hear. I was really worried about that.
entries.translation: Ofisa Reyes: Winjo mano kelo kue. Ne an gi kibaji ahinya kuom mano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: As for your milk supply, being sick can sometimes cause a temporary dip. Make sure you're staying hydrated, resting as much as possible, and eating nutritious foods.
entries.translation: Laktar: Kuom wach golo chak, bedo matuo samoro nyalo miyo chak wuok matin kuom ndalo matin. Tem mondo imodh pii mang'eny, yue kaka nyalore, kendo icham chiemo makelo ber e dendi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Officer Reyes: I'll definitely try to do that. It's been hard to rest with the baby and work, but I know it's important.
entries.translation: Ofisa Reyes: Abiro temo timo mano. Osebedo matek yudo thuolo mar yueyo to an gi nyathi kendo atiyo, kata kamano ang'eyo ni en gima duong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Absolutely. And don't hesitate to ask for help from your partner or family members if you need it. Taking care of yourself is essential for taking care of Sofia.
entries.translation: Laktar: Adier. Kendo kik iluor kwayo kony koa kuom jaodi kata joodi ka idwaro kony. Ritori en gima duong' ahinya mondo irit Sofia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Officer Reyes: Thank you, Doctor. I appreciate your advice and support.
entries.translation: Ofisa Reyes: Erokamano, Laktar. Amor gi puonj gi kony ma imiya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: You're welcome, Officer Reyes. Let's go ahead with the rest of your exam, and if you have any other questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to ask.
entries.translation: Laktar: Arwaki, Ofisa Reyes. We wadhi nyime gi pim mari modong', kendo ka in gi penjo moro amora kata kibaji, yie kik iluor penjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Officer Reyes: Sounds good. Thank you again.
entries.translation: Ofisa Reyes: Mano ber. Erokamano kendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician Assistant: Good morning, Dr. Adebayo. I understand you're a bit confused about your upcoming procedure. Can you tell me what's going on?
entries.translation: Jakony Laktar: Oyaure, Laktar Adebayo. Awinjo ni wach chenro mabiro midhitimni chochi?. Be inyalo nyisa gima timore?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bosede Adebayo: Honestly, I'm not sure why I'm here. My knee has been hurting, but I don't remember scheduling anything like this.
entries.translation: Bosede Adebayo: Adier, ok ang'eyo gimomiyo antie kae. Chonga osebedo ka rama, to ok apar ka ne achano gimoro ma kama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician Assistant: Okay, let's clarify things. You're scheduled for a radiofrequency ablation, or RFA, procedure today for your knee pain. Remember discussing this with your doctor?
entries.translation: Jakony Laktar: Kare, we waler gigo. Ochan mondo otimni thieth mar radiofrequency ablation, kata RFA, kawuono ne rem mar chongi. Be iparo ka ne iwuoyo e wi mae gi laktar mari?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bosede Adebayo: Oh, right! Yes, the doctor mentioned something about using heat to numb the nerves. Is that what this is?
entries.translation: Bosede Adebayo: Oo, kare! Ee, laktar ne owacho gimoro kuom tiyo gi liet mondo ler otho thudhno. Be mano e gima idwa timni?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician Assistant: Exactly. RFA uses radio waves to generate heat and target specific nerves causing your pain. It can provide long-term relief without surgery.
entries.translation: Jakony Laktar: Mano e en. RFA tiyo gi boche mag radio mondo olos liet ma iketo e leche masie ma kelo rem mari. Onyalo kelo kue mar kinde malach ma ok oyang'i.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bosede Adebayo: That sounds promising. But is it safe? Are there any risks?
entries.translation: Bosede Adebayo: Mano winjore maber. To be ober ma ok okel hinyruok? Be nitie hinyruok moko manyalo wuokie?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bosede Adebayo: Okay, that makes me feel a bit better. What happens during the procedure?
entries.translation: Bosede Adebayo: Kare, mano miyo awinjo maber matin. Ang'o ma timore e kinde mar thieth?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bosede Adebayo: Will I be awake during it?
entries.translation: Bosede Adebayo: Be abiro bedo ka aneno sa thieth?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician Assistant: You'll be awake but sedated to keep you comfortable. You might feel some pressure or mild discomfort during the needle insertion, but it shouldn't be painful.
entries.translation: Jakony Laktar: Ibiro bedo ka ineno makmana ni ibiro miyi yadh keto thudhno mondo kik iwinj rem. Inyalo winjo dicho kata rem matin ka isoko sindan, to ok onego obed malit.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bosede Adebayo: And after the procedure?
entries.translation: Bosede Adebayo: To bang' thieth?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bosede Adebayo: Thank you for explaining everything so clearly. I feel much more informed now.
entries.translation: Bosede Adebayo: Erokamano kuom lero gik moko duto maler. Koro awinjo ka ang'eyo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician Assistant: You're welcome, Dr. Adebayo. It's important to understand your treatment options. If you have any more questions, don't hesitate to ask.
entries.translation: Jakony Laktar: Erokamano, Laktar Adebayo. En gima ber mondo ing'e yore mag thieth ma in go. Ka in gi penjo moko, kik iluor penjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Agent: Hi! This is Elena from HealthHub. Who am I speaking with?
entries.translation: Jachung': Nang'o! Mae en Elena mowuok HealthHub. Awuoyo gi ng'a?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Hi Elena, I'm Miguel Ramirez.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Nang'o Elena, An Miguel Ramirez.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Agent: Hi Miguel! How can I help you today?
entries.translation: Jachung': Nang'o Miguel! Ere kaka anyalo konyi kawuono?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I saw on the news that there's a booster shot available for the flu vaccine and I was wondering if I could schedule an appointment to get one.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Naneno e weche manyien ni nitiere chanjo mar siro chanjo mar homa to napenjo ka anyalo yudo thuolo mar biro mondo ayude.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Agent: Sure, I can help you with that. First, can you verify your date of birth for me?
entries.translation: Jachung': Ee, anyalo konyi gi mano. Mokwongo, inyalo nyisa tarik mari mar nyuol?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: It's March 12, 1945.
entries.translation: Jatuo: En Dwe Mar Adek, tarik 12, 1945.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Agent: Thank you. And just to confirm, have you had your initial flu shot already?
entries.translation: Jachung': Erokamano. Kendo mana mondo anen ni awinji kare, bende iseyudo chanjoni mokuongo mar homa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Yes, I got it a few months ago.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Ee, nayude dweche matin mokalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Agent: Great. And do you have any underlying health conditions that we should be aware of?
entries.translation: Jachung': Ber. Bende in gi tuoche moko ma onego wang'e?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Just high blood pressure, but I'm taking medication for it.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Mana presha mamalo, to amwonyo yath ne mano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Agent: Okay, noted. Let me check our availability for booster shots. It looks like we have some openings next week. Would Tuesday or Thursday work better for you?
entries.translation: Jachung': Kare, awinjo. We ane ka nitie thuolo mar yudo chanjo mar siro.Nenore ni wan gi thuolo moko juma mabiro. Bende Tich Ariyo kata Tich Ang'wen nyalo bedo maber kodi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Tuesday would be great. Do you have anything in the morning?
entries.translation: Jatuo: Tich Ariyo nyalo bedo maber. Bende un gi thuolo e seche mag okinyi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Agent: Yes, we have an opening at 10:00 AM. Does that work for you?
entries.translation: Jatuo: Ee, wan gi thuolo saa 4:00 okinyi. Bende mano ber kodi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Perfect.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Ber ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Agent: Alright, Miguel. You're all set for your booster shot on Tuesday at 10:00 AM. We'll send you a confirmation email with all the details. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
entries.translation: Jagoro: Kare, Miguel. Osechan ni chanjoni mar siro Tich Ariyo saa 4:00 okinyi. Wabiro oroni imel ma jiwo wachni mani kod weche duto. Bende nitie gimoro amora ma anyalo konyigo kawuono?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: No, that's it. Thank you so much, Elena.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Ooyo, mano kende. Erokamano ahinya, Elena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Agent: You're welcome, Miguel. Have a great day!
entries.translation: Jagoro: Aruaki, Miguel. Bed gi odiechieng' maber!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse Practitioner: Mr. Adeyemi, I understand you sustained an injury while working on a neonatal sepsis case. Can you tell me more about what happened?
entries.translation: Nas mar thieth: Migosi Adeyemi, awinjo ni ne ihinyori sama ne ithiedho nyathi mayom manigi tuo mar sepsis. Be inyalo nyisa mathoth ewi gima ne otimore?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tunde Adeyemi: It was... chaotic. We were rushing to get the baby stabilized, and I... I tripped over some equipment. Cut my hand pretty badly on a scalpel that had fallen.
entries.translation: Tunde Adeyemi: Ne... ne en gima tek ahinya. Ne warikni mondo waket nyathino oduog kare, kendo an... ne achwanyora e gige tich moko. Ne ang'ado lweta malit gi pala moro mane olwar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tunde Adeyemi: Is there... a risk for the baby? Or me?
entries.translation: Tunde Adeyemi: Be nitie... masira manyalore kuom nyathi? Kata an?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tunde Adeyemi: I feel terrible. It was just... a stupid accident.
entries.translation: Tunde Adeyemi: Awinjo marach. Ne en mana... masira marach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse Practitioner: Accidents happen, Mr. Adeyemi, especially in high-stress situations. Right now, our priority is your health and preventing any complications from this injury. Let's get this cleaned up.
entries.translation: Nas mar thieth: Masiche timorega, Migosi Adeyemi, ahinya sama nitie thagruok mang'eny. Sani, gima duong'  en ngima mari kendo geng'o masira moro amora ma nyalo wuok e hinyruok ni. We waluoke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient Instructions for Prenatal Screening Tests:
entries.translation: Chike Mag Jatuo Ewi Pim mitimone Joma Yach:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remember, these instructions are general guidelines. Always consult with your healthcare provider for personalized advice and specific instructions based on your individual situation.
entries.translation: Par ni, chikegi gin matiyo kum ji duto. Kinde te lalri gi jathieth mari mondo omiyi paro kod chike mowinjore kodi in iwuon ka luwore gi chal mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Mr. Kariuki," Dr. Zhao said, his voice calm and steady, a stark contrast to the butterflies doing the tango in my stomach. "How are you feeling?"
entries.translation: "Migosi Kariuki," Laktar Zhao nowacho, dwonde ne okwe kendo ne otegno, mopogore ahinya gi iya mane ludre ahinya. "Iwinjo nade?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Feeling?" I stammered, trying to sound brave but failing miserably. "Like a punctured tire, Doc. Like someone let all the air out of me."
entries.translation: "Awinjo?" Ne adwoko ka dwonda ng'adore, ne atemo mondo awuo ka ng'ama jachir to ne otamre chuth. "Chalo tail motuch, Laktar. Ka gima ng'ato nogolo muya duto mowuok kuoma."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Zhao nodded sympathetically, his eyes crinkling at the corners. "That's understandable, Godbless. Lung surgery is a major procedure. It takes time to recover."
entries.translation: Laktar Zhao noyiengo wiye gi ng'wono, ka kona mag wengene ojowre. "Mano winjore, Godbless. Yang'o obo en chenro maduong'. Kawoga seche mondo ng'ato ochang."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "The good news," Dr. Zhao continued, "is that we were able to remove the tumor completely. And the lymph nodes were clear."
entries.translation: "Wach maber," Laktar Zhao nomedo, "en ni ne wanyalo golo tuma no duto. Kendo limf nod nene ler."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My heart skipped a beat. Clear? Did that mean... cancer-free?
entries.translation: Chunya ne olikni matin. Ler? Bende mano ne nyiso... aonge gi kansa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Does that mean I'm cured?" I blurted out, hope blooming in my chest like a stubborn dandelion.
entries.translation: "Bende mano nyiso ni achango?" Ne awacho mapiyo, geno ne pong'o chunya ka maua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Zhao smiled gently. "It's a very good sign, Godbless. But we'll need to keep monitoring you closely. Regular check-ups, scans... just to be safe."
entries.translation: Laktar Zhao nobwonjo mos. "En ranyisi maber ahinya, Godbless. To wabiro dwaro mondo wasiki ka warangi machiegni. Pimo dendi seche duto, piche... mana mondo wanen ni gik moko ber."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Thank you, Doc," I said, my voice thick with emotion. "Thank you for everything."
entries.translation: "Erokamano, Laktar," ne awacho, dwonda ne chalo mar ng'ama dwa ywak. "Erokamano kuom gikmoko duto."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Zhao patted my shoulder reassuringly. "You're a fighter, Godbless. You'll get through this."
entries.translation: Laktar Zhao nopado goka mos mondo ojiwa. "In jalweny, Godbless. Ibiro loyo mae."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And as I walked out of the office, the sun shining brighter than it had in months, I believed him. I was Peter Kariuki, mail carrier extraordinaire, and I wasn't going down without a fight.
entries.translation: Kendo kane awuok e ofis, chieng' ne rieny maler moloyo kaka ne osebedo korieny e dweche mokalo, ne ayie kuome. Ne an Peter Kariuki, jater barupe malich, kendo ne ok adhi lwar ka ok agoyo lweny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse Thompson: Good morning, Captain Rallapalli. Please, take a seat. How are you feeling today?
entries.translation: Nas Thompson: Oyaore Captain Rallapalli. Yie ibed piny. Iwinjo nade kawuono?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Captain Rallapalli: Honestly, Nurse Thompson, not great. I've been feeling unusually fatigued lately, and my wife noticed I've been looking a bit pale.
entries.translation: Captain Rallapalli: Adier, Nas Thompson, awinjo marach. Asebedo ka awinjo kaol ahinya ndalogi, kendo chiega nofwenyo ni rangi mar denda opogore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse Thompson: I see. Have you experienced any lightheadedness or shortness of breath?
entries.translation: Nas Thompson: Awinjo. Be isebedo kiwinjo ka wiyi yot kata ka muchi ng'adore?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Captain Rallapalli: A little bit, especially when I stand up quickly. And I've been having trouble concentrating, which is concerning given my profession.
entries.translation: Captain Rallapalli: Matin, to moloyo ka achung' apoya. Kendo asebedo ka okanyal keto pacha e gimoro, ma en gima lich kaluwore gi tija.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse Thompson: I understand. Let's check your vitals. Your blood pressure is a bit low, and your heart rate is slightly elevated. Have you been eating and drinking normally?
entries.translation: Nas Thompson: Awinjo. We wapimi. Presa mari mar remo ni piny matin, kendo adundo mari gwecho matek matin. Be isebedo ka ichiemo kendo modho kaka pile?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Captain Rallapalli: Not really. My appetite hasn't been great, and I've been forgetting to drink water.
entries.translation: Captain Rallapalli: Ooyo. Gombona mar chiemo pok obedo maber, kendo asebedo ka wiya wil gi modho pi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Good morning, Saloua. I've reviewed your recent lab results following the removal of the foreign body from your finger.
entries.translation: Laktar: Oyaore Saloua. Aseneno duoko mag pimo mane owuok machiegni bang' golo gimoro ei lith lweti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Saloua: Hi, Dr. Tang. That's good to hear. What did the results show?
entries.translation: Saloua: Oyaore Laktar Tang. Mano ber winjo. Ang'o mane duoko nyiso?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: The lab analysis confirmed that the object removed was indeed a small splinter of wood, consistent with what you described happening while working in your garden.
entries.translation: Laktar: Duoko nyiso ni gino mane ogol en yien matin, masiro gima niwacho ni notimore ka nitiyo e puothi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Saloua: That's a relief. I was worried it might be something more serious.
entries.translation: Saloua: Mano ber ahinya. Ne aluor ni nyalo bedo gimoro marach moloyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Understandable. The good news is there are no signs of infection in the surrounding tissue, and the wound is healing nicely.
entries.translation: Laktar: Awinjo. Gima ber en ni onge ranyisi mar tuoche mamoko e aluora mar ring'o no, kendo adhola chango maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Saloua: That's great news. Does this mean I can stop taking the antibiotics you prescribed?
entries.translation: Saloua: Mano ber ahinya. Bende mano nyiso ni anyalo weyo muonyo yadh antibayotik mane imiya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Yes, you can discontinue the antibiotics now. However, keep the wound clean and covered for another couple of days just to be safe.
entries.translation: Laktar: Ee, sani inyalo weyo yadh antibayotik. Kata kamano, rit adhola mondo obed maler kendo iume kuom ndalo moko ariyo kende mondo obed maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Saloua: Will do. Is there anything else I should be aware of?
entries.translation: Saloua: Abiro timo kamano. Bende nitie gimoro amora monego ang'e?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Just monitor the area for any redness, swelling, or increased pain, although I don't anticipate any complications given how well it's healing.
entries.translation: Laktar: Mana rang'o adhola ka po ni dobed makwar, okuot, kata ka obedo malit moloyo, kata obedo ni ok apar ni gimoro amora marach nyalo timore nikech kaka ochango maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Saloua: Okay, sounds good. Thank you, Dr. Tang.
entries.translation: Saloua: Kare, ber. Erokamano Laktar Tang.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: You're welcome, Saloua. If you have any concerns or questions later on, don't hesitate to reach out.
entries.translation: Laktar: Arwaki, Saloua. Ka in gi luoro kata penjo moro amora bang'e, kik ilew tudori koda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Saloua: I appreciate that. Thanks again for your help.
entries.translation: Saloua: Amor gi mano. Erokamano kendo kuom kony mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Not a problem. Take care, Saloua.
entries.translation: Laktar: Onge wach. Ritri maber, Saloua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instructions for Managing COPD Before Your Surgery
entries.translation: Chike mag Rit mar COPD Kapok Idhi e Yang'o
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. Get Enough Sleep: Aim for 7-8 hours of quality sleep each night. Sleep is essential for your body to heal and repair itself. Establish a regular sleep schedule and create a relaxing bedtime routine.
entries.translation: 5. Nind Moromo: Tem nindo maber seche 7-8 otieno ka otieno. Nindo ber ne dendi mondo ochang kendo olosre. Ket chenro mar nindo kendo los chenro mar nindo ma hoyo chunyi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 6. Avoid Triggers: Identify and avoid things that worsen your COPD symptoms, such as air pollution, dust, pollen, and strong odors. If possible, stay indoors on days with poor air quality.
entries.translation: 6. We Gik ma Medo Tuo: Fweny kendo we gik ma medo tuoni mar COPD, kaka yamo ma ochido, buru, polen, kod tik mang'we. Ka nyalore, bed e ot e ndalo ma yamo ok ler.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 7. Practice Breathing Exercises: Your doctor or a respiratory therapist can teach you breathing exercises that can help improve your lung capacity and reduce shortness of breath. Practice these exercises regularly.
entries.translation: 7. Tim orako mar Yueyo: Laktar mari kata ng'at ma olony e weche yueyo nyalo puonji timo orako mar yueyo ma nyalo konyo medo teko mar obo kod duoko piny muya marem. Tim orako gi kinde ka kinde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 8. Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water throughout the day to keep your mucus thin and easier to cough up. Avoid excessive caffeine and alcohol, as they can dehydrate you.
entries.translation: 8. Madh Pi: Madh pi mang'eny e odiechieng' duto mondo omi othinyo obed mareprep kendo mayot golo kifuolo. We madho kahawa kod kong'o mang'eny, nikech ginyalo miyo ibed ma ionge pi e dendi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 9. Manage Stress: Stress can worsen COPD symptoms. Find healthy ways to manage stress, such as yoga, meditation, or spending time in nature.
entries.translation: 9. We Paro mang'eny: Paro mang'eny nyalo medo tuoni mar COPD. Yud yo maber mar weyo paro mang'eny, kaka yoga, bet mos kama iling', kata bedo oko kaka e tie yien kata nam.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 10. Keep Your Appointments: Attend all your pre-operative appointments and follow your doctor's instructions carefully. This will help ensure you're in the best possible condition for surgery.
entries.translation: 10. Rit Chenro mar neno Laktar: Dhi e chenro duto mochan kapok idhi e yang'o kendo ti gi chike laktar maber. Mae biro konyo  chal mar dendi obed maber moloyo ne yeng'o.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions or concerns about managing your COPD before surgery, don't hesitate to ask your doctor or nurse. We're here to help you every step of the way.
entries.translation: Ka in gi penjo moro amora kata paro e wi rito COPD mari kapok idhi e yeng'o, kik iluor penjo laktar kata nas mari. Wan ka mondo wakonyi e okenge te.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stay strong, Chunyan Cheng! You've got this.
entries.translation: Bed gi teko, Chunyan Cheng! Inyalo timo mae.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Subject: Urgent Referral: Sophia Morales - Severe Muscle Weakness and Pain
entries.translation: Wach Maduong': Oro Iri Sophia Morales - Rem kod Nyosruok Mager e Puch
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please contact me immediately to discuss Sophia's case further and coordinate her referral.
entries.translation: Yie itudri koda mapiyo mondo wawuo kuom wach Sophia kendo wachan kaka ibiro ore iri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sincerely,
entries.translation: Gi luoro,
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Social Worker
entries.translation: Jatij Oganda
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Given the seriousness of missing work for an annual physical exam, it is imperative that you strictly adhere to the following instructions. Failure to do so may result in disciplinary action from your employer.
entries.translation: Nikech ok en gima yot koso dhi e tich mondo idhi otimni pim mar dendi mitimoga higa ka higa, en gima duong' mondo iluw chike maluwogi. Ka ok itimo kamano ng'ama ondiki tich nyalo miyi kum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. Do not return to work until you have received clearance from Dr. Conti. This clearance will be provided in the form of a signed doctor's note, which you must present to Mr. Moshi upon your return.
entries.translation: 2. Kik idog e tich nyaka Laktar Conti miyi rusa. Rusa ni ibiro chiw  e yo mar barup laktar manigi sei, ma nyaka imi Migosi  Moshi chieng' ma iduogo e tich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. While you are absent from work, you are strictly prohibited from engaging in any strenuous physical activity. This includes exercise, sports, and heavy lifting. Rest is essential for your recovery.
entries.translation: 3. Sa ma ok idhi e tich, kik itim tich moro amora matek. Ma oriwo; orako, tuke kod ting'o gik mapek. Yueyo en gima konyo  kuom chango mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. Schedule a follow-up appointment with Dr. Conti within the next week to monitor your progress and determine when you can safely return to work.
entries.translation: 5. Ket chenro mar dok ir Laktar Conti e juma mabiro mondo onen kaka idhi kendo mondo oyang ka po ni inyalo dok e tich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 6. Provide a copy of the doctor's note to your Human Resources department for their records.
entries.translation: 6. Ter fotokopi mar barup laktar e ofis ma ochung' ne jotich mondo oket e rekod mag gi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remember, your health is paramount. By following these instructions, you can ensure a swift and full recovery while minimizing any negative impact on your employment.
entries.translation: Par, ngima mari en gima duong'. Ka iluwo chike gi to ibiro chango piyo kendo ibiro geng'o chandruok moro amora manyalo timore e tich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Hello?" a voice on the other end says. "This is Dr. Kinsley. How can I help you today?"
entries.translation: "Halo?" dwol moro wacho e wi simu. "Ma en Laktar Kinsley. Ere kaka anyalo konyi kawuono?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Hi, Dr. Kinsley," I manage to say, my voice trembling a little. "I'm trying to quit smoking, and I'm really struggling. I'm sweating like crazy, my chest hurts, and I just feel awful."
entries.translation: "Halo, Laktar Kinsley," awacho, ka dwonda tetni matin. "Atemo weyo madho ndawa, kendo aseyudo ka tekna ahinya. Luya tuchna mang'eny ahinya, kora rama, kendo awinjo marach ahinya."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I take a deep breath, trying to steady myself. "I've been smoking for over forty years," I admit. "About a pack a day. Sometimes more if I'm stressed."
entries.translation: Aywayo muya matut, ka atemo yudo teko. "Asebedo ka amadho ndawa kuom higni mokalo piero ang'wen," Ayie. "Paket achiel e odiechieng'. Seche moko mang'eny ne mano ka an gi parruok."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Okay," Dr. Kinsley says. "That's a long time. But it's never too late to quit. We have a lot of options to help you manage the cravings and withdrawal symptoms. Have you tried anything in the past?"
entries.translation: "Kare," Laktar Kinsley wacho. "Mano en kinde malach. Kata kamano podi okolewo weyo. Wan gi yore mang'eny manyalo konyi loyo gombo kod ranyisi mag weyo. Isetemo gimoro amora chon?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I tried cold turkey a few times," I say. "But I always ended up going back to it. The cravings were just too strong."
entries.translation: "Nasetemo weyo apoya ndalo matin," Awacho. "To nasiko ka adokie. Gombo nene pek ahinya."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I listen intently, feeling a glimmer of hope. Maybe this time will be different. Maybe with Dr. Kinsley's help, I can finally kick this habit for good.
entries.translation: Achiko ita maber, ka awinjo geno matin. Nyalo bedo ni kindeni biro bedo mopogore. Nyalo bedo ni gi kony mar Laktar Kinsley, anyalo weyo timni nyaka chieng'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That sounds good," I say. "I'm willing to try anything."
entries.translation: "Mano winjore maber," Awacho. "An gi yie mar temo gimoro amora."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Great," Dr. Kinsley says. "Let's start by getting some basic information from you, and then we can discuss the best treatment plan for your specific needs."
entries.translation: "Ber ahinya," Laktar Kinsley wacho. "We wachak gi yudo weche moko kuomi, kae to wanyalo wuoyo kuom chenro maber mar thieth maber kodi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I answer Dr. Kinsley's questions, I feel a sense of relief wash over me. I'm not alone in this anymore. I have a plan, and I have support. And maybe, just maybe, I can finally breathe easy again.
entries.translation: Sama aduoko penjo mag Laktar Kinsley, awinjo ka chunya kue. Ok an kenda e wachni kendo. An gi chenro, kendo an gi kony. Kendo nyalo bedo, nyalo anyalo bedo, ni anyalo yueyo mayot kendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient Education Handout: Weight Management and Dementia
entries.translation: Oboke Mar Puonjo Jatuo: Rito Kilo mar del kod Tuo Mar Wich Wil
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some key points to consider:
entries.translation: Eri weche madongo ma inyalo keto e paro:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remember, every step towards a healthier weight is a step towards a better quality of life. Be patient with yourself and seek support when needed. You are not alone in this journey.
entries.translation: Par ni, okang' moro amora ma itimo mar yudo kilo maber en okang' mar yudo ngima maber. Bed gi kinda kendo ikwa kony ka dwarore. Ok in kendi e wuodhni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For more information or personalized advice, please contact your healthcare provider or a registered dietitian.
entries.translation: Ne yudo weche momedore kata puonj mowinjore kodi, yie itudri gi laktar mari kata ng'at ma olony e weche mag chiemo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sincerely,
entries.translation: Mari Modimbore,
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your Healthcare Team
entries.translation: Tim mari mar weche thieth
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I understand your concern, Ms. Kovačić. Let's go through your history carefully. Can you tell me about your previous conditions?
entries.translation: Laktar: Awinjo kibaji ma in go, Mikayi Kovačić. Wanyalo chako gi nono weche magi machon mos. Be inyalo nyisa kuom tuoche mane in go chon?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Well, I have lupus, which flares up sometimes, and I also have type 1 diabetes. Managing my blood sugar has been a struggle lately.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Ee, an gi tuo mar lupus, ma biroga mager kendo seche moko, kendo an gi tuo mar sukar mar kido 1. Rito sukar e remba osebedo tich matek e ndalogi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Those are significant conditions to manage during pregnancy. Have you been seeing specialists for these?
entries.translation: Laktar: Mago gin tuoche madongo ma nyaka irit maber ka iyach. Be iseneno jolony kuom tuochegi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Yes, Dr. Tanaka for my lupus and Dr. Moloi for my diabetes. They've been adjusting my medications, but I still feel exhausted all the time.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Ee, Laktar Tanaka ne tuo mar lupus kod Laktar Moloi ne tuo mar sukar. Gisebedo ka giloko yath ma amatiyogo, to pod awinjo ka aol seche duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: We'll need to coordinate closely with them. How about your heart? I see a note about a previous arrhythmia.
entries.translation: Laktar: Biro dwarore mondo wati kanyachiel kodgi. To adundo mari dhi nade? Aneno ndiko moro kuom arrhythmia mane in go chon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Yes, I had an ablation a few years ago. It's been mostly fine, but sometimes I get palpitations when I'm stressed.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Ee, ne an gi ablation higni moko mokalo. Asebedo maber, mak mana ni seche moko adundona gocho matek ka aparora mang'eny.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Okay, we'll definitely monitor that closely. And your thyroid? I see you're on levothyroxine.
entries.translation: Laktar: Kare, wabiro luwe machiegni. To tairoid mari? Aneno ni imuonyo levothyroxine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Yes, I have Hashimoto's. My levels have been fluctuating a lot recently, which adds to the fatigue.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Ee, an gi Hashimoto's. Rom mare osebedo ka lokore ahinya e ndalogi, ma miyo aol moloyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: We'll need to check your thyroid levels frequently. Anything else I should know about?
entries.translation: Laktar: Dwarore ni wapim rom mar tairoid mari kinde ka kinde. Be nitie gimoro machielo ma onego ang'e?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I also have asthma, but it's usually well-controlled. Lately, though, I've been feeling a bit short of breath.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Bende an gi asthma, to arite maber. Kata kamano e ndalogi, asebedo ka awinjo ka mucha rumo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: We'll keep an eye on that too. With all these factors, we'll need a comprehensive plan for your prenatal care and delivery.
entries.translation: Laktar: Wabiro rango mano bende. Gi wechegi duto, wabiro dwaro chenro maber mar ritruok sama iyach kendo gi sama inyuol.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Thank you, Doctor. I just want to make sure the baby and I are both safe.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Erokamano, Laktar. Adwaro mana bedo gi adier ni nyathi koda wan maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: We'll do everything we can to ensure a healthy pregnancy for you both. Let's start by reviewing your current medications and scheduling some tests.
entries.translation: Laktar: Wabiro timo duto ma wanyalo mondo wanen ni ich mari obedo maber ne un uduto. Wanyalo chako gi neno yath ma imuonyo sani kendo timo pim moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician: Good morning, Ms. Elara Voss. I see you're here for your DOT physical and colon cancer screening.
entries.translation: Laktar: Oyaore, Mikayi Elara Voss. Aneno ni ibiro kae ne pimo mar DOT kaachiel gi pimo tuo mar kansa mar ich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elara: Yes, that's right. My husband, Kaelen, insisted on coming with me. He's been a bit worried.
entries.translation: Elara: Ee, mano kare. Chuora, Kaelen, noramo ni nyaka obi koda. Osebedo ka owinjo kibaji matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kaelen: I just want to make sure everything is okay. We've heard some scary things about colon cancer.
entries.translation: Kaelen: Adwaro mana ni mondo abed gadier ni gik moto duto dhi maber. Wasebedo kawawinjo weche malich kuom tuo mar kansa mar ich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elara: Not really, just some occasional back pain from sitting at my desk all day.
entries.translation: Elara: Ooyo, mana ng'eya ema ramaga seche moko nikech abedo piny e mesana odiechieng' duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician: Okay, we'll make a note of that. And any family history of colon cancer?
entries.translation: Laktar: Kare, wabiro ndiko mano piny. Bende nitiere ng'ato ang'ata e anyuola ma ne nigi kansa mar ich?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elara: My grandfather had it, but he was much older when he was diagnosed.
entries.translation: Elara: Kwarwa ne nikode, kata kamano ne hike osemedore ahinya kane oyudego.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician: That's helpful information. We'll definitely take that into consideration. Now, let's proceed with the physical exam.
entries.translation: Laktar: Mano en wach makonyo. Wabiro kete e paro. koro, wadhi nyime gi pimo dendi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [After the physical exam]
entries.translation: [Bang' pimo del]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kaelen: Is it painful?
entries.translation: Kaelen: Bende olit?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician: Most people don't find it painful, but you will be sedated during the procedure to ensure your comfort.
entries.translation: Laktar: Ji mang'eny ok winj lit, kata kamano ibiro miyi yath mamiyi nindo sama itimoni chenro no mondo kik iwinj lit.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elara: Okay, that sounds reasonable. When can we schedule it?
entries.translation: Elara: Kare, mano winjore. Wachan obed chieng' mane?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician: We can schedule it for next week. Would that work for you?
entries.translation: Laktar: Wanyalo timo chenro mar juma mabiro. Bende mano biro bedo maber ne i?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elara: Yes, that works.
entries.translation: Elara: Ee, mano ber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician: Great. We'll get everything set up for you. Do you have any other questions?
entries.translation: Laktar: Ber ahinya. Wabiro ikoni gik moko duto. Bende in gi penjo moro amora?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kaelen: No, I think that covers it. Thank you for explaining everything.
entries.translation: Kaelen: Ooyo, aparo ni mano oromo. Erokamano kuom lero gik moko duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician: You're welcome. It's important to stay on top of your health. We'll see you next week for the colonoscopy.
entries.translation: Laktar: Arwaki En gima ber rito ngimani. Wabiro neni juma mabiro ne pim mar kolonoskopi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Log entry, 14:32.
entries.translation: Ndiko mar odiechieng', 14:32.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Eldridge: Good morning, Mrs. Thorne. I understand you have some concerns about your menstrual cycle?
entries.translation: Laktar Eldridge: Oyaore, Mikayi. Thorne. Ayudo ni paro chandi kuom kinde magi mag dwe?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Thorne: I understand, but the pain is really affecting my daily life. I just want to see someone who can help me figure this out quickly.
entries.translation: Mikayi Thorne: Awinjo, makmana ni remno chando ngimana ma pile ahinya. Adwaro mana neno ng'at ma nyalo konya ng'eyo tiend wechegi mapiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Thorne: Alright, Doctor. I trust your judgment. But please, let's get to the bottom of this as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Mikayi Thorne: Kare, Laktar. Ageno yiero mari. Kata kamano, yie, wang'e tiend wachni mapiyo kaka nyalore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Eldridge: Absolutely. We'll do everything we can to get you feeling better soon.
entries.translation: Laktar Eldridge: Adier. Wabiro timo duto ma wanyalo mondo iwinj maber mapiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician: Good morning, Ms. Rostami. I see from your records that you're here for a follow-up regarding your sleep apnea. How have you been feeling since we last spoke?
entries.translation: Laktar: Oyaore, Mikayi Rostami. Aneno e rekode magi ni ibiro kae ne thieth mari mar chandruok nindo. Iwinjo nade nyaka ne wawuoyo mogik?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Rostami: Honestly, not great. I'm still waking up feeling exhausted, and my partner says I snore really loudly and sometimes stop breathing in my sleep.
entries.translation: Mikayi Rostami: Kuom adier, ok adhi maber. Pod achiewo ka aol, kendo jaoda wacho ni atwaro matek ahinya kendo seche moko aweyo yueyo sama anindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician: I understand. That is concerning. We need to get a better picture of what's going on. Have you noticed any other symptoms, such as morning headaches, difficulty concentrating during the day, or mood changes?
entries.translation: Laktar: Awinjo. Mano lich. Onego wang’e gima timore maber. Bende iseneno ranyisi mamoko, kaka wich bar gokinyi, tek mar keto pachi kuom gima itimo odiechieng’, kata lokruok kaka iwinjo e chunyi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Rostami: Yeah, definitely. I have headaches almost every morning, and I find it hard to focus at work. My mood has been pretty low lately too.
entries.translation: Mikayi Rostami: Ee, adier. Wiya bara chiegni gokinyi duto, kendo ayudo ka tekna keto pacha e tich. Chunya bende tinde osebedo ka opong' gi kuyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Rostami: I try to, but sometimes it's just so uncomfortable. The mask leaks air, and the pressure feels too high.
entries.translation: Mikayi  Rostami: Atemo, to seche moko awinjo marach ka atiyo kode. Mask no golo muya, kendo presa no awinjo ka ng'eny ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Rostami: Okay, I'm willing to try anything that might help.
entries.translation: Mikayi  Rostami: Kare, aikora mar temo gimoro amora manyalo konyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Rostami: Alright, I'll do my best. Thanks, doctor.
entries.translation: Mikayi Rostami: Kare, abiro temo. Erokamano, laktar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physician: You're welcome, Ms. Rostami. We'll get to the bottom of this and find a solution that works for you. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any further questions or concerns.
entries.translation: Laktar: Orwaki, Mikayi Rostami. Wabiro neno gima timore kendo wabiro yudo yo manyalo konyi. Kik iwe tudri kodwa ka in gi penjo moro amora kata kibaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Hello, Mr. and Mrs. Kowalski. What brings you in today?
entries.translation: Laktar: Nang'o Migosi gi Mikayi Kowalski. Ang'o makelou kawuono?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I'm sweating a lot and feeling really shaky.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Luya tuchna ahinya kendo awinjo ka atetni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: When did these symptoms start?
entries.translation: Laktar: Ranyisi magi nochako karang'o?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: About an hour ago, right after I took my new medication.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Machiegni gi sa achiel mokalo, mana bang' ka ne asemuonyo yadha manyien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spouse: We're really worried, Doctor. He's been acting so strange.
entries.translation: Jaod Jatuo: Wan gi kibaji ahinya, Laktar. Osebedo ka otimo timbe moko magalagala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I understand your concern. Let me check your vitals and see what's going on. Mr. Kowalski, please have a seat on the exam table.
entries.translation: Laktar: Ang'eyo ni uluor. We mondo apim dendi ane gima timore. Migosi Kowalski, yie ibed piny e mesa mar pim.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Okay.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Kare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Your blood pressure is a little high, and your heart rate is elevated. Are you experiencing any other symptoms, like nausea or dizziness?
entries.translation: Laktar: Presha mar rembi ni malo matin, kendo aduondo mari gocho matek mokalo. Be iwinjo ranyisi mamoko, kaka chuny malemo kata kawirawira?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: A little bit dizzy, yeah.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Kawirawira matin, ee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Okay. It's possible that you're having a reaction to the medication. I'm going to prescribe you something to help with the sweating and shakiness, and I want you to stop taking the new medication immediately.
entries.translation: Laktar: Kare. Nyalore ni mano ikelo gi yath. Adhi ndikoni gimoro mabiro konyo  gi luya kod tetni, kendo adwaro ni iwe tiyo gi yath manyien no sanisani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spouse: Thank you, Doctor. We'll do that.
entries.translation: Jaod Jatuo: Erokamano, Laktar. Wabiro timo kamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: You're welcome. If your symptoms worsen or don't improve, please don't hesitate to come back or go to the emergency room.
entries.translation: Laktar: Orwaki. Ka ranyisi magi omedore kata ok ochango, yie kik iluor duogo kata dhi e od  joma oyudo masira mapiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Thanks, Doctor.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Erokamano, Laktar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spouse: We really appreciate your help.
entries.translation: Jaod Jatuo: Wamor ahinya gi kony mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's frustrating not being able to do the things I used to. I just want to be able to walk without wincing, maybe even get back out in the garden a bit. Hopefully, this new treatment can help.
entries.translation: En gima chando chuny ka ok anyal timo gik mane ajatimo. Adwaro mana ni abed ni anyalo wuotho ma ok awinjo rem, kendo anyalo dok e puodho matin. Ageno  ni thieth manyien ni nyalo konyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Aaliyah Patel: Good morning, Mr. and Mrs. Kim. I'm Dr. Khumalo. I understand Mr. Kim was injured at work yesterday?
entries.translation: Laktar Aaliyah Patel: Oyaore uru, Migosi gi Mikayi Kim. An Laktar Khumalo. Awinjo ni Migosi Kim ne oyudo hinyruok e tich nyoro?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Jin-Woo Kim: Yes, that's right. I was moving some boxes and I felt a sharp pain in my back.
entries.translation: Migosi Jin-Woo Kim: Ee, kamano. Ne adaro sanduge moko eka ne awinjo rem matek e ng'eya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Min-ji Kim: He's been having trouble breathing ever since, doctor. And with the baby coming soon... we're just so worried.
entries.translation: Mikayi Min-ji Kim: Osebedo gi chandruok e yueyo chakre kanyo, laktar. To gi nyathi mabiro machiegni... wan mana gi kibaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Khumalo: I understand your concern. Let's start by examining your back, Mr. Kim. Can you tell me where exactly the pain is?
entries.translation: Laktar Khumalo: Awinjo kibaji mari. We wachak gi pim mar ng'eyi, Migosi Kim. Inyalo nyisa ni en kanye sie ma rem nitie?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Kim: It's right here, in the lower part of my back.
entries.translation: Migosi Kim: Entie ka, e piny ng'eya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Khumalo: Okay. And how would you describe the pain? Is it sharp, dull, aching?
entries.translation: Laktar Khumalo: Kare. To inyalo lero rem no nade? Ochuopo, otin, oguecho?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Kim: It's sharp, especially when I move.
entries.translation: Migosi Kim: Ochuopo, ahinya ahinya ka asudo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Khumalo: I see. And have you had any shortness of breath before this injury?
entries.translation: Laktar Khumalo: Aneno. To nisebedo gi pek mar yueyo kanepok ihinyri?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Kim: No, not really. I mean, I get a little winded sometimes, but nothing like this.
entries.translation: Migosi Kim: Ooyo, ok kamano. Gima awacho, mucha chotga seche moko, to ok machalo kama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Khumalo: Okay. I'd like to listen to your lungs now. Please take a deep breath in and out for me.
entries.translation: Laktar Khumalo: Kare. Daher chiko ita e oboyeni koro. Yie iyuena matut aeto igol muya oko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: (Dr. Khumalo listens to Mr. Kim's lungs with a stethoscope.)
entries.translation: (Laktar Khumalo chiko ite e obo Migosi Kim gi stethoskop.)
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Khumalo: Mr. Kim, I hear some wheezing in your lungs. Have you ever been diagnosed with asthma or any other lung condition?
entries.translation: Laktar Khumalo: Migosi Kim, Awinjo ka oboyeni golo koko moro. Osegayud ni in gi athma kata tuo moro amora mar obo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Kim: No, never.
entries.translation: Migosi Kim: Ooyo, podi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Khumalo: Alright. Given your symptoms and the wheezing, I'm concerned that you may have developed chronic lung disease. This can be caused by exposure to dust, fumes, or other irritants in the workplace.
entries.translation: Laktar Khumalo: Kare. Kaluwore gi ranyisi magi kod koko no, paro chanda ni nyalo bedo ni iyudo tuo mar obo molandre. Ma inyalo kel gi riyo kama nitie buru, iro, kata gigo mamoko manyalo kelo chilo e muya kama itiye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Kim: Chronic lung disease? Is that serious? Will it affect the baby?
entries.translation: Migosi Kim: Tuo mar obo molandre? Orach kamano? Obiro landore kuom nyathi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Kim: So what do we do now?
entries.translation: Migosi Kim: Koro watim ang'o sani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Kim: Thank you, doctor. We appreciate your help.
entries.translation: Migosi Kim: Erokamano, laktar. Wamor gi kony mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Khumalo: You're welcome. We'll do everything we can to get you feeling better and ensure a healthy pregnancy for both of you.
entries.translation: Laktar Khumalo: Arwaki. Wabiro timo duto ma wanyalo mondo iwinj maber kendo wabiro neno ni ich obedo maber ne un duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hi Dr. Wanjala,
entries.translation: Ber Laktar Wanjala,
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Given her symptoms and family history, I thought it would be best to discuss her case with you. She's eager to get some answers and reassurance. What would you recommend as the next steps for her evaluation?
entries.translation: Kaluwore gi ranyisi mage kod chal mar tuoche e anywola margi, ne aparo ni ber ka awuoyo kodi e wi wachne. Odwaro yudo dwoko moko kod kony. Ang’o ma diyal ne kaka okang’ ma luwo ne nonro mare?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Medical Student (Sofia Rossi): Good morning, Mr. Adebayo. My name is Sofia Rossi, and I'm a medical student working with Dr. Lee. How are you feeling today?
entries.translation: Japuonjre thieth (Sofia Rossi): Oyaore, Migosi Adebayo. Nyinga en Sofia Rossi, to an japuonjre thieth matiyo gi Laktar Lee. Iwinjo nade kawuono?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adebayo: I'm cold. And my hair is falling out. That's why I'm here.
entries.translation: Migosi Adebayo: Awinjo koyo. Kendo yier chot. Mano e momiyo antiere ka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sofia: I see. We can certainly address both of those concerns. Could you tell me a bit more about when the shivering started?
entries.translation: Sofia: Awinjo. Wanyalo nono weche ariyogo. Bende inyalo wachana ni tetni nochako kar ang'o?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adebayo: It started a few days after the surgery. Just like the hair loss. You doctors always say everything is normal, but something is wrong.
entries.translation: Migosi Adebayo: Ne ochakore ndalo manok bang' ka ne oseyang'a. Mana kaka yiega machot go. Un lakteche uwachoga ni weche duto beyo, to nitie gimoro marach.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sofia: I understand your frustration, Mr. Adebayo. It's completely valid to feel concerned when you experience unexpected symptoms after surgery. Can you tell me more about what makes you feel like something is wrong?
entries.translation: Sofia: Awinjo gima omiyo chunyi nyosore, Migosi Adebayo. En gima owinjore mondo ibed gi kibaji kiyudo ranyisi maok ne ipar  ni inyalo yudo bang' yeng'o. Bende inyalo wachona maler gima omiyo iwinjo kagima gimoro rach?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adebayo: My cousin back home, he had surgery too. The doctors said he was fine, but then he got sick. Really sick. They didn't listen to him.
entries.translation: Migosi Adebayo: Owadwa ma dala, bende ne oyang'. Laktar nowacho ni en maber, to bang'e nobedo matuo. Matuo ahinya. Ne ok giwinje.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adebayo: You say that, but will you really listen? Or will you just tell me it's normal and send me away?
entries.translation: Migosi Adebayo: Iwacho kamano, to bende ibiro winja adier? Koso ibiro wacho ni weche dhi maber aeto iriemba adhi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sofia: I promise I will listen. And I won't dismiss your concerns. Let's start by checking your vitals and examining your surgical site. Then we can talk more about the hair loss and shivering. Is that okay with you?
entries.translation: Sofia: Asingora ni abiro winji. Kendo ok abi jwang'o wechegi. We wachak gi pimo gik mochuno kendo nono kama ne oyang'. Bang'e wanyalo wuoyo matut kuom yier lwar kod tetni. Mano ber kodi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adebayo: Okay. But if you don't find anything, don't just tell me it's in my head.
entries.translation: Migosi Adebayo: Ber. To ka ok iyudo gimoro amora, kik iwachna ni en mana paro e wiya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sofia: I won't. We'll keep investigating until we have answers. Now, let's get you warmed up with a blanket while we talk.
entries.translation: Sofia: Ok abi wacho kamano. Wabiro dhi nyime gi nonro nyaka wayud duoko. Koro, we wamiyi onget mondo omiyi liet sama wawuoyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: Good morning, Mrs. Chen. I see you're here about some neck pain. I'm sorry to hear that's bothering you. Can you tell me a little more about what's been going on?
entries.translation: Jafamasi: Oyawre, Mikayi Chen. Aneno ka ibiro kuom rem mar ng'ut. Agoyo mos ni gino chandi. Bende inyalo lera matin gima osebedo ka timore?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Chen: Good morning. Yes, it started a few days ago. Just a dull ache at first, but it's gotten worse. Especially when I turn my head.
entries.translation: Mikayi Chen: Oyawre. Ee, nochako ndalo manok mokalo. Ne en mana rem matin mokwongo, to koro omedore. Ahinya ahinya ka aloko wiya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: I understand. That sounds uncomfortable. Have you tried anything for it so far?
entries.translation: Jafamasi: Awinjo. Mano nenore ka gima chendo. Bende isetemo gimoro amora kuome nyaka sani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Chen: Just some heat patches, but they haven't really helped much.
entries.translation: Mikayi Chen: Mana keto gik maliet , kata kamano pok gikonyo ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: Okay. Do you have any other medical conditions or are you taking any other medications currently?
entries.translation: Jafamasi: Kare. Bende in gi tuoche mamoko kata imuonyo yedhe mamoko sani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Chen: No, just some vitamins.
entries.translation: Mikayi Chen: Ooyo, mana vitamin moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Chen: Sure, that would be great.
entries.translation: Mikayi Chen: Ee, mano dibed maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: Okay. I'd recommend taking [specific medication and dosage] as needed for pain. Be sure to follow the instructions on the label carefully. If the pain persists or gets worse, please let your doctor know.
entries.translation: Jafamasi: Kare. Anyalo jiwo ni itigi [yath ma sie kod dos mare] kaka dwarore ne rem. Nen ni iluwo chik manie kore malong'o. Ka rem osiko kata omedore, yie inyis laktar mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Chen: Thank you so much. I appreciate your help.
entries.translation: Mikayi Chen: Erokamano ahinya. Amor gi kony mari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: You're welcome, Mrs. Chen. I hope you feel better soon.
entries.translation: Jafamasi: Orwaki, Mikayi Chen. Ageno ni ibiro winjo maber machiegni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Surgeon: Hello, Mr. Hoang. I'm Dr. Saputra. Please, have a seat. How can I help you today?
entries.translation: Laktar Majayang': Nang'o, Migosi Hoang. An Laktar Saputra. Yie ibed piny. Anyalo konyi nade kawuono?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Long Hoang: Hi, Dr. Saputra. My wrist has been bothering me for months. It's this dull ache right here, especially when I grip things or bend my wrist back.
entries.translation: Long Hoang: Nang'o, Laktar Saputra. Ng'ut lweta osebedo kachanda kwom dweche. En rem matin kae, ahinya ahinya ka amako gimoro kata ka adolo ng'ut lweta kadok chien.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Surgeon: I see. Can you tell me more about when this pain started?
entries.translation: Laktar Majayang': Awinjo. Inyalo nyisa maler chieng' mane remno nochakore?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Busisiwe: It started a few months ago, maybe four or five. I play tennis a lot, and I think I might have overdone it one day. Since then, it's just been this constant nagging pain.
entries.translation: Busisiwe: Nochakore dweche matin mokalo, nyalo bedo ang'wen kata abich. Atugo tenis ahinya, kendo aparo ni nyalore ni ne atuge mokalo tong' chieng' moro. Chakre chieng'no, osebedo ka en rem mapek mosiko.
