entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Surgeon: Okay. Have you tried any treatments or medications so far?
entries.translation: Laktar Majayang': Kare. Bende isetemo thieth kata yath moro amora nyaka sani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Busisiwe: Just some ice and ibuprofen, but it doesn't seem to do much.
entries.translation: Busisiwe: Baraf kende gi ibuprofen, to nenore ka ok gitim gima duong'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Surgeon: Alright. I'd like to examine your wrist if that's okay.
entries.translation: Laktar Majayang': Kare. Daher nono ng'ut lweti ka iyie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Busisiwe: Sure.
entries.translation: Busisiwe: Ayie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Surgeon: (Examines Busisiwe's wrist) Does it hurt when I press here?
entries.translation: Laktar Majayang': (Nono ng'ut lwet Busisiwe) Bende olit ka adiyo ka?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Busisiwe: Yeah, a little.
entries.translation: Busisiwe: Ee, matin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Surgeon: How about here?
entries.translation: Laktar Majayang': To ka?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Busisiwe: Ouch! That's the spot.
entries.translation: Busisiwe: Ayi! Kanyo ema remo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Surgeon: Okay. And when I move your wrist like this?
entries.translation: Laktar Majayang': Kare. To ka asudo ng'ut lweti kama?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Busisiwe: Yeah, that definitely hurts.
entries.translation: Busisiwe: Ee, mano remo adier.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Surgeon: Based on your symptoms and my examination, it seems like you might have a tear in the triangular fibrocartilage complex, or TFCC. It's a cartilage structure in the wrist that helps stabilize the joint.
entries.translation: Laktar Majayang': Kaluwore gi ranyisi mag tuoni kod nono mara, nenore ni nyalo bedo ni triangular fibrocartilage complex kata TFCC mari oyiech. En chogo manie ng'ut lwedo ma konyo siro fuoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Busisiwe: Is that serious?
entries.translation: Busisiwe: Bende mano rach?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Busisiwe: Surgery sounds scary.
entries.translation: Busisiwe: Yang'o to awinjo ka buoga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Surgeon: I understand your concern. Surgery is always a last resort. But if the pain persists and affects your daily activities, it might be the best way to get you back to playing tennis pain-free.
entries.translation: Laktar majayang': Awinjo paroni. Yeng'o en yiero ma itimo giko. To ka remno odhi nyime kendo ochando tije ma itimo pile, to onyalo bedo yo maber mar duoki e tugo tenis ma onge rem.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Busisiwe: Okay. What do you recommend we do first?
entries.translation: Busisiwe: Kare. Idwaro ni watim ang'o mokwongo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Busisiwe: That sounds like a plan.
entries.translation: Busisiwe: Mano nenore ka paro maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Surgeon: Great. I'll write you a prescription for the splint and refer you to a physical therapist. Let's schedule a follow-up appointment in four weeks to see how you're doing.
entries.translation: Laktar Majayang': Ber. Abiro ndikoni mondo omiyi gimoro matek mar tweyo lwedo kendo aori ir jatim orako mar thieth. Waket chenro mar romo kendo bang' jumbe ang'wen mondo wane kaka idhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Busisiwe: Okay, sounds good. Thank you, Dr. Saputra.
entries.translation: Busisiwe: O, mano ber. Erokamano, Laktar Saputra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Surgeon: You're welcome, Mr. Hoang. Feel better soon.
entries.translation: Laktar Majayang': Arwaki, Migosi Hoang. Chang mapiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here is a set of patient-friendly instructions for your care at home:
entries.translation: Magi e chike mayot ne jatuo luwo ma inyalo luwo ka intie e dala:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dear Yaa Boakye,
entries.translation: Moher Yaa Boakye,
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thank you for seeing me today about your skin concerns. I understand you are experiencing rough patches of skin and need a doctor's note for work. Based on my examination, I recommend the following care plan:
entries.translation: Erokamano kuom nena kawuono kuom chandruok mar pien dendi ma in go. Ang'eyo ni in kod kuonde ma gwargwar kendo idwaro barua mar laktar ma konyi e tich. Kaluwore gi nonro ma asetimo, anyalo nyisi kaka inyalo ritori:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have provided you with a doctor's note excusing you from work for the next two days to allow your skin to heal. Please follow up with me in one week if your symptoms persist or worsen.
entries.translation: Asemiyi barua mar laktar ma miyi thuolo mar koso dhi e tich kuom odiechienge ariyo mabiro mondo dendi oyud thuolo mar chango. Yie itudri koda bang' juma achiel ka ranyisi podi nitie kata omedore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ivan Kuznetsov
entries.translation: Laktar Ivan Kuznetsov
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient Description:
entries.translation: Weche matut e wi Jatuo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Good morning, Mr. Fall. I'm Dr. Kamau. I see you're here today because of constipation. How long has this been going on?
entries.translation: Laktar: Oyawre, Migosi Fall. An Laktar Kamau. Aneno ni ibiro kawuono nikech dhi oko tek. Wachni osetimore kinde maromo nade?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Fall: Oh, a few weeks, maybe. It's nothing really. Just getting older, I suppose.
entries.translation: Migosi Fall: Ooh, nyalo bedo jumbe matin. Ok en gima lich. Amedo mana bedo ma oti, aparo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Fall: Well, maybe a little less hungry than usual. And tired, yes. But like I said, just getting older.
entries.translation: Migosi Fall: Ee, nyalo bedo ni kech ne ok chanda ahinya. Kendo ne aol, ee. Kata kamano kaka ne awacho, amedo mana ti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: It's completely normal to feel tired as we age, but sudden changes can sometimes be significant. And changes in appetite can also be related. Have you been feeling any pain or discomfort in your abdomen?
entries.translation: Laktar: En gima timore pile ni wamedo bedo ma ool kawati, kata kamano lokruok mapiya nyalo bedo gima rach. Kendo lokruok e chiemo bende nyalo bedo ni otudre kode. Isebedo kiwinjo rem koso marach e iyi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Fall: A little bit, sometimes. Nothing major.
entries.translation: Migosi Fall: Matin, seche moko. Ok en gima lich ahinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Fall: (Hesitates) Well... I did notice a little blood in the toilet the other day. But it was just once. Probably nothing.
entries.translation: Migosi Fall: (Ka odiko) Ee... Ne aneno remo matin e choo nyocha. Kata kamano ne en dichiel kende. Nyalo bedo ni ok en gimoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Fall: I suppose so. I just don't want to make a big fuss over nothing.
entries.translation: Migosi Fall: Anyalo yie. En mana ni ok adwar loko gima tin onen ka gima lich.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: It's not making a fuss, it's taking care of your health. And it's much better to check and find nothing than to ignore something that could be treated. We'll take this one step at a time, okay?
entries.translation: Laktar: Ok en loko gima tin onen gima lich, en rito ngima. Kendo ber ahinya pimo aeto iyud ni onge gimoro moloyo weyo fwenyo gima ne inyalo thiedh. Wabiro timo mae mosmos, kare?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Fall: Okay, doctor. Thank you.
entries.translation: Migosi Fall: Kare, laktar. Erokamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Eke: Good afternoon, Marcus. I see you were injured at work. Can you tell me a bit about what happened?
entries.translation: Laktar Eke: Oimore, Marcus. Aneno ni ne ihinyori e tich. Inyalo nyisa matin gima ne otimore?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Eke: I understand. Let's take a look at that ankle first. Does it hurt when I press here?
entries.translation: Laktar Eke: Awinjo. We warang ombong' tiendi mokwongo. Be olit ka adiyo ka?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Marcus: Ouch! Yeah, that hurts.
entries.translation: Marcus: Aiii! Ee, mano lit.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Eke: Okay, it looks a bit swollen. We'll get an X-ray to make sure nothing's broken. Now, about your chest pain. You mentioned it hurts when you breathe deep. Have you had any shortness of breath or coughing?
entries.translation: Laktar Eke: Kare, oneno ka ma okuot matin. Wabiro goye picha mar X-ray mondo wane ni onge gima otur. Koro, ewi rem mar kor. Ne iwacho ni oremo sama iyueyo matut. Bende isebedo ka muchi rumo kata isebedo ka ifuolo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Marcus: Yeah, a little bit. Mostly just when I move around too much or try to lift anything.
entries.translation: Marcus: Ee, matin. Ahinya ahinya sama awuotho ahinya kata atemo ting'o gimoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Eke: I see. Given your history, I'm concerned about the possibility of emphysema, especially with the chest pain and shortness of breath. We'll need to run some tests to check your lung function.
entries.translation: Laktar Eke: Awinjo. Kaluwore gi sigandi, an gi luoro nyalo bet ni en tuo mar emphysema, to moloyo nikech rem mar kor kod yueyo machuok. Nyaka wapim mondo wane kaka obo tiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Marcus: Emphysema? Isn't that something old people get?
entries.translation: Laktar: Emphysema? Donge mano en gima jomaoti ema yudo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Marcus: Thanks, doc. I appreciate it.
entries.translation: Marcus: Erokamano, Laktar. Aduoko erokamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Eke: You're welcome, Marcus. Take care.
entries.translation: Laktar Eke: Orwaki, Marcus. Ritri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient ID 734: So, doc, what's the verdict? Did the booster shot do its thing? My wife here has been worrying herself sick about it.
entries.translation: Jatuo ma Namba mare en 734: Koro, laktar, duoko en mane? Bende sindan mar siro chanjo no notimo tije? Chiega kae paro osechando ahinya nikech wachni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spouse: Oh thank goodness! I was so worried. With all the travel he does for competitions, I just want to make sure he's protected.
entries.translation: Chi Jatuo: Erokamano Nyasaye! Ne an gi kibaji ahinya. Gi wouth te ma odhie nikech piem, adwaro mana neno ni obedo ma oritore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient ID 734: See, honey? Told you not to worry. My immune system is tough as nails.
entries.translation: Jatuo ma Namba mare en 734: Ineno, jahera? Nene awachoni ni kik ibed gi kibaji. Chenro mar denda mar kedo gi tuo otegno ahinya ka musumal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: It certainly seems that way. Of course, we'll continue to monitor your levels over time, but for now, everything looks great. You're cleared for your upcoming competitions.
entries.translation: Laktar: Nenore kamano adier. to gadiera, wabiro dhi nyime gi ng'iyo rom gi e dendi kaka kinde sudo, kata kamano, gie sani, gikmoko te neno maber. Omiyi thuolo mar dhi e piem mabiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spouse: That's wonderful news! Thank you so much, Doctor.
entries.translation: Chi Jatuo: Ma en wach maber ahinya! Erokamano ahinya, Laktar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient ID 734: Yeah, thanks, doc. Appreciate it. Guess I'll be hitting the gym extra hard to celebrate!
entries.translation: Jatuo ma Namba mare en 734: Ee, erokamano, laktar. Aduoko erokamano. Abiro dhi timo orako matek e jim mondo aduok erokamano!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dear Ms. Emily Anderson,
entries.translation: Moher Emily Anderson,
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 1. Maintain patient confidentiality: Always protect your patients' privacy and only share information with authorized individuals.
entries.translation: 1. Rit maber wache maling'ling mar jatuo: Seche duto rit weche maling'ling' mag jatuo maok iwuoyo gi ng'ato ang'ata mak mana joma nigi thuolo mar ng'eyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. Communicate effectively: Be clear, concise, and respectful in your communication with patients, families, and colleagues.
entries.translation: 2. Wuo maber: Wuo e yo maler, machuok, kendo gi luor kiwuoyo gi jotuo, joodgi, kod jotich weteni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. Be honest and ethical: Always act with integrity and honesty, even when it's difficult.
entries.translation: 3. Wach adiera kendo luw chike: Tim giki gi adiera kendo kiluwo chike, kata ka tek.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Be respectful of others: Treat everyone with dignity and respect, regardless of their background or beliefs.
entries.translation: 4. Bed gi luor kuom jomoko: Wuo gi ji duto gi luor, ma ok odewo kama giaye kata yie margi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. Be accountable for your actions: Take responsibility for your mistakes and learn from them.
entries.translation: 5. Bed jal makao ting' mar gikma otimo: Kitimo gikmaricho to yie aeto ipuonjri kuomgi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 6. Continuously learn and improve: Stay up-to-date on the latest medical knowledge and practices.
entries.translation: 6. Puonjri kendo med lony pile: Bed malony kendo puonjri weche kod yore manyien mag thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 7. Seek support when needed: Don't be afraid to ask for help from colleagues or mentors.
entries.translation: 7. Many kony ka idwaro: Kik iluor kwayo kony kuom jotich weteni kata joma puonji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 8. Maintain appropriate boundaries: Establish clear boundaries with patients and colleagues to ensure professionalism.
entries.translation: 8. Ket tong' mowinjore e kindi gi jomoko: Ket tong' mowinjore e kindi gi jotuo kod jotich weteni mondo itim tich kajalony.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 9. Be a role model: Set a positive example for others in the medical field.
entries.translation: 9. Bed ranyisi maber: Ket ranyisi maber ne jomoko e tich mar thieth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 10. Remember the importance of self-care: Take care of your own physical and mental health so you can provide the best possible care to your patients.
entries.translation: 10. Ng'e ber mar rito ngima mari: Rit ngima mari mar del kod obuongo mondo irit jotuo maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your Care Team
entries.translation: Jorit ngima mari
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: Hello, Mr. Gomis. I'm Chutima, the pharmacist. I understand you're here for your medications related to your upcoming colonoscopy.
entries.translation: Jafamasi: Osawore, Migosi Gomis. An Chutima, jafamasi. Awinjo ni in ka nikech yedhe motudre gi kolonoskopi mari mabiro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Gomis: Yeah, I guess so. My wife, Martha, insisted I come. Honestly, I'd rather just ignore the whole thing.
entries.translation: Migosi Gomis: Eee, aparo kamano. Chiega, Martha, nochuna ni abi. Adier, daher ka aweyo wachno duto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Gomis: It's just... embarrassing, you know? And being in this wheelchair makes everything more complicated. Plus, I don't see why I need to go through all this hassle for some little polyps.
entries.translation: Migosi Gomis: En mana... wichkuot, ing'eyo? Kendo bedo e wilcheya ni miyo gikmoko bedo matek. E wi mano, ok ane gima omiyo  dwarore ni akadh e chandruogni duto nikech polyps matindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Gomis: I suppose that makes sense. But what about the prep? I've heard horror stories about the laxatives.
entries.translation: Migosi Gomis: Aparo ni mano winjore. To nade kuom ikruok? Asewinjo sigendni malich ewi yedhe mamiyo oko bedo mareprep.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Gomis: Alright, I guess I can manage. Martha won't let me hear the end of it if I back out now anyway.
entries.translation: Migosi Gomis: Kare, aparo ni anyalo timo mano. Martha ok bi weya aywe ka aweyo sani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Gomis: Thanks, Chutima. I appreciate it. Maybe it won't be as bad as I thought.
entries.translation: Migosi Gomis: Erokamano, Chutima. Amor kode. Samoro ok obi bedo marach kaka naparo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: You're welcome, Mr. Gomis. I'm glad we could chat. Let's get those medications sorted out for you, shall we?
entries.translation: Jafamasi: Orwaki, Migosi Gomis. Amor ni ne wanyalo wuoyo. We wamiyi yedhego, koso?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hey Coach Miller,
entries.translation: Nang'o Koch Miller,

entries.english: Nurse: Hello, this is Nurse Wilson with the telehealth service. How can I help you today?
entries.translation: Nas: Halo, mae en Nas Wilson ma tiyo kod telehealth service. Anyalo konyi nade kawuono?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Hi, my name is Peter Njoroge. I'm calling because my doctor recommended a double-balloon enteroscopy, and I have a few questions about the procedure.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Amosi, nyinga en Peter Njoroge. Agoyo simu nikech laktar  mara ong'ado ni odwaro ni otimna double-balloon enteroscopy, kendo an kod penjo moko ewi chenro no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Okay, Mr. Njoroge. I can certainly help you with that. But first, could you tell me a little bit about your medical history? I see here you have a few conditions listed.
entries.translation: Nas: Kare, Migosi Njoroge. Anyalo konyi e wechego. Kata kamano mokwongo, bende inyalo nyisa matin ewi thieth mari chakre chon? Aneno ka in gi tuoche moko mondiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Sure. I have high blood pressure, diabetes, and I had a heart attack about five years ago. I'm also on blood thinners for a previous clot.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Ee. An kod tuo mar Presa mamalo mar remo, tuo sukar, kendo ne ayudo tuo mar adundo maweyo gwecho higni abich mokalo. Kendo atiyogi yath ma miyo remo bedo mareprep nikech remba nopoto ndalo moko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: I see. That's helpful to know. Given your history, there are a few things we need to consider before scheduling the enteroscopy. Are you currently experiencing any symptoms like abdominal pain or bleeding?
entries.translation: Nas: Aneno. Mano ber ng'eyo. Kaluwore kod weche thieth mari machon, nitiere weche moko monego wapar kapok wachano mondo iyud enteroscopy. Bende sani ineno ranyisi moko kaka ich maremo kata wuok remo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Yes, I've had some stomach pain and dark stools lately. That's why my doctor suggested the test.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Ee, iya osebedo karama kendo oko mara tinde rateng'. Mano emomiyo laktar mara oparo ni otimna pim no.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: That makes sense. Will I need to stay in the hospital after the enteroscopy?
entries.translation: Jatuo: Mano winjore. Bende biro dwarore ni abed e osiptal bang' enteroscopy?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: It depends on how the procedure goes and if any interventions are needed. Since you have some underlying health conditions, we might want to keep you for observation for a bit longer than usual, just to be safe.
entries.translation: Nas: Mano luwore kod kaka chenro odhi kendo ka dwarore ni otim gimoro amora. Nikech in kod tuoche moko, wanyalo dwaro ni warangi mondo wariti kuom kinde mabor moloyo kaka  pile, mana mondo manen ni in maber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I understand. Is there anything else I need to do to prepare?
entries.translation: Jatuo: Awinjo. Bende nitie gimoro amora monego atim mondo aikra?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Yes, you'll need to follow a specific diet and bowel preparation instructions before the procedure. We'll send you detailed information about that. Do you have any other questions for me right now?
entries.translation: Nas: Ee, biro dwarore mondo icham chiemo moro masie kod iko wach mar dhi oko kapok otimni chenro no. Wabiro oroni weche momedore ewi mano. Bende in kod penjo moro amora ma idwa penja sani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: No, I think that covers it for now. Thank you for explaining everything.
entries.translation: Jatuo: Ooyo, aparo ni mano oromo koro. Erokamano kuom lero weche te.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_luo, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: You're welcome, Mr. Njoroge. We'll be in touch soon to schedule your appointment and go over the preparation details. Have a good day.
entries.translation: Nas: Arwaki, Migosi Njoroge. Wabiro tudore kodi machiegni mondo waketi e laini mar neno laktar kendo wapim weche mag ikruok. Bed kod odiechieng' maber.
